en.description: Diffuse pattern: activation occurs in code and technical text, medical terminology, investment promotions, news release opinions, meeting narratives, and private emails. Raw/text or data processing recurs in technical passages, but does not explain all passages.

patterns.name: path in code identifiers
patterns.context: The path identifier recurs in Python-style code, near function calls and assignment expressions.

patterns.name: Entity-tracking terminology
patterns.context: Project template documentation about entities, change-tracking sets, and attribute states; activation is distributed across proper names and tracking terms.

patterns.name: Medical term antiangiogenic
patterns.context: The phrase antiangiogenic effect in a medical paper title triggers activation across a technical term.

patterns.name: Investment email promotion
patterns.context: Tells the recipient they previously requested investment ideas, followed by email marketing source information.

patterns.name: Voting and press release
patterns.context: Addresses Karen and expresses support for releasing a press release.

patterns.name: Automated sending of raw text
patterns.context: Explains how a script handles key semantics when sending text, and sends raw text through a parameter.

patterns.name: One-on-one meetings after a meeting
patterns.context: Describes meeting people from the Baltimore/Washington area one-on-one; the sentence is incomplete.

patterns.name: Storage architecture and raw data
patterns.context: Discusses storage arrays, data transfer between host servers, and ILM infrastructure services.

patterns.name: URL decoding
patterns.context: Answers how to handle percent-encoded data, recommending a call to rawurldecode; activation spans the function-name boundary.

patterns.name: Private travel email
patterns.context: Opens an email to an acquaintance, asking about or following up on flight arrangements.

7_78.description: 模式分散：代码与技术文本、医学术语、投资宣传、新闻稿意见、会面叙述及私人邮件均有激活。技术段中 raw/text 或数据处理反复出现，但不足以解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 path
patterns.context: Python 风格代码中反复出现 path 标识符，且位于函数调用和赋值表达式附近。

patterns.name: 实体追踪术语
patterns.context: 关于实体、变更追踪集合及属性状态的项目模板说明；激活分布在专名和追踪术语上。

patterns.name: 医学术语 antiangiogenic
patterns.context: 医学论文题目中的 antiangiogenic effect，触发词横跨一个专业术语。

patterns.name: 投资邮件宣传语
patterns.context: 告知收件人其曾请求投资点子，随后出现邮件营销来源信息。

patterns.name: 投票与发布新闻稿
patterns.context: 称呼 Karen，并表达投票支持发出新闻稿。

patterns.name: 自动化发送原始文本
patterns.context: 说明脚本发送文本时如何处理按键语义，并通过参数发送原始文本。

patterns.name: 会后逐一会面
patterns.context: 叙述与巴尔的摩/华盛顿地区的人士逐一会面；句子未完。

patterns.name: 存储架构与原始数据
patterns.context: 讨论存储数组、主机服务器间的数据传递及 ILM 基础服务。

patterns.name: URL 解码
patterns.context: 回答如何处理 percent-encoded 数据，建议调用 rawurldecode；激活跨函数名边界。

patterns.name: 私人行程邮件
patterns.context: 熟人邮件开头，询问或跟进航班安排。

en.description: Activation often falls on proper names, terms, or title fragments split by tokenization; it also appears with whitespace and uppercase titles in court documents, and voting or investment-promotion language in two email types. The examples lack a stable, consistent trigger token.

patterns.name: Fragmented strings in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls within proper names or terms split into multiple subword tokens, often when a name is followed by a line break or continuing text; the precise trigger position varies across examples.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, medical abstracts, German text, and web content

patterns.name: Typesetting whitespace and headings in legal documents
patterns.context: Large blocks of whitespace and line breaks appear alongside uppercase legal headings.

patterns.name: Voting and email phrases
patterns.context: A first-person email expresses support for an action; activation is concentrated on a name and several tokens in the phrase.

patterns.name: Investment-promotion email wording
patterns.context: Notifies the recipient that they subscribed to investment advice; includes a URL or marketing-email context.

7_78.description: 激活多落在分词后的专名、术语或标题片段，另见法院文书空白与大写标题，以及两类邮件中的投票、投资推广用语；各例缺少稳定一致的触发 token。

patterns.name: 专名中的片段化字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在被分成多个子词 token 的专名或术语内部，常在名称后换行或继续文本时出现；不同例子中具体触发位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、德语文本及网页内容

patterns.name: 法律文书中的排版空白与标题
patterns.context: 大段空格、换行及大写法律标题相邻出现。

patterns.name: 投票及邮件短语
patterns.context: 第一人称邮件中表达投票支持某项行动；激活集中于人名和短语中若干 token。

patterns.name: 投资推广邮件词语
patterns.context: 通知收件人其订阅了投资建议，包含网址或营销邮件语境。

en.description: Covers numbers, operators, and instructions in math problems, as well as several unrelated text topics: brain-computer interfaces, software signatures, Myanmar history, travel emails, music albums, and immunoassays. Activation cues are diffuse, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Math problems dense with numbers and symbols
patterns.context: Variables, integers, operators, and instructions interleave in math exercises or problems; activation is scattered across numbers and problem wording.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, algebra and arithmetic problems

patterns.name: Multiword term in a title
patterns.context: A title-like phrase at the start of an abstract continuously describes a type of system or model; especially strong on “interface”.

patterns.name: Signatures and software packages
patterns.context: Technical text discusses obtaining and comparing Java package signatures; also includes paths and function parameters.

patterns.name: Myanmar organizational history and names
patterns.context: Historical narrative includes Myanmar place names, personal names, and information about an organization’s founding.

patterns.name: Travel booking confirmation email
patterns.context: Email thanks the recipient for booking travel and introduces a copy of the booking.

patterns.name: Album titles and lyric descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces an album, track titles, or lyrics; parentheses in titles and within-word fragments show strong activation.

patterns.name: Immunocomplex assay terminology
patterns.context: Describes precipitation of immunocomplexes in patient serum samples, ELISA testing, and immunoglobulin monitoring.

7_78.description: 覆盖了数学题中的数字、运算符和指令，也覆盖数个彼此不同的文本主题：脑机接口、软件签名、缅甸史、旅行邮件、音乐专辑和免疫检测。激活线索分散，未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 数值与符号密集的数学题
patterns.context: 数学练习或题目中，变量、整数、运算符和指令交错出现；激活散布在数字及题目用语上。

patterns.name: 多词术语标题
patterns.context: 摘要开头的标题式短语，连续描述某类系统或模型；对“interface”尤其强。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，脑机接口研究

patterns.name: 签名与软件包
patterns.context: 技术说明讨论 Java 包签名的获取与比较；也包括路径和函数参数。

patterns.name: 缅甸组织史与人名
patterns.context: 历史叙述中出现缅甸地名、人物名及组织成立信息。

patterns.name: 旅行预订确认邮件
patterns.context: 邮件感谢收件人预订旅行，并引出预订副本。

patterns.name: 专辑标题与歌词描述
patterns.context: 介绍专辑、曲目标题或歌词；标题的括号及词内片段有较强激活。

patterns.name: 免疫复合物检测术语
patterns.context: 描述患者血清样本中免疫复合物的沉淀、ELISA 检测及免疫球蛋白监测。

en.concept: Subword fragments and proper names/technical terms
en.description: Activation is distributed across word-initial T and proper-name fragments, within-word French segmentation, Emoji/platform terms, programming terminology, biomedical words, and numerical math text; it spans domains with no single stable semantic or contextual condition.

patterns.name: Words beginning with uppercase T and following subword fragments
patterns.context: T appears at the beginning of a word followed by several subword tokens; it sometimes continues into a proper name or word. These examples alone do not establish whether a specific position or part of speech is required
patterns.domain: News headlines, encyclopedia article titles, sports coverage, and other mixed text

patterns.name: Within-word segmentation in French forms
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple subword tokens in French medical case reports or formal policy text; activation appears on some word fragments
patterns.domain: French medical papers, EU policy text

patterns.name: Discussion of Emoji and platform implementation
patterns.context: Discusses how WhatsApp, iOS, and Android handle or copy Emoji libraries

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Immune system, antigen, and biomolecule terminology appears in patent background text

patterns.name: Programming language names and technical terms
patterns.context: Discusses programming skills for job applications, website JavaScript dependencies, or no-script compatibility; related terms appear with different tokenizations

patterns.name: Number sequences and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Digit strings, arithmetic expressions, and sequence problems interleave; insufficient evidence to infer a specific trigger rule

patterns.name: Other within-word segmentation in news headlines
patterns.context: A news headline about Enron acquiring a power plant includes a tokenized fragment of the place name Dabhol

7_78.concept: 分词片段与专名/技术词
7_78.description: 激活分布在词首T及专名片段、法语词内切分、Emoji/平台词、编程术语、生物医学词和数字数学文本；跨领域且未见单一稳定语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 大小写T开头的词及其后续子词片段
patterns.context: T作为词首后接若干子词token；有时延续成专名或词语。仅凭这些例子无法确认是否要求特定位置或词类
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、百科条目标题、体育报道及其他混合文本

patterns.name: 词内切分的法语词形
patterns.context: 法语医学病例或正式政策文本中，词被分成多个子词token；激活出现在部分词片段上
patterns.domain: 法语医学论文、欧盟政策文本

patterns.name: Emoji及其平台实现讨论
patterns.context: 讨论WhatsApp、iOS、Android如何处理或复制Emoji库

patterns.name: 生物医学术语及词内片段
patterns.context: 免疫系统、抗原及生物分子术语出现在专利背景说明中

patterns.name: 编程语言名称及技术词
patterns.context: 讨论求职编程技能、网站JavaScript依赖或无脚本兼容；相关词以不同分词方式出现

patterns.name: 数字序列与数学表达式
patterns.context: 数字串、算术表达式和序列问题交错出现；缺少足够证据判断具体触发规则

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的其他词内切分
patterns.context: Enron收购电厂的新闻标题，出现地名Dabhol的分词片段

en.description: Responds to both question stems and numerical answers in DM Mathematics problems, covering arithmetic in different bases, least common multiples, factors and divisibility, prime/composite classification, algebraic extrema, and equation solving. The commonality is structured math Q&A rather than any single operation.

patterns.name: Arithmetic in different bases
patterns.context: Asks about addition or subtraction in a given base, often using multidigit numbers; activation also appears on numbers in the answers.

patterns.name: Least common multiple problems
patterns.context: Asks for the least common multiple of integers, with a numerical answer.

patterns.name: Factor, divisibility, and prime/composite classification
patterns.context: Asks whether a number is a factor, is divisible by another number, or is composite; often answered with True/False.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics number theory classification problems

patterns.name: Extremum questions in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: First gives a relation between variables or a set of candidate numbers, then asks for the smallest or second-largest value.

patterns.name: Solving for unknowns in equations
patterns.context: Provides an equation or system of equations involving variables and asks for a specified unknown; the answer may be negative.

7_78.description: 对 DM Mathematics 数学题中的题干与数字答案均有响应，覆盖进制加减、最小公倍数、因数与整除及素合数判断、代数极值和解方程；共同点是结构化的数学问答，而非某个单一运算。

patterns.name: 不同进制中的算术题
patterns.trigger: “In base”以及“what is”后跟带符号的数值和“+”或“-”
patterns.context: 询问某进制下的加减法，数值常含多位数字；激活也出现在题目答案的数字中。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的进制算术问答

patterns.name: 最小公倍数题
patterns.context: 询问整数的最小公倍数，答案为数字。

patterns.name: 因数、整除与素合数判断
patterns.context: 判断一个数是否为因数、是否整除或是否为合数；常由 True/False 作答。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的极值提问
patterns.context: 先给出变量关系或一组候选数，再询问其中最小或第二大的值。

patterns.name: 方程组求未知数
patterns.context: 给出由变量构成的方程或方程组，要求解指定未知数；答案可能是负数。

en.description: Primarily responds to the fixed wording and format of DM math problems: probabilities for drawing sequences without replacement, divisibility/factor judgments, and rounding problems; also activates on a passage of Italian prose expressing thanks.

patterns.name: Sampling without replacement probability
patterns.context: Repeatedly asks for the probability of drawing a specific sequence without replacement from a given string or set of letters, often with a numerical fraction as the answer; activation is especially concentrated on sequence and related sampling language
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, combinatorics and probability problems

patterns.name: Divisibility and factor judgments
patterns.context: Asks whether an integer is a factor or multiple of another integer, followed by True/False

patterns.name: Rounding values to the nearest thousand
patterns.context: Gives a problem based on equations or integer arithmetic and asks to round a variable or value to a specified magnitude, with an answer near the thousands

patterns.name: Italian text of thanks
patterns.context: Continuous Italian prose containing expressions of gratitude and writing; unlike the math problem types
patterns.domain: PhilPapers, Italian academic or acknowledgment text

7_78.description: 主要响应DM数学题的固定问句与格式：不放回抽取序列概率、整除/因数判断及取整题；另对一段意大利语致谢散文有激活。

patterns.name: 不放回抽样概率
patterns.context: 重复询问从给定字母串或字母集合中不放回抽取特定序列的概率，常出现数字分数答案；激活尤其集中在 sequence 及相关抽样表述

patterns.name: 整除与因数判断
patterns.context: 以问句判断一个整数是否为另一个整数的因数或倍数，随后给出 True/False

patterns.name: 数值取整到千位
patterns.context: 给出由方程或整数运算构成的题目，要求将变量或数值取整至指定数量级，并给出千位附近的答案

patterns.name: 意大利语致谢文字
patterns.context: 意大利语连续散文中包含表达感谢、写下文字等措辞；与数学题型不同
patterns.domain: PhilPapers，意大利语学术或致谢文本

en.description: Primarily sensitive to numbers and digit strings, including split identifiers, negative numbers, and fractions, often in math problems but also in patent numbers and virus classifications. Activation also appears on code identifiers and template-field fragments, so it cannot be reduced entirely to a numerical pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers, integers, and numeric fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within integers, digit strings, or signed/fractional values; some digit strings are split across multiple tokens, and the pattern is not limited to math contexts.
patterns.domain: Math problems, patent numbers, virology literature, and code discussions

patterns.name: Math Q&A and classification format
patterns.context: Problems ask to continue a sequence, classify a number as prime/composite, solve an equation, or compare values; numbers near these phrases also activate.

patterns.name: Patent citation numbers
patterns.context: Digit fragments activate in series numbers for Japanese patent publications.

patterns.name: Numbers in virus names
patterns.context: Rotavirus classification names contain combinations of numbers and letters; other pathogen names also appear in the same passage.

patterns.name: Code and technical identifiers
patterns.context: Activation appears near code identifiers, property names, or template fields; number triggers in the same passage may share the main pattern.

7_78.description: 主要对数字及数字串（含被拆分的编号、负数和分数）敏感，常见于数学题，也见专利号和病毒分型；另有代码标识符、模板字段等词片段激活，不能完全归入数字模式。

patterns.name: 数字、整数与数值片段
patterns.context: 激活落在整数、数字串或带符号/分数的数值内部；部分数字串被分成多个 token，且不限于数学语境。
patterns.domain: 数学题、专利编号、病毒学文献及代码讨论

patterns.name: 数学问答与判断格式
patterns.trigger: «What is the next»、«Is»、«composite number»、«prime»、«Solve»、«Which is smaller»、«nearest to»
patterns.context: 题目要求续列、判定素数/合数、解方程或比较数值；这些短语附近也有数字激活。

patterns.name: 专利引用编号
patterns.context: 日本专利公开文献的系列编号中，数字片段被激活。

patterns.name: 病毒名称中的数字
patterns.context: 轮状病毒分型名称中出现数字与字母组合；同段还包括其他病原体名称。

patterns.name: 代码与技术标识符
patterns.context: 代码标识符、属性名或模板字段附近出现激活；同段数字触发可能与主模式相同。

en.concept: Salient word fragments and emphasis expressions
en.description: Activation mainly falls on the English fixed expressions sense, sure, and especially, and within or at the ends of Polish words (particularly fragments such as ść, ł, and ć); scattered English words such as polite explanations and suggestion also activate.

patterns.name: “sense” collocations
patterns.context: Expresses whether something is reasonable, worth doing, or has practical benefit; activation falls on sense

patterns.name: “sure” expressing certainty
patterns.context: Emphasizes inability to be fully certain about the cause in a hardware troubleshooting context; activation falls on sure

patterns.name: “especially” emphasizing diagnostic value
patterns.context: Medical discussion emphasizes the importance of a particular clue for diagnosis

patterns.name: Polish suffix “ść”
patterns.context: Within a Polish word, at the end of an abstract noun; appears in a parliamentary speech sentence

patterns.name: Polish stem/suffix fragment “zdolność”
patterns.context: A Polish abstract noun discussing the EU’s capacity; activation falls on the suffix

patterns.name: Word-internal, stress-like activation in Polish
patterns.context: In Polish text, activation falls on a single character within a word, not at the end of a sentence

patterns.name: Within-word activation in Polish
patterns.context: Activation is distributed within or at the ends of Polish words, rather than being restricted to one fixed word

patterns.name: Common word fragments in polite expressions
patterns.context: Friendly wording requesting assistance or feedback; several common words are marked, with no consistent local word-form feature

patterns.name: English “suggestion”
patterns.context: An email makes a suggestion and asks for specifics

7_78.concept: 词语显著片段与强调表达
7_78.description: 激活主要落在英文固定表达 sense、sure、especially，以及波兰语词语内部或词尾（尤以 ść、ł、ć 等片段为显著）；另有礼貌说明和 suggestion 等零散英文词。

patterns.name: “sense” 搭配
patterns.trigger: “it makes … sense” / “make(s) … sense”，其中 “sense” 激活为 10
patterns.context: 句中表达某事是否合理、值得做，或是否有实际效益；激活落在 sense

patterns.name: “sure” 强调确定性
patterns.context: 在硬件故障排查语境中强调无法完全确定原因；激活落在 sure

patterns.name: “especially” 强调诊断价值
patterns.context: 医学论述中强调某项线索对诊断的重要性

patterns.name: 波兰语词尾“ść”
patterns.context: 波兰语词形内部，位于抽象名词词尾；此处处于议会发言句中

patterns.name: 波兰语词干/词尾片段“zdolność”
patterns.context: 波兰语抽象名词，讨论欧盟的能力；激活落在词尾

patterns.name: 波兰语词语内部重音式激活
patterns.context: 波兰语文本中，激活落在词语内部的单个字符，并非句末

patterns.name: 波兰语词语内部激活
patterns.context: 激活分布于波兰语词内部或词尾；并非仅一个固定词

patterns.name: 礼貌表达中的常用词片段
patterns.context: 请求协助或反馈的友好说明；多个常见词被标记，未见统一的局部词形特征

patterns.name: 英语“suggestion”
patterns.context: 邮件中提出建议并追问具体内容

en.description: Primarily responds to the collocation “makes sense” when evaluating whether something is reasonable, including negation and different persons and domains; also responds to “load properly” in a technical title and “special” in affectionate email praise.

patterns.name: “sense” collocation expressing judgment
patterns.context: sense follows makes, often in sentences evaluating whether an action, plan, or inference is reasonable; may include negation, modality, or a person complement.
patterns.domain: Email, forum Q&A, technical discussions, general narrative

patterns.name: “load properly” in a scenario title
patterns.context: A game development Q&A title describes a Detail Scene failing to load correctly; no sense collocation appears.

patterns.name: “special” as affectionate praise
patterns.context: An intimate email directly praises the recipient, near emotional expressions such as feel, beautiful, and cherished; no sense collocation appears.

7_78.description: 主要响应评价某事是否合理的“makes sense”搭配，包含否定和不同人称、领域；另对技术标题中的“load properly”及亲密邮件赞美语中的“special”有响应。

patterns.name: “sense”搭配判断
patterns.trigger: «sense»10／«makes»9« sense»（包括 “it makes sense”“it doesn't make sense”）
patterns.context: 在 makes 后接 sense，常处于评价某个行动、方案、推断是否合理的句子中；可带否定词、情态或人称补语。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛问答、技术讨论、一般叙述

patterns.name: 场景标题中的“load properly”
patterns.context: 游戏开发问答的标题中，描述 Detail Scene 无法正常加载；不呈现 sense 搭配。

patterns.name: “special”情感赞美
patterns.context: 亲密邮件中直接赞美收信人，邻近 feel、beautiful、cherished 等情感表达；不呈现 sense 搭配。

en.description: Primarily responds to special and its emotional evaluative contexts; also activates on time words such as early and late, as well as an isolated negative statement about fights and the technical expression as such.

patterns.name: Evaluative use of special
patterns.context: Describes experiences, feelings, people, or things, often with “feel/make/so”; conveys that something is special, cherished, or distinctive.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, emotional expression, sports interviews, general web text

patterns.name: Time expressions with early
patterns.context: Modifies a time or daily activity, such as “very early one morning” and “back early Sunday”; no clear additional semantic condition.

patterns.name: Time expressions with late
patterns.context: Describes it being late or feeling late, appearing in “felt so late here” and a fatigue-related technical chat context.

patterns.name: Fighting in a negative sentence
patterns.context: A negative statement in “I dont start fights at all”; no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: such in technical terminology
patterns.context: Explains whether an implementation qualifies as a hash table, in a qualifying or reserved-judgment construction.

7_78.description: 主要响应 special 及其情感评价语境；另对 early、late 等时间词，以及孤立的 fights 否定句和技术表达 as such 有激活。

patterns.name: special 的评价用法
patterns.context: 用于形容经历、感受、人或事物，常与“feel/make/so”搭配；强调特别、珍贵或与众不同。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、情感表达、体育采访、一般网络文本

patterns.name: early 的时间表达
patterns.context: 修饰时间或日常活动，如“very early one morning”“back early Sunday”；无明显额外语义条件。

patterns.name: late 的时间表达
patterns.context: 描述时间已晚或感觉晚，分别出现在“felt so late here”和技术聊天中的疲倦语境。

patterns.name: 否定句中的打架
patterns.context: “I dont start fights at all”中的否定陈述；与主模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 技术术语中的 such
patterns.context: 解释某实现是否属于 hash table，出现在限定或保留判断的句式中。

en.description: The strongest common pattern is the modifier «special» and its emphatic, evaluative contexts, spanning texts about personal feelings, music, sports, and technology; there is also a weaker response to local evaluative expressions such as «late», «strange», and «great».

patterns.name: “special” and its emotional-evaluative contexts
patterns.context: Positively evaluates a person, experience, thing, or ability, emphasizing that it is special, precious, or unusual; sometimes includes personal feelings or commemorative significance
patterns.domain: Emails, music interviews, sports stories, technology reviews, biographical profiles

patterns.name: Being late or staying up late
patterns.context: In chat, describes feeling that it is late or having stayed awake

patterns.name: Something strange or unexpected to the senses
patterns.context: Describes the sound and feel of a ball during sports, finding the experience strange

patterns.name: Positive reaction to a plan or proposal
patterns.context: Evaluates a proposal rhetorically, then shifts to sarcasm or describes an unfavorable outcome

7_78.description: 最强共同模式是修饰语«special»及其强调、评价语境，横跨私人情感、音乐、体育、科技等文本；另对«late»、«strange»和«great»等局部评价表达有较弱响应。

patterns.name: “special”及其情感评价语境
patterns.context: 对人、经历、事物或能力作正面评价，强调特别、珍贵或不寻常；有时包含个人情感或纪念意味
patterns.domain: 邮件、音乐访谈、体育故事、科技评论、人物介绍

patterns.name: 迟、晚或熬夜的状态
patterns.context: 聊天中描述自己觉得时间很晚或一直没睡

patterns.name: 感官上的奇怪或出乎意料
patterns.context: 描述运动中球的声音和触感，认为体验奇怪

patterns.name: 对方案或提议的积极反应
patterns.context: 以反问形式评价一个提议，随后转向讽刺或讲述不佳后果

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on special (describing something as special, unique, or precious) and expressions of feelings such as feel/feeling; there are also emotional words in music reminiscences, the technical phrase such, and Feel in song titles.

patterns.name: special and degree modifiers
patterns.context: The direct trigger is special, appearing when describing a person, music, software, or experience as especially valuable or unique; degree adverbs and preceding evaluations provide semantic context.
patterns.domain: Emotional expression, music, biographical profiles, technology reviews

patterns.name: Words for feelings and emotions
patterns.context: Directly states subjective feelings or emotional states; sometimes related to intimate relationships, musical experiences, or reactions to other people's behavior.

patterns.name: Narratives about memories and music appreciation
patterns.context: Recalls listening to music and the positive feelings it brought; activation markers are scattered across words for remembering, listening, and feeling rather than concentrated on a shared special word form.

patterns.name: Analogy qualification in technical descriptions
patterns.context: Qualifies an implementation in a technical explanation; the author expresses uncertainty about whether a structure is implemented as described earlier. Not directly related to special or emotional expression.

patterns.name: Feeling phrase in a title
patterns.context: The word appears in a song title in a track listing, not as an emotional statement in the main text.

7_78.description: 激活主要集中在 special（描述事物的特别、独特或珍贵）及 feel/feeling 等感受表达；另有音乐回忆中的情绪词、技术短语 such，以及曲名中的 Feel。

patterns.name: special 及程度修饰
patterns.context: 直接触发词是 special，在描述人、音乐、软件或某件经历具有特别价值、独特性时出现；程度副词和前文评价提供语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 情感表达、音乐、人物介绍、技术评论

patterns.name: 感受与情绪词
patterns.context: 对主观感受或情绪状态作直接陈述；有时与亲密关系、音乐体验或对他人行为的反应相关。
patterns.domain: 私人邮件、音乐回忆、评论

patterns.name: 记忆与音乐欣赏叙述
patterns.context: 回忆聆听音乐及其带来的积极感受；激活标记分散在回忆、聆听和感受词上，而非集中于某个共同的特殊词形。

patterns.name: 技术描述中的类比限定
patterns.context: 在技术说明中限定实现方式，作者表示不确定某结构是否按前述方式实现；与 special 或情绪表达无直接关系。

patterns.name: 标题中的感受短语
patterns.trigger: «Feel»7，位于歌曲名 «How Does It Feel» 中
patterns.context: 词语出现在专辑曲目列表的标题里，不是正文中的情绪陈述。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、音乐曲目列表

en.description: Primarily activates on feel/feels and related expressions of subjective feelings, covering emotional, bodily, and athletic experiences, and also appearing in song titles; well also activates in email greetings.

patterns.name: feel(s) expressions of feeling
patterns.context: Discusses subjective feelings, emotions, bodily sensations, or athletic experiences; often appears in structures such as how it feels and how I’d feel, and also in the song title Feel
patterns.domain: Online narratives, sports/equipment experiences, lyrics and song titles

patterns.name: well in greetings
patterns.context: Asks after someone's well-being in an email greeting

7_78.description: 主要对 feel/feels 及相关主观感受表达激活，涵盖情绪、身体与运动体验，也出现在歌曲标题；另对邮件问候中的 well 激活。

patterns.name: feel(s) 表达感受
patterns.context: 谈论主观感受、情绪、身体或运动体验；常出现在 how it feels、how I’d feel 等结构中，也有歌曲名中的 Feel
patterns.domain: 网络叙述、体育/装备体验、歌词与歌曲标题

patterns.name: well 的问候语
patterns.context: 邮件问候中询问对方近况

en.description: Activations are scattered across common words such as feel/felt, well, and all; code identifiers such as WALKABLE and True; state in a patent; and the exclamation On. There is no unified trigger condition across contexts.

patterns.name: Forms or phrases containing feel
patterns.context: feel/felt appears in sentences asking about feelings or describing how someone feels; 1 is a song title, 10 is a direct question, and 5 is an interview narrative.

patterns.name: well and nearby email pleasantries
patterns.context: In an email greeting or well-wish, well means being well; both instances are near doing.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of all
patterns.context: At the end of the fixed expression “at all,” preceded by “for any reason or no reason”.
patterns.domain: Terms of service or disclaimers in emails

patterns.name: WALKABLE in a testability identifier
patterns.context: In the uppercase enum value NOT_WALKABLE, activation falls on the latter part of WALKABLE.

patterns.name: True in a unit test method name
patterns.context: Inside the PHPUnit test method name testTrueIsTrue; the strongest activation is on the final True.

patterns.name: Does in a song title
patterns.context: In an interrogative song title; Feel activates most strongly, while the preceding words activate more weakly.

patterns.name: state in a critical-state expression
patterns.context: A patent technical description of whether a vehicle is approaching a dangerous or critical state.

patterns.name: On in a colloquial exclamation
patterns.context: Appears in the exclamation “Oh Come On!” followed by an exclamation mark.

7_78.description: 激活分散在 feel/felt、well、all 等常见词及 WALKABLE、True 等代码标识符，还有专利中的 state 和感叹语 On；不同语境间缺少统一触发条件。

patterns.name: feel 的词形或词组
patterns.context: feel/felt 出现在询问感受或描述某人感觉的句子中；1 是歌曲标题，10 是直接提问，5 是叙述采访。
patterns.domain: 歌曲标题、个人叙述、邮件

patterns.name: well 及其附近的邮件寒暄
patterns.context: 邮件问候或祝愿中，well 表示安好；两处都邻近 doing。

patterns.name: all 的强调用法
patterns.context: 固定表达 “at all” 的末尾，前文为 “for any reason or no reason”。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的服务条款或免责声明

patterns.name: 可测试性标识符中的 WALKABLE
patterns.context: 大写枚举值 NOT_WALKABLE 中，激活落在 WALKABLE 的后半部分。

patterns.name: 单元测试方法名中的 True
patterns.context: PHPUnit 测试方法 testTrueIsTrue 的方法名内部；主要强激活位于末尾 True。

patterns.name: 歌曲标题中的 Does
patterns.context: 歌曲标题的疑问句中；Feel 的激活最强，前面的词也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 关键状态表达中的 state
patterns.context: 描述车辆是否接近危险或临界状态的专利技术说明。

patterns.name: 口语感叹中的 On
patterns.context: 出现在感叹 “Oh Come On!” 中，后接感叹号。

en.concept: The phrase at all and sporadic words
en.description: The most prominent feature is the fixed phrase “at all,” often used in negation or degree expressions and appearing across multiple genres. Other activations occur separately in song titles, test naming, the unit second, “matters most,” and “working” in technical contexts, with no clear shared condition.

patterns.name: The phrase “at all”
patterns.context: Used in negation or degree expressions; common in “not … at all” and “no reason at all,” and can also appear in questions
patterns.domain: Q&A, emails, legal statements, scale descriptions, and technical migration discussions

patterns.name: “Feel” in a song title
patterns.context: Appears in a song track title

patterns.name: Truth-value expression in a test name
patterns.context: PHPUnit test class and method naming

patterns.name: Time unit “second”
patterns.context: Used as the unit of seconds after a webpage load-time statistic

patterns.name: The expression “matters most”
patterns.context: Emphasizes what is most important or meaningful

patterns.name: Use of “working”
patterns.context: Asks whether a command or solution is effective

7_78.concept: at all 短语及零散词项
7_78.description: 最突出的是固定短语“at all”，常用于否定或程度表达，跨多种文体出现。其余激活分别落在歌曲标题、测试命名、秒的单位、“matters most”和技术语境的“working”，彼此缺乏明显共同条件。

patterns.name: 短语“at all”
patterns.context: 用于否定或程度表达；常见于“not … at all”“no reason at all”，也可出现在疑问句中
patterns.domain: 问答、邮件、法律陈述、量表说明及技术迁移讨论

patterns.name: 歌曲标题中的“Feel”
patterns.context: 出现在歌曲曲目标题中

patterns.name: 测试名称中的真值表达
patterns.context: PHPUnit 测试类和方法命名

patterns.name: 时间单位“second”
patterns.context: 网页加载时间的统计值后，作为秒的单位

patterns.name: “matters most”表达
patterns.context: 强调最重要或最有意义的事物

patterns.name: “working”用法
patterns.context: 询问某个命令或解决方案是否有效

en.description: Activations are scattered across genres: prominent on or in lists, and also involving question words or sentence-final judgment words, title subword fragments, formula symbols, code identifiers, and technical terms. No stable semantic pattern explains all the instances.

patterns.name: or at clause or sentence boundaries
patterns.context: In lists, alternatives, or additional explanations, or is often followed by the like, other noun phrases, or sentence components; sometimes near commas or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Patent technical texts, legal narratives, physics papers

patterns.name: Sentence-final words in negation or questions
patterns.context: In questions, confirmations, or judgments, activation falls on content words at or near the end of a sentence; local contexts vary.

patterns.name: Words in song titles
patterns.context: A subword fragment or complete word within a title in a music track listing is marked; the strongest point falls on Feel at the end of a title.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In a nested square-root formula, numbers, text related to radical signs, and ellipses are activated.

patterns.name: Pronouns and emotion words in personal narratives
patterns.context: A first-person account of a romantic experience, with activations scattered across names, emotional descriptions, and evaluative expressions.

patterns.name: Question phrasing in programming discussions
patterns.context: The questioner describes a code inheritance issue and ends with the self-deprecating phrase dumb question.

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in test code
patterns.context: Multiple fragments of a camel-case test name in a PHPUnit test class are activated.

patterns.name: Descriptions of anomalies or events in technical text
patterns.context: Describes phenomena such as abnormal discharges and cracking in sputtering fabrication, as well as methods for suppressing them.

patterns.name: Colloquial expression near a code command
patterns.context: A forum reply first gives a shell command example, then colloquially suggests trying it online.

patterns.name: Emphasis word in a paper's conditional statement
patterns.context: A physics paper discusses the order of EWPhT in a conditional statement; activation is concentrated on order in first order.

patterns.name: Rotating equipment and backflow terminology
patterns.context: A steam turbine or similar device reverses, due to backflow or a similar process; this co-occurs with the or pattern in the same passage.

7_78.description: 激活分散在多种文体中：显著出现于列举中的 or，也涉及疑问或句末判断词、标题词片段、公式符号、代码标识符及技术术语；未见能统一解释全部片段的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 句末或分句边界的 or
patterns.context: 在列举、备选或补充说明中，or 后常接 the like、其他名词短语或句子成分；有时邻近逗号或标点。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、法律叙述、物理学论文

patterns.name: 否定或疑问句中的句末词
patterns.context: 疑问、确认或判断性表达中，激活落在句末或近句末的实词；局部上下文并不一致。

patterns.name: 歌曲标题中的词语
patterns.context: 音乐曲目列表里，标题内部的词片段或完整词被标记；最强点落在标题末尾的 Feel。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 嵌套平方根公式中，数字、根号相关文本和省略号被激活。

patterns.name: 个人叙述中的人称与情感词
patterns.context: 第一人称讲述恋爱经历，激活散布于人名、情感描述和判断表达。

patterns.name: 编程讨论中的问题措辞
patterns.context: 提问者描述代码继承问题，并以自谦的 dumb question 收尾。

patterns.name: 测试代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: PHPUnit 测试类的方法名中，驼峰式测试名称的多个片段被激活。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的异常或事件表述
patterns.context: 描述溅射制造中异常放电、开裂等现象及其抑制方法。

patterns.name: 代码命令附近的口语表达
patterns.context: 论坛回复先给出 shell 命令示例，再以口语建议尝试在线运行。

patterns.name: 论文条件句中的强调词
patterns.context: 物理论文以条件句讨论 EWPhT 的阶数；激活集中在 first order 的 order。

patterns.name: 旋转设备与回流术语
patterns.context: 蒸汽涡轮或类似设备反转，原因涉及回流或类似过程；与同段的 or 模式并存。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple corpora: they commonly occur on “or” connecting alternatives, coordinated items, or aliases; they also appear in newline-separated lists and the symbols/index structures of mathematical formulas. The topics of patents, medicine, Q&A, and other texts vary widely, making a single-topic explanation unlikely.

patterns.name: Local connective use of or
patterns.context: Connects two items in coordinated options, alternative possibilities, or aliases; surrounding words may come from engineering descriptions, questions, medical names, and other contexts.
patterns.domain: Multidomain texts; patents, Q&A, medicine, and others

patterns.name: Item separators in lists or titles
patterns.context: A newline-separated album track listing; activation falls near the entry text and formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula structure
patterns.context: Mathematical or physics formulas containing subscripts, products, indices, and ellipses; not ordinary English contexts.

patterns.name: Material composition descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Describes polarizer protective films, oriented molecular chains, and optional material compositions.

patterns.name: Gate or wedge device descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Describes a wedge device restricting a gate's opening or closing.

patterns.name: Coordinated descriptions of equipment and operations in patents
patterns.context: Describes observation windows, gloves, operations, and equipment transfer doors in an isolator.

patterns.name: Reverse motion and direction in patents
patterns.context: Describes vehicle movement forward/backward, reverse rotation, or similar situations involving cams or turbines; the trigger may also primarily be the coordinator “or”.

patterns.name: Local words not clearly classified
patterns.context: Aliases for Pompe disease and glycogen storage disease type II are coordinated; activation also covers internal name fragments, so it is unclear whether the trigger is the conjunction or local forms of the proper names.

7_78.description: 激活分散于多种语料：常见于“or”连接替代项、并列项或别称；另见换行列表及数学公式的符号/索引结构。专利、医学、问答等主题差异很大，难以由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: or 的局部连接用法
patterns.trigger: «or»，尤其是“«or»10 backward”“back«flow»3« or»10 the”“«closing»5« or»9”“«II»4« or»9”
patterns.context: 在并列选项、替代可能或别称之间连接两项；周边词可来自工程描述、问句、医学名称等。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本；专利、问答、医学及其他

patterns.name: 列表或标题中的条目分隔
patterns.trigger: «↵»及换行前后的歌曲条目，如“«Goodbye»”“«How Does It Feel»”
patterns.context: 换行分隔的专辑曲目列表；激活落在条目文字与格式边界附近。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式结构
patterns.context: 数学或物理学公式，包含下标、乘积、索引与省略号；不是普通英语语境。

patterns.name: 专利中的材料构造表述
patterns.trigger: “«or»9 a dichroic polarizing material”中的“or”，以及邻近的“iodine-based compound”
patterns.context: 描述偏振片保护膜、取向分子链及可选材料组成。

patterns.name: 专利中的门或楔形装置表述
patterns.context: 描述楔形装置限制门的开启或关闭。

patterns.name: 专利中的设备与操作并列表述
patterns.context: 描述隔离器内的观察窗、手套、作业及设备搬运门。

patterns.name: 专利中的反向运动及转向
patterns.context: 凸轮或涡轮装置语境中描述车辆前进/倒退、反向旋转或类似情形；触发处也可能主要是并列词“or”。

patterns.name: 未能明确归类的局部词项
patterns.trigger: “«or» GSD II”附近的疾病别称列表
patterns.context: Pompe 综合征与糖原贮积病 II 型的别称并列；激活还覆盖名称内部片段，无法确定是连接词还是专名局部形式导致。

en.description: Most instances activate on or in coordinated options, alternatives, or list structures, across patent and non-patent texts; a few peaks fall on local words such as and, On, &, or running, which cannot be explained by a single trigger condition.

patterns.name: Choice or alternative connective “or”
patterns.context: Strong activation often falls on or in coordinated choices, alternatives, or contrastive lists; some activation also falls on adjacent high-frequency function words or expressions, so not all instances can be explained by the same trigger word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; patents, forums, literature, legal testimony, religious texts, etc.

patterns.name: Coordination and technical relations in patent texts
patterns.context: In technical descriptions in patent backgrounds or claims, or connects directions, failure types, interval categories, or chemical bond options; and may also be activated in nearby coordinated structures.

patterns.name: Coordinated choices in non-patent texts
patterns.context: In questions, parallel constructions, negation, or lists in testimony, or connects possibilities, actions, or denials.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, literary prose, legal testimony

patterns.name: Other local high activations with no stable trigger pattern
patterns.context: Isolated activations occur in exclamations, a symbolic connective in religious texts, and phrases describing vehicle direction; their relation to the main coordinated-or pattern is unclear.
patterns.domain: Online colloquial text, religious exhortations, patent texts

7_78.description: 多数片段在并列选项、替代项或列举结构中的 or 处激活，跨专利与非专利文本；少数峰值落在 and、On、& 或 running 等局部词上，无法由同一触发条件确定解释。

patterns.name: 选择或替代连接词“or”
patterns.context: 强激活常落在并列选择、替代项或转折式列举中的 or；但也有激活落在相邻的高频功能词或表达上，不能把全部片段都解释为同一个触发词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；专利、论坛、文学、法律证词、宗教文本等

patterns.name: 专利文本中的并列与技术关系
patterns.context: 专利背景或权利要求式技术描述中，or 连接方向、故障类型、区间类别或化学键选项；and 也可能在邻近并列结构中被激活。

patterns.name: 非专利文本中的并列选择
patterns.context: 在疑问、排比、否定或证词列举中，or 连接可能性、行动或否认事项。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、文学散文、法律证词

patterns.name: 其他局部高激活，未见稳定触发模式
patterns.context: 孤立激活分别出现在感叹语、宗教文本中的符号连接词，以及车辆行驶方向短语；与主要的 or 并列模式关系不明确。
patterns.domain: 网络口语、宗教劝诫、专利文本

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “or” connecting alternatives, commonly in “X or Y” and “or not.” There are also local activations in the patent explanatory phrase “that is to say” and the lyric “Tell Me I’m Wrong”.

patterns.name: Choice coordination word or
patterns.context: Connects two coordinated options, states, categories, or actions; common in “X or Y” structures, sometimes followed by “not”.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, forum discussions, legal testimony, product/media descriptions, and other genres

patterns.name: Paraphrase or explanatory emphasis
patterns.context: In a technical background sentence, “that is to say” introduces further explanation of a previously mentioned location or situation.

patterns.name: Imperatives and pronouns in lyrics
patterns.context: Appears in a quoted song lyric or title-like phrase, where several consecutive pronoun/imperative words and a negative judgment word are marked.

7_78.description: 主要对连接备选项的“or”强烈响应，常见于“X or Y”及“or not”。另有专利释义短语“that is to say”和歌词“Tell Me I’m Wrong”中的局部激活。

patterns.name: 选择性并列词 or
patterns.context: 连接两个并列选项、状态、类别或行为；常见于“X or Y”结构，有时后接“not”。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、论坛讨论、法律证词、产品/媒体描述等多种文体

patterns.name: 释义或强调说明
patterns.context: 在技术背景句中用“that is to say”引出对前述位置或情况的进一步说明。

patterns.name: 歌词中的祈使与人称词
patterns.context: 出现在引号内的歌曲歌词或歌名式短句中，多个连续的人称/祈使词及否定判断词被标记。

en.description: In every segment, or stands out in coordinated choices, alternatives, or either-or expressions; topics and genres vary, with the connective in a choice relation as the unifying feature.

patterns.name: or in coordinated choices
patterns.context: Activation falls on or in lists or alternative structures, including “forward or backward,” “sleeping mode or a power-saving mode,” “RSVP or not,” and “conversion … or conversion …”.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, as well as forum Q&A and discussions; mostly options or conditions in formal explanatory prose, but also appearing in colloquial questions.

7_78.description: 各段都在并列选项、替代方案或二选一表达中突出 or；主题和文体不一，统一线索是选择关系中的连接词。

patterns.name: 并列选择中的 or
patterns.trigger: «or»10（部分段落还伴随 or 前后的分词、标点或短语）
patterns.context: 激活落在列举或备选结构中的 or；包括“forward or backward”“sleeping mode or a power-saving mode”“RSVP or not”“conversion … or conversion …”等。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明，也见论坛问答与讨论；多为正式说明文中的选项或条件，也可出现在口语式提问中。

en.description: The most salient cue is specify, used across different domains to indicate a designated target or property. Other activations involve cancer research, split technical terms, literal or metaphorical uses of track, and scattered object and vocabulary activations that do not share a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: specify meaning designate or assign a specific property
patterns.context: Appears in contexts explaining how cells or genes determine a specific location, target, or property; also appears in machine-learning contexts referring to specified or generalized learning.
patterns.domain: Biology, developmental, and neuroscience research abstracts

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on fragments of technical terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on split abbreviations, intra-word fragments, or technical-term subwords whose semantic connections are not apparent.

patterns.name: Cancer and treatment contexts
patterns.context: Cancer appears as a disease, a target of pain management, or a goal of treatment research.

patterns.name: Literal use of tracks
patterns.context: Refers separately to charged-particle tracks in gas and, metaphorically, to guiding someone onto the right track; the contexts otherwise differ.
patterns.domain: Particle-detector project descriptions; online legal advice

patterns.name: Descriptions or classifications of specific entities
patterns.context: Activations occur in descriptions of entities such as religious identities, tumor models, or molecular entities, with no shared local syntactic or semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Other low-intensity lexical activations
patterns.context: These occur in discussions of motor learning and legal-advice text, and cannot be explained by the same contextual conditions.
patterns.domain: Research project descriptions and online advice

7_127.description: 最显著线索是不同领域中表示指定目标或性质的 specify；另有癌症研究、拆分专业术语、track 的字面或比喻用法，以及分散的对象和词汇激活，彼此模式并不统一。

patterns.name: specify 表示指定或赋予特定性质
patterns.trigger: «specify»10、«specify»9；以及 «specify»10 where particular macrom«olecules» are synthesized
patterns.context: 出现在解释细胞或基因如何决定特定位置、目标或属性的语境中；也出现于学习模型中，指向指定或泛化学习
patterns.domain: 生物学、发育与神经科学研究摘要

patterns.name: 特定专业术语的碎片激活
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的缩写、词内片段或专业术语子词上，片段本身的语义联系不明显
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与项目描述

patterns.name: 癌症及其治疗语境
patterns.context: 癌症作为疾病、疼痛管理对象或治疗研究目标出现

patterns.name: tracks 的字面用法
patterns.context: 分别指气体中的带电粒子径迹，以及比喻性地指引导某人走上正轨；除此之外语境不同
patterns.domain: 粒子探测器项目描述；网络法律建议

patterns.name: 面向特定对象的描述性或分类语境
patterns.context: 激活出现在宗教身份、肿瘤模型或分子实体等对象的描述中，未见共同的局部句法或语义条件
patterns.domain: 网页文本与生物医学文本

patterns.name: 其他低强度词汇激活
patterns.context: 分属运动学习讨论与法律建议文本，无法由相同上下文条件解释
patterns.domain: 研究项目描述与网页建议

en.description: Activations are scattered across words or fragments such as Wire, HIV, execs, Raw potato, e.g., World, and examining. Only a few share an initial word or local spelling; overall, there is no unified semantic or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Wire-initial words
patterns.context: wire occurs at the beginning of a word, including wire bonding and wireless; what follows refers separately to connecting electrical contacts, messaging services, and communications devices.

patterns.name: HIV infection
patterns.context: HIV is followed immediately by infection in a sentence describing infection rates among heterosexual women.

patterns.name: Word-final s
patterns.context: Lowercase s appears as a plural suffix referring to businesspeople.

patterns.name: Raw potato
patterns.context: Raw is followed by potato, describing potato starch in diets for weaned piglets.

patterns.name: e in the abbreviation e.g.
patterns.context: Lowercase e after a space begins the abbreviation e.g., in a context giving examples of energy measurements.

patterns.name: World-initial words
patterns.context: World appears at the beginning of a title or news headline, followed separately by a news-brief title and a headline about world leaders.
patterns.domain: Business email subject lines, news headlines

patterns.name: examining
patterns.context: The present participle examining describes researchers investigating protein interactions in living cells.

7_127.description: 激活分散于 Wire、HIV、execs、Raw potato、e.g.、World 和 examining 等词或片段；仅少数共享词首或局部拼写，整体缺乏统一语义或语境模式。

patterns.name: Wire 词首
patterns.context: wire 作为词首，涵盖 wire bonding 与 wireless；后续内容分别指连接电接触点、消息服务和通信设备

patterns.name: HIV infection
patterns.context: HIV 后紧接 infection，句中描述异性女性感染情况

patterns.name: 词尾 s
patterns.context: 小写 s 作为复数词尾，指商业人士

patterns.name: Raw potato
patterns.context: Raw 后接 potato，描述断奶仔猪日粮中的马铃薯淀粉

patterns.name: e.g. 缩写中的 e
patterns.context: 空格后的小写 e 是 e.g. 缩写的起始部分，位于举例说明能量测量的语境

patterns.name: World 词首
patterns.context: World 作为标题或新闻标题的词首，后续分别为新闻简报标题与世界领导人相关标题
patterns.domain: 商业邮件标题、新闻标题

patterns.name: examining
patterns.context: 现在分词 examining 用于描述研究者考察活细胞中的蛋白质相互作用

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the negative structure “did not” in scientific abstracts, covering different outcomes such as not affecting, recording, conducting, or continuing. It also responds to the first-person story opening “I tell you.”

patterns.name: Negative auxiliary did not
patterns.context: Scientific abstracts describe an intervention, experimental condition, feature, or outcome as not occurring, changing, or being achieved; usually followed by a base-form verb.

patterns.name: First-person narrative opening
patterns.context: Addresses the audience directly while telling a story in the first person; not in the context of a paper abstract.

7_127.description: 主要对科学摘要中的“did not”否定结构强烈响应，涉及未影响、未记录、未进行或未继续等不同结局；另对一段第一人称故事开场“I tell you”响应。

patterns.name: 否定助动词 did not
patterns.context: 科学摘要中描述干预、实验条件、特征或结局未发生、未改变或未达到；通常后接动词原形。
patterns.domain: 医学与生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 第一人称叙事开场
patterns.context: 直接对听众说话，以第一人称讲述故事；不属于论文摘要语境。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to rented (rent or lease), across a range of styles. There are also a few ungrouped patent descriptions, housing policy contexts, and code-path/filing contexts; common function words and punctuation are also marked.

patterns.name: rent/rented verb
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on rented, especially its past participle/past-tense use describing rented items, places, or housing; no particular object or syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including patents, legal texts, forums, news commentary, encyclopedias, and literature

patterns.name: Sporadic common words and punctuation
patterns.context: These tokens appear in high-activation contexts, but their triggering conditions are unclear; they may be local context accompanying rented or noise.

patterns.name: Patent invention-description terms
patterns.context: A patent-style sentence introduces a plastic container suitable for holding food and beverages; the excerpt does not contain rented.

patterns.name: Housing and social-housing contexts
patterns.context: Discusses expanding social housing and cooperating with the private rental sector.

patterns.name: Code file paths and initial filing
patterns.context: A code file path is listed, followed by discussion of handling an initial filing oneself; rented does not appear.

7_127.description: 主要对 rented（租用/出租）强烈响应，跨多种文体出现；另有少量无法归并的专利描述、住房政策及代码路径/申报语境，常见虚词和标点也被标记。

patterns.name: rent/rented 动词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 rented，尤其是描述租用物品、场所或住房的过去分词/过去式用法；不要求特定宾语或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 专利、法律、论坛、新闻评论、百科、文学等多种文体

patterns.name: 零散常见词与标点
patterns.context: 这些 token 出现在高激活上下文中，但触发条件不明确，可能是伴随 rented 的局部上下文或噪声。

patterns.name: 专利发明描述词
patterns.context: 专利式句子介绍一种适用于盛装食品和饮料的塑料容器；片段中没有 rented。

patterns.name: 住宅与社会住房语境
patterns.context: 讨论扩大社会住房，并与私人租赁部门合作。

patterns.name: 代码文件路径及初始申报
patterns.context: 先列出代码文件路径，随后谈到自行办理初始申报；未出现 rented。

en.concept: Word-final s, especially in proper-name possessives
en.description: In most passages, activations concentrate on s, especially possessive ’s attached to proper names; it also occurs at the ends of titles or proper names. A few abbreviation-final s and year possessives show weaker or similar activations.

patterns.name: s in possessives
patterns.context: Attached directly after a person’s, place’s, or organization’s name to form a possessive; the character is sometimes tokenized separately.
patterns.domain: Web text such as news, commentary, bibliographies, and biographies

patterns.name: Word-final s in proper names
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of a proper name or title word, not necessarily as a possessive; for example, “Travels” and “adapts.”

patterns.name: Emphatic word-final s in phrases
patterns.context: Activation occurs in abbreviated forms, but is weaker than the primary trigger and differs from the possessive pattern.

patterns.name: s after numeric years
patterns.context: Attached to a time expression, meaning “last week’s” rather than a plural or ordinary possessive.

7_127.concept: 词尾 s，尤指专名所有格
7_127.description: 多数段落中，激活集中在 s，尤其是附着于专名后的所有格 ’s；也见于标题或专名的词尾 s。少数缩写词尾和年份所有格出现较弱或相似激活。

patterns.name: 所有格中的 s
patterns.context: 直接附着在人名、地名或机构名之后，构成所有格；有时字符被拆成独立 token。
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、书目及人物介绍等网页文本

patterns.name: 专名词内的词尾 s
patterns.context: 位于专名或标题词的末尾，不一定能确定是所有格；如 “Travels”“adapts”。

patterns.name: 短语中的强调性词尾
patterns.context: 激活出现在缩写形式中，但强度低于主要触发；与所有格模式不同。
patterns.domain: 叙述或口语化网页文本

patterns.name: 数字年份后的 s
patterns.context: 附着于时间表达，表示“上周的”而非复数或普通所有格。

en.description: The most consistent cue is English be-copular constructions, especially it’s (appearing in nine passages), followed by a state, evaluation, or complement. There are also scattered lexical activations that are difficult to group into a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: is in an apostrophe contraction
patterns.context: it’s occurs in an English possessive or contraction, especially when followed by a complement or clause; it is not restricted to a particular semantic domain.
patterns.domain: English prose such as news, commentary, dialogue, and game and film descriptions

patterns.name: Adjective or participle after be
patterns.context: be or it’s serves as a copula/auxiliary, followed by a state, evaluation, identity, or complement; the specific triggering forms are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Scattered phrase and entity-word triggers
patterns.context: These words occur in different passages without shared, clear local syntactic or semantic conditions; they may be weakly related incidental activations.

7_127.concept: 英语系词结构，尤以 it’s 为主
7_127.description: 最稳定的线索是英语 be 系词结构，尤其是 it’s（九段出现），后接状态、评价或补语；此外有多处零散词项激活，难以归为一致模式。

patterns.name: 撇号缩写中的 is
patterns.context: 英语所有格或缩写中出现 it’s，尤其是句中继续接补语或从句；不局限于特定语义领域。
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、对话、游戏与电影介绍等英语散文

patterns.name: be 动词后的形容词或分词
patterns.trigger: «be» 后的形容词/分词，如 «becoming»、«is»、«was»；另见 «It»’«s» 后接 «official»、«clear»、«not»、«so»、«a»
patterns.context: 句子中 be 或 it’s 充当系词/助动词，后接状态、评价、身份或补语；具体触发形式并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 分散的短语与实体词触发
patterns.context: 这些词在各段出现，但缺少共同、明确的局部句法或语义条件；可能是弱相关的偶发激活。

en.description: Primarily activates in English constructions where this/these/it introduces a state, judgment, or contrastive complement. Common forms include still and this is/was, and activation can extend to a following passive-result predicate. There is also an isolated intra-word fragment from Italian occorre.

patterns.name: Judgment or contrast after a demonstrative/pronoun
patterns.context: A sentence uses this/these/it to introduce a judgment, state, or contrastive complement; highlights often fall on still or on was/is after this.
patterns.domain: English explanatory, news, encyclopedia, legal, and academic prose

patterns.name: Passive/result expression after “this was”
patterns.context: A passive or resultative predicate follows this was; in some examples, strong activation also occurs within the predicate word.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia narrative, political and historical prose

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Italian occorre
patterns.context: An Italian sentence discusses the need for foresight following the introduction of new rules; strong activation falls on a final fragment of occorre.
patterns.domain: Formal European Parliament discourse in Italian

7_127.concept: 指示性判断与状态补充
7_127.description: 主要激活于英语中 this/these/it 引出状态、判断或转折补充的结构，常见 still、this is/was，并可延伸到其后的被动结果谓语。另有意大利语 occorre 词内片段的孤例。

patterns.name: 指示代词/代词后的判断或转折
patterns.context: 句中以 this/these/it 引出判断、状态或转折补充；高亮常落在 still，或 this 后的 was/is。
patterns.domain: 英语说明、新闻、百科、法律及学术 prose

patterns.name: “this was”后的被动/结果表达
patterns.context: this was 后接被动或结果性谓语；部分例子在谓语词内部也出现强激活。
patterns.domain: 英语百科叙述、政治历史 prose

patterns.name: 意大利语 occorre 的词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语讨论新规出台后需要具备预见能力的句子；强激活落在 occorre 的末尾片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语正式论述

en.description: Primarily responds to contexts near English perfect, passive, or continuous predicates, especially been and adjacent function words; it also appears in expressions of lack. Activations also occur on intra-word subwords in Italian parliamentary text, years and dates, and ordinary definite articles, as well as on an unclassifiable isolated example.

patterns.name: English passive perfect and been
patterns.context: English predicates formed with be/been and a past participle or -ing form, including perfect, passive, or continuous constructions; strong activations often occur on been, the following predicate, and adjacent function words. Also occurs in the negative sentence “It «is»8 «not»7 often the «case»5”.
patterns.domain: English prose across domains, academic abstracts, forums, and encyclopedia narrative

patterns.name: Intra-word subword fragments in Italian
patterns.context: In continuous Italian text, words are split into multiple subword tokens; activations concentrate on intra-word fragments, often in longer or morphologically complex words.

patterns.name: Number- or date-related text
patterns.context: Activations occur around years, dates, or numerical expressions, but the syntactic and semantic contexts differ across passages, so it is unclear whether the numbers themselves trigger them.
patterns.domain: Academic texts, news, or historical prose

patterns.name: Expressions of lack or non-occurrence
patterns.context: English expressions describing something as insufficient, absent, or not commonplace; some overlap with the perfect-tense pattern.

patterns.name: Generic referential the
patterns.context: The definite article the is activated in several ordinary English noun phrases, but the semantic and syntactic environments are inconsistent; this may be incidental to adjacent grammatical structures.

7_127.concept: 英语完成/被动结构附近的激活
7_127.description: 主要响应英语中完成、被动或持续谓语附近的上下文，尤其是 been 及相邻功能词；也见于表示缺乏的表达。意大利语议会文本中的词内子词、年份日期和普通定冠词处亦有激活，另有无法归类的孤例。

patterns.name: 英语被动完成时与 been
patterns.context: 英语中 be/been 与过去分词或 -ing 形式构成的完成、被动或持续谓语；强激活常出现在 been、后续谓语及相邻功能词处。也见于否定句“It «is»8 «not»7 often the «case»5”。
patterns.domain: 多领域英语散文、学术摘要、论坛和百科叙述

patterns.name: 意大利语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语连续文本中，单词被切分成多个子词 token；激活集中在词内碎片，常涉及较长或形态复杂的词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会文本

patterns.name: 数字或日期相关文本
patterns.context: 年份、日期或数字表达处有激活，但各段中的句法与语义背景不同，无法确认是否由数字本身触发。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、新闻或历史性散文

patterns.name: 关于缺乏或未发生的表达
patterns.context: 描述研究或某种情况不足、缺失或未成为常态的英语表述；部分与完成时模式重合。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要与评论性散文

patterns.name: 泛指的所指词 the
patterns.context: 若干普通英语名词短语中的定冠词 the 有激活，但所处语义和句法环境不统一，可能是相邻语法结构的伴随现象。

en.concept: English function words and discourse structure
en.description: Activations fall on a range of English syntactic and discourse markers: been in perfect/passive constructions, is not evaluative constructions, already, remains, awaited, and the parenthetical contrast marker however. Trigger words and positions are not consistent.

patterns.name: been in “has been the focus”
patterns.context: In the perfect construction “has been the focus of,” the focus is the core noun phrase; the context describes industrial espionage.

patterns.name: been in “are … been held”
patterns.context: Occurs in the nonstandard grammatical sequence “these … are been held by the realist,” adjacent to held.

patterns.name: Negative construction “is not the case”
patterns.context: The copula is is followed by not the case, indicating that something is not so.

patterns.name: is in a skeptical rhetorical question
patterns.context: A rhetorical question asks whether a phenomenon has received adequate scrutiny; is introduces the evaluative predicate questionable.

patterns.name: “is already known”
patterns.context: is is followed by already known, indicating that a structure is already known in a patent background.

patterns.name: Negative construction “this is not the most important”
patterns.context: is not is followed by a superlative evaluation, discussing the importance of research findings or methods.

patterns.name: already in “as already seminally suggested”
patterns.context: already modifies the past participle suggested, indicating that a relevant suggestion had already been made.

patterns.name: remains in “This remains”
patterns.context: This is the subject, and remains introduces an unresolved or unsettled legal question.

patterns.name: awaited in “are awaited”
patterns.context: The passive are awaited indicates that research results are still expected or awaited.

patterns.name: Concessive/contrast marker “however”
patterns.context: After sentence-initial This, the parenthetical however signals contrast before stating that it represents an additional component.

7_127.concept: 英语功能词与篇章结构
7_127.description: 激活落在多种英语句法与篇章标记上：完成／被动结构中的 been、is not 评价结构、already、remains、awaited，以及插入转折 however；触发词和位置并不统一。

patterns.name: “has been the focus”中的 been
patterns.context: “has been the focus of”这一完成时结构中，the focus 为核心名词短语；上下文描述工业间谍活动。

patterns.name: “are … been held”中的 been
patterns.context: 出现在“these … are been held by the realist”这一非标准语法序列中，紧邻 held。

patterns.name: 否定结构“is not the case”
patterns.context: 系动词 is 后接 not the case，表示情况并非如此。

patterns.name: 质疑性反问中的 is
patterns.context: 对某种现象是否受到足够审查作反问，is 引出评价性谓语 questionable。

patterns.name: “is already known”
patterns.trigger: “flattening the bow ends«,»2« is»5« already»9« known»4”
patterns.context: is 后接 already known，说明专利背景中某种结构已为人所知。

patterns.name: 否定结构“this is not the most important”
patterns.context: is not 后接最高级评价，讨论研究结果或方法的重要性。

patterns.name: “as already seminally suggested”中的 already
patterns.context: already 修饰过去分词 suggested，表示此前已有相关先行建议。

patterns.name: “This remains”中的 remains
patterns.context: This 作主语，remains 引出尚未解决或未定的法律问题。

patterns.name: “are awaited”中的 awaited
patterns.context: 被动语态 are awaited，表示研究结果仍待公布或期待。

patterns.name: 让步转折标记“however”
patterns.context: 句首 This 后以插入语 however 转折，再陈述其代表额外组件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various syntactic structures and styles: they commonly occur in structures involving the, be/been, and that/it, as well as judgments, negation, and abstract discussion. No stable content theme runs through all passages, and many strongly activated tokens are far apart.

patterns.name: The and following noun structures
patterns.context: Often occurs in noun phrases or copular constructions; it appears across corpora but not every instance of the activates, and some highly activated tokens are far apart.
patterns.domain: Narrative, academic, and legal texts across domains

patterns.name: been in perfect/copular constructions
patterns.context: Follows an auxiliary and links a statement to a following noun or evaluation; also occurs in the ordinary expression “been quietly deemphasized.”
patterns.domain: Expository writing, commentary, academic discourse, forum discussions

patterns.name: be forms in judgment and evaluation sentences
patterns.context: Judges, evaluates, or describes the nature, problem, or legal principle of something; the trigger position is not fixed and need not be adjacent to be.

patterns.name: Issues, focuses, and subjects of inquiry in general discourse
patterns.context: Discusses research subjects, issues, or evaluations of phenomena, often in abstract discourse; the specific triggering words differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Academic, policy, commentary, and technical writing

patterns.name: Propositions or reference introduced by that/this
patterns.context: Refers to prior text or introduces a proposition or clause, often in argumentation, judgment, or explanation; capitalization and syntactic position vary.
patterns.domain: Argumentative writing, legal texts, forum discussions

patterns.name: Negation or rebuttal expressions
patterns.context: Denies facts, limits judgments, or questions something; scattered across narrative and commentary.

patterns.name: it with evaluative or temporal expressions
patterns.context: it functions as a referent or dummy subject, followed by an evaluation or description of an event’s occurrence.

patterns.name: Emphatic or resultative past participle
patterns.context: A past participle describes a problem being exposed, in discussion of technical-system problems.

patterns.name: Statements of legal principles
patterns.context: A formal legal construction describes a specific right as a fundamental principle established by precedent.

7_127.description: 激活分散在多种句法与文体中：常见于 the、be/been、that/it 等结构，以及判断、否定和抽象论述；没有贯穿全部段落的稳定内容主题，且许多强激活 token 相距较远。

patterns.name: “the”词形及后续名词结构
patterns.context: 多出现在名词短语或系表结构中；不同语料里均有，但并非每次出现 the 都激活，部分高激活 token 与其间隔较远。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、学术文本、法律文本

patterns.name: 完成时/系表中的“been”
patterns.trigger: «been»，尤其“has «been» the «focus»”“have «been» the «subject»”“is «been» …”（原文分别为“has … been the focus”“have been the subject”“has … been the subject”）
patterns.context: 在助动词之后，连接陈述与后续名词或评价；也有普通“been quietly deemphasized”用法。
patterns.domain: 说明文、评论、学术论述、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 判断与评价句中的 be 系列
patterns.context: 判断、评价或说明某事物的性质、问题或法律原则；触发位置并不固定，也未必紧邻 be。

patterns.name: 广义论述中的问题、焦点与调查对象
patterns.context: 讨论研究对象、问题或对某现象的评价，常见于抽象论述；各段具体触发词并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 学术、政策、评论、技术说明

patterns.name: that/this 引出的命题或指代
patterns.context: 指代前文或引出命题、从句，且常位于论证、判断或解释中；大小写和句法位置各异。
patterns.domain: 论述文、法律文本、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 否定或反驳式表达
patterns.trigger: “«isn’t» helped”“«don’t» actually exist”“«didn’t» stop”“«not» all … «it’s» cracked up to be”“«not» scrutinized”
patterns.context: 否定事实、限制判断或质疑某事；分散在叙述与评论中。
patterns.domain: 说明文、故事叙述、论坛评论

patterns.name: “it”与评价/时间表达
patterns.trigger: “«it» … cracked up to be”“«it» apparently came about in 1969”
patterns.context: it 作指代或形式主语，后接评价或事件发生描述。

patterns.name: 强调或结果性过去分词
patterns.context: 以过去分词描述问题被揭露，位于技术系统问题的论述中。

patterns.name: 法律原则表述
patterns.context: 正式法律句式，将特定权利表述为既有判例的基本原则。

en.description: Activates across news, commentary, history, and academic papers, commonly in expressions of judgment, anaphora, and summary, and also on was and word-internal fragments; there is no single stable lexical or thematic pattern.

patterns.name: Judgment after qualifying or emphatic expressions
patterns.context: The surrounding text explains a phenomenon, action, or judgment. Activations are distributed across emphatic, referential, and evaluative expressions; there is no fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: News reports, encyclopedia entries, online comments

patterns.name: Transitions and summary statements in papers
patterns.context: Academic discussion refers back to prior text, introduces evidence, or describes the paper’s topic; words such as this/the and study/paper are common.

patterns.name: English past-tense auxiliary or copula “was”
patterns.context: English narratives or papers state a past condition or prior discussion; activation falls on was and nearby words.

patterns.name: Sporadic subword fragments and proper-name/morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Portuguese words or fragments of English word forms/proper names; their shared semantic conditions are difficult to determine from the fragments.
patterns.domain: Portuguese European Parliament texts; book reviews or academic commentary

7_127.description: 激活跨新闻、评论、历史及论文文本，常见于判断、回指、总结等表达，也包括was及词内片段；没有单一稳定词汇或主题模式。

patterns.name: 限定或强调性表达后的判断
patterns.trigger: [1] «the» «center»«found»；[2] «apparent» «behavior» «has been the focus»；[7] «it's not all it's cracked up to be»
patterns.context: 周围出现对现象、行为或判断的说明，激活分散在强调、指称及评价性表达中；并非固定短语。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、百科说明、网络评论

patterns.name: 论文中的承接与总结语句
patterns.trigger: [6] «the lessons from these 2 states formed the basis»；[8] «This is further confirmed by a recent study»；[10] «This question is the subject of the present paper»
patterns.context: 学术论述中回指前文、引入证据或说明论文主题，常见 this/the、study/paper 等词。

patterns.name: 英语过去时助动词或系词“was”
patterns.trigger: [4] «That was the main picture»；[9] «was already discussed»
patterns.context: 英语叙述或论文中陈述过去状态、既有讨论；激活落在 was 及邻近词上。

patterns.name: 零散词片及专名/形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部的子词片段或英语词形/专名片段，难以从片段确定共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本；书评或学术评论

en.concept: English case expressions and sporadic structures
en.description: Primarily activates on the English “This/That is (not) the case” expression and nearby words; there is also one instance of the “among the ones that” structure, and relazione in the Italian “Nella mia relazione.”

patterns.name: “This is [not] the case” expression
patterns.context: Demonstrative This/That + be + (optional not/adverb) + the case; activation often falls on case, and sometimes on is, the, not, or nearby words.
patterns.domain: Across legal, academic, patent-background, philosophical, and news genres

patterns.name: “among the ones” structure
patterns.context: After a plural subject, are among the ones that describes several options as belonging to the solutions currently under consideration.

patterns.name: relazione in an Italian relative clause
patterns.context: An excerpt from an Italian parliamentary speech; relazione occurs in a relative-clause context, with activation concentrated on that word.

7_127.concept: 英语 case 表达式及零散结构
7_127.description: 主要对英语“This/That is (not) the case”表达式及其邻近词激活；另有一例“among the ones that”结构，以及意大利语“Nella mia relazione”中的 relazione。

patterns.name: “This is [not] the case”表达式
patterns.trigger: “This is especially the case”, “this is not the case”, “That is not the case”, “That’s certainly the case”, “This is the case”
patterns.context: 指示词 This/That + be +（可选 not/副词）+ the case；激活多落在 case，部分也落在 is、the、not 或周边词。
patterns.domain: 跨法律、学术论文、专利背景、哲学、新闻等文体

patterns.name: “among the ones”结构
patterns.trigger: “are among the ones that are currently being explored”
patterns.context: 复数主语后接 are among the ones that，描述若干选项属于当前探索的方案。
patterns.domain: 专利背景／通信网络技术

patterns.name: 意大利语关系从句中的 rel​​azione
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言片段；关系从句语境中出现 rel​​azione，激活集中于该词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会／意大利语政治发言

en.description: Activations concentrate on case-related judgments and exemplification, and also respond to discourse-linking expressions involving quotation, limits on knowledge, contrast, and objects of review; there is also a French opinion word and a demonstrative pronoun. The examples span languages and domains and are difficult to reduce to a single meaning.

patterns.name: French opinion and uncertainty
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses Descartes’s judgment about opinions acquired through education, describing those opinions as uncertain.

patterns.name: “the case” in a negative judgment
patterns.context: First states that a condition does not hold or apply, then explains that the case does not fall under that situation.

patterns.name: Demonstrative pronoun “celle”
patterns.context: A French academic sentence uses a demonstrative pronoun to refer back to the previously mentioned method (here, a clustering method).

patterns.name: Findings of fact in appellate review
patterns.context: Explains that the trial court’s findings of fact are subject to review by the appellate court.

patterns.name: Quoting a pleading or lawyer’s brief
patterns.context: Introduces a direct quotation from the appellant’s brief.

patterns.name: Authorial knowledge limitation and systematic review
patterns.context: In a review-style scientific text, limits claims to the authors’ knowledge and states that no relevant systematic review exists.

patterns.name: Contrast word “however”
patterns.context: Introduces a contrast or additional limitation after describing a technical solution, cost, or component.

patterns.name: “the case” in an affirmative judgment
patterns.context: A legal argument makes an affirmative judgment, then limits the objects or matters to which it applies.

patterns.name: Giving a concrete example
patterns.context: After introducing a device or technology, gives a specific example to illustrate the preceding claim.

patterns.name: A specific situation involving the study population
patterns.context: After describing a measurement or reliability problem, states that the problem applies to a specific population or measure.

7_127.description: 激活集中于“case”相关判断与举例句式，也响应引述、知识限定、转折、审查对象等篇章连接表达；另有法语观点词及指示代词。跨语言、跨领域，难归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 法语观点与不确定性
patterns.context: 法语句子谈笛卡尔对受教育时传来的意见之判断，意见被说成不确定

patterns.name: 否定判断中的“the case”
patterns.context: 先述某条件不成立或不适用，再说明该案不属于这种情形

patterns.name: 指示代词“celle”
patterns.context: 法语学术句中以指示代词回指前述方法（此处为聚类方法）

patterns.name: 上诉审查中的事实认定
patterns.context: 说明审判法院的事实认定是上诉法院审查的对象

patterns.name: 引述诉状或律师文书
patterns.context: 引出对上诉方文书内容的直接引用

patterns.name: 作者知识限定与系统综述
patterns.context: 综述性科学写作中限定作者所知，并称不存在相关系统综述

patterns.name: 转折词“however”
patterns.context: 在说明技术方案、成本或组件之后引出转折或补充限制

patterns.name: 肯定判断中的“the case”
patterns.context: 法律论述先作肯定判断，再限定其适用对象或事项

patterns.name: 例示具体案例
patterns.context: 在介绍设备或技术后，用具体实例说明前述说法

patterns.name: 研究对象中的具体情形
patterns.context: 在说明测量或可靠性问题后，指出该问题适用于特定人群或指标

en.description: Across domains, prominent activations often fall on English expressions that continue or introduce a judgment, observation, or subsequent event, especially transitions in legal opinions; there are also local triggers in Portuguese philosophical judgments and in news, academic, and product reporting.

patterns.name: Concluding/argument-introducing phrases in English opinions
patterns.context: Continues a legal argument, points out how facts correspond to or differ from precedent, or introduces the court’s judgment; often appears at the start of a sentence or at a paragraph transition.

patterns.name: Fact-finding language in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Discusses the trial record, evidence, findings of fact, and appellate review; highlights how the court handles existing findings of fact.

patterns.name: Judgment word in Portuguese philosophical discourse
patterns.context: In a discussion of Descartes and views on educational tradition, gives a general evaluation of an opinion; activation concentrates on “acima”.

patterns.name: Follow-up events and announcements in reporting
patterns.context: Reports a follow-up announcement or news event, organized around when the event occurred; this example concerns a television program and a dispute over an investigation.

patterns.name: Response and follow-up measures in business reporting
patterns.context: First describes management’s response as undisclosed, then recounts the next action taken by a government department.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia English articles, real estate and administrative affairs

patterns.name: Summary of observations in a research paper
patterns.context: Based on data or phenomena described earlier, begins listing observations; the topic is recurrence of excessive involvement behavior.

patterns.name: Additional selling point in a product introduction
patterns.context: Adds a noteworthy product feature after introducing a smartphone’s camera hardware and software functions.

7_127.concept: 论述与事件的承接引导
7_127.description: 跨领域文本中，显著激活常落在承接或引出判断、观察、事件后续的英语表达上，尤其是法律判决中的论证衔接；另有葡语哲学判断及新闻、学术、产品报道中的局部触发。

patterns.name: 英语判决中的结论／论证引导语
patterns.trigger: “That is not the case here”, “That was the case”, “The courts have, it is true”, “This argument was made”
patterns.context: 在法律论证中承接前文、指出事实与先例的对应或差异，或引出法院的判断；常出现在句首或段落转折处。

patterns.name: 法律审理中的事实认定措辞
patterns.trigger: “the trial court's findings are the ones which are before this court on appeal”
patterns.context: 讨论审判记录、证据、事实认定及上诉审查；突出法院对既有事实认定的处理。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语哲学论述中的判断词
patterns.context: 笛卡尔及教育传承观点的讨论中，对意见作概括性评价；激活集中在“acima”。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 葡萄牙语哲学文本

patterns.name: 报道中的事件后续与公告
patterns.context: 以事件发生时间为线索，报道公告或新闻事件的后续；此例涉及电视节目与调查争议。

patterns.name: 商业报道中的回应及后续措施
patterns.trigger: “Following the response, which was not made public”
patterns.context: 先描述管理层回应未公开，再叙述政府部门采取下一步行动。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 英文条目，地产与行政事务

patterns.name: 研究论文中的观察总结
patterns.trigger: “One of the observations that can be made”
patterns.context: 基于前文描述的数据或现象，开始列举可得观察；主题为过度参与行为的复发。

patterns.name: 产品介绍中的补充卖点
patterns.context: 在介绍智能手机相机硬件及软件功能后，补充值得注意的产品特点。

en.description: Primarily responds to academic arguments that refer back to evidence or phenomena and explain their evidential role; it also responds to introductions of additional points, replies based on personal experience, first-person academic statements, and descriptions of legal proceedings and appellate review.

patterns.name: Observations and their evidential role
patterns.context: In academic or patent discourse, refers back to prior evidence, phenomena, or arguments and explains how they support a hypothesis, belief, or solution.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical abstracts, patent background

patterns.name: Summary and quotation in argumentation
patterns.context: Introduces an additional point in expository writing or summarizes previously presented material.

patterns.name: Recounting personal experience
patterns.context: In informal conversation, responds to another person’s statement with personal experience.

patterns.name: First-person statement in philosophical commentary
patterns.context: In philosophical commentary or academic writing, the author shifts to the first person to explain their writing, argument, or speaking plans.

patterns.name: Countermotion in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes a litigant filing a motion and its scheduling.

patterns.name: Appellate deference to trial findings of fact
patterns.context: States that despite conflicting evidence, the appellate court reviews the lower court’s findings of fact.

7_127.description: 主要响应学术论证中回指证据或现象并说明其支持作用；也响应引出补充要点、个人经验回应、第一人称学术发言，以及法律程序与上诉审表述。

patterns.name: 观察及其论据作用
patterns.trigger: “observations”，以及 “This is another argument in favor of”
patterns.context: 学术或专利论述中，回指前文证据、现象或论点，并说明它们对假设、信念或方案的支持作用。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 论证中的总结与引述
patterns.context: 说明文中引出补充要点，或对前述材料作归纳。

patterns.name: 个人经验回顾
patterns.context: 非正式对话中以个人经历回应他人陈述。

patterns.name: 哲学评论中的第一人称发言
patterns.context: 哲学评论或学术文本中，作者转入第一人称说明写作、论述或发言安排。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的反动议
patterns.context: 描述诉讼当事人提交动议及其排期。

patterns.name: 上诉审对审判事实认定的依循
patterns.trigger: “the ones which are before this court on appeal”
patterns.context: 指出虽有证据矛盾，上诉法院仍审查下级法院的事实认定。

en.description: Strongly responds to summary phrases in biomedical papers, such as “These observations/data/results,” that refer back to prior findings, data, or experimental results, especially when followed by an inference, conclusion, or statement of significance.

patterns.name: “observations” as the subject of an evidence summary
patterns.context: After describing clinical findings, experimental results, or observations, uses “These observations” to introduce an inference, support a hypothesis, or explain significance.

patterns.name: “data” as the subject of an evidence summary
patterns.context: After reporting experimental or clinical data, uses “These data” to summarize the conclusions they suggest or support.

patterns.name: “results” as the subject of an evidence summary
patterns.context: After describing results from a procedure, experiment, or figure, uses “These results” to introduce a conclusion or interpretation.

7_127.description: 对生物医学论文中“These observations/data/results”这类回指前述发现、数据或实验结果的总结短语强烈响应，尤其是其后接推论、结论或意义陈述的语境。

patterns.name: “observations”作为证据总结主语
patterns.context: 前文陈述临床发现、实验结果或观察事实，随后以“These observations”引出推论、支持某假说或说明意义。

patterns.name: “data”作为证据总结主语
patterns.context: 前文报告实验或临床数据，随后用“These data”概括其提示或支持的结论。

patterns.name: “results”作为证据总结主语
patterns.context: 前文描述处理、实验或图表结果，随后用“These results”引出结论或解释。

en.concept: Citation and attribution markers in technical literature
en.description: Primarily responds to prior art, method descriptions, and patent citation formats in patent backgrounds; it also activates on news quotations and speaker attribution, figure and reference cross-references in medical papers, and citation parentheses, numbers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Patent literature citation labels
patterns.context: Cites or summarizes prior art in patent background paragraphs, often in a parenthetical citation at the end of a sentence or in a reference on a new line; activation also occurs near citation numbers.

patterns.name: Narration of patent prior art
patterns.context: Introduces methods, materials, or technologies proposed in prior patents or non-patent literature; adjacent to literature labels and citation numbers.

patterns.name: News quotations and attribution
patterns.context: In news reports, identifies the speaker after a direct quotation or uses a conjunction within the quotation to continue an explanation; may occur alongside periods and quotation marks.

patterns.name: Figure or literature cross-references in medical literature
patterns.context: Medical papers cite a figure or earlier study in the methods/results narrative, with figure numbers, bracketed numbers, author names, or footnote links nearby.

patterns.name: Technical terminology and method descriptions in patents
patterns.context: States the roles and steps of materials, devices, biomolecules, or manufacturing methods in patent backgrounds or technical descriptions; not necessarily adjacent to a citation label.

patterns.name: End-of-sentence punctuation and parenthetical citation structure
