patterns.context: Cited material is often placed in parentheses at the end of a sentence, followed by a period or comma; activations occur around parentheses, numbers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Figure/reference markers in papers
patterns.context: The main text points to a figure and includes a web anchor or Markdown link format.

patterns.name: Statistical measures and author citations
patterns.context: Medical research reports measures and cites prior work using author names and footnotes/hyperlinks.

patterns.name: Splitting personal names in reported quotations
patterns.context: A name is tokenized or split in news text, appearing in attribution after a direct quotation.

patterns.name: Checkpoint phrasing in emergency access reporting
patterns.context: Disaster or traffic-control news describes a checkpoint being set up; this occurs in the article text after a quotation and has no direct connection to patent citation formats.

7_127.concept: 技术文献中的引用与归属标记
7_127.description: 主要响应专利背景中的现有技术、方法描述及专利文献引用格式；另对新闻引语/发言归属、医学论文的图表与参考文献交叉引用，以及引用括号、编号和标点有激活。

patterns.name: 专利文献引用标签
patterns.context: 专利背景技术段落中引用或概述现有技术，常在句末括号或换行参考文献处出现；引用编号附近也有激活。

patterns.name: 专利现有技术叙述
patterns.context: 介绍既有专利或非专利文献提出的方法、材料或技术；与文献标签及引用编号相邻。

patterns.name: 新闻引语与报道归属
patterns.context: 新闻报道中直接引语之后标注发言者，或引语中以连接词继续说明；也可能伴随句号和引号。

patterns.name: 医学文献中的图表或文献交叉引用
patterns.context: 医学论文在方法/结果叙述中引用图或先前研究，附近有图号、方括号编号、作者名或脚注链接。

patterns.name: 专利中技术术语及方法叙述
patterns.trigger: «suppress» the» formation» of»、«method» for» obtaining»、«method» of» controlling»
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术描述中陈述材料、器件、生物分子或制造方法的作用与步骤；本身不一定紧邻引用标签。

patterns.name: 引文句末标点及括号结构
patterns.context: 引用内容常置于括号内并位于句末，随后接句号或逗号；括号、编号和标点周边均有激活。

patterns.name: 论文图像/参考文献标记
patterns.context: 正文指向图示并伴随网页锚点或 Markdown 链接格式。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及数字化排版

patterns.name: 统计指标与作者引文
patterns.context: 医学研究报告测量指标并以作者和脚注/超链接形式引证既往工作。

patterns.name: 报道引语中的人物姓名拆分
patterns.context: 新闻文本中姓名被分词或拆分，出现在直接引语后的发言归属位置。

patterns.name: 急救通行报道中的检查站措辞
patterns.context: 灾害或交通管制新闻中叙述检查站设置，属于引语之后的报道正文，与专利引用格式无直接联系。

en.description: Activations are distributed across common function words, inter-sentence contrast or elaboration, transitions between patent problems and solutions, literature citations, and the aims of paper discussions; there are also sporadic terms and formatting noise, with no overall unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Start of an inter-sentence contrast or addition
patterns.context: At a paragraph or discourse transition, a connective introduces a contrast, addition, or new point; the marker often occurs at the start of a word.

patterns.name: Problem-to-solution transition in patent background
patterns.context: Describes a problem with an existing structure, then introduces a proposed solution or a later embodiment.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Literature citations and evidence references
patterns.context: Refers to existing solutions or literature through review, quotation, or patent numbers.

patterns.name: Statements of discussion or research aims
patterns.context: Discusses research results or describes predictions and the aims of the current study.

patterns.name: Common function words such as «in»
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary English syntactic positions; nearby activations also cover expressions such as 「more detail」. The fragments alone do not reveal a specific semantic condition.

patterns.name: Other sporadic terms
patterns.context: Appear in varied syntactic positions, with no confirmed shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Patents, academic papers, news narratives, and other texts

patterns.name: Noise and uncertain subword fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in formulas, citations, or formatted text, so no stable pattern can be confirmed from them.

7_127.description: 激活分散于常见功能词、句间转折补充、专利问题与方案过渡、文献引用及论文讨论目的等位置；另有零散词项和格式噪声，整体未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 句间转折或补充起始
patterns.context: 段落或论述推进处，用连接词引出转折、补充或新观点；标记常出现在词首。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、论文及报告

patterns.name: 专利背景中的问题—方案过渡
patterns.trigger: «problem»、«above»、«In order to solve»、«As will be described»
patterns.context: 描述现有结构的问题，再引出拟采用的方案或后文实施例。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与技术说明

patterns.name: 文献引用与证据引述
patterns.context: 通过回顾、引述或专利号指向已有方案或文献。

patterns.name: 讨论或研究目的表述
patterns.context: 论文讨论研究结果，或说明预测及当前研究目标。

patterns.name: «in» 等常见功能词
patterns.context: 出现在普通英文句法位置，附近激活也覆盖「more detail」等表达；单凭片段难以判断是否有特定语义条件。

patterns.name: 其余零散词项
patterns.context: 散见于不同句法位置，未形成可确认的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、学术论文、新闻叙述及其他文本

patterns.name: 噪声与不确定子词
patterns.context: 嵌在公式、引用或格式化文本中，无法据此确认稳定模式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及格式化文本

en.concept: Words in citation and discussion contexts
en.description: The most consistent pattern is in introducing figure numbers, patent numbers, or literature sources in patent backgrounds; there are also discussion/citation contexts and a few scattered function-word, pronoun, and infinitive triggers that are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Citation-introducing expression in patent background
patterns.context: Occurs in patent backgrounds or prior-art narratives, followed by a figure number, patent number, or literature source; activation concentrates on in within the citation phrase.

patterns.name: Academic statements about discussion/descriptions
patterns.context: Activation appears in discussion, citation, or description of prior research or evidence, often in literature contexts introduced by in, though the distribution is not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Patents, academic papers, medical research, and legal texts

patterns.name: to in an infinitival purpose construction
patterns.context: to appears in the purpose construction in order to, followed by solve; prominent only in this example.

patterns.name: Negative word not
patterns.context: Occurs in a negative judgment; this example is is not always high. Activation is weak, with no stable pattern of neighboring words.

patterns.name: Pronoun I
patterns.context: The first-person pronoun occurs in a sentence where the narrator says they do not know something.

patterns.name: Sporadic function words or unclassified triggers
patterns.context: Appear respectively in a passive perfect construction, a demonstrative expression, and a patent sentence that continues a description of a device; the current sample is insufficient to group them into a shared pattern.

7_127.description: 最一致的模式是在专利背景中以 in 引出图号、专利号或文献来源；另有讨论/引用语境，以及少量分散的功能词、代词和不定式触发，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的引证引出语
patterns.context: 位于专利背景或现有技术叙述中，后接图号、专利号或文献来源；激活集中在引证短语中的 in。

patterns.name: 讨论/描述类学术表述
patterns.context: 激活出现在对既有研究或证据的讨论、引用描述中，常见于 in 引导的文献语境，但分布并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 专利、学术论文、医学研究及法律文本

patterns.name: 不定式目的结构中的 to
patterns.context: to 位于 in order to 目的结构中，后接 solve；只在此例突出。

patterns.name: 否定词 not
patterns.context: 处于否定判断中；本例为 is not always high，激活较弱且未见稳定邻接模式。

patterns.name: 代词 I
patterns.context: 第一人称代词处于叙述者说明自己不知道某事的句子中。

patterns.name: 零散功能词或未归类触发
patterns.context: 分别出现在被动完成式、指示语及专利设备承接句中，当前样本不足以归为共同模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions that introduce figures and present results in papers; it also responds more weakly to first/latest events, further explanation or judgments, argumentative transitions, and emphatic words in news quotations. Triggers are distributed, with no single strict grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: Figure/figure content presentation
patterns.context: Introduces a figure, figure number, or figure content in a research paper; activation concentrates on “in” and nearby figure-related expressions.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially biomedical, materials science, and crystallography

patterns.name: Superlative or highlighting recent developments
patterns.context: An event or action is described as occurring for the first time or emphasized as the latest step in a series; activation falls around first/latest.

patterns.name: Further explanation or explicit judgment
patterns.context: Signals that a point will be elaborated later in the text, or uses further to introduce a stronger claim.

patterns.name: Contrast and argumentative transition
patterns.context: A philosophical argument first acknowledges some criticism, then qualifies its conclusion with however; activation is prominently concentrated on not.

patterns.name: Emphatic statement in a quotation
patterns.context: A news report quotes a speaker and continues with a description of the situation or consequences; activation falls near he or what.

7_127.description: 主要响应论文中引出图示、结果呈现的表达；另对首次/最新事件、进一步说明或判断、论证转折及新闻引语中的强调词有较弱响应。触发形式分散，未见单一严格语法模式。

patterns.name: 图示/图中展示
patterns.trigger: “illustrated in Figure”“results are shown in”“are shown in Fig.”
patterns.context: 研究论文中引出图、图号或图中内容，激活集中在 “in” 及后续图示表达附近。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其生物医学、材料科学及晶体学

patterns.name: 最高级或突出最新进展
patterns.trigger: “is the first time”“was the latest move”
patterns.context: 事件或行动被描述为首次发生，或被强调为一系列行动中最新的一步；激活落在 first/latest 一带。

patterns.name: 进一步说明或明确判断
patterns.trigger: “as discussed in more detail below”“It is further clear”
patterns.context: 正文中提示后文会详述某点，或以 further 引出加强的论断。

patterns.name: 对照与论证转折
patterns.trigger: “What I do not think Kant shows, however”
patterns.context: 哲学论述中先认可部分批评，再以 however 限定其结论；激活显著集中在 not。

patterns.name: 引语中的强调性陈述
patterns.context: 新闻报道引述发言，并接续对处境或后果的描述；激活落在 he 或 what 附近。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code identifiers and routing, scientific terminology and paper phrasing, names and personal descriptions, energy news, and patent mechanical wording; there is no trigger concept that is stably shared across passages.

patterns.name: index string within a word
patterns.context: The case-sensitive string index appears in technical paths, configuration code, or CSS properties; strong activation concentrates on its character fragments

patterns.name: Energy market news text
patterns.context: Contexts involving hourly indexes, TVA, and energy trading news

patterns.name: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase name
patterns.context: The enzyme name and its numbering and chemical-name components

patterns.name: Assignables code identifier
patterns.context: Appears in code text with file extensions and coordinate-like numbers

patterns.name: Laravel routes and authentication code
patterns.context: Login-page route definitions and authentication-controller calls

patterns.name: Person name Glenn Duffie Shriver
patterns.context: The proper name is repeated after a line break

patterns.name: Description of a Sacramento political columnist
patterns.context: Introduces someone's influence, profession, and city

patterns.name: Reaction-time research phrasing
patterns.context: Describes a reaction-time study with and without interference from a tapping task

patterns.name: Oblique arrangement description in a patent
patterns.context: Describes the separating surfaces between sections of cargo rails and their inclined arrangement

7_251.description: 激活分散在代码标识符与路由、科学术语和论文表述、人名与人物描述、能源新闻及专利机械措辞中；没有跨段稳定共享的触发概念。

patterns.name: 词内 index 字符串
patterns.context: 大小写的 index 出现在技术路径、配置代码或 CSS 属性中；强激活集中在其字符片段

patterns.name: 能量市场资讯文本
patterns.context: hourly indexes 与 TVA、能源交易新闻的上下文

patterns.name: 葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶名称
patterns.context: 酶名及其编号、化学名称组成部分

patterns.name: Assignables 代码标识符
patterns.context: 出现在带有文件扩展名和坐标样式数字的代码文本中

patterns.name: Laravel 路由与认证代码
patterns.context: 登录页路由定义及认证控制器调用

patterns.name: 人名 Glenn Duffie Shriver
patterns.context: 专名在换行后重复出现

patterns.name: 萨克拉门托政治专栏作家描述
patterns.context: 介绍某人的影响力、职业和所在城市

patterns.name: 反应时间研究表述
patterns.context: 描述有无敲击任务干扰时的反应时间研究

patterns.name: 专利中的斜向布置描述
patterns.context: 描述货物导轨部分之间的分隔面及其倾斜布置

en.concept: Subword fragments of split proper names and terms
en.description: Activations span code and numbers, medical terminology and experimental procedures, project and business names, proper names and book titles in encyclopedia headings, and split uppercase headings. Activations often fall on split word fragments, but the examples have no shared semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structured numbers
patterns.context: In text such as code or file paths, activations fall on identifiers split by tokenization, periods, and colons, followed by digit strings.

patterns.name: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase name
patterns.context: In biomedical terminology, the name includes glucose 6-phosphate and the enzyme name; activations are distributed across split word fragments, numbers, and hyphens.

patterns.name: Character fragments in proper names
patterns.context: When proper names such as people and places in encyclopedia titles or openings are split into multiple subwords, some short character fragments activate; no clear shared meaning is apparent across these examples.

patterns.name: Procedures and hydrolysis in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Describes experimental procedures involving radiolabeling, treatment methods, and chromatographic analysis; stronger activations concentrate on procedural verbs and hydrolysis.

patterns.name: Disease-name heading
patterns.context: The medical article title contains “Minimal residual disease”; activation falls especially on split fragments of Minimal.

patterns.name: Business index name and plural suffix
patterns.context: An energy-market email mentions new hourly indexes from TradersNews Energy; activations fall on name fragments, a question mark, and the plural suffix of index.

patterns.name: Research project name
patterns.context: The project or research name Fragile Families and Child Wellbeing Study appears, with activations on split word fragments.

patterns.name: Clay in a book title
patterns.context: The encyclopedia article is titled after the novel Feet of Clay and repeats the title at the beginning; activation concentrates on split fragments of Feet.

patterns.name: Split uppercase heading
patterns.context: An uppercase heading or title is split into multiple short character fragments; it contains a string resembling “MORE TROUBLES FOR COMESA ~NA…”, but there is insufficient context to determine its full meaning.

7_251.concept: 被切分的专名与术语片段
7_251.description: 激活覆盖代码与数字、医学术语和实验操作、项目及商业名称、百科标题中的专名/书名，以及大写拆分标题。激活常落在被切分的词片，但各例没有统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构化数字
patterns.context: 代码或文件路径一类的文本中，激活落在被分词拆开的标识符、点号和冒号上，后接数字串。

patterns.name: 葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶名称
patterns.context: 生物医学术语中，名称包含 glucose 6-phosphate 及其酶名，激活分布在拆分的词片和数字、连字符上。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目记录/生物医学

patterns.name: 专名中的字符片段
patterns.context: 百科条目标题或开头的人名、地名等专名被分成多个子词时，部分短字符片段激活；这些例子之间未见明确共同词义。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的操作与水解
patterns.trigger: « procedure» « described» « introduces» « removed» « acid» « hydrolysis» « Using»
patterns.context: 描述放射性标记、处理方法及层析分析的实验过程；较强激活集中在操作动词和 hydrolysis。

patterns.name: 疾病名称标题
patterns.context: 医学文章标题中出现“Minimal residual disease”，激活尤其落在 Minimal 的拆分词片。

patterns.name: 商业索引名称及复数词尾
patterns.context: 能源市场邮件谈及 TradersNews Energy 的新 hourly indexes；激活落在名称片段、问号及 index 的复数词尾。
patterns.domain: Enron 商业邮件/能源市场

patterns.name: 研究项目名称
patterns.context: 项目或研究名称中出现 Fragile Families and Child Wellbeing Study，激活落在拆分词片段。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目记录/社会科学研究

patterns.name: 书名中的 Clay
patterns.trigger: «Fe» «et» « of» « Clay»，并在后文重复 «Fe» «et» « of»
patterns.context: 百科条目以小说书名 Feet of Clay 为标题，并在开头重复书名；激活集中在 Feet 的拆分片段。

patterns.name: 大写拆分标题
patterns.context: 大写标题或题名被切成多个短字符片段；标题含近似 “MORE TROUBLES FOR COMESA ~NA…” 的字串，但上下文不足以确定完整含义。

en.concept: Specialized long words and rare subword fragments
en.description: Activations often fall on specialized long words and their internal subword fragments: medical terminology, chemical reagents and methods, obliqu- forms, food names, and astronomical notation. tr-/trichlor- and obliqu- recur across passages, while the other patterns are more sporadic.

patterns.name: tr-/trichlor- forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments of long medical or chemical words beginning with tr, especially trichlor-; the words do not share meanings.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, analytical chemistry, and water treatment

patterns.name: obliqu- forms
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the string obliqu-, used to describe the course of the pulmonary artery and the axial tilt of a planet.

patterns.name: Chemical analysis and hydrolysis
patterns.context: Chemical treatments, analytical techniques, reagents, and compound names in method or experiment descriptions; several highly activated words are specialized long words.

patterns.name: Medical diagnosis and imaging terminology
patterns.context: Medical abstracts contain specialized terms related to diseases, tissues, or diagnostic imaging; highly activated locations are scattered within terms.

patterns.name: Specific food name
patterns.context: The name of an Indian carrot dessert and its introductory text, with activation on split fragments of the name.

patterns.name: Astronomy and numerical notation
patterns.context: Celestial names, angle values, and astronomical terms after a line break; the obliqu- fragment also appears in passage 4.

7_251.concept: 专业长词及罕见子词片段
7_251.description: 激活多落在专业长词及其内部子词片段：医学术语、化学试剂与方法、obliqu- 词形、食品名称和天文记号。tr-/trichlor-与 obliqu- 有跨段复现，其余模式较分散。

patterns.name: tr-/trichlor-词形
patterns.context: 激活落在以 tr 开头的医学或化学长词片段，尤其 trichlor-；词义并不相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分析化学与水处理

patterns.name: obliqu-词形
patterns.context: 激活集中于 obliqu- 字符串，分别用于描述肺动脉走向和行星轴倾角。

patterns.name: 化学分析与水解
patterns.trigger: « acid»8« hydrolysis»10；« hydrolysis»9；« mass»3« spectrometry»4；« tr»9«ichlor»...
patterns.context: 方法或实验描述中的化学处理、分析技术、试剂及化合物名称；若干高激活词是专业长词。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、催化研究、环境化学

patterns.name: 医学诊断与成像术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中出现疾病、组织或诊断成像相关专业词；高激活位置分散在术语内部。

patterns.name: 特定食品名称
patterns.context: 印度胡萝卜甜点名称及其介绍性文字，激活在名称的切分片段上。

patterns.name: 天文学与数值记号
patterns.context: 换行后的天体名称、角度数值和天文术语；obliqu- 片段也见于段4。

en.description: The strongest cross-domain pattern is the tokenized obliqu- word family, especially the subword «liqu»; the full proper name FK Metalurg Skopje also activates, as does the suffix of hydrolysis in two scientific abstracts.

patterns.name: Tokenized activation in obliquely
patterns.context: Words containing the obliqu- stem are split into multiple tokens; the strongest activation concentrates on the subword «liqu», while surrounding affixes and context play a weaker role.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; climate, patents, optics, sports, medicine, and other genres

patterns.name: Proper name FK Metalurg Skopje
patterns.context: The proper name and its token fragments activate continuously, followed by a line break and repeated FK; no clearly shared contextual condition with other patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Hydrolysis suffix subword
patterns.context: Triggered in the term hydrolysis; both examples are from scientific abstracts, but their surrounding topics differ.
patterns.domain: PubMed scientific abstracts; biochemical labeling or materials catalysis

7_251.description: 最强且跨领域的模式是 obliqu- 词族的分词片段 «liqu»；另有 FK Metalurg Skopje 专名整串激活，以及两篇科学摘要中 hydrolysis 的词尾激活。

patterns.name: obliquely 的分词激活
patterns.context: 包含词干 obliqu- 的单词被切分成多个 token；最强激活集中在子词 «liqu»，周围词缀及上下文只起较弱作用。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；气候、专利、光学、体育、医学等文体

patterns.name: 专名 FK Metalurg Skopje
patterns.context: 专名及其分词片段连续激活，后接换行和重复的 FK；未见与其他模式明显相同的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 维基百科；足球俱乐部名称

patterns.name: hydrolysis 词尾子词
patterns.context: 在术语 hydrolysis 中触发；两例均为科学摘要语境，但周围主题不同。
patterns.domain: PubMed 科学摘要；生化标记或材料催化

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous fragments, including tokenized multilingual words, code and punctuation, category labels, garbled text, file paths, and chemical symbols; no single theme explains all samples. Some triggers may be related to subword boundaries or special characters.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in Russian text
patterns.context: Russian words are split into multiple subword tokens; examples occur in a regex explanation for finding IP addresses and in an agricultural policy sentence.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, EuroParl political text

patterns.name: Personal-information field labels
patterns.context: A Russian table header uses vertical bars to separate personal-information fields such as name, address, postal code, and phone number.

patterns.name: Punctuation and identifiers in code
patterns.context: In code, source comments, or build configuration, activations fall near quotation marks, subwords within words, and code identifiers; contexts vary.

patterns.name: Category labels on a category page
patterns.context: A Wikipedia article lists categories for football players and clubs in consecutive Category lines.

patterns.name: Corrupted or nonstandard character sequence
patterns.context: An IRC message contains a string of characters that appears garbled or incorrectly decoded.

patterns.name: Network configuration path term
patterns.context: The Linux network interface configuration path /etc/network/interfaces is tokenized; it appears in a technical question about network settings and router behavior.

patterns.name: Calcium ion symbol
patterns.context: The symbol Ca+ appears in a biomedical abstract describing phospholipid hydrolysis and calcium mobilization related to muscarinic stimulation.

7_251.description: 激活分布于多语种拆分词、代码与标点、分类标签、乱码、文件路径及化学符号等异质片段；没有一个主题能解释全部样本。部分触发可能与子词边界或特殊字符有关。

patterns.name: 俄语文本中的分词片段
patterns.context: 俄语词语被拆成多个子词 token；分别出现在查找 IP 地址的正则说明和农业政策句子中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、EuroParl 政治文本

patterns.name: 个人信息字段标签
patterns.context: 俄语表格标题以竖线分隔姓名、地址、邮编和电话号码等个人信息字段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的正则表达式/数据格式讨论

patterns.name: 代码中的标点及标识符
patterns.context: 代码、源码注释或构建配置中，激活落在引号、词内子词及代码标识符附近；上下文各异。

patterns.name: 分类页面中的分类标签
patterns.context: 维基百科条目以连续的 Category 行列出足球运动员及俱乐部分类。

patterns.name: 损坏或非标准字符序列
patterns.context: IRC 发言处出现一串疑似乱码或错误解码的字节字符。

patterns.name: 网络配置路径词
patterns.context: Linux 网络接口配置路径 /etc/network/interfaces 被拆分；位于询问网络设置与路由器行为的技术问题中。

patterns.name: 钙离子符号
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，muscarinic 刺激相关的磷脂水解与钙动员描述里出现 Ca+ 符号。

en.concept: Abstract nouns and structured syntax fragments
en.description: Some passages highlight abstract nouns (often -tion or -ment words, as well as account); other triggers include regular-expression symbols, code operators and identifiers, and HTML tags. These are difficult to unify as one semantic feature.

patterns.name: Abstract nominal vocabulary
patterns.context: Abstract nouns denoting states, processes, attributes, or business outcomes appear in body text; common endings are -tion and -ment, although “account” does not follow this suffix pattern.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, encyclopedias, business, and psychology texts

patterns.name: Regular-expression symbols
patterns.context: Symbols occur in a regular expression used to match content such as IP addresses.

patterns.name: Operators and punctuation in code
patterns.context: Symbols appear in code or grammar-rule fragments, with dense operators and separators standing out.

patterns.name: Russian code identifiers and structural symbols
patterns.context: Russian identifiers appear alongside assignment, indexing, and code-formatting structures.

patterns.name: HTML markup and product-page fragments
patterns.context: Tags and attributes in an HTML product-page fragment appear next to prices and purchase buttons.

7_251.concept: 抽象名词及结构化语法片段
7_251.description: 一组段落突出抽象名词（多为 -tion、-ment 词，另有 account）；另有正则表达式符号、代码运算符与标识符、HTML 标签等结构化文本触发，难以归并为同一语义特征。

patterns.name: 抽象名词化词汇
patterns.context: 正文中出现表示状态、过程、属性或业务结果的抽象名词；常见词尾为 -tion、-ment，但 “account” 不符合这一词尾规律。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、百科、商业与心理学文本

patterns.name: 正则表达式符号
patterns.context: 符号处于用于匹配 IP 地址等内容的正则表达式中。

patterns.name: 代码中的运算符与标点
patterns.context: 符号出现在代码或语法规则片段中，密集运算符、分隔符较突出。

patterns.name: 俄文代码标识符与结构符号
patterns.context: 俄文标识符与赋值、索引和代码排版结构并列出现。

patterns.name: HTML 标记与商品页面片段
patterns.context: 商品页面 HTML 片段中，标签和属性与价格、购买按钮相邻。

en.description: The most prominent shared trigger is “development” and its neighboring research/intervention contexts, especially R&D, treatment, vaccines, and trials in biomedicine; it also responds to local phrases concerning agricultural breeding, philosophical argument, and public health.

patterns.name: Development followed by research/solution-related content
patterns.context: Appears when describing the R&D, establishment, or advancement of a product, method, treatment, vaccine, trial, or technology; common in the noun phrase “development of”, as well as “development and implementation”.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, patent backgrounds, and NIH research plans

patterns.name: Treatments and interventions
patterns.context: Discusses treatments, immunotherapy, or treatment regimens that improve disease outcomes; related passages also mention prospects for future treatment.

patterns.name: Biomedical research subjects and disease contexts
patterns.context: Describes organisms, diseases, pathological processes, antibodies, or vaccines in biomedical research; this pattern partly overlaps with R&D and treatment themes, but also includes research findings on growth and reproduction.

patterns.name: Causation and conservation of energy in physicalist arguments
patterns.context: Discusses how Christian physicalists respond to or use philosophical arguments.

patterns.name: Agricultural crops and hybrid breeding
patterns.context: Introduces crop varieties and production processes such as maize hybrid breeding and inbred lines.

patterns.name: Public-health relevance statements
patterns.context: Emphasizes the burden, harm, or importance of controlling disease in a public-facing or project-narrative style.

patterns.name: Outlook and prospects phrasing
patterns.context: Describes possible future research directions, treatment options, or medical advances.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, medical papers, and research plans

7_251.description: 最突出的共同触发是“development”及其邻近研究/干预语境，尤其是生物医学中的研发、治疗、疫苗和试验；同时也响应农业育种、哲学论证及公共卫生表述等局部词组。

patterns.name: development 后接研究/解决方案类内容
patterns.context: 出现在描述研发、建立或推进某种产品、方法、治疗、疫苗、试验或技术时；常见于名词短语“development of”，也有“development and implementation”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景及 NIH 研究计划

patterns.name: 治疗与干预措施
patterns.context: 谈及改善疾病结局的治疗、免疫疗法或治疗方案；相关段落也出现未来治疗前景。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究对象及疾病语境
patterns.context: 在生物医学研究中描述生物体、疾病、病理过程、抗体或疫苗；该模式与研发、治疗主题部分重叠，但也包括生长繁殖等研究结果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及研究计划

patterns.name: 物理主义论证中的因果与能量守恒
patterns.context: 讨论基督教物理主义者如何回应或使用哲学论证。

patterns.name: 农业作物与杂交育种
patterns.context: 介绍作物种类及玉米杂交育种、近交系等生产过程。

patterns.name: 公共卫生相关性陈述
patterns.context: 以面向公众或项目叙述的语气强调疾病负担、危害或控制的重要性。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、医学论文

patterns.name: 展望与前景措辞
patterns.context: 描述未来可能的研究方向、治疗选择或医学进展。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学论文及研究计划

en.description: High activations are scattered across the words separation, working, by, stability, refuge, and commitment; some are the words themselves, while others are embedded in different contexts, with no unified syntax or theme apparent.

patterns.name: separation
patterns.context: In accounts of interpersonal relationships or things being distinguished or separated, nearby text includes between; it may also refer to technical separation and purification.

patterns.name: working
patterns.context: Working describes people or groups engaged in some task, followed by a field or object.

patterns.name: by
patterns.context: By marks manner, means, or agent; it appears in a solvent extraction process and a calendrical expression, with differing semantic relations.

patterns.name: stability
patterns.context: Stability summarizes the stability of a team or lineup; the preceding text mentions experience, personnel, and familiarity with a system.
patterns.domain: Online article, possibly about a team or sports

patterns.name: refuge
patterns.context: A place of refuge is provided to persecuted people in a historical account of founding a colony.

patterns.name: commitment
patterns.context: An organization uses commitment to express its dedication to patients and patient care.

7_251.description: 高激活分散在 separation、working、by、stability、refuge、commitment 等词上；有些是词项本身，有些嵌在不同语境中，未见统一句法或主题。

patterns.name: separation
patterns.context: 在人际关系或事物被区分、分开的叙述中，附近出现 between；也可能是技术性的分离与纯化。

patterns.name: working
patterns.context: 以 working 描述人员或群体正在从事某项工作，后接领域或对象。
patterns.domain: 科研项目、医疗/教育、学术论文

patterns.name: by
patterns.context: by 作为方式、手段或执行者标记；分别出现在溶剂萃取工艺和历法表达中，语义关系不完全相同。

patterns.name: stability
patterns.context: 以 stability 概括团队或阵容的稳定性，前文提到经验、人员及熟悉系统。
patterns.domain: 网络文章，可能涉及团队或体育

patterns.name: refuge
patterns.context: 受迫害者被提供避难之处，出现在建立殖民地的历史叙述中。

patterns.name: commitment
patterns.context: 机构以 commitment 表达对患者及患者护理的承诺。

en.description: Activations are scattered across -ation in Cooper/international words, multi- compounds, and subwords in activity, by, involvement, collaboration, ample, and the place name Lucas; only a few show clear intra-word fragment patterns.

patterns.name: Cooperation in international collaboration names
patterns.context: In names of international organizations, conferences, or official documents, Cooperation is split into multiple subword tokens; activation falls on the word-final tion and the following preposition on
patterns.domain: Organization names, international cooperation, and policy documents

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in international(s)
patterns.context: The word internationals is tokenized, with activation concentrated on the middle «ation»; the context refers to international players

patterns.name: multi- compound fragments
patterns.context: Compounds beginning with multi-; examples occur in multi-purpose and multi-instrumentalist, with activation concentrated on multi
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, venues, and musician biographies

patterns.name: activity
patterns.context: In overviews of political columns, hearings, and other activities

patterns.name: by
patterns.context: Appears in the structure “is by exploiting” when describing methods of industrial espionage

patterns.name: involvement and collaboration
patterns.context: Activations fall on abstract nouns in descriptions of youth participation in projects and creative collaboration

patterns.name: ample
patterns.context: In academic papers discussing sufficient evidence

patterns.name: Subword in the name Lucas
patterns.context: The county name Lucas in a court-decision title is split into multiple uppercase tokens, with activation concentrated on UC

7_251.description: 激活分散于 Cooper/国际词中的 -ation、multi- 复合词，以及 activity、by、involvement、collaboration、ample 和地名 Lucas 的子词；仅少数呈现明确词内片段规律。

patterns.name: 国际合作名称中的 Cooperation
patterns.context: 国际机构、会议或公文名称中，Cooperation 被拆分为多个子词 token；激活落在词尾 tion 及其后介词 on
patterns.domain: 机构名称、国际合作与政策文书

patterns.name: international(s) 词内片段
patterns.context: 单词 internationals 被分词后，激活集中在中间的 «ation»，语境指国际球员

patterns.name: multi- 复合词片段
patterns.context: multi- 开头的复合词；出现于 multi-purpose 和 multi-instrumentalist 中，激活集中在 multi
patterns.domain: 百科全书条目，场馆及人物音乐简介

patterns.name: activity
patterns.context: 政治专栏、听证会与行动等活动的概述中

patterns.name: by
patterns.context: 描述工业间谍实施方式时，出现在“is by exploiting”结构中

patterns.name: involvement 与 collaboration
patterns.context: 介绍青少年参与项目及创作合作时，激活落在抽象名词

patterns.name: ample
patterns.context: 学术论文论述证据充足时
patterns.domain: 医学与性别多样性研究

patterns.name: Lucas 名字中的子词
patterns.context: 法律判决标题的县名 Lucas 被拆分为多个大写 token，激活集中在 UC

en.description: Activations span English, Russian, Bulgarian, German, and Chinese code comments, mainly falling on internal subwords or character fragments of tokenized words; uppercase word segments in legal titles also occur. There is no unified meaning or syntactic function.

patterns.name: “ation” within English compounds
patterns.context: Activations concentrate in international/cooperation-related English words split into multiple tokens, especially the internal “ation” fragment; surrounding word forms differ.

patterns.name: Character fragments within Russian words
patterns.context: In Cyrillic Russian text, activations fall on characters or subword fragments within words; examples concern geography, tabular names, and dialogue or meeting records, with no apparent fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: Russian encyclopedia, tabular data, meeting records

patterns.name: Slavic morphological word segments
patterns.context: In Bulgarian sentences, activations are scattered across internal subword fragments of inflected and long words; they are not limited to one word or syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian in the European Parliament corpus

patterns.name: Word boundaries in tokenization
patterns.context: In continuous German text, words are split into multiple subwords, with activations on internal fragments of verbs, nouns, and other words; no clear semantic constraint is apparent.

patterns.name: Uppercase word segments in court titles
patterns.context: In formal court-document titles, activations concentrate on the all-uppercase institution name and split “VETERANS”; line breaks and layout whitespace are also marked.

patterns.name: Chinese comments in code
patterns.context: In Chinese comments after Java method code, Chinese characters and punctuation are activated; similar patterns are scarcely present in the code body.

7_251.description: 激活跨英文、俄语、保加利亚语、德语及中文代码注释，主要落在拆分词的内部子词或字符片段；另见法律标题大写词段。没有统一词义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 英文复合词内部的“ation”
patterns.context: 激活集中在被拆分为多个 token 的国际/合作相关英文词中，尤其是内部的“ation”片段；前后词形不同。

patterns.name: 俄语词内部的字符片段
patterns.context: 西里尔文俄语文本中，激活落在词内的字符或子词片段上；涉及地理、表格姓名以及对话/议事文字，并无明显固定词义。
patterns.domain: 俄语百科、表格数据、议事记录

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语形态词段
patterns.context: 保加利亚语句子中，激活分散在屈折词和长词的内部子词片段；不局限于单一词或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会语料中的保加利亚语

patterns.name: 分词的单词边界
patterns.context: 德语连续文本中，词被切分成多个子词，激活出现在动词及名词等词内片段；未见明确语义限定。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法律/政策文本

patterns.name: 法院标题的大写词段
patterns.trigger: «UNITED»2 STATES COURT« OF»4« APPEALS»2« FOR»5« V»5«ET»9«ER»9«ANS»4…
patterns.context: 正式法院文书标题中，激活集中在全大写机构名称和拆分的“VETERANS”上，标题换行及排版空白也有标记。

patterns.name: 代码中的中文注释
patterns.context: Java 方法代码之后的中文注释中，中文字符及标点被激活；代码主体几乎未见同类模式。

en.description: The clearest repeated activation cue is the Russian ending «ение»; others are scattered across Bulgarian word forms, several words in Chinese technical notes, the Japanese particles «に» and «する», and Russian greetings and forms of address. Segment 5 lacks a clear corresponding cue.

patterns.name: Russian ending/morpheme «ение»
patterns.context: A common Russian noun ending, -ение, appears within a word; activation concentrates on this substring despite differences in surrounding meaning and syntax
patterns.domain: Russian parliamentary texts, encyclopedia quotations, Q&A

patterns.name: Russian «сближаване» stem
patterns.context: Appears in the Bulgarian phrase «Териториално, социално и икономическо сближаване»; it is not a clear instance of the Russian ending pattern

patterns.name: Chinese terms related to «服务»
patterns.context: Code comments describe cross-app launching and binding services for Android Intent
patterns.domain: Github, Java code and Chinese comments

patterns.name: Chinese «仅支持» description
patterns.context: Code comments describe the permitted character range for property or field names
patterns.domain: Github, C# code and Chinese XML documentation comments

patterns.name: «通过» in Chinese technical documentation
patterns.context: Describes the role of project-file and filter associations in the IDE

patterns.name: Japanese particle «に»
patterns.context: Appears as a case or locative particle in Japanese technical Q&A sentences, with activation at multiple positions

patterns.name: Japanese «する»
patterns.context: Verb form in a Japanese technical sentence; the same segment also contains a «に» particle pattern

patterns.name: Greeting in Russian Q&A
patterns.context: A greeting opens a question about changing a WebView address; activation concentrates within the greeting

patterns.name: Morpheme in Russian «адреса»
patterns.context: Appears in the title «Смена адреса WebView», referring to changing a WebView address

patterns.name: Scattered activations in Chinese project-file documentation
patterns.context: Chinese description of project-file and filter associations; salient activations are scattered, with no single clear triggering substring

7_251.concept: 多语种词素与功能词片段
7_251.description: 激活最明确的重复线索是俄语词尾「ение」；其余分散于保加利亚语词形、中文技术注释中的若干词、日语助词「に」与「する」，以及俄语问候和地址词。第5段缺少清楚对应线索。

patterns.name: 俄语词尾/词素「ение」
patterns.context: 词中出现俄语名词常见的 -ение 词尾，触发集中在该子串；周围词义和句法不同
patterns.domain: 俄语议会文本、百科引文、问答

patterns.name: 俄语「сближаване」词干
patterns.context: 出现在「Териториално, социално и икономическо сближаване」这一保加利亚语短语中；不是俄语词尾模式的明显实例
patterns.domain: EuroParl，保加利亚语政治/社会议题

patterns.name: 中文「服务」相关术语
patterns.trigger: 「服»务」，同段还出现「跨»应»用»启»动」「绑»定»服»务」
patterns.context: 代码注释中描述 Android Intent 的跨应用启动与绑定服务

patterns.name: 中文「仅支持」说明
patterns.trigger: 「仅»支»持」，处于「分组名称，仅支持中文、字母」中
patterns.context: 代码注释说明属性或字段允许的名称字符范围

patterns.name: 日语助词「に」
patterns.trigger: 「に」；多处出现，如「サーバーに」「期間内に」「ところに」
patterns.context: 日语技术问答句中作为格助词或处所助词出现，激活分布在多个位置

patterns.name: 日语「する」
patterns.context: 日语技术句中的动词形式；同段也有助词「に」模式

patterns.name: 俄语问答中的问候语
patterns.context: 在 WebView 地址更换的问题后以问候语开头；激活集中在问候词内部

patterns.name: 俄语「адреса」中的词素

en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords within words, word fragments, and function words in multilingual text: Chinese expressions of increasing degree, conjunctions, and version references; Japanese financial-registration wording; English content words and internal word fragments; and Russian and Bulgarian word fragments. The segments lack a stable shared semantic or grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: Chinese “越…越…” construction
patterns.context: Appears in “随着互联网的发展，保障用户的信息安全也越来越重要”; activation concentrates on “越来越,” expressing an increasing degree.

patterns.name: Japanese financial regulatory registration wording
patterns.context: Describes registration with Japan’s Financial Services Agency by a funds-transfer business operator; activations involve financial terms and grammatical components expressing registration.

patterns.name: Subword within English word col-ossal
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal subword fragment of the English word “colossal”; the surrounding sentence evaluates a player’s performance.

patterns.name: Internal Russian word fragments in an algorithm description
patterns.context: A Russian answer describes writing a custom function to find the minimum; activation is distributed across fragments within Russian word forms rather than a single complete word.

patterns.name: Fragments within Chinese words and subjective expression
patterns.context: After code output, the Chinese comment “我觉得你很麻…” appears, with strong activation on “觉得”; fragments in “香蕉” and “吗” also activate.
patterns.domain: Code and Chinese Q&A snippets on StackExchange

patterns.name: Function words in VC++ project-file documentation
patterns.context: Describes information included in a generated VC++ project file; “以及” connects file-version information with information about application usage. Local activations also occur on “包” and “生”.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in Russian technical instructions
patterns.context: Recommends installing a component unsupported by Java 5 and configuring it in pom.xml; strong activation falls on an internal fragment of “Установите” (install).

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in EU parliamentary text
patterns.context: Appears in Bulgarian text concerning agriculture, rural areas, and parliamentary procedure; activation falls on internal fragments of consecutive words.

patterns.name: Version-condition expression in Chinese technical text
patterns.context: A code comment describes restrictions on cross-app launching and binding services in versions above 5.0; activation concentrates on “以上”.

patterns.name: Content word in English marketing text
patterns.context: Activation falls on “content” in disclosures about affiliate marketing and hiding premium website content; nearby “more”, “great”, and “premium” also show weaker activation.

7_251.description: 激活分散在多语种文本的词内子词、词语片段和功能词上：中文程度递增、连接及版本表达，日语金融登记词句，英语内容词与单词内部片段，以及俄语、保加利亚语词形片段。各段缺少稳定共享的语义或语法模式。

patterns.name: 中文“越…越…”结构
patterns.context: 出现在“随着互联网的发展，保障用户的信息安全也越来越重要”中，激活集中在表示程度递增的“越来越”。

patterns.name: 日语金融监管登记表述
patterns.context: 描述资金转移业务经营者向日本金融厅登记；激活涉及金融业务词语及登记语法成分。

patterns.name: 英语词内部子词 col-ossal
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词“colossal”的内部子词片段；周围是评价球员表现的句子。

patterns.name: 俄语词形内部片段与算法描述
patterns.context: 俄语回答中描述编写自定义函数以寻找最小值；激活分布在俄语词形内部的片段，而非单一完整词。

patterns.name: 中文词语内部片段及主观表达
patterns.context: 代码输出之后出现中文评论“我觉得你很麻…”，其中“觉得”激活较强；另有“香蕉”“吗”等词片段激活。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的代码与中文问答片段

patterns.name: VC++ 项目文件说明中的功能词
patterns.context: 说明生成的 VC++ 项目文件所包含的信息；“以及”连接文件版本信息与应用程序使用信息。另有“包”“生”等局部激活。

patterns.name: 俄语技术指令中的词内片段
patterns.context: 建议安装 Java 5 不支持的组件，并在 pom.xml 中进行设置；强激活位于“Установите”（安装）的词内片段。

patterns.name: 欧盟议会文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在农业、乡村地区及议事程序相关的保加利亚语文本中；激活落在连续词语的内部片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 中文技术文本的版本条件表达
patterns.context: 代码注释说明跨应用启动和绑定服务在 5.0 版本以上的限制；激活集中于“以上”。
patterns.domain: 中文 Android 技术注释

patterns.name: 英语营销文本中的内容词
patterns.context: 联盟营销披露及网站隐藏高级内容的说明中，激活在“content”；邻近的“more”“great”“premium”也有较弱激活。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on within-word subwords or character fragments in multilingual text. Fragments near «ко» recur in Bulgarian, Polish, and Russian; several Chinese translation characters also show high activation. Other activations occur in copyright notices, technical Q&A, and multilingual word forms, making it difficult to infer a stable semantic or stylistic feature.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments near the suffix «ко»
patterns.context: When Russian, Bulgarian, Polish, and other words are split into multiple subwords, the fragment «ко» is adjacent to a following within-word fragment; Segment 1 also activates on «ら» in «何らか». The examples are not the same complete word
patterns.domain: Multilingual machine translation, language data, and technical text

patterns.name: Specific Chinese subword fragments
patterns.context: Single characters or subword fragments in Chinese sentences; they occur in software-interface translations, policy articles, and software-project descriptions, with no clear shared meaning
patterns.domain: Chinese translation strings and technical/policy documents

patterns.name: Character fragments in Russian copyright text
patterns.context: Character-level or subword-level fragments at the start of copyright notices and Russian text; activation falls within words rather than on complete words

patterns.name: Other highly activated language fragments
patterns.context: Markers are scattered across Bulgarian, Polish, and Russian sentences; no shared lexical or syntactic trigger can be confirmed
patterns.domain: European Parliament corpus and Russian Q&A

patterns.name: Within-word Chinese character fragments and numeric-code text
patterns.context: In a StackExchange explanation of HTTP status codes, activation falls on a Japanese kana fragment; the segment also contains numbers and English technical terms, but no clear rule shared with other segments

patterns.name: Scattered fragments in Q&A/code requests
patterns.context: In a Russian StackExchange question, markers are scattered across words used to request help and code; no reliable shared trigger pattern is apparent across other activated segments

7_251.description: 激活主要落在多语种文本的词内子词或字符片段；其中保加利亚语、波兰语、俄语里反复出现「ко」附近片段，中文译文也有若干高激活单字。其余分布在版权注释、技术问答和多语种词形中，难以归纳为稳定语义或文体特征。

patterns.name: 后缀「ко」附近的词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语/保加利亚语/波兰语等词被切分成多个子词时，片段「ко」紧邻后续词内片段；第1段另在「何らか」中「ら」处激活。各例并非同一完整词
patterns.domain: 多语种机器翻译、语言数据及技术文本

patterns.name: 中文特定子词片段
patterns.context: 中文句子中的单字或子词切分片段；分别处于软件界面译文、政策文章、软件项目说明中，没有明显共同语义
patterns.domain: 中文翻译字符串及技术/政策文档

patterns.name: 俄语版权文字中的字符片段
patterns.context: 版权声明及俄语文本开头的字符级/子词级片段，激活落在词内而非完整词上
patterns.domain: 代码注释、俄语版权声明

patterns.name: 其他高激活语言片段
patterns.context: 标记散布于保加利亚语、波兰语和俄语句子中，尚无可确认的共同词汇或句法触发条件
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会语料及俄语问答

patterns.name: 词内汉字片段与数字码文本
patterns.context: StackExchange 的 HTTP 状态码解释中，激活落在日文假名片段；段内还包含数字及英文技术词，但未见其与其他段共享的明确规则

patterns.name: 问答/代码请求中的零散片段
patterns.context: 俄语 StackExchange 提问中，标记散落在请求帮助和编写代码的词语中；与其他激活段没有可靠共同触发模式

en.description: Activations occur on within-word fragments or short words in Chinese, Japanese, Greek, Russian, and English. The only clear cross-segment repetition is the English competitive word family, which appears in technical, research, and business contexts. Other triggers are scattered and show no unified semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Nested within-word triggers: Chinese character-bound morphemes
patterns.context: Chinese characters are marked as standalone tokens or within-word fragments, often in longer compounds or technical descriptions; triggers are scattered, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Morphemes in continuous Japanese text
patterns.context: Activations fall on particles or within-word characters in Japanese sentences; examples involve IPN feature descriptions and a literary sentence, with different contexts.

patterns.name: Greek word-form fragments
patterns.context: A fragment of a word in a Greek parliamentary speech activates strongly; the surrounding discussion concerns left- and right-wing political positions.

patterns.name: Russian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on within-word fragments in Russian technical Q&A or sentences; the two instances have different semantic and syntactic contexts.

patterns.name: English competitive word family
patterns.context: Activates in collocations such as competitive design, competitive continuation funding, and competitive advantage; all three segments use the adjective competitive.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, research applications, business descriptions

patterns.name: Internal fragments in English compounds
patterns.context: In Segment 7, the same word competitive is split into comp + etitive, and both fragments are marked; this may relate to the word-family pattern.

7_251.description: 激活分布在中、日、希、俄、英语的词内片段或短词上；唯一清晰跨段重复的英语词族是 competitive，出现在技术、科研和商业语境。其余触发分散，未显示统一语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 词内嵌套触发：汉字限界词素
patterns.trigger: 「有限公司」中的「限」；「以」；以及「生」「包」「含」等
patterns.context: 中文字符以独立 token 或词内片段被标记，常见于较长的复合词或技术说明；触发点分散，未见一致语义条件。

patterns.name: 日语连续文本中的词素
patterns.context: 日文句子中，激活落在助词或词内字符上；分别涉及 IPN 功能说明和文学句子，语境并不相同。

patterns.name: 希腊语词形片段
patterns.context: 希腊语议会发言中，句内一个词的片段强激活；周边讨论左右政治立场。

patterns.name: 俄语词形片段
patterns.context: 俄语技术问答或句子中，激活落在词内片段上；两处语义和句法环境不同。

patterns.name: 英语 competitive 词族
patterns.context: 在竞争性设计、竞争性续资、竞争优势等搭配中激活；三段均为形容词 competitive。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、科研申请、商业描述

patterns.name: 英语复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 段7中同一 competitive 词被拆为 comp + etitive，两个片段均标记；可能与词族模式有关。

en.description: High activations are scattered across multilingual technical text, code, and websites, falling on Chinese 本/令/觉/仅, Japanese 動, Russian дело, Khmer fragments, and local words such as company names and 常亮; no stable shared semantic or syntactic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Chinese function word “仅”
patterns.context: Appears in Chinese/Japanese sentences explaining a restriction, object, or reason; the two instances differ in language and syntactic context, so a shared grammatical function cannot be confirmed
patterns.domain: Chinese-Japanese technical Q&A and code comments

patterns.name: Chinese character “本”
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “根本目的” (fundamental purpose) in a security explanation

patterns.name: Chinese character “令”
patterns.context: The word “令牌” (token) in an OAuth authorization-flow explanation

patterns.name: Khmer text string
patterns.context: A Khmer text fragment is followed immediately by the code field advisoryTitle; the visible fragment is incomplete

patterns.name: Russian boundary-value expression
patterns.context: A sentence discussing a value that cannot fall within a certain range and involving a boundary value

patterns.name: Chinese character “觉”
patterns.context: The colloquial Chinese expression “我觉得你很……” appears after code output

patterns.name: Japanese character “動”
patterns.context: A Japanese question title about the behavior of TextInput for gas

patterns.name: Final character in a company name
patterns.context: A company-name field on a customer-support or business page
patterns.domain: Website text, customer support, and company information

patterns.name: Character “亮”
patterns.context: An Android code comment describes keeping the screen always on

7_251.description: 高激活分散在多语种技术文本、代码和网页中，分别落在中文本/令/觉/仅、日文動、俄文дело、柬文片段及公司名、常亮等局部字词；看不出稳定共同语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 中文功能词“仅”
patterns.context: 位于解释限制、对象或原因的中文/日文句子中；两处语言和句法环境不同，无法确认共同语法功能
patterns.domain: 中日文技术问答与代码注释

patterns.name: 中文“本”字
patterns.context: 安全说明中“根本目的”这一固定短语

patterns.name: 中文“令”字
patterns.context: OAuth 授权流程说明中的“令牌”一词

patterns.name: 柬文字串
patterns.trigger: [4]“ប្រទេស”“អតថ”附近的柬文字符及其组合
patterns.context: 柬文文本后紧接代码字段 advisoryTitle；可见片段残缺
patterns.domain: 多语种代码或配置文件

patterns.name: 俄文边界值表达
patterns.context: 讨论某个值不能取某范围、涉及边界值的句子

patterns.name: 中文“觉”字
patterns.context: 中文口语句式“我觉得你很……”嵌在代码输出之后

patterns.name: 日文“動”字
patterns.context: 关于 gas 的 TextInput 行为的日文问题标题

patterns.name: 公司名称末字
patterns.context: 客户支持页或商业页面的公司名称字段
patterns.domain: 网页文本、客服与企业信息

patterns.name: “亮”字
patterns.context: Android 代码注释描述保持屏幕常亮

en.description: Activations occur on within-word subword fragments across multiple scripts, with examples in Japanese, Russian, Greek, Hebrew, and Chinese. No stable semantic, syntactic, or domain pattern is apparent; the feature appears to respond to specific subword/script fragments, and the sample is insufficient to infer a shared linguistic property.

patterns.name: Japanese «ら» forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on Japanese kana/word fragments, especially within words or phrases; the examples have no obvious shared meaning

patterns.name: Within-word Russian fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across within-word subword fragments in continuous Russian text, with no consistent syntactic or semantic position

patterns.name: Within-word Greek fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Greek text, responses fall on within-word subword fragments rather than on an evidently consistent word class or meaning

patterns.name: Hebrew/cross-script fragments
patterns.context: An English explanation contains a Hebrew proper name or term; activation falls on a Hebrew-letter fragment

patterns.name: Chinese characters and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Several characters or multi-character word fragments activate in Chinese technical explanations, with no stable semantic category apparent

patterns.name: Characters in an HTTP status-code explanation
patterns.context: Explains the HTTP 200 status code in Japanese; it may overlap with the Japanese-fragment pattern, but evidence is insufficient to determine whether the status code itself receives a specialized response

patterns.name: Russian explanation beside Python code
patterns.context: Russian text interspersed with Python function code; activation remains on Russian word fragments rather than code

7_251.description: 激活分布在多种文字中的词内子词片段：日语、俄语、希腊语、希伯来语和中文均有例子。没有稳定的语义、句法或领域模式；更像对特定子词/文字片段的响应，样本不足以提炼共同语言学特征。

patterns.name: 日语文本中的「ら」形态
patterns.trigger: 「何らか」中的「ら」；「いかにも」中的「か」、「少し」中的「し」
patterns.context: 激活落在日语假名/词语片段上，尤其在词内或短语中；这些例子之间没有明显共同词义

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语连续文本中，激活散布于词内子词片段，没有一致的句法或语义位置

patterns.name: 希腊语词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本，响应落在词内子词片段，而非显然一致的词类或语义

patterns.name: 希伯来语/跨文字片段
patterns.trigger: 「נשיא」中的「יא」；「בית דין」中的「ב」等希伯来字母片段
patterns.context: 英语说明中夹杂希伯来语专名或术语；激活在希伯来字母片段上

patterns.name: 中文字符与词组片段
patterns.trigger: 「社区」中的「区」；「节点」、「扩展名」附近的字符
patterns.context: 中文技术说明中，若干字符或多字符词片段被激活，未见稳定的语义类别

patterns.name: HTTP 状态码说明中的字符
patterns.context: 日语解释 HTTP 200 状态码；可能与日语片段模式重叠，但不足以确定对状态码本身有专门响应

patterns.name: Python 代码旁的俄语说明
patterns.context: 俄语文字夹着 Python 函数代码，激活仍在俄语词片段而非代码上

en.description: Primarily sensitive to Chinese characters and their token boundaries. Chinese appears in natural language, translation resources, code comments, or mixed Chinese-English text; the feature also responds to Japanese text mixing kanji and kana, and occasionally to corrupted text.

patterns.name: Chinese characters and token boundaries
patterns.context: Chinese sentences or phrases, often where Chinese words are split into multiple tokens, spaces appear between characters, or Chinese is mixed with English; no specific word meaning is required
patterns.domain: Chinese text, code comments, translation strings, encyclopedia prose

patterns.name: Japanese kanji-kana mixtures
patterns.context: Japanese characters mixed with Latin-letter abbreviations such as IPN in a Japanese technical explanation
patterns.domain: Japanese technical documents or Q&A text

patterns.name: Corrupted character-encoding background in Chinese text
patterns.context: A Japanese string contains garbled or corrupted characters; activation also covers adjacent normal Japanese characters

7_251.description: 主要对中文字符及其分词边界敏感，中文出现在自然语言、翻译资源、代码注释或中英文混排中；也响应日文汉字假名混排，偶见乱码背景。

patterns.name: 中文字符及分词边界
patterns.trigger: 中文字符，如「你」「喜」「香」「蕉」「源」「举」「观」「察」，以及中文子词之间的空位（«»）
patterns.context: 中文句子或短语，常见于中文词语被拆成多个 token、字符间有空位，或中英文混排的片段；不要求特定词义
patterns.domain: 中文文本、代码注释、翻译字符串、百科正文

patterns.name: 日文汉字假名混排
patterns.trigger: 「関」「連」「更」「新」「処」「理」等汉字及相邻假名、片假名
patterns.context: 日文技术说明句中，日文字符与 IPN 等拉丁字母缩写混排
patterns.domain: 日文技术文档或问答文本

patterns.name: 中文字符编码损坏背景
patterns.trigger: 「マー▯」「▯ャ」「オー▯」中的替换字符 ▯，与附近日文文本同现
patterns.context: 日文字符串出现乱码或字符损坏；激活同时覆盖相邻正常日文字符

en.description: Activations mainly fall on East Asian scripts and their local subwords or characters; they also occur near the English word “Traditionally,” Java annotations, and webpage markup. They are scattered across corpora and styles, with no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Highlighted Chinese characters in Chinese strings
patterns.context: Triggers are scattered across multiple Chinese words, often interspersed with unmarked Chinese characters; the feature does not appear to respond only to a fixed word or meaning
patterns.domain: Chinese websites, code comments, software localization text

patterns.name: “Traditionally” and its Chinese translation
patterns.context: An English word is marked in subword pieces at the beginning of a sentence, followed by a description of research practices or technical methods

patterns.name: Japanese kana phrase
patterns.context: A phrase mixing kana and kanji in the body of a Japanese email

patterns.name: Characters in Chinese proper names
patterns.context: A Chinese program title in an English introduction is marked character by character

patterns.name: Characters adjacent to HTML/XML markup
patterns.context: In webpage source code, activation appears beside HTML attributes and Chinese navigation/button text

patterns.name: English code decorator symbol
patterns.context: A Java annotation appears before a comparator method implementation; activation falls only on the @ symbol

patterns.name: Near garbled or replacement characters
patterns.context: The beginning of an application description contains anomalous or garbled characters, followed by a Chinese title

7_251.description: 激活主要落在中日韩文字及其局部子词、字符上；另在英文“Traditionally”、Java 注解和网页标记邻近处出现。跨语料与文体分散，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 中文字符串中高亮汉字
patterns.trigger: 中文文本中的单字，如「根」「本」「传」「统」「台」「创」等；另见「所有」「最大堆」
patterns.context: 触发分散在多个中文词语中，常与未标记的中文字符交错；不像是只响应某个固定词或语义
patterns.domain: 中文网页、代码注释、软件本地化文本

patterns.name: “Traditionally”及中文译义
patterns.context: 英文词被拆分标记，出现在句首，后接研究实践或技术手段的描述

patterns.name: 日文假名短语
patterns.context: 日文邮件正文中的假名及汉字混合短语

patterns.name: 中文专名字符
patterns.context: 英文介绍中的中文节目名被逐字标记

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标记邻接的字符
patterns.context: 网页源码中，激活出现在 HTML 属性与中文导航/按钮文案相邻处

patterns.name: 英文代码装饰符
patterns.context: Java 注解出现在比较器方法实现前，激活仅落在 @ 符号

patterns.name: 乱码或替代字符附近
patterns.context: 应用说明文本开头含异常字符或乱码，后接中文标题

en.description: Activations are mainly scattered across morphemes and short words in Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Hebrew, and other scripts, often in compounds, terminology, and website text; there is no single semantic theme, and a few Latin-letter strings also activate.

patterns.name: Japanese compounds and kanji morphemes
patterns.context: Activations fall on consecutive Japanese kanji or kana morphemes in Japanese sentences, book titles, or terminology; there is no single fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: Japanese financial explanations, literary quotations, bibliographies, and philosophical texts

patterns.name: Chinese two-character words and semantic collocations
patterns.context: In Chinese explanatory text, activation often falls on the component characters of two-character words, especially terminology or information-dense expressions.
patterns.domain: Algorithm comments, IDE documentation, browser security explanations

patterns.name: Chinese website navigation and acknowledgments
patterns.context: Short Chinese interface or explanatory text, such as website navigation labels and project acknowledgments.
patterns.domain: Website source code and open-source project documentation

patterns.name: Within-word Russian fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered within Russian word forms in descriptions of programs and accompanying materials, license conditions, and related topics.

patterns.name: Hebrew morphemes
patterns.context: Letters or morphemes within Hebrew words activate in institution names quoted in English encyclopedia prose.
patterns.domain: Hebrew proper names in encyclopedia articles

patterns.name: Scattered Latin letters and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Letter strings interspersed in code comments, links, or license text; activations are scattered and show no stable shared trigger
patterns.domain: Code, website source code, and license text

7_251.description: 激活主要散布在日、中、俄、希伯来等文字中的词素与短词，常见于复合词、术语和网页文本；没有单一语义主题，少量拉丁字母也被激活。

patterns.name: 日文复合词及汉字词素
patterns.trigger: 日文字符，如「資」「金」「移」「動」「業」「務」「提」「供」「され」「いかにも」「山」「独り」「生き」「心地」「悟り」「形而上学」「哲学」
patterns.context: 日语句子、书名或术语中，激活落在连续的日文汉字、假名词素上；并无单一固定词义。
patterns.domain: 日语金融说明、文学引文、书目及哲学文本

patterns.name: 中文双字词与语义搭配
patterns.context: 中文说明文字中，激活常落在双字词的组成字上，尤其是术语或信息较密集的表述。
patterns.domain: 算法注释、IDE 文档、浏览器安全说明

patterns.name: 中文网页导航及致谢用语
patterns.context: 网页导航标签、项目致谢等简短中文界面或说明文字。
patterns.domain: 网页源码与开源项目文档

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在俄语词形内部，覆盖程序及配套材料、许可条件等表述。

patterns.name: 希伯来语词素
patterns.context: 希伯来语词内的字母或词素被激活，位于英语百科正文引用的机构名称中。
patterns.domain: 百科文章中的希伯来语专名

patterns.name: 零散拉丁字母及数字表达
patterns.context: 代码注释、链接或许可文本中夹杂的字母串；激活较零散，未显示稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页源码及许可文本

en.description: Activations concentrate on continuous fragments in Chinese, Japanese, and other non-Latin scripts, especially Chinese technical explanations; they also cover multilingual quotations embedded in English and Chinese entertainment-related words. Topics vary across segments.

patterns.name: Functional descriptions in Chinese technical documentation
patterns.context: Chinese technical documentation, code comments, or explanations, especially consecutive Chinese words, grammatical particles, and punctuation; specific topics vary across segments
patterns.domain: Github code comments/documentation, Chinese website text

patterns.name: Japanese text fragments
patterns.context: Japanese sentences or technical Q&A; activations are distributed across multiple tokens in continuous Japanese text

patterns.name: Non-Latin scripts and multilingual proper names
patterns.context: Multilingual proper names or quotations appear in English narratives, biographies, or Q&A

patterns.name: Chinese entertainment-related words
patterns.context: Chinese words interspersed among English news, music-related text, and proper names; the context differs from other Chinese technical segments

7_251.description: 激活集中于中文、日文及其他非拉丁文字的连续片段，尤其包括中文技术说明；也覆盖夹在英文中的多语种引文和中文娱乐词语。跨段主题不统一。

patterns.name: 中文技术文档中的功能说明
patterns.trigger: 如“最…堆”“同源策略”“关联信息”“串口输出”“需要观察串口”等中文技术词语与说明文字
patterns.context: 中文技术文档、代码注释或说明中，尤其是连续的中文词语及其语法助词、标点；各段具体主题并不一致
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释/文档、中文网页文本

patterns.name: 日文文本片段
patterns.trigger: 「いかにも山の中に」「HTTP 200はOKという意味で」等日文假名、汉字及助词
patterns.context: 日语句子或技术问答；激活分布在日文连续文本的多个 token 上

patterns.name: 非拉丁文字与多语种专名
patterns.trigger: 希伯来文「המכון להסברת…」、俄文「Здравствуй」、中文「超级女声」
patterns.context: 多语种专名或引文出现在英文叙述、人物介绍或问答中

patterns.name: 中文娱乐类词语
patterns.context: 夹在英文新闻、音乐相关文字及专名之间的中文词语；上下文与其他中文技术段不同
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 混合语言网页文本

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the letter substring “ummy”: it appears in dummy (test, placeholder, or mock objects) and gummy (food), as well as in several semantically unrelated or abnormally segmented contexts.

patterns.name: dummy in strings
patterns.context: dummy combines with prefixes or suffixes to form code identifiers, test data, or names of temporary/mock things; activation centers on the substring ummy in dummy.

patterns.name: gummy food word
patterns.context: ummy occurs in the word gummy, adjacent to fajitas or bears; one other instance is adjacent to a non-food string.

patterns.name: ummy substring inside other words
patterns.context: The activation fragment appears as a substring within a word or near a string boundary, but the context does not form a clear, consistent semantic category; some words are split or appear in garbled text.
patterns.domain: Medical titles, medical abstracts, energy emails, and trading Q&A

7_446.concept: 字符串子串 ummy
7_446.description: 激活最稳定地落在字母子串“ummy”上：出现在 dummy（测试、占位或模拟对象）和 gummy（食品）中，也出现在数个语义不相干或切分异常的上下文里。

patterns.name: 字符串中的 dummy
patterns.context: dummy 与前缀或后缀组合成代码标识符、测试数据或临时/模拟事物名称；激活集中在 dummy 的子串 ummy。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、选举测试叙述

patterns.name: gummy 食品词
patterns.context: ummy 出现在 gummy 一词中，分别邻接 fajitas 或 bears；另有一次与非食品字符串相邻。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 随文文本、饮食/营养文章

patterns.name: 其他词内部的 ummy 字符串
patterns.context: 激活片段呈现为词内子串或字符串边界附近，但上下文不构成清楚一致的语义类别；其中有词语被切分或乱码样式文本。
patterns.domain: 医学标题、医学摘要、能源邮件及交易问答

en.description: The strongest activations mostly occur on the spelling fragment «ummy» (Dummy/yummy); others occur on heh in the name Maragheh and word-initial he in healing. Triggers span code, food, encyclopedia, and web contexts, suggesting a response primarily to local character or subword forms.

patterns.name: Dummy substring
patterns.context: Mixed-case “Dummy” appears in code identifiers or ordinary words; in segments 1, 5, and 6 it is part of an identifier, while in segments 2 and 3 it occurs in garbled, delimiter-like text.
patterns.domain: Code, encyclopedia narratives, and web text

patterns.name: yummy substring
patterns.context: Inside the lowercase word “yummy,” or in garbled text beginning with y followed by “ummy”; associated with food or adult-content contexts.
patterns.domain: Food reviews, health articles, adult web text

patterns.name: Fragment in the name Qush Qayeh
patterns.context: In the Persian name transliteration “Qush Qayeh Maragheh,” activation falls on the “heh” part at the end of the name.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in healing
patterns.context: In the quoted word “healing,” activation centers on the initial “he”; the sentence mentions healing springs.

7_446.concept: 对特定子词片段的响应
7_446.description: 最强激活多落在拼写片段 «ummy»（Dummy/yummy）上；另有名字 Maragheh 中的 heh、healing 词首 he。触发跨代码、食品、百科及网页语境，可能主要响应局部字符或子词形态。

patterns.name: Dummy 子串
patterns.context: 在代码标识符或普通词中出现大小写混合的 “Dummy”；第 1、5、6 段中它是标识符的一部分，第 2、3 段中处于乱码式分隔文本内。
patterns.domain: 代码、百科叙述及网页文本

patterns.name: yummy 子串
patterns.context: 小写单词 “yummy” 内，或乱码文本中以 y 开头、紧接 “ummy”；对应美食语境或成人内容语境。
patterns.domain: 食品评论、健康文章、成人网页文本

patterns.name: Qush Qayeh 名字中的片段
patterns.context: 波斯名字转写 “Qush Qayeh Maragheh” 中，激活落在名字末尾的 “heh” 部分。

patterns.name: healing 的内部片段
patterns.context: 引号括起的单词 “healing” 中，激活集中于词首 “he”；句子提到疗愈泉水。

en.description: Activation centers on the literal fragments “1038” and “url,” especially in DOIs, URLs, or URL-like identifiers; the rest is sporadic across local tokens in code, field names, API documentation, plotting Q&A, queries, and directory names, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: 10.1038 DOI identifier
patterns.context: Journal names, DOI prefixes, or DOI numbers occur; sometimes the DOI is split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: URLs and related identifiers
patterns.context: Code contains URL parameters, URL helper functions, or fictional URLs, or an identifier appears as a domain-like string

patterns.name: Hash algorithm name fragment
patterns.context: Appears as part of an identifier in Rust code near secp256k1-related code

patterns.name: Test users and status fields
patterns.context: User records and status text appear in Laravel/PHP test data construction

patterns.name: Ad campaign and label relationship
patterns.context: Google Ads protobuf resource names and their documentation strings describe the relationship between campaigns and labels

patterns.name: Plotting terminology
patterns.context: A ggplot2 Q&A title discusses line and point geometries for different data series

patterns.name: Bitmap and icon fallback
patterns.context: Test code calls an icon service and falls back to a style when icon retrieval fails

patterns.name: Spelling fragment and memory query
patterns.context: Code mixed with data records is followed by a SQL-like “select Mem… limit” query; the name/key fragment and the word for memory may trigger separately

patterns.name: Names and page-number typography in a directory
patterns.context: Names in bibliography-style directory lines are split by spaces, underscores, or tokenization and accompanied by page numbers

7_446.concept: URL/DOI 标识符片段
7_446.description: 激活集中于字面片段“1038”和“url”，尤其是 DOI、URL 或 URL 式标识符；其余分散在代码、字段名、API 文档、绘图问答、查询及目录姓名中的局部 token，缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: DOI 的 10.1038 标识
patterns.trigger: «1038»10，常与前面的《Nature Communications》及 DOI 片段同现
patterns.context: 出现期刊名、DOI 前缀或 DOI 编号时；有时 DOI 被拆成多个 token

patterns.name: URL 及其相关标识符
patterns.trigger: «url»10、«Url»10；也包括「10.1038/」中的 URL 式斜杠结构
patterns.context: 代码中出现 URL 参数、URL 辅助函数或虚构 URL，或标识符以域名式字符串呈现
patterns.domain: 软件代码与学术元数据

patterns.name: 哈希算法名称片段
patterns.context: Rust 代码中，作为标识符的一部分出现在 secp256k1 相关代码附近

patterns.name: 测试用户与状态字段
patterns.context: Laravel/PHP 测试数据构造中出现用户记录和状态正文

patterns.name: 广告活动与标签关系
patterns.context: Google Ads protobuf 资源名及其文档字符串描述活动与标签的关系

patterns.name: 图形绘制术语
patterns.context: ggplot2 的问答标题讨论不同数据系列的线和点几何对象

patterns.name: 位图与图标回退
patterns.context: 测试代码调用图标服务，并在图标获取失败时回退到样式

patterns.name: 拼写片段与内存查询
patterns.context: 代码夹杂数据记录，随后出现 SQL 式「select Mem… limit」查询；该姓名/键名片段与内存词可能分别触发

patterns.name: 目录中的姓名与页码排版
patterns.context: 书目式目录行中，姓名被空格、下划线或分词拆开，并附页码

en.concept: Compound identifiers and linked titles in technical text
en.description: Activation centers on technical strings with underscores or subword segmentation: code identifiers, configuration keys, and documentation terms; it also often occurs in Wikipedia Markdown link titles in HackerNews. Isolated cases involve diagnostic documentation, image-processing steps, and measurement expressions; link boundaries may contribute to triggering.

patterns.name: Wikipedia links and link text
patterns.context: Embedded Wikipedia or Markdown links in HackerNews posts, with titles split into multiple tokens; often accompanied by link previews, citations, or adjacent links.

patterns.name: Identifiers and underscore naming in code
patterns.context: Identifiers appear in code, configuration, or SQL/data-processing snippets, often adjacent to field, variable, or function names.
patterns.domain: Github code, configuration files, StackExchange programming answers

patterns.name: Subword segmentation within code identifiers
patterns.context: Class names, constants, configuration keys, or abbreviations in code are split into multiple subwords/tokens; not every occurrence of an underscore triggers activation.
patterns.domain: Github test code, documentation examples, configuration files

patterns.name: Documentation titles and linked technical terms
patterns.context: Occurs mainly in the title portion of Wikipedia links; words in titles are joined with underscores, or appear as proper names or technical terms.

patterns.name: Status/diagnostic text in technical explanations
patterns.context: Documentation text explaining program input handling, escaping rules, or exit status, mixed with command/manual-page markup.

patterns.name: Image-processing steps and label/contour terms
patterns.context: Describes steps for sorting by coordinates, extracting regions of interest, and binarizing labels.

patterns.name: Numeric and measurement expressions in natural language
patterns.context: A sentence gives terrain elevation difference as a number and unit, followed by a Wikipedia link title.

patterns.name: Numbering and Markdown link boundaries
patterns.context: Appears in quoted posts or Markdown link lists; these boundary tokens occur together with link titles, making it difficult to determine whether they trigger independently.

7_446.concept: 技术文本中的复合标识符与链接标题
7_446.description: 激活集中在带下划线或子词切分的技术字符串：代码标识符、配置键、文档术语；另常见于 HackerNews 的维基百科 Markdown 链接标题。单例还涉及诊断文档、图像处理步骤和测量表达，链接边界可能参与触发。

patterns.name: 维基百科链接及链接文本
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子中嵌入的维基百科链接或 Markdown 链接，标题被拆成多个 token；常伴随链接预览、引用或相邻链接。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符及下划线命名
patterns.trigger: “_status_es_for_a_user”“todo_include_todos”“predictions”“pred_and_labels”等，特别是下划线分隔的标识符
patterns.context: 代码、配置或 SQL/数据处理片段中出现标识符，常与字段名、变量名或函数名相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、配置文件、StackExchange 编程回答

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部的子词切分
patterns.trigger: “TestDummy::times”“m_db_load”“cf”“RTD”等混合大小写、缩写或分词后的代码片段
patterns.context: 代码中的类名、常量、配置键或缩写被拆成多个子词/token；并非所有出现下划线的情形都触发。
patterns.domain: Github 测试代码、文档示例、配置文件

patterns.name: 文档标题与技术术语链接
patterns.context: 主要出现在维基百科链接的标题部分；标题内部使用下划线连接词，或呈现专名、术语。

patterns.name: 技术说明中的状态/诊断文字
patterns.context: 说明程序输入处理、转义规则或退出状态的文档文字，夹杂命令/手册页标记。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、命令行手册风格

patterns.name: 图像处理步骤与标签/轮廓术语
patterns.context: 描述按坐标排序、提取感兴趣区域并对标签二值化的操作步骤。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术回答，图像处理

patterns.name: 自然语言中数值与测量表达
patterns.context: 句子中以数字和单位表达地形高差，后接维基百科链接标题。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 地理/铁路相关讨论

patterns.name: 编号及 Markdown 链接边界
patterns.trigger: “[1]”“[4]”“](http://...”等编号、方括号和链接分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在帖子引用或 Markdown 链接列表中；这些边界 token 与链接标题共同出现，难以断定单独触发。

en.concept: Lists of proper names and Swedish
en.description: One activation pattern occurs in dense lists of proper names and metadata such as institutions and personal names, often alongside numbers and punctuation; another broadly covers word subfragments in Swedish parliamentary or document text.

patterns.name: Lists of proper names and institutional entities
patterns.context: Proper names such as people, companies, organizations, and places occur densely, often comma-separated or in tables, legal bill names, email headers, author attributions, and institutional addresses; activation also covers some adjacent numbers, punctuation, and common words.
patterns.domain: Directories and tables, legal documents, code comments, encyclopedia entries, email, and academic attributions

patterns.name: Swedish text
patterns.context: Continuous Swedish sentences or parliamentary/document contexts; activation covers many Swedish words and their subword fragments, not just proper names.

7_446.concept: 专名串列与瑞典语
7_446.description: 一类激活于密集专名及机构、姓名等元数据串列，常伴随编号和标点；另一类广泛覆盖瑞典语议会或文书文本中的词语子片段。

patterns.name: 专名与机构实体串列
patterns.trigger: “Diners Club”“USA & Canada”“Charles G. MILLER”“Oracle Corporation”“Attaque 77”“Enron Energy Services”“Samuel”“Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona”
patterns.context: 姓名、公司、组织、地点等专名密集出现，常以逗号分隔，或处于表格、法律案名、邮件头、作者署名和机构地址中；激活也覆盖部分紧邻的编号、标点和普通词。
patterns.domain: 目录与表格、法律文书、代码注释、百科条目、邮件及学术署名

patterns.name: 瑞典语文本
patterns.trigger: “Angående den andra frågan”“Herr talman, ärade ledamöter”“Muntlige stemmeforklaringer”
patterns.context: 连续的瑞典语句子或议会/文书语境；激活覆盖大量瑞典语词及其子词片段，而非仅专名。

en.concept: Proper names and fields in structured text
en.description: Activation spans several kinds of structured text: email addresses and headers, IP/access logs, Swedish parliamentary speeches, Scala code, physics paper citations, and sports rosters. The shared feature appears to be a response to formatting markers, proper names, and segmented fields rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: Email headers and routing information
patterns.context: Email headers, forwarded messages, or recipient lists contain email addresses, domains, and routing fields; the email body need not have any particular content.

patterns.name: IP addresses and server logs
patterns.context: In server access or security logs, IP addresses are adjacent to structured fields such as requests and timestamps.

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary discussion text
patterns.context: Continuous Swedish sentences concerning social conditions, the environment, health legislation, or parliamentary debate.

patterns.name: Types and success values in code
patterns.context: A combination of Future, Success, and long class-like random strings in Scala-style code.

patterns.name: Symbols and citations in physics papers
patterns.context: Theoretical physics paper text discussing central symmetry, ensembles, and related literature citations.

patterns.name: Player entries in sports rosters
patterns.context: Line-by-line lists comprising names, position abbreviations, schools, and numbers.
patterns.domain: Sports player rosters or draft materials

7_446.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与字段
7_446.description: 激活覆盖多种结构化文本：邮件地址与邮件头、IP/访问日志、瑞典语议会发言、Scala 代码、物理论文引文及体育名单；共同特征更像对格式标记、专名和分段字段的响应，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: 电子邮件头部与邮件路由信息
patterns.trigger: “Received: from”“From:”“mail to:”以及地址中的“@”“.”和逗号
patterns.context: 邮件头部、转发邮件或收件人列表中出现邮箱地址、域名及路由字段；不要求特定邮件正文内容。

patterns.name: IP 地址与服务器日志
patterns.context: 服务器访问或安全日志中，IP 地址与请求、时间戳等结构化字段相邻。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 引用的服务器日志

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会讨论文本
patterns.context: 连续的瑞典语句子，涉及社会条件、环境、卫生立法或议会辩论。

patterns.name: 代码中的类型与成功值
patterns.context: Scala 风格代码中，Future、Success 与长的类随机字符串的组合。

patterns.name: 物理学论文的符号与引文
patterns.context: 讨论中心对称性、系综及相关文献引用的理论物理论文文本。

patterns.name: 体育名单中的球员条目
patterns.trigger: “(135)-x Matt Johnson, db, Eastern Washington”“(1152) Danny Coale, wr, Virginia Tech”“Oklahoma”
patterns.context: 姓名、位置缩写、学校和编号组成的逐行列表。
patterns.domain: 体育球员名单或选秀资料

en.description: Mostly occurs at boundaries of structured fragments in code or logs: the closing parenthesis, line number, and newline in Java stack frames are most prominent; also covers assignments, numeric lists, and field lines. One other case activates on the word ending of arrestering in a Swedish political sentence and is difficult to unify with the code pattern.

patterns.name: Android crash stack-trace line endings
patterns.context: Call frames in Java/Android exception stack traces, especially the closing parenthesis and newline after the line number

patterns.name: Android Activity crash stack trace
patterns.context: AndroidRuntime error logs containing Activity call frames, with a closing parenthesis and newline after the line number, followed by subsequent logs

patterns.name: Java/Spring call-frame endings
patterns.context: File line number and closing parenthesis at the end of Java stack frames, followed by a Maven artifact marker

patterns.name: Code assignment or field-initialization line endings
patterns.context: Code lines end after an assigned number or a closing parenthesis, often with indentation or a newline

patterns.name: Numeric expressions in statistical code
patterns.context: Near R-style numeric vectors, parameter assignments, or scientific notation expressions

patterns.name: Numeric matrices or coordinate data
patterns.context: Multiple comma-separated decimal values followed by code such as alpha1 <- par[1]
patterns.domain: Numeric data and statistical code / StackExchange

patterns.name: Specific word ending in a Swedish parliamentary speech
patterns.context: A formal condemnation concerning Israel's arrest of the Palestinian people; activation centers on the word ending

patterns.name: Indented attributes and form fields
patterns.context: Consecutive indented field/attribute names, comma-separated values, and null-coalescing-style assignments

7_446.concept: 结构化片段边界标记
7_446.description: 主要出现在代码或日志中结构化片段的边界：Java 调用帧的右括号、行号与换行最突出；也覆盖赋值、数值列表及字段行。另有一例激活于瑞典语政治语句的 arrestering 词尾，难与代码模式统一。

patterns.name: Android 崩溃堆栈行结尾
patterns.context: Java/Android 异常堆栈中的调用帧，尤其是行号后面的右括号和换行
patterns.domain: Android 日志／StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: Android Activity 崩溃堆栈
patterns.context: AndroidRuntime 错误日志中含 Activity 的调用帧，行号后接右括号、换行及后续日志
patterns.domain: Android 日志／StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: Java/Spring 调用帧结尾
patterns.context: Java 堆栈调用帧末尾的文件行号、右括号，后跟 Maven artifact 标记

patterns.name: 代码赋值或字段初始化行结尾
patterns.context: 代码行在赋值后的数字或右括号处结束，常伴随缩进或换行

patterns.name: 统计代码中的数值表达式
patterns.context: R 风格数值向量、参数赋值或科学计数法表达式附近

patterns.name: 数字矩阵或坐标数据
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的多组小数数值，后接 alpha1 <- par[1] 一类代码

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会演说中的特定词尾
patterns.context: 关于以色列拘捕巴勒斯坦人民的正式谴责语句；激活集中在词尾部分

patterns.name: 缩进式属性与表单字段
patterns.context: 连续缩进的字段/属性名、逗号分隔值和空值合并式赋值

en.description: Primarily responds to number-dense math problems: consecutive variable definitions, decimal arithmetic involving negative numbers, and requests to round or determine number properties. There is also sporadic activation on date/legal number formats and Jenkins Java environment code.

patterns.name: Arithmetic problems rounding decimals
patterns.context: A math problem first gives decimal values or an expression and asks for the result to be rounded to a specified precision; activation centers on the rounding wording, numbers, and operators.

patterns.name: Consecutive variable definitions and questions about results
patterns.context: Problems define multiple variables using Let, then form a subsequent expression with addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division, and ask for the result, rounded value, or a property; this can occur even without an explicit rounding request.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics arithmetic and number theory Q&A

patterns.name: Negative numbers and subtracting negatives
patterns.context: A numeric expression contains negative numbers, consecutive minus signs, or subtraction of a negative number, often alongside variable definitions and decimal-precision questions.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and numeric formats
patterns.context: Structured text contains numbers, dates and times, commas, decimal points, and periods, without visible mathematical reasoning context.
patterns.domain: StackExchange JSON/technical text; FreeLaw case titles and citations

patterns.name: Jenkins/Java environment code
patterns.context: Groovy-style build-script code involving directory cleanup, a try block, and setting Java environment variables.

patterns.name: Prime or composite classification
patterns.context: A numerical relationship or constructed expression is given first, followed by a question about whether the result is prime or composite.

patterns.name: Multiple-choice options and continuation of fill-in questions
patterns.context: A problem fragment contains answer options or is cut off mid-question; it may coexist with subsequent variable definitions, but the trigger evidence is weak.

7_446.concept: 数值密集文本与数学运算
7_446.description: 主要响应数值密集的数学题：连续定义变量、进行含负数的小数运算，并要求舍入或判断数的性质。另对日期/法律数字格式及 Jenkins Java 环境代码有零散激活。

patterns.name: 舍入小数的算术题
patterns.trigger: “rounded to”“rounded to four dps”“Round … to 5 decimal”“rounded to 7 decimal”
patterns.context: 数学题先给出带小数的数值或算式，并要求将结果舍入到指定精度；激活集中在舍入措辞、数字和运算符附近。

patterns.name: 连续定义变量并询问结果
patterns.context: 题目通过 Let 定义多个变量，使用加减、乘法或除法组成后续表达式，再问结果、舍入值或性质；即使未明确舍入也可出现。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 算术与数论问答

patterns.name: 负数及减去负数
