patterns.context: A README contains a NOTE instructing users to install a framework first; activation concentrates on NOTE and the following instructions

patterns.name: Geometric terminology in a mathematics paper
patterns.context: In an abstract describing a mathematical structure, activation falls on left-invariant

patterns.name: Derivative and variable expressions
patterns.context: Asks for a higher-order derivative of a function with respect to variable c

patterns.name: Time conversion and intervals
patterns.context: Given clock times, asks for the number of minutes or a time interval

patterns.name: Arithmetic problems in different bases
patterns.context: Specifies a base and asks for addition or subtraction of signed numbers; activation spans problems in multiple bases

patterns.name: Ordinal ranking queries
patterns.context: Asks for the specified rank after sorting several values

patterns.name: Technical description in a patent background
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph describes coal, sulfur content, and a treatment process

patterns.name: C/C++ header and macro code
patterns.context: Source code first includes a header, then defines a macro that compares and calculates a difference

7_1130.description: 激活分散于异质内容：README安装提示、数学论文术语、微积分与时间/排序题、多进制运算题、专利技术叙述及C/C++头文件和宏定义；没有贯穿所有段的明确共同触发模式。

patterns.name: Entity Framework 安装说明
patterns.trigger: "NOTE: You should first install the Entity Framework"
patterns.context: README 中出现 NOTE 提示，要求先安装某框架；激活集中在 NOTE 及其后续说明

patterns.name: 数学论文中的几何术语
patterns.context: 摘要描述数学结构时，激活落在 left-invariant 上

patterns.name: 导数与变量表达式
patterns.context: 询问函数在变量 c 上的高阶导数

patterns.name: 时间换算与间隔
patterns.context: 以钟表时间为输入，询问分钟数或时间间隔

patterns.name: 不同进制的算术题
patterns.trigger: "In base 11"、"In base 6"、"In base 9"、"In base 10"、"In base 8"、"In base 14"、"In base 4"、"In base 16"
patterns.context: 题目指定进制并要求对带符号数字进行加减；激活跨越多种进制题目

patterns.name: 序数式排序查询
patterns.context: 要求在若干数值中找出按大小排序后的指定名次

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术叙述
patterns.context: 专利背景段落描述煤、硫含量及处理过程

patterns.name: C/C++ 头文件与宏代码
patterns.context: 源代码先包含头文件，再定义一个比较并求差的宏

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper names beginning with Mont, split entity subword fragments, numbers in mathematical text, technical abbreviation fragments, and individual words in historical and biomedical contexts; there is no clear unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Mont- at the start or within a word
patterns.context: Names of people, places, or organizations beginning with Mont; activation falls on the Mont substring despite differing subsequent spelling and context.

patterns.name: Split subwords within entity names
patterns.context: Activation appears on fragments of proper names or compound words split by tokenization; the highlighted substring itself does not form a consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: Numbers in sequences or numerical problems
patterns.context: In mathematical problems or computational contexts, activation falls on number tokens; no clear shared operation condition is evident in any pair of examples.

patterns.name: Word fragments related to writing systems and number updates
patterns.context: Abbreviation or uppercase-word fragments in technical questions; the contexts concern remote updates and SQL updates, respectively.

patterns.name: The term tax farmer
patterns.context: The term is strongly activated when describing tax contractors under the French Ancien Régime.

patterns.name: The word infection
patterns.context: The word is strongly activated when describing the ability of HIV to establish infection in macaques.

7_1130.description: 激活分散在 Mont 开头的专名、拆分的实体词片段、数学文本中的数字、技术缩写片段，以及历史和生物医学语境中的单个词；没有明确统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词首或词内的 Mont-
patterns.context: 以 Mont 开头的人名、地名或机构名；激活落在 Mont 子串上，后续拼写和上下文不同。

patterns.name: 实体词内部的拆分子词
patterns.context: 激活出现在被分词拆开的专名或复合词片段中；高亮子串本身不构成一致语义类别。

patterns.name: 数字序列或数值题目中的数字
patterns.context: 数学题或计算上下文中，激活落在数字 token 上；未见两例共享的明确运算条件。

patterns.name: 书写系统、数字更新相关词片段
patterns.context: 技术问句中的缩写或大写词内部片段；上下文分别涉及远程更新与 SQL 更新。

patterns.name: 税农一词
patterns.context: 描述法国旧制度税务承包者时，该词受到强激活。

patterns.name: 感染一词
patterns.context: 描述 HIV 在猕猴中的感染建立能力时，该词受到强激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across mathematical and scientific text, vehicle patents, medical terms, code fields, and sports commentary. Local cues vary, including numerical comparisons, new, directions, ions, periodic structures, Name fields, and player evaluations; no unified semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and ordinals
patterns.context: Mathematics questions or computational expressions include ordinals, derivatives, variables, or requests to compare a set of values; nearby symbols include parentheses, commas, and minus signs

patterns.name: “new” in research-finding titles
patterns.context: In research titles or abstracts, new introduces a contribution, insight, or method
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts/titles, involving upconversion and species migration

patterns.name: Spatial directions and reverse trajectories
patterns.context: Describes vehicle position changing with a turn, or discusses curved trajectories in the opposite direction

patterns.name: Gallbladder cancer terminology
patterns.context: The cancer name and its repeated mentions; the word is tokenized into fragments such as “gall”, “bl”, and “adder”

patterns.name: Ion effects and sensitivity
patterns.context: Project descriptions discuss the effects of ions, especially potassium and calcium, on a form of sensitivity; the truncated word “neurom” appears at the end

patterns.name: Periodic structures and translation-invariant function spaces
patterns.context: Discusses perturbations of periodic structures and properties of a linearized operator in function spaces

patterns.name: Name fields and identifiers
patterns.context: In code or data records, a field named Name is followed by different types of identifiers and values

patterns.name: Sports commentary and player positions
patterns.context: Comments on whether a player met expectations, as well as their draft position and performance; then shifts to colloquial expressions of preference

7_1130.description: 激活分散于数学与科学文本、车辆专利、医学词项、代码字段及体育评论；局部触发线索各异，包括数值比较、new、方位、离子、周期结构、Name 字段及球员评价，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学表达式与序数
patterns.trigger: “the third derivative of u(c) wrt c?”；“biggest value in 2, -0.1, -20”
patterns.context: 数学问句或运算表达中出现序数、导数、变量，或要求比较一组数值；括号、逗号和负号等符号邻近

patterns.name: “new”研究发现标题措辞
patterns.context: 研究标题或摘要中，以 new 引出贡献、见解或方法
patterns.domain: 学术摘要/标题，涉及上转换、物种迁移

patterns.name: 空间方位与反向轨迹
patterns.context: 描述车辆位置随转向变化，或讨论相反方向的曲线轨迹

patterns.name: 胆囊癌词项
patterns.context: 癌症名称及其重复提及；词被分词为“gall”“bl”“adder”等片段

patterns.name: 离子效应与敏感性
patterns.context: 项目说明中讨论离子，尤其钾和钙，对某种敏感性的影响；末尾出现截断词“neurom”
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究项目说明

patterns.name: 周期结构与平移不变函数空间
patterns.context: 讨论周期结构扰动及线性化算子在函数空间中的性质

patterns.name: Name 字段与标识符
patterns.context: 代码或数据记录中，字段名 Name 后接不同类型的标识符和值

patterns.name: 体育评论与球员位置
patterns.context: 评论球员是否达到预期，以及其选秀位置和表现；随后转为口语化偏好表达

en.concept: Common English word forms and collocations
en.description: Activations concentrate on Always + verb, privat- forms related to privatization, and collocations of major with nouns from different fields; isolated fragments such as Golden State, Calvert, and when given also trigger activation.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases with Always
patterns.context: Capitalized Always at the start of a sentence, followed by a verb, indicates consistently performing an action; appears in an option and a recommendation

patterns.name: Privatization root
patterns.context: The stem privat- appears in privatization/privatisation and inflected forms, discussing privatization of industries or enterprises.
patterns.domain: Politics and public policy news, public services research

patterns.name: Collocations with major and superlative descriptions
patterns.context: major functions as an adjective or nominal modifier, referring to major components, complexes, sports leagues, or major investors; specific collocations vary.

patterns.name: Special or residual triggers
patterns.context: Seen only in individual contexts: the proper name Golden State, the tokenized fragment of Calvert, and the dosing expression when given in a clinical trial; no shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedia, news, clinical trial abstracts

7_1130.description: 激活集中于 Always + 动词、privat- 私有化词形，以及 major 与不同领域名词的搭配；另对 Golden State、Calvert 和 when given 等孤立片段有响应。

patterns.name: Always 固定短语
patterns.context: 句首大写的 Always，后接动词，表示始终执行某操作；分别出现在选择项和建议语句中。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、软件使用建议

patterns.name: 私有化词根
patterns.context: privat- 词干出现在 privatization/privatisation 及其屈折形式中，讨论行业或企业私有化。
patterns.domain: 政治与公共政策新闻、公共服务研究

patterns.name: major 搭配及最高级描述
patterns.context: major 作形容词或名词性修饰语，涉及主要组成、复合体、体育联盟，或主要投资者；具体搭配各异。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、体育百科、商业文本

patterns.name: 特殊或残余触发
patterns.context: 仅见于个别上下文，分别是专名 Golden State、Calvert 的分词片段，以及临床试验中 when given 的给药表达；缺少共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、新闻、临床试验摘要

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across the locative sense of opposite, legal and code terms, proper names, and token fragments; most high activations do not share an obvious semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Locative sense of opposite
patterns.context: When describing the relative position of places or objects, means “across from”; occurs in “opposite the two air intakes” and “opposite the Houses of Parliament”.

patterns.name: Subword fragment within proprietary
patterns.context: In a legal text, proprietary is split into subword tokens; strong activation falls on the final fragment etary, preceded by pri.

patterns.name: Legal use of govern
patterns.context: A legal discussion explains that a constitutional standard applies when medical care is refused.

patterns.name: Exceptionless name
patterns.context: Appears as the beginning of the software client proper name Exceptionless, followed by less.

patterns.name: Callback identifier fragment
patterns.context: In code, occurs in the Future method call f1.addCallback; activation falls on the add fragment of the identifier.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of leader’s
patterns.context: In a course description, the possessive apostrophe in team leader’s role is unusually encoded as a control-character token, which receives strong activation.

patterns.name: TypeScript name
patterns.context: In a headline about automatically converting a React codebase to TypeScript, activation falls on the Script fragment of the language name.

patterns.name: Isolated strong word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the sentence They customarily functions; tokenization splits customarily, and strong activation falls on custom.
patterns.domain: Web text, semantically or syntactically incoherent

patterns.name: Other relatively strong terms
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context, with no shared stable local structure or semantic trigger condition evident.
patterns.domain: Mixed code, technical, and course texts

patterns.name: Weakly related word senses or form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within split ordinary words or word-form fragments; there is insufficient evidence for a shared trigger pattern.

7_1130.description: 强激活分散在 opposite 的位置义、法律与代码词项、专名及分词碎片上；多数高激活没有共享的明显语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: opposite 的词义激活
patterns.context: 在描述地点或物体之间相对位置时，表示“在……对面”；出现于“opposite the two air intakes”和“opposite the Houses of Parliament”。
patterns.domain: 汽车维修说明、百科条目

patterns.name: proprietary 内部子词片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中，单词 proprietary 被拆成子词 token；强激活落在词尾片段 etary，前面紧邻 pri。

patterns.name: govern 的法律语境用法
patterns.context: 法律论述中，说明某项宪法标准适用于医疗照护被拒的情形。

patterns.name: Exceptionless 名称
patterns.context: 作为软件客户端专名 Exceptionless 的词首部分出现，后接 less。

patterns.name: Callback 标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码中位于 Future 的方法调用 f1.addCallback；激活落在标识符的 add 片段。

patterns.name: leader’s 的分词片段
patterns.context: 课程描述中 team leader’s role 的所有格符号被异常编码为控制字符 token，强激活落在该符号上。

patterns.name: TypeScript 名称
patterns.context: 在将 React 代码库自动转换为 TypeScript 的标题中，激活落在语言名称的 Script 片段。

patterns.name: 独立的强词片段
patterns.context: 出现在句中 They customarily functions；分词将 customarily 拆开，强激活落在 custom。
patterns.domain: 网页文本，语义或句法不连贯

patterns.name: 其他较强词项
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同语境中，未见共同的稳定局部结构或语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术、课程等混合文本

patterns.name: 弱相关的词义或词形碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的普通词内部或词形片段；没有足够证据支持共同触发模式。

en.description: The clearest cue is scope terms such as all and most, often co-occurring with content retrieval, provision, access, or listing; other content concerns time, evaluation, technical connections, and segment-specific topics, so the overall theme is scattered.

patterns.name: All, entire, or complete scope
patterns.context: Trigger words indicate totality, complete coverage, or an upper bound of scope; they sometimes directly modify an object and sometimes occur in phrases such as “all the …”.
patterns.domain: Web text, Q&A, technical documentation, patents, popular science, and sports ticketing

patterns.name: Retrieval, configuration, or provision of functionality
patterns.context: Software or service contexts describe obtaining, providing, accessing, or configuring a function; includes expressions about obtaining all items or an interface.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, Q&A, and product promotion

patterns.name: Collecting or presenting information and items
patterns.context: Lists or aggregates multiple items, data, resources, or information; some examples emphasize all available content.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, education, academic publishing, and product promotion

patterns.name: Routing or connection between technical objects
patterns.context: Describes routing, connection, or access relationships between signals, services, or computers.
patterns.domain: Patents, internet services, and computer technology texts

patterns.name: Time, date, or file timestamp
patterns.context: Mentions a date, time, or time-related attribute.

patterns.name: Evaluation and review
patterns.context: Reviews, evaluates, or checks assignments, learning performance, articles, or code.
patterns.domain: Education, academic, and software security texts

patterns.name: Specific terms, proper names, or heading formats
patterns.context: Technical documentation includes headings, section labels, regulatory names, or specialized terms; these forms themselves do not clearly share trigger points with other segments.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, code security, and regulatory technical texts

patterns.name: School learning and student progress
patterns.context: Describes teachers collecting evidence and assessing students’ learning and understanding.

patterns.name: Sports event ticketing and prices
patterns.context: Requests prices and explains prices for Angels opening-day game tickets.

patterns.name: Music service promotion
patterns.context: Promotes accessible online music and subscription services.

patterns.name: Vulnerability disclosure and code security
patterns.context: Notes that software developers failed to check all the code, then discusses a vulnerability.

patterns.name: File-system interface documentation
patterns.context: Describes an interface for reading or setting a file’s last-modified time.

7_1130.description: 最明显的线索是 all、most 等全量或范围词，常与获取、提供、访问或列举内容同现；另有时间、评估、技术连接及各段专属主题，整体主题分散。

patterns.name: 全部、所有或完整范围
patterns.context: 触发词表示全量、完整覆盖或范围上限；有时直接修饰对象，有时出现在“all the …”一类短语中。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、问答、技术文档、专利、科普及体育票务

patterns.name: 获取、配置或提供功能
patterns.context: 软件或服务语境中描述取得、提供、访问或配置某项功能；包含关于获取所有项目或接口的表达。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、问答及产品宣传

patterns.name: 汇集、呈现信息或项目
patterns.context: 列举或汇集多项内容、数据、资源或信息；有些例子强调全部可用内容。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、教育、学术出版及产品宣传

patterns.name: 技术对象间的路由或连接
patterns.context: 描述信号、服务或计算机之间的路由、连接或访问关系。
patterns.domain: 专利、互联网服务及计算机技术文本

patterns.name: 时间、日期或文件时间
patterns.context: 提及某项日期、时间或与时间相关的属性。

patterns.name: 评估与审查
patterns.context: 对作业、学习表现、文章或代码进行审阅、评估或检查。
patterns.domain: 教育、学术及软件安全文本

patterns.name: 具体术语、专名或标题格式
patterns.context: 技术文档中出现标题、章节标签、法规名或专门术语；这些形式本身与其他片段的触发点不明显一致。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、代码安全及法规相关技术文本

patterns.name: 学校学习与学生进展
patterns.context: 描述教师收集证据、评估学生学习与理解情况。

patterns.name: 体育赛事票务与价格
patterns.context: 围绕天使队开幕日比赛门票的询价与价格说明。

patterns.name: 音乐服务宣传
patterns.context: 宣传可访问的网络音乐及订阅服务。

patterns.name: 漏洞披露与代码安全
patterns.trigger: “Vulnerability:”“developers forgot to review all the code”
patterns.context: 指出软件开发者未检查全部代码，转入漏洞说明。

patterns.name: 文件系统接口说明
patterns.trigger: “filesystem library”“getting and setting the last write time”
patterns.context: 说明用于读取或设置文件最后写入时间的接口。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to numerical expressions, especially percentages followed by of-phrases, as well as quantities, units, and scale; local triggers also include code shuffle, cricket terminology, age limits, and domain-specific terms.

patterns.name: Percentages followed by quantity nouns
patterns.context: A percentage or ratio is followed by an of-phrase describing a share, quantity, or group within a whole.
patterns.domain: News, policy, research, and statistical descriptions

patterns.name: Large numbers and orders of magnitude
patterns.context: Numbers are split across multiple tokens, or scale is described using thousands, millions, and similar magnitudes; often adjacent to nouns or computational contexts.
patterns.domain: General explanatory prose, technical texts, statistical reports

patterns.name: Numbers, units of measurement, and prices
patterns.context: A numerical value combined with currency, weight, age, or other units to indicate cost, output, or a limit.
patterns.domain: Business reporting, mining news, social reporting

patterns.name: Shuffle instruction in program code
patterns.context: Appears in VM IR/code comments and test code, involving the shuffle instruction and vector masks.

patterns.name: Cricket term duck and its definition
patterns.context: Explains being dismissed without scoring in cricket and the usage of “breaking one's duck”, and mentions extended uses of the word outside cricket.

patterns.name: Majority in a proportion description
patterns.context: States that two mobile platforms account for most phones; the passage also includes a percentage of smartphone sales.

patterns.name: Under in an age-limit context
patterns.context: Describes teenagers below the legal drinking age and gives an age limit of 21.

patterns.name: Planned sample and follow-up completion
patterns.context: Reports the sample size, follow-up schedule, and completion rate for a study of BRCA mutation carriers.

patterns.name: Subscription prices and billing periods
patterns.context: Compares an annual fee converted to a monthly rate with a monthly subscription price, mentioning a music service.

patterns.name: Mineral output and monthly comparisons
patterns.context: Reports Peruvian mine gold production by month and relates cumulative output to a proportion.

patterns.name: Infrastructure proportion and water-quality risks
patterns.context: Gives the proportion of water-system pipes in the context of contaminants entering tap water due to aging infrastructure.

patterns.name: Energy supply security and import dependence
patterns.context: Discusses EU energy targets and uses the share of resources from abroad to indicate import dependence.

patterns.name: Specific date or precise time marker
patterns.context: A date at the beginning of a passage, followed by an estimate of readership; co-occurs with other numerical expressions in the passage.

patterns.name: BRCA genetic variant marker
patterns.context: A genetic variant identifier for mutation-positive families, appearing in a description of study samples.

7_1130.description: 主要对数字量化表达敏感，尤其是百分比后接 of 短语，以及数量、单位和规模；另有代码 shuffle、板球术语、年龄界限及若干领域专属名词等局部触发。

patterns.name: 百分比及其后续数量名词
patterns.trigger: «%» 后紧接 «of»，常再出现限定词和名词，如 «%»« of»« the»、«%»« of»« subjects»
patterns.context: 百分比或比例表达后接 of 短语，说明总体中的份额、数量或群体。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政策、科研和统计说明

patterns.name: 大数与数量级表达
patterns.trigger: «000»、«million»、«billion» 或带逗号的数值，如 «10»«000»、«100»« million»、«200»
patterns.context: 数字被拆分为多个 token，或用千、百万等数量级描述规模；常与名词或计算语境相邻。
patterns.domain: 一般说明文、技术文本、统计报道

patterns.name: 数字、计量单位及价格
patterns.context: 以数值加货币、重量、年龄等单位表示费用、产量或界限。
patterns.domain: 商业报道、矿业新闻、社会报道

patterns.name: 程序代码中的 shuffle 指令
patterns.context: 出现在 VM IR/代码注释与测试代码中，涉及 shuffle 指令及向量掩码。
patterns.domain: 程序代码与编译器测试

patterns.name: 板球术语 duck 及其释义
patterns.context: 解释板球中未得分出局和“breaking one's duck”的用法，并提及该词在板球以外的引申使用。

patterns.name: 比例描述中的 majority
patterns.context: 说明两类移动平台占手机的大多数；段中也出现智能手机销量百分比。

patterns.name: under 搭配年龄界限
patterns.context: 描述青少年低于法定饮酒年龄，并给出 21 岁界限。

patterns.name: 计划样本与随访完成情况
patterns.context: 报告 BRCA 突变携带者研究的样本数、随访安排及完成比例。

patterns.name: 订阅价格与计费周期
patterns.context: 比较年度费用折算月费与月度订阅价格，提及音乐服务。

patterns.name: 矿产产量与月份比较
patterns.context: 按月份报告秘鲁矿山黄金产量，并将累计产量与比例联系起来。

patterns.name: 基础设施比例及水质风险
patterns.context: 在老化基础设施导致污染物进入自来水的背景下，给出供水系统管道比例。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生与基础设施说明

patterns.name: 能量供应安全与进口依赖
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟能源目标，并以资源来自外部的比例说明进口依赖。

patterns.name: 特定日期或精确时间标记
patterns.context: 段首日期，后接关于读者规模的推算；与本段其他数字表达并存。

patterns.name: BRCA 基因变异标记
patterns.context: 作为突变阳性家系的遗传变异标识，出现在研究样本描述中。

en.description: Every passage includes proportions or numerical quantification; the most salient shared cue is of near percentages and their denominators. Numbers, units, and denominator structures also occur in contexts involving surveys, health, law, business, and personal finance.

patterns.name: Percentage followed by of / of the
patterns.context: A percentage value is followed by of, then a denominator such as a whole, group, or period; the values vary widely and are not limited to a particular proportion
patterns.domain: Statistics, reporting, legal, and everyday financial texts

patterns.name: Numbers in percentage expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in expressions of proportions or shares, often with of; however, numbers and percent signs are not marked identically in every passage
patterns.domain: Statistics, health, law, business, and personal finance

patterns.name: Quantity descriptions of fractions or proportions
patterns.context: States the proportion of a group or whole, or the share of a quantity relative to a total
patterns.domain: Survey results, demographics, health, and legal texts

patterns.name: Amounts or proportions associated with contracts and financial objects
patterns.context: Percentages describe contract shares, income-to-savings ratios, or bill-tip proportions
patterns.domain: Online discussions, travel guides, personal finance

patterns.name: Proportion plus statistical results
patterns.context: Uses percentages to report the composition, coverage, or outcomes of survey or program groups
patterns.domain: Organizational surveys, adoption programs, medical web-promotion research

patterns.name: Non-percentage uses of numbers and units
patterns.context: Numbers and units appear, but respectively refer to work effort, angles, or weight restrictions rather than percentages; if related to this neuron, the response may be to number/unit forms
patterns.domain: Business news, descriptions of legal restrictions

patterns.name: General numerical and denominator structures
patterns.context: Numbers, units, or percentages are followed by of-phrases, with denominators such as populations or working hours; some annotations fall on tokens adjacent to numbers

7_1130.description: 各段都含比例或数字量化表达，最显著的共同线索是百分数附近的 of 及其分母；也见数字、单位与分母结构，涉及调查、健康、法律、商业和个人财务。

patterns.name: 百分比后接 of / of the
patterns.trigger: «%»…«of»；尤其是“«50»% of the”、“«96» percent of”等
patterns.context: 百分比数值后出现 of，后接总体、群体或某个时期中的分母；数值跨度很大，不局限于特定比例
patterns.domain: 统计、报道、法律与日常财务文本

patterns.name: 百分比表达中的数字
patterns.context: 数字处于比例或占比表达中，常与 of 连用；但数字和百分号并非每段都以相同方式标记
patterns.domain: 统计、健康、法律、商业及个人理财

patterns.name: 分数或比例的数量描述
patterns.trigger: «of»后的总体或部分量词，如“«of» the surveyed organizations”、“«of» the children”、“«of» the Internauts”
patterns.context: 陈述某群体或总体所占比例，或某数量相对于总量的占比
patterns.domain: 调查结果、人口统计、健康与法律文本

patterns.name: 金额或比例与合同、财务对象
patterns.trigger: “«62»3.5«%» of the «contract»”、“«50»% of your «income»”及“«10»% of your … bill”
patterns.context: 百分比描述合同份额、收入储蓄比例或账单小费比例
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、旅行指南、个人理财

patterns.name: 比例加统计结果叙述
patterns.trigger: “«of» the «surveyed» organizations”、“«of» the «children» who participated”、“«of» the «Internauts» were women”
patterns.context: 以百分比报告调查或项目群体的组成、覆盖率或结果
patterns.domain: 组织调查、收养项目、医学网络宣传研究

patterns.name: 数字与单位的非百分比用法
patterns.trigger: “«100» percent of his or her efforts”、“«10» degree”、“«20» pound”
patterns.context: 出现数词和单位，但语义分别是工作投入、角度或重量限制，并非百分比；若与本神经元相关，可能是对数字/单位形式的响应
patterns.domain: 商业新闻、法律限制描述

patterns.name: 一般数值与分母结构
patterns.trigger: “«101»9”、“«81» percent of the Internauts”、“«3»% of children”、“«50»% of the workday”
patterns.context: 数字、单位或百分比之后接 of 结构，具体分母可为人群、工作时间等；部分标注落在数字邻近 token 上
patterns.domain: 医学、法律及调查统计文本

en.description: Activations concentrate mainly on further/further…more, indicating further advancement, expansion, or increase; these occur in contexts involving increases in amounts and scale, organizational initiatives, and advancing actions. A few passages concern the scale of technical deployments and cost-sharing in legal projects.

patterns.name: Further indicating advancement, increase, or continuation
patterns.context: At the beginning or within a sentence, introduces a further action, quantity, scope, cost, or delay, often paired with a following noun or verb; strong activation falls on further or nearby words.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, commercial copy, legal, and general online texts

patterns.name: Increase in quantity or scale
patterns.context: Involves quantified statements about amounts, proportions, quantities, or costs; includes comparative more or expressions of scale such as proportions, amounts, and bulk.
patterns.domain: News reports, insurance, software deployment, legal/infrastructure texts

patterns.name: Advancing plans, projects, and organizational action
patterns.context: Describes the launch, support, lobbying, or implementation of projects, initiatives, organizations, or collective action, including related funding situations.
patterns.domain: Community advocacy, political history, business email, event reports

patterns.name: Scaling technical deployments and teams
patterns.context: Software release and cloud deployment contexts emphasize helping teams expand capacity or deployment scale.

patterns.name: Cost-sharing in legal planning
patterns.context: Describes infrastructure plans and the proportions of costs borne by different parties.

7_1130.description: 激活主要集中在 further/further…more，表示进一步推进、扩展或增加；同时见于金额与规模增加、组织倡议和行动推进。少数段落涉及技术部署规模及法律项目费用分担。

patterns.name: further 表示推进、增加或后续
patterns.trigger: “Further”/“further”，后接 “enable”、“lobbying delegations”、“north”、“in annual premiums”、“Enron’s efforts”、“court filings”、“delay”；另有“further … more”
patterns.context: 在句首或句中引出进一步的行动、数量、范围、成本或延误，常与后续名词或动词搭配；强激活落在 further 或其后邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、商业宣传、法律及一般网络文本

patterns.name: 数量或规模的增加
patterns.trigger: “$15,000 more”，“$1,400 more”，“$18.5 million in damage”，“a large % of the largest Azure deployments”，“the bulk of this sewer”
patterns.context: 涉及金额、比例、数量或成本的量化陈述；出现比较性 more，或由比例、金额、bulk 等表达规模。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、保险、软件部署、法律/基础设施文本

patterns.name: 计划、项目及组织行动的推进
patterns.trigger: “launching a … pilot to help further enable”，“delegation … to request”，“This initiative should also further … efforts”，“organizers … fund the anniversary celebration”
patterns.context: 描述项目、倡议、组织或集体行动的启动、支持、游说或落实，也包括相关资金状况。
patterns.domain: 社区宣传、政治史、企业邮件、活动报道

patterns.name: 技术部署和团队规模化
patterns.trigger: “single-handedly helped thousands of dev teams to go beyond …”，“a large % of the largest Azure deployments”
patterns.context: 软件发布和云端部署语境，强调帮助团队扩大能力或部署规模。

patterns.name: 法律规划中的资金分担
patterns.trigger: “pay for the bulk of this sewer”，“Grayslake paying only”
patterns.context: 描述基础设施方案及不同主体承担费用的比例。
patterns.domain: 法律文件、地方基础设施规划

en.description: Primarily activates on the adverb further, often in verb phrases indicating advancement, continuation, or further handling; also includes more indicating an increase in quantity and a subword fragment of featured in a hiring list.

patterns.name: Subsequent actions with further
patterns.context: Used adverbially before a verb to indicate continuing, advancing, or adding subsequent action; followed by different elements including enable, sociological research, develop, remove, Enron’s efforts, consideration, raids, and activities
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; community initiatives, research, history, business, and general narration

patterns.name: more indicating an increase
patterns.context: Indicates an additional increase in a comparative or quantitative context; in segment 3, more occurs in the amount difference “$1,400 more in annual premiums”
patterns.domain: News reporting on personal insurance costs

patterns.name: Tokenized form of featured
patterns.context: In a web hiring list, featured is split into two consecutive subword fragments and activated; job openings and candidates are listed afterward

7_1130.description: 主要对副词 further 激活，常见于表示推进、延续或进一步处理的动词短语；另有 more 表示数量增加，以及招聘列表中 featured 的子词片段激活。

patterns.name: further 后续动作
patterns.context: 在动词前作副词，表示继续、推进或增加后续行动；后接 enable、sociological research、develop、remove、Enron’s efforts、consideration、raids、activities 等不同成分
patterns.domain: 跨领域；社区倡议、研究、历史、商业及一般叙述

patterns.name: more 表示增加
patterns.context: 比较或数量语境中表示额外增加；第3段的 more 位于金额差异“$1,400 more in annual premiums”中
patterns.domain: 个人保险费用的新闻报道

patterns.name: featured 切分形态
patterns.context: 网页招聘列表中，词 featured 被分成两个连续子词片段激活，后面列出职位与候选人

en.description: Activations occur in structures such as further, more, and of the, as well as in contexts involving quantity, progress, classification, coordination, and assistance. Trigger words and syntactic positions are inconsistent, so they cannot be reduced to a single stable feature.

patterns.name: Further / degree following than
patterns.context: Occurs before or after verbs or nouns to indicate continued progress, greater depth, or degree comparison; position varies.
patterns.domain: Web text, research, technical Q&A, political reporting

patterns.name: Of the structure
patterns.context: Common in “quantity/part + of the + noun” structures; activations concentrate near of and the.

patterns.name: More degree comparison
patterns.context: More indicates degree, quantity, or additional items in a list, with varying collocations.

patterns.name: Quantity and scale descriptions
patterns.context: Numerical values, units of measure, scale, or proportions; activations occur near quantity expressions.

patterns.name: Coordination or parallel comparison across entities
patterns.context: Describes cooperation between parties or parallel processing and comparison of multiple entities.

patterns.name: List or classification items
patterns.context: Contexts involving the enumeration and classification of items, positions, or questions.

patterns.name: Phased progress or time intervals
patterns.context: Describes project progress or the time and stages following an event.

patterns.name: Community support and assistance
patterns.context: Describes measures to support a community or reliance on aid; differs from the other trigger patterns.

7_1130.description: 激活分布于 further、more、of the 等结构及数量、进展、分类、协调和援助语境；触发词与句法位置不统一，无法归结为单一稳定特征。

patterns.name: further / than 后续程度
patterns.context: 出现在动词或名词前后，表示继续推进、深入或程度比较；位置不固定
patterns.domain: 网页文本、科研、技术问答、政治报道

patterns.name: of the 结构
patterns.trigger: “third of the issues” [6]、“rest of the team” [9]、“half of their food” [10]
patterns.context: 常见于“数量/部分 + of the + 名词”结构；激活集中在 of、the 附近
patterns.domain: 法律、技术问答、新闻报道

patterns.name: more 程度比较
patterns.context: more 表示程度、数量或列表中新增内容，搭配方式不一
patterns.domain: 新闻、矿业报道、招聘广告

patterns.name: 数量与规模表述
patterns.trigger: “23,000 metric tons” [7]、“$3 million” [8]、“63 million worth”及“280,000 cattle” [10]
patterns.context: 数值、计量单位、规模或比例信息；激活落在数量表达附近

patterns.name: 跨对象协调或并行比较
patterns.context: 描述双方协作，或多个对象并行处理与比较

patterns.name: 列表或分类项目
patterns.trigger: “featured jobs” [5]、“the third of the issues listed” [6]
patterns.context: 条目、职位或问题的列举与分类语境

patterns.name: 分阶段进展或时间间隔
patterns.trigger: “scheduled for June”及“commissioning was underway” [7]、“Three months after the storm” [10]
patterns.context: 描述项目进度或事件发生后的时间与阶段

patterns.name: 社区支持与援助
patterns.trigger: “Community Leaders’ pilot to help further enable” [1]、“relied upon aid” [10]
patterns.context: 描述支持社区的举措或依赖救济；与其他触发模式不同
patterns.domain: 社区项目、灾害救援报道

en.concept: Parts and members of a set
en.description: In most passages, “of” connects a quantity or part to a whole, commonly in “one/rest/some of…” and quantity structures; another passage is triggered by the exclusion expression “from further consideration.”

patterns.name: “of” connecting quantities, parts, and wholes
patterns.context: Connects a set with its components in expressions of quantity, ordinals, membership, or parts such as “rest/some”; often near “the” and group nouns.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedic text, legal documents, emails, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Subsequent consideration of excluded entities
patterns.context: Describes excluding certain entities from later evaluation or selection.

7_1130.description: 多数段落中，“of”连接数量或部分与整体，常见于“one/rest/some of…”及数量结构；另有一段触发于“from further consideration”的排除表达。

patterns.name: “of”连接数量、部分与整体
patterns.trigger: «of»，见“first of three”“rest of the team”“rest of the Rome Group”“21 of the 26 partners”“one of 10 defendants”“one of 9 Jalore contingents”“rest of the markup”“some of the companies”
patterns.context: 在数量、序数、成员或“rest/some”等部分表达中，连接集合与其组成部分；常靠近“the”及群体名词
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、法律文书、邮件及技术讨论

patterns.name: 排除对象的后续考量表达
patterns.trigger: «from»« further»« consideration»，尤其是“eliminate from further consideration”
patterns.context: 描述将某些对象排除出后续评估或选择

en.concept: Quantity and ordinal expressions in sets
en.description: Primarily responds to “of the” and preceding quantifiers, ordinals, or generalizing words, especially “most of the”; also covers set and ordinal expressions such as all the/all these, first of, and second of, as well as one of in a medical context.

patterns.name: Quantity phrase “of the”
patterns.context: In phrases expressing a quantity, proportion, or ranking within a whole, immediately following a number or quantifier; activation centers on the.

patterns.name: “most of the” quantity structure
patterns.context: Most is followed by of the, then a group, object, or component being counted or summarized.

patterns.name: “all the” generalizing structure
patterns.context: Makes a universal generalization about a group; can be followed by a specific noun or modify a range in a comparative sentence.

patterns.name: “first of” in a range or sequence
patterns.context: First of is followed by a quantity or set, indicating that an event or thing is part of a plan or series.

patterns.name: The second of two / second item
patterns.context: Second is followed by a set introduced by of two, or serves as an ordinal modifier of beneficiary.

patterns.name: Non-quantitative “one of”
patterns.context: Classifies a drug within a category, in the form one of + category noun.

7_1130.concept: 集合中的数量与序列表达
7_1130.description: 主要响应“of the”及其前面的数量、序数或总括词，尤其是“most of the”；也覆盖 all the/all these、first of、second of 等集合与序列表达，另有医学语境中的 one of。

patterns.name: 数量短语“of the”
patterns.context: 在表示整体中的数量、比例或排序的短语中，紧邻数字或数量词前；强度集中在 the。

patterns.name: “most of the”数量结构
patterns.trigger: «most»« of»« the»；原文如 “most of the men”“most of its branches”“most of the army”
patterns.context: most 后接 of the，再接被统计或概括的群体、物品或组成部分。

patterns.name: “all the”总括结构
patterns.trigger: «all»« the»，以及“all these places”中的 «all»« these»
patterns.context: 对一组对象作全称概括；可接具体名词，也可在比较句中修饰范围。

patterns.name: 范围或序列中的“first of”
patterns.trigger: “the first of three planned debates”及“the first of many steamboats”
patterns.context: first of 后接数量或集合，说明某事件、事物属于一个计划或系列。

patterns.name: 第二个／两者中的第二项
patterns.trigger: “the second of two virtually identical class actions”与“the second beneficiary”
patterns.context: second 后接 of two 的集合，或作为序数定语修饰 beneficiary。

patterns.name: 非数量性的“one of”
patterns.context: 将某药物归入一个类别，句式为 one of + 类别名词。

en.description: Primarily responds to the ordinal phrase “first of …”, often identifying the first item in a set, series, or event; also responds once to to in “adding to,” where it indicates addition or intensification.

patterns.name: Ordinal phrase “first of ten”
patterns.context: The ordinal first is followed by of + a quantity or limiting element, indicating the first item in a sequence, category, or set; modifiers may intervene.
patterns.domain: Narrative texts such as encyclopedic, legal, and news writing

patterns.name: “adding to” followed by a quantity
patterns.context: Adding to is followed by a noun phrase and indicates intensifying or increasing something; in this example, the quantity marker falls on to.

7_1130.description: 主要响应序数短语“first of …”，常用于指出集合、系列或事件中的首项；另有一次响应“adding to”中表示增添、加剧的 to。

patterns.name: 序数短语“first of ten”
patterns.context: 序数 first 后接 of + 数量或限定成分，表示某序列、类别或集合中的首项；中间可插入修饰语
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、新闻等叙述性文本

patterns.name: “adding to”及其后接数量
patterns.context: adding to 后接名词短语，表示加剧或增加某事；本例数量标记落在 to

en.description: Activates mainly in comparative increment expressions such as little/a bit more and more or less, and also in quantity comparisons with more/less and do more work; sporadic triggers include added/adding to, encyclopedic time adverbs, and newest.

patterns.name: Comparative degree phrases
patterns.context: The degree word little immediately precedes more, meaning “slightly more” or a comparative increment; passage 1 also contains the contrastive phrase more or less the same.

patterns.name: Numerical comparisons in sequences or proportions
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts comparing quantity, proportion, or degree; some examples also contain little more.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, web reporting, technical discussions

patterns.name: Expressions of addition or its result
patterns.context: Adding to describes something further worsening a situation; added to describes people being included in a team.

patterns.name: Adverbial expressions of time and events
patterns.context: Marks a period or adds another experience or position when narrating past events; triggers are scattered and do not form the same fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Degree modifier newest
patterns.context: Uses newest to describe one of three objects in a comparison.

patterns.name: Additional work or comparison
patterns.context: More modifies subsequent work or comparison, indicating that something still needs to be done further.

patterns.name: Legal payment and proportion limits
patterns.context: Defines a payment proportion range by percentage in the context of contract rescission.

patterns.name: Resignation and worsening conditions
patterns.context: A company executive resigns, and the event is reported as one factor worsening ongoing turmoil.

7_1130.description: 主要激活于 little/a bit more、more or less 等比较增量表达，也见 more/less 数量比较及 do more work；另有 added/adding to、百科时间副词和 newest 等零散触发。

patterns.name: 比较程度短语
patterns.context: 程度词 little 紧邻 more，表示“稍多一些”或比较增量；第 1 段也出现对照式 more or less the same。
patterns.domain: 多种文体中的普通比较表达

patterns.name: 序列或比例中的数值比较
patterns.context: 出现在数量、比例或程度的比较语境中；部分例子同时有 little more。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、网页报道、技术讨论

patterns.name: 新增或加入的结果表达
patterns.context: adding to 描述某事进一步加剧局面；added to 描述人员被纳入队伍。

patterns.name: 时间与事件的副词表达
patterns.context: 在叙述过去事件时标示期间或补充另一项经历、职务；触发词分散，未形成相同固定短语。

patterns.name: 程度修饰词 newest
patterns.context: 在对三个对象作比较时，以 newest 描述其中之一。

patterns.name: 额外工作或比较
patterns.trigger: «do»« some»« more»« work»；«do»« a bit»« more»« comparison»
patterns.context: more 修饰后续工作或比较，表达尚需进一步进行某事。

patterns.name: 法律支付与比例限制
patterns.trigger: «a little»« more»« than»« 10»«%» but« less» than« 20»«%»
patterns.context: 合同撤销背景下，以百分比界定支付比例区间。

patterns.name: 辞职及局势恶化
patterns.context: 公司负责人辞职，并被报道为加剧持续动荡的一环。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of increase, addition, extra amounts, and comparative degree, especially additional/add/added near quantities, time, durations, or newly added items; also covers comparative words and uses meaning intensification of a situation, with some nearby function words activating as well.

patterns.name: Comparative or additive degree
patterns.context: Compares configurations, quantities, or degree, or proposes making something more forgiving; activations concentrate on comparative words and nearby expressions.

patterns.name: Extra or added
patterns.context: Indicates that something is added or increased, or that something is extra; often used with to or as a noun modifier.
patterns.domain: Patent background, encyclopedias, forums, news emails, legal texts

patterns.name: Added time or duration
patterns.context: Explicitly discusses time taken, extra duration, or a legal time limit; time units or time/period occur near expressions of increase or addition.
patterns.domain: Patent background, legal texts, corporate emails

patterns.name: Extra objects, functions, or maintenance
patterns.context: Describes newly added roles, functions, equipment, or maintenance items, with added time not being the core concept.

patterns.name: Progression to consequences or a change in circumstances
patterns.context: An event is described as worsening an existing situation rather than simply increasing a quantity.

patterns.name: Common function-word combinations in phrases
patterns.context: Activations also fall on articles, prepositions, or nearby nouns in specific phrases; these local collocations do not constitute a unified, independent semantic trigger condition.

7_1130.description: 主要响应增加、添加、额外及比较程度表达，尤其是 additional/add/added 与数量、时间、期限或新增项目相邻；也覆盖比较词和加剧局势的用法，部分邻近虚词一并激活。

patterns.name: 比较或增减程度
patterns.context: 比较配置、数量或程度，或提出让某事更宽松；激活集中在比较词及其邻近表达。

patterns.name: 额外或增加
patterns.context: 表示某项内容被添加、增加，或某事物属于额外部分；常与 to 连用，或修饰名词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、百科、论坛、新闻邮件、法律文本

patterns.name: 增加的时间或期限
patterns.context: 明确讨论耗时、额外时长或法律期限；时间单位或 time/period 与增加、额外等表达相邻。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、法律文本、企业邮件

patterns.name: 额外的对象、功能或维护
patterns.context: 描述新增的职务、功能、设备或维护项目，不以时间增加为核心。

patterns.name: 递进至后果或局势变化
patterns.context: 某事件被描述为加剧既有局势，而非单纯增加数量。

patterns.name: 短语中的常见虚词组合
patterns.context: 激活也落在特定词组中的冠词、介词或邻近名词上；这些局部搭配不构成统一的独立语义触发条件。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to structures in which additional precedes a noun, covering new functions, costs, permissions, terms, and more; it also responds to expressions of increased or cumulative results such as added efficiency and adds … total. Other weak activations are scattered across their respective contexts.

patterns.name: Additional followed by a noun
patterns.context: Used attributively before a noun or in an “additional …” noun phrase; the noun phrase often describes new staffing arrangements, functions, efficiency, costs, power, or algorithm components.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, patents, Q&A, emails, and academic papers

patterns.name: Increase and cumulative result
patterns.context: Describes the quantity or result of an increase or addition; one instance uses added attributively, and another uses adds as a verb followed by cumulative time taken.
patterns.domain: Engine patent background; manufacturing-process patent background

patterns.name: Degree and improvement
patterns.context: One passage asks about the extent of an improvement; another emphasizes the complete version in a casual comment. The triggers differ, and the semantic connection is weak.

patterns.name: Quantity comparison and emphasis
patterns.context: Compares gun incidents with the number of gun purchases, using the comparative more and quantity expressions. Activation is weak, with no common trigger phrase immediately nearby.

patterns.name: Incidental activation of general vocabulary or syntax
patterns.context: In passage 1, the strongest activation is on «additional»10, while several ordinary words earlier in the passage show weaker activation; no condition consistent with the main trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in the Nascom 2 feature context
patterns.context: Strong activation still corresponds to additional features; weaker markers such as these and that may simply reflect nearby context and do not show an independent, stable pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a patent sentence
patterns.context: These words occur in a diesel-engine efficiency comparison, but strong activation corresponds to «added»9 efficiency; the other words do not yet support an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a StackExchange sentence
patterns.context: Discusses adding solar lights to existing fixtures; apart from add and other words related to addition, activations are scattered, so no independent unified trigger condition can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a patent manufacturing process
patterns.context: Describes time spent on manufacturing and testing steps; strong activation falls on adds … total. The other activations may relate to the sentence’s cumulative-time expression, but evidence is insufficient to distinguish further patterns.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a patent equipment-cost sentence
patterns.context: Discusses bidirectional information flow and smart-appliance costs; the main strong activation is «additional»9 cost, while the other words do not show an independent, stable pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a HackerNews comment
patterns.context: Several weak activations occur in expressions about the extent of an improvement and the complete version; beyond the degree/improvement pattern noted above, they cannot be classified as a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in an email about legislation
patterns.context: Describes a proposed bill granting coordination authority; the strongest activation is «additional»9, while other words are scattered across the syntactic structure.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a paper sentence
patterns.context: Discusses regularization and the number of tasks in incremental learning; the strongest activation is «additional»9, while surrounding words may be contextual co-activations.

7_1130.description: 主要对 additional 后接名词的结构强烈响应，涵盖新增功能、成本、权限、术语等；也响应 added efficiency、adds … total 等增加及累积结果表达。其余弱激活分散于各自语境。

patterns.name: additional 后接名词
patterns.trigger: «additional»9/10；以及其后名词，如 «additional»10 ADC、«additional»10 «features»3、«additional»9 efficiency/cost/powers/regularization term
patterns.context: 在名词前作定语，或与后续名词短语构成“额外的……”；名词短语常描述新增的人事安排、功能、效率、成本、权力或算法项。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、问答、邮件、学术论文等多种文体

patterns.name: 增加与累积结果
patterns.context: 描述增加、添加所带来的量或结果；一次以 added 作定语，另一次以 adds 作谓语，后接累积耗时。
patterns.domain: 发动机专利背景；制造工艺专利背景

patterns.name: 程度与改进
patterns.context: 一段询问改进幅度；另一段在口语评论中强调完整版本。两例触发词不同，语义联系较弱。

patterns.name: 数量比较与强调
patterns.context: 围绕枪支事故与枪支购买数量作比较，出现比较级 more 和数量表达。激活较弱，且没有紧邻的共同触发短语。

patterns.name: 一般词汇或句法偶发激活
patterns.context: 第1段的显著激活集中在 «additional»10，但前文若干普通词也有较弱激活；看不出与主触发模式一致的条件。

patterns.name: Nascom 2 功能语境中的零散激活
patterns.context: 强激活仍对应 additional features；these、that 等较弱标记可能只是邻近语境，未呈现独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: 专利句中的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在柴油机效率比较语境，但强激活对应 «added»9 efficiency，其他词暂不足以构成独立模式。

patterns.name: StackExchange 句中的零散激活
patterns.context: 谈论在既有灯具之外增加太阳能灯；除 add 等与添加语境相关外，激活词分散，无法确认独立统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 专利制造流程中的零散激活
patterns.context: 描述制造与测试步骤耗时，强激活落在 adds … total；其余激活可能与该句的累积耗时表达有关，但证据不足以细分。
patterns.domain: USPTO 制造工艺专利背景

patterns.name: 专利设备成本句中的零散激活
patterns.context: 讨论双向信息流与智能家电成本；主要强激活为 «additional»9 cost，其他词未显示独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: HackerNews 评论中的零散激活
patterns.context: 改进幅度与完整版本的表达中出现若干弱激活；除前述程度/改进模式外，不能归为统一触发。

patterns.name: 邮件法案语境中的零散激活
patterns.context: 描述拟议法案授予协调权限；强激活为 «additional»9，其他词散布于句法结构中。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的政策讨论

patterns.name: 论文句中的零散激活
patterns.context: 讨论增量学习中的正则化与任务数；强激活为 «additional»9，周边词可能是上下文伴随激活。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions such as additional/added and more that indicate increase or added degree; also responds to supplemental content, further development, and the quantity phrase little more. Additional also triggers when used as a title modifier.

patterns.name: Additional / added additions
patterns.context: Indicates extra people, content, tables, capabilities, or efficiency; [8] is Additional in a title.

patterns.name: Degree or quantity of more
patterns.context: Compares or indicates an additional quantity or degree; common structures include more information, more than, more incentives, and more commonly.

patterns.name: Act of adding or supplementing
patterns.context: Explicitly describes adding insight to existing content; occurs alongside additional.

patterns.name: Development and further refinement
patterns.context: Indicates further progress or deepening of an existing project rather than a direct increase in quantity.

patterns.name: Little modifying comparative quantity
patterns.context: Little combines with more to indicate slightly more or slightly exceeding a quantity; [10] also contains “more than half”.

7_1130.description: 主要响应 additional/added、more 等表示增加或额外程度的表达；也响应补充内容、进一步发展，以及 little more 的数量短语。Additional 作职衔修饰语也触发。

patterns.name: additional / added 增补
patterns.context: 表示额外增加的人、内容、表格、能力或效率；[8]为职衔中的 Additional。
patterns.domain: 专利、百科传记、邮件、新闻

patterns.name: more 的程度或数量
patterns.context: 比较或表示额外数量、程度；常见结构为 more information、more than、more incentives，也包括 more commonly。

patterns.name: 添加、补充的动作
patterns.context: 明确描述在已有内容上补充 insight；与 additional 同现。

patterns.name: 发展、进一步完善
patterns.context: 表示继续推进或深化已有项目，而非直接表示数量增加。
patterns.domain: 电视制作相关百科叙述

patterns.name: little 修饰比较数量
patterns.context: little 与 more 连用，表示稍多或略超过某数量；[10]另有“more than half”。

en.description: Activations occur most consistently in the incremental expression “little more” and where additional modifies a noun; they also appear in “adding to,” meaning increase or intensification, and “more information,” expressing a need for further information. The contexts span forums, news, legal, business, and encyclopedic texts.

patterns.name: “a little more” expressing an increase in degree or quantity
patterns.context: “Little more” forms an incremental expression of quantity, degree, or a feature, usually preceded by a; it modifies information, forgiving, hitboxes, flippant, or a percentage following rescission.

patterns.name: Additional followed by a noun
patterns.context: Additional precedes a noun to indicate an extra position, person, authorization, table, or maintenance item; capitalization and sentence structure vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, news, police reporting, business and legal texts

patterns.name: Adding to + noun phrase
patterns.context: Adding to introduces an increase or intensification of an existing state, such as turmoil; it need not occur in the same sentence as additional.

patterns.name: Other weaker uses of more
patterns.context: More modifies the noun information to express a need for further information; the same passage also contains little more, but this marker is weaker and adjacent to the highly activated phrase.

7_1130.description: 激活最一致地出现在“little more”递增表达，以及 additional 作名词前置修饰语处；也见于“adding to”表示增加、加剧，和“more information”表达进一步需求。跨论坛、新闻、法律、商务及百科文本。

patterns.name: “a little more”表达程度或数量增加
patterns.context: “little more”构成数量、程度或特征的递增表达，通常前有 a；修饰 information、forgiving、hitboxes、flippant 或 rescission 后的百分比等。

patterns.name: additional 后接名词
patterns.context: additional 位于名词前，表示额外的职务、人员、权限、表格或维护；大小写不同，所在句式也不同。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、新闻、警务报道、商务法律文本

patterns.name: adding to + 名词短语
patterns.context: adding to 引出某种既有事态的增加或加剧，如 turmoil；不要求与 additional 同句出现。

patterns.name: 其他较弱的 more 用法
patterns.context: more 修饰名词 information，表达需要进一步的信息；同段另有 little more，但此处标记较弱且与高激活短语相邻。

en.description: Strong activations mainly concentrate on expressions of more, extra, or further, commonly involving “more” and its degree modifiers, as well as “additional” and “further”; a few local triggers occur in particular collocations, across scattered contexts.

patterns.name: Increase in quantity or degree
patterns.context: Expresses a need for, provision of, or increase in more of something; sometimes qualified by “a little,” “a bit,” or “additional,” and may use “further” to indicate further development or promotion.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, business emails, news, and encyclopedic narrative

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers in lexical or syntactic collocations
patterns.context: These words occur in various syntactic and semantic environments; some do not clearly express increase or comparison, so it is uncertain whether they belong to the same main pattern.

7_1130.description: 强激活主要集中在更多、额外或进一步的表达，常见于“more”及其程度修饰语，也包括“additional”“further”；另有少量搭配中的局部触发，语境分散。

patterns.name: 数量或程度增加
patterns.trigger: “more”后接程度、时间、信息或形式等，如“a little more information”“a little more forgiving”“additional forms”“additional and undefined powers”“a bit more time”
patterns.context: 表达需要、提供或增加更多某物；有时由“a little”“a bit”“additional”限定，也可出现“further”表示进一步发展或促进。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、商务邮件、新闻及百科叙述

patterns.name: 词汇或句法搭配的零散触发
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在多种不同句法和语义环境中；部分并不明确表达增加或比较，无法确定是否与主模式相同。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various word-initial or internal token fragments: Inter- (especially interactions), Ass-, Legacy, programmed, Spanish title fragments, and connexin. Most occur in titles or abstracts, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word-initial Inter- segmentation
patterns.context: Word-initial Inter is tokenized separately, with subsequent tokens forming a complete word; includes interactions and interictal.

patterns.name: Lexical triggers in titles
patterns.context: Word-initial Ass combines with subsequent fragments to form Assessment or Assets; activation concentrates on the word-initial fragment and immediately following suffix.

patterns.name: Legacy strategy phrase
patterns.context: Legacy policy appears in statements about management systems and network policies.

patterns.name: programmed in patents
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of the field of an invention, describing programmable and reprogrammable logic gate arrays.

patterns.name: Spanish title word fragments
patterns.context: Token fragments from Spanish titles; stronger activations include conjunctions and prepositional fragments between words.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the connexin channel term
patterns.context: Appears in biomedical discussions of CL-CT interactions and connexin channels; activation concentrates on the tokenized word connexin.

7_1247.concept: 分词边界／词形片段响应
7_1247.description: 激活分散于多种词首或词内分词片段：Inter-（尤其 interactions）、Ass-、Legacy、programmed、西语标题片段及 connexin。多数来自标题或摘要，缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Inter-词首切分
patterns.context: 词首 Inter 被单独切成 token，后续 token 拼成完整单词；包括 interactions 和 interictal。

patterns.name: 标题中的词汇性触发
patterns.context: 词首 Ass 与后续片段组成 Assessment 或 Assets，激活集中于词首及紧邻后缀。

patterns.name: 遗留策略短语
patterns.context: Legacy policy 出现在关于管理系统和网络策略的陈述中。

patterns.name: 专利中的 programmed
patterns.context: 出现在发明领域说明中，描述可编程、可重新编程的逻辑门阵列。

patterns.name: 西班牙语标题字词片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语标题的分词片段；较强激活包括单词间的连接词与介词片段。

patterns.name: 连接蛋白通道词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 CL-CT 相互作用及连接蛋白通道的生物医学讨论中；激活集中于被切分的 connexin 词。

en.concept: Lexical and formatting cues at the start of titles
en.description: Strongly responds to the word-initial forms of Interactions and Assessment/Assessing, especially title-style openings in biomedical titles; also responds to Assets in financial enumerations and the form label Assessment Only.

patterns.name: Title opening with “Interactions”
patterns.context: Begins with “Interactions between …”, followed by the interacting entities; all three examples show high activation on “Interactions”.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles or abstract headings

patterns.name: Word-initial “Assessment” and title phrasing
patterns.context: Begins with “Assessment of …”, describing the evaluation of an effect, change, condition, or method.

patterns.name: Other forms of Assessment or repeated formatting
patterns.context: Includes a title opening with “Assessing …”, or “Assessment Only” in a table or form, including repeated line breaks.
patterns.domain: Biomedical titles, administrative or financial text

patterns.name: Accounting item enumeration
patterns.context: “Assets” appears as the first item in a financial enumeration, followed by liabilities, expenses, and income.

7_1247.concept: 标题开头的词汇与格式线索
7_1247.description: 强烈响应 Interactions 和 Assessment/Assessing 词首，尤其是生物医学标题中的标题式开头；另响应财务列举中的 Assets 及表单标签 Assessment Only。

patterns.name: “Interactions”标题开头
patterns.context: 以“Interactions between …”开头，后接相互作用的对象；三例均以“Interactions”高激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要标题

patterns.name: “Assessment”词首及标题句式
patterns.context: 以“Assessment of …”开头，描述对某种效应、变化、病症或方法的评估。

patterns.name: Assessment 的其他形式或重复排版
patterns.context: 出现“Assessing …”标题开头，或表格/表单中的“Assessment Only”及换行重复。
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题、行政或财务文本

patterns.name: 会计项目列举
patterns.context: “Assets”作为财务项目列举的首项，后续列出负债、费用和收入。

en.description: All snippets mark from, which has the highest activation; it occurs in expressions of source, origin, derivation, and inverse coordinate transformations. Nearby articles, prepositions, and technical content vary, and no stable trigger pattern independent of from is apparent.

patterns.name: Source or origin expressions introduced by from
patterns.context: Appears in phrases explaining where, from whom, or on what basis something arises, begins, or is transformed; nearby elements often include to, a, the, or formulas/technical terms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English technical explanations, code comments, Q&A, and narrative

patterns.name: Function words and local collocations adjacent to from
patterns.context: These words also activate in multiple snippets, but generally less strongly than from; they occur in varied syntactic positions and show no stable independent semantic condition.

7_1247.concept: from及来源/起点关系
7_1247.description: 所有片段都标记了 from，且强度最高；它出现在来源、起点、推导依据、坐标反变换等表达中。周围冠词、介词及技术内容各异，暂看不出独立于 from 的稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: from 引出的来源或起点表达
patterns.context: 出现在说明某事物从何处、由何者或根据什么产生、开始、转换的短语中；附近常见 to、a、the 或公式/术语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文技术说明、代码注释、问答及叙述

patterns.name: 与 from 相邻的功能词和局部搭配
patterns.context: 这些词在多个片段中也有激活，但强度通常低于 from，分布于多种句法位置，未显示稳定的独立语义条件。

en.description: Activations concentrate on derivation transitions and explanations following equations in mathematical discourse, especially steps introduced by “Then”; there are also responses to corollaries, proofs, guarantees, definitions, calculations, and “where”-style explanations of conditions.

patterns.name: Derivation steps introduced by “Then”
patterns.context: Follows an equation or prior discussion and introduces the next derivation, calculation, or conclusion; Then is marked in multiple passages

patterns.name: Summary inferences after a theorem, equation, or argument
patterns.context: Explains that an equation or prior conditions support a conclusion, property, or subsequent construction

patterns.name: Explanation of relations or conditions following equations
patterns.context: Adds definitions of variables, functions, or conditions in equations after a formula
patterns.domain: Explanations of formulas in mathematical papers

patterns.name: Proof process and mathematical conclusion terms
patterns.context: Describes proof, guarantees, definitions, or calculations in formal mathematical derivations; the trigger words vary, but all occur near equations

7_1247.concept: 数学推导衔接与说明
7_1247.description: 激活集中于数学论述中的推导衔接和公式后说明，尤其是“Then”引出步骤；另对推论、证明、保证、定义、计算及“where”式条件解释有响应。

patterns.name: “Then”引出的推导步骤
patterns.context: 位于公式或先前论述之后，引入接下来的推导、计算或结论；在多个段落中标记的都是 Then

patterns.name: 定理、等式或论证后的总结推论
patterns.trigger: “So actually”“It follows”“which is consistent with”“which is compatible with”“Then, as you noted”
patterns.context: 说明公式或先前条件支持某个结论、性质或后续构造

patterns.name: 公式后的关系或条件说明
patterns.context: 公式之后补充定义变量、函数或方程中的条件
patterns.domain: 数学论文中的公式说明

patterns.name: 证明过程与数学结论词
patterns.context: 在形式化数学推导中说明证明、保证、定义或计算操作；触发词彼此不同，均出现在公式附近

en.description: Activations occur mainly in mathematical LaTeX text, especially the set-membership symbol \in and nearby formulas, variables, and line breaks; there are also norm formulas and questions about Borel sets.

patterns.name: Set-membership symbol in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical definitions, propositions, or formulas to indicate that an object belongs to a set; often adjacent to variables, set names, and formula punctuation.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers and math Q&A, mainly LaTeX

patterns.name: Formula boundaries and line breaks in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on formulas or boundaries between formulas and prose, including multiline layouts; these positions also often co-occur with set-membership symbols, so it is unclear whether line breaks are an independent trigger.

patterns.name: Norms and operator expressions
patterns.context: Formula fragments containing operator norms, matrix quantities, and their definitions; no clear \in trigger is observed.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, possibly linear algebra or analysis

patterns.name: Textual mentions of Borel sets
patterns.context: Natural-language questions repeatedly mention Borel sets, topological space, open, or closed; formulas and \in also occur locally.

7_1247.concept: 数学公式中的集合隶属符号
7_1247.description: 激活主要出现在数学 LaTeX 文本，尤其集合隶属符号 \in 及其邻近的公式、变量和换行处；另有范数公式与 Borel 集问答。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的集合隶属符号
patterns.context: 出现在数学定义、命题或公式中，表示对象属于集合；常邻接变量、集合名及公式标点。
patterns.domain: 数学论文及数学问答，主要为 LaTeX

patterns.name: 数学排版中的公式边界与换行
patterns.trigger: 公式附近的换行符「↵」，以及 $$、\[、\begin{aligned} 等公式结构
patterns.context: 激活集中于公式或公式与正文的边界、跨行排列处；这些位置也常与集合隶属符号同现，不能确定换行本身是否独立触发。

patterns.name: 范数与算子表达式
patterns.context: 算子范数、矩阵量及其定义所在的公式片段；未见明显的 \in 触发。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，可能涉及线性代数或分析

patterns.name: Borel 集合的文字提及
patterns.trigger: 「Borel subset」及其在拓扑空间中的定义与提问
patterns.context: 自然语言问题中重复出现 Borel 集、topological space、open 或 closed；局部也有公式及 \in。

en.description: Responds broadly to mathematical typesetting: operations, relations, limits, summations, and subscript/superscript structures in formulas are most prominent; also responds to formula line breaks and adjacent English conditions, corollaries, and explanations. Occurs across multiple mathematical fields.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula structure
patterns.context: Structured symbols appear in mathematical formulas or displayed equations; surrounding content usually includes variables, sets, functions, or equations
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical papers and math Q&A; spans [1]–[10]

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting markers near mathematical formulas
patterns.context: When formulas span lines or are embedded in paper formatting; these markers commonly occur together with mathematical symbols

patterns.name: Connectives in English mathematical discourse
patterns.context: Interleaved with formula content in English explanations or statements of theorems and conditions
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers or math Q&A; spans [2], [3], [4], [6], [7], [8], [9], [10]

7_1247.concept: 数学公式与论文排版
7_1247.description: 对数学排版文本有广泛响应：公式中的运算、关系、极限、求和与上下标结构最突出，也响应公式换行及相邻的英文条件、推论和解释；跨多个数学领域出现。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式结构
patterns.trigger: 诸如「\sum」「\oplus」「\lim」「\prod」「\in」「\rightarrow」「\leq」及公式中的上下标、括号
patterns.context: 数学公式或行间公式中出现结构化符号；周围通常是变量、集合、函数或等式
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文及数学问答；覆盖 [1]–[10]

patterns.name: 数学公式附近的换行与排版标记
patterns.context: 公式跨行或嵌入论文排版时；这类标记常与数学符号共同出现

patterns.name: 英文数学论述中的连接词
patterns.context: 英文解释或陈述定理、条件、推论时，与公式内容交错

en.description: Activations concentrate on examples, explanations, and transitional expressions, especially for example and commas; they also cover Q&A requests, code callbacks, mathematical instructions, medical associations, and patent phrasing, with some patterns represented by only one example.

patterns.name: Example-introducing expressions and their punctuation
patterns.context: Phrases introducing examples; occur in varied contexts including academic writing, patents, Q&A, and code

patterns.name: Expressions of recency, interest, and use
patterns.context: Introduces recent interest or the use of a material in patent background sections

patterns.name: Introducing a topic and suggesting a fresh review
patterns.context: A paper proposes reanalyzing recent experimental data from a different perspective

patterns.name: Requests or examples in Q&A
patterns.context: Asks about an operation or implementation method in a StackExchange question

patterns.name: Code callbacks and parameter separators
patterns.context: A callback function is separated by commas and a closing parenthesis in an asynchronous JavaScript call

patterns.name: Factorization instruction in a math problem
patterns.context: Requests the prime factorization of a given integer

patterns.name: Statistical association and interaction statements
patterns.context: Reports statistical associations among genetic variants, treatment factors, and disease risk

patterns.name: Factual and conditional statements in explanatory patent phrasing
patterns.context: Describes specific circumstances, conditions, or arguments in patent background text

patterns.name: Examples and citation format in patent text
patterns.context: Lists device examples and introduces a Japanese published application in a patent description

patterns.name: Causal and illustrative transitions in patent technology text
patterns.context: First describes a technical consequence, then gives a communications system as an example

patterns.name: Local high-frequency words or affix triggers
patterns.context: Appears only in individual snippets; insufficient evidence that these each constitute a stable pattern

7_1247.concept: 说明与举例的衔接表达
7_1247.description: 激活集中于例示、解释和衔接表达，尤其是 for example 及逗号；也覆盖问答请求、代码回调、数学指令、医学关联和专利句式，部分模式仅单例。

patterns.name: 例示用语及其标点
patterns.context: 例子引入语；在学术、专利、问答和代码等多种上下文中出现

patterns.name: 近期、兴趣与用途表述
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中介绍近期关注或某项材料的用途

patterns.name: 话题引出与建议重新审视
patterns.context: 论文中提出对近期实验数据采用不同视角重新分析

patterns.name: 问答中的请求或举例
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题描述中询问某种操作或实现方式

patterns.name: 代码回调与参数分隔
patterns.context: JavaScript 异步调用中，以逗号和闭括号分隔回调函数

patterns.name: 数学题中的因数分解指令
patterns.context: 要求列出给定整数的质因数

patterns.name: 统计关联与交互作用表述
patterns.trigger: “interaction with HRT”、“interactions between HRT and numbers of”
patterns.context: 报告遗传变异、治疗因素与疾病风险之间的统计关联

patterns.name: 说明性专利句式中的事实与条件
patterns.trigger: “regardless of whether”、“In particular, for example, in view of the fact that”
patterns.context: 阐述专利背景中的具体情形、条件或论据

patterns.name: 专利文本中的举例与引用格式
patterns.trigger: “Examples of this … are as follows. For example, Japanese Unexamined Patent Application Publication”
patterns.context: 专利说明中列举设备实例并引出日本公开申请

patterns.name: 专利技术因果与示例衔接
patterns.trigger: “with the result that it cannot be done away with”及“in xDSL systems … for example”
patterns.context: 先说明技术后果，再以通信系统举例

patterns.name: 局部高频词或词缀触发
patterns.context: 仅在个别片段中出现；缺乏足够证据表明它们各自构成稳定模式

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal decision boilerplate and citations, gluing in code, quantum-physics assumptions, and biomedical discussions of materials, receptors, cell distribution, and cancer comparisons; there is no clear shared local trigger or unified semantics.

patterns.name: “or” and legal citation punctuation in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in appellate decision paragraphs, connecting litigation issues or introducing rules, section numbers, and legal citations in parentheses; both “or” and citation punctuation activate in this passage.

patterns.name: The word form gluing and gluing in code
patterns.context: A code string describes constructing a Scheme by gluing X and Y along U; activation falls on the token fragments of gluing.

patterns.name: Relationship between ceramic morphology and material properties
patterns.context: Discusses the morphology, defects, fracture strength, and improved surface properties of polycrystalline alumina ceramic brackets.

patterns.name: Court decision phrasing and party possessives
patterns.context: A judge states a decision on criminal convictions and sentences, with attorney information and appellate decision boilerplate.

patterns.name: Default judgment and summary judgment
patterns.context: A party fails to respond to a summary judgment motion; the court cites uncontroverted facts and rules; square brackets mark editorial additions in a citation.

patterns.name: A single local setting in mathematical physics
patterns.context: Introduces a single local setting assumption after mathematical statements involving Pauli operators, observables, and multiple observers.

patterns.name: Administrative litigation and legislative or administrative remedies
patterns.context: An appellant seeks judicial review of administrative action; the court finds that relief is available only through legislative or administrative channels and dismisses the request.

patterns.name: Receptor binding and biological response
patterns.context: Compares the effects of gangliosides on CT and hCG binding, action, and response, involving receptor complexes.

patterns.name: Tissue distribution of enteric glial cells
patterns.context: Describes the distribution and numerical differences of GFAP-expressing enteric glial cells in the plexuses and muscle layers of the bovine jejunum.

patterns.name: Cancer mortality comparison
patterns.context: Compares cancer deaths in the U.S. population, with lung cancer compared against several other cancers.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstract or public health statement

7_1247.concept: none
7_1247.description: 激活分散于法律判决套语与引文、代码中的 gluing、量子物理假设，以及生物医学中的材料、受体、细胞分布和癌症比较；没有明显共享的局部触发词或统一语义。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的“or”及法律引文标点
patterns.context: 出现在上诉裁决段落，连接诉讼事项或引出规则、条款编号及括号内的法律引文；本段对“or”和引文标点均有激活。

patterns.name: gluing 词形及代码中的 gluing
patterns.context: 代码字符串描述将 X、Y 沿 U 粘合构造 Scheme；激活落在 gluing 的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 陶瓷形貌与材料性能关系
patterns.trigger: «relationship»2« to»2 fracture toughness« and»4 strength；«the»4 morphology；«the»2 surface characteristics
patterns.context: 讨论多晶氧化铝陶瓷托槽的形貌、缺陷、断裂强度及改善表面特性。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要，材料性能

patterns.name: 法院判决措辞及当事人所有格
patterns.context: 法官陈述对刑事定罪和刑罚的裁决，并带有律师信息及上诉判决套语。

patterns.name: 缺席答辩与简易判决
patterns.trigger: failed to« file»2« a»2 response；«summary»1 judgment；«[»2«by»5«]»9
patterns.context: 当事人未回应简易判决动议，法院援引未否认事实及规则；方括号标记引文中的编辑补字。

patterns.name: 数学物理中的单一局域设置
patterns.trigger: «Assume»1« that»9 local settings are parameterized« by»3« a»2« single»1
patterns.context: 在 Pauli 算符、观测量及多方观察者的数学表述后，引入单一局域设置假设。

patterns.name: 行政诉讼及立法、行政救济渠道
patterns.trigger: «through»9« legislative»3« or»3« executive»2 channels；«dismissed» the« claim»3
patterns.context: 上诉人寻求对行政行为的司法审查，法院认为救济只能通过立法或行政渠道取得并驳回请求。

patterns.name: 受体结合与生物学响应
patterns.trigger: «the»3« binding»4« and»4 action；«Both»9 hCG-« and»6 CT-receptor complexes

en.concept: Conditions and structure in mathematical formulas
en.description: Activations concentrate mainly in LaTeX mathematical text, especially piecewise definitions and condition lines containing if/for, relation symbols, and cases/array structures; they also cover general equation environments and formal statements around formulas that explain objects, conditions, or properties. Some punctuation may be incidental.

patterns.name: “if” conditions in piecewise definitions
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions, conditions in piecewise functions or cases/array are introduced by condition phrases, often accompanied by condition variables and inequalities or relation symbols.
patterns.domain: Formal technical writing in mathematical papers and math Q&A

patterns.name: Equation environments and structural control symbols
patterns.context: Structural boundaries and nearby content in LaTeX formulas, matrices, or piecewise expressions; may co-occur with condition text but does not require if.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, mainly ArXiv; also StackExchange

patterns.name: Mathematical relations and connectives in formulas
patterns.context: In formal mathematical statements, natural language before and after formulas explains objects, conditions, definitions, or properties; trigger words are distributed, with no single fixed term apparent.

patterns.name: Commas and adjacent punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation and phrase transitions near formulas or mathematical terms; may be an incidental feature of a broader mathematical typesetting/context pattern, with limited explanatory power on its own.

7_1247.concept: 数学公式中的条件与结构
7_1247.description: 激活主要集中于 LaTeX 数学文本，尤其是分段定义及条件行中的 if/for、关系符号和 cases/array 结构；也覆盖一般公式环境，以及公式周围解释对象、条件或性质的正式表述。个别标点可能只是伴随特征。

patterns.name: 分段定义中的“if”条件
patterns.context: 数学表达式中，分段函数或 cases/array 的各行以条件短语引出，常伴随条件变量与不等式或关系符号。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与数学问答中的正式技术写作

patterns.name: 公式环境与结构控制符
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式、矩阵或分段表达式的结构边界及其紧邻内容；可能与条件文本共同出现，但不要求出现 if。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，主要为 ArXiv；另有 StackExchange

patterns.name: 数学关系与公式中的连接词
patterns.trigger: “where”“for all”“whenever”“is measurable”“the unitary operator”“interaction of the type”
patterns.context: 正式数学陈述中，公式前后用自然语言说明对象、条件、定义或性质；触发词分散，未见单一固定词项。

patterns.name: 逗号及邻接标点
patterns.context: 公式或数学术语附近的标点与短语衔接处；可能是更广泛数学排版/语境模式的伴随特征，单独解释力有限。

en.description: Most activations occur in condition explanations in mathematical formulas, especially “with”, “if”, “whenever”, and nearby formula delimiters; there are also lists of issues in legal documents and career narratives in football biographies.

patterns.name: Condition-introducing phrases in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Specifies the domain of a variable, function conditions, or index relations in a formula; nearby content often includes braces, alignment environments, or piecewise definitions.

patterns.name: Condition markers in piecewise definitions
patterns.context: A condition is followed by an inequality or variable value, usually within a piecewise formula such as cases/array.

patterns.name: Relation-condition markers in formulas
patterns.context: A natural-language phrase introduces conditions on variables or indices.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, matrix or set-relation formulas

patterns.name: “with” condition phrases in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Immediately after a formula definition, subsequent text gives additional constraints on variables, vectors, or matrices.

patterns.name: Enumeration of issues in legal argument
patterns.context: A legal opinion or decision summarizes a party’s claim that a lower court erred and lists the reasons.

patterns.name: Career description in a biographical entry
patterns.context: A biographical entry introduces a retired footballer and their professional career.

7_1247.concept: 条件引导表达及局部列举
7_1247.description: 多数激活出现在数学公式的条件说明处，尤其是“with”“if”“whenever”及其附近的公式括号；另有法律文书的争点列举和足球人物简介中的生涯叙述。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的条件引导短语
patterns.trigger: “with”后接“in”“if”“whenever”之一，常引出数学条件；如“with { }”, “{ if }”, “{ whenever }”
patterns.context: 公式中说明变量所在区域、函数条件或指标关系；附近常有大括号、对齐环境或分段定义。

patterns.name: 分段定义中的条件标记
patterns.trigger: “if”及其邻近的“{”“\text{”“}”，如“{ if }”“\text{ if } x < 0”
patterns.context: 条件后接不等式或变量取值，通常位于 cases/array 等分段公式中。

patterns.name: 公式中的关系条件标记
patterns.context: 以自然语言短语引出变量或指标成立条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、矩阵或集合关系公式

patterns.name: 数学公式里的“with”条件短语
patterns.context: 紧接公式定义后，后续给出变量、向量或矩阵的附加约束。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的争点列举
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决书中概述一方指称下级法院错误，并列出理由。

patterns.name: 人物简介中的生涯描述
patterns.context: 人物条目介绍退役足球运动员及其职业经历。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、体育人物条目

en.description: Sensitive to conditional statements in mathematical formulas and technical texts, especially words such as “for all,” “if,” and “where,” and nearby formula structures; commonly found in set constraints, piecewise definitions, boundary conditions, and statements of variable scope.

patterns.name: Mathematical conditional phrase “for all”
patterns.context: A conditional word introduces a variable, domain, or piecewise condition; typically appears in English mathematical explanations following a formula.

patterns.name: Piecewise conditions and boundary symbols in formulas
patterns.context: Formulas contain piecewise definitions, set conditions, boundary conditions, or aligned mathematical expressions; activation often falls on conditional lead-ins and nearby structural symbols.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and scientific papers, including typeset formulas

patterns.name: Set and quantifier constraints
patterns.context: Constraints on mathematical objects are stated using set relations, membership relations, and universal conditions.

patterns.name: English explanatory phrases following formulas
patterns.context: Brief English statements near mathematical formulas explain variables, scope, or definitions; these words often occur at the boundary between formulas and natural-language explanations.

patterns.name: Local triggers at word boundaries or in formula contexts
patterns.context: In addition to general conditional expressions, some activations may be triggered by local word forms or typesetting near formula boundaries; the examples available are insufficient for further subdivision.

7_1247.concept: 数学公式中的条件说明
7_1247.description: 在数学公式及技术文本中，对条件性说明尤其“for all”“if”“where”等词及其邻近的公式结构敏感；常见于集合约束、分段定义、边界条件和变量适用范围的表述。

patterns.name: 数学条件引导词“for all”
patterns.context: 条件词引出变量、定义域或分段条件；通常出现在公式后的英文数学说明中。

patterns.name: 公式中条件分段与边界符号
patterns.context: 公式中出现分段定义、集合条件、边界条件或对齐的数学表达；激活常落在条件引导语及其附近的结构符号上。
patterns.domain: 数学与科学论文，含公式排版

patterns.name: 集合与量词约束
patterns.context: 用集合关系、属于关系和全称条件陈述数学对象的约束。

patterns.name: 公式后的英文解释性短语
patterns.context: 数学公式附近以简短英文交代变量、适用范围或定义；这些词常出现在公式与自然语言说明的交界处。

patterns.name: 单词边界或公式语境中的局部触发
patterns.context: 除通用条件表达外，部分激活可能由公式边界附近的局部词形或排版触发，现有例子不足以进一步细分。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal texts and mathematical formulas: in legal passages they often fall on that-clauses and words related to courts, claims, and procedure; in formulas they repeatedly fall on conditional expressions such as for/all/every and in, with sporadic triggers on equals signs, multiplication signs, and punctuation.

patterns.name: that in English conditional sentences
patterns.context: Introduces a claim, judgment, or conclusion in legal reasoning; also occurs in mathematical corpora in formula conditions «for» ...

patterns.name: Function-word sequences in legal style
patterns.context: Describes court rulings, parties’ claims, and litigation procedures in judicial opinions; activation falls on multiple common function words in continuous argumentation

patterns.name: for conditions in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Specifies the range conditions satisfied by variables or objects in formulas, definitions, or boundary-value problems
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical papers and StackExchange mathematics content

patterns.name: in and mathematical objects in formulas
patterns.context: Indicates that a variable belongs to a region or set in a mathematical expression; may co-occur with for conditions
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical papers, StackExchange mathematics content

patterns.name: Equals signs in formulas
patterns.context: Defines operators or expressions in mathematical formulas; in this example, the trigger marker occurs on the equals sign

patterns.name: Multiplication signs in mathematical formulas
