patterns.context: Indicates multiplication or quantities being multiplied in a formula

patterns.name: Commas in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Punctuation in formulas or explanatory text in mathematical papers; occurs in isolation, without a clear shared meaning

patterns.name: that-clauses and disputed conclusions in legal sentences
patterns.context: Addresses legal issues such as arguability, constitutional claims, or withdrawal from a conspiracy defense

patterns.name: Ruling-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses district court rulings on claims or procedural issues

patterns.name: Unpublished-opinion wording
patterns.context: Explains the precedential effect of unpublished decisions in court opinions

patterns.name: Boundary-value problem expressions
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas for partial differential equations or acoustics problems

patterns.name: for x in probability densities
patterns.context: States the range of variable values after a probability density expression

patterns.name: for conditions in asymptotic estimates
patterns.context: Specifies the variable range over which an asymptotic estimate applies

patterns.name: Universal condition for fractional perimeter
patterns.context: States that the fractional perimeter is finite over a range of parameters

7_1247.concept: 条件与从句引导词
7_1247.description: 激活分散在法律文本与数学公式中：法律段落里常落在 that 从句及法院、主张、程序等词；公式里反复落在 for/all/every、in 等条件表达，也有等号、乘号及标点等零散触发。

patterns.name: 英语条件句中的 that
patterns.context: 法律论证中引出主张、判断或结论；在数学语料中也见于公式条件 «for» ...
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院意见书、数学论文

patterns.name: 法律语体中的功能词序列
patterns.trigger: «the»、«his»、«and»、«from»、«of» 等；并伴随 district court、constitutional claims、defense 等法律词语
patterns.context: 司法意见书中描述法院裁定、当事人主张及诉讼程序；激活落在连续论述中的多个常见功能词上

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 for 条件
patterns.trigger: «for»，以及相邻的 «all»、«every»；常见结构为 «for» ... «all» 或 «for» ... «every»
patterns.context: 公式、定义或边界值问题中说明变量或对象所满足的范围条件
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文及 StackExchange 数学内容

patterns.name: 公式中的 in 及数学对象
patterns.trigger: «in»，邻近 Ω、\mathbb{R}^d、x 等集合或变量
patterns.context: 数学表达式中表示变量属于某个区域或集合；可与 for 条件同现
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、StackExchange 数学内容

patterns.name: 公式中的等号
patterns.context: 数学公式定义算子或表达式；本例中触发标记出现在等号上

patterns.name: 数学公式中的乘号
patterns.context: 公式中表示乘法或数量相乘

patterns.name: 数学符号中的逗号
patterns.context: 数学论文公式或说明文字里的标点；孤立出现，缺少明确共同语义

patterns.name: 法律句中的 that 从句与争议结论
patterns.trigger: «that»，后接 «any»、«his» 或 «the» 等从句成分
patterns.context: 论证可争辩性、宪法主张或撤出共谋抗辩等法律问题

patterns.name: 裁定相关词汇
patterns.context: 讨论地区法院对主张或程序问题的裁定

patterns.name: 未发表意见书措辞
patterns.context: 法院意见书中说明未发表判决的先例效力

patterns.name: 边界值问题表达
patterns.context: 偏微分方程或声学问题的数学公式

patterns.name: 概率密度中的 for x
patterns.context: 概率密度表达式后说明变量取值范围

patterns.name: 渐近估计中的 for 条件
patterns.context: 给出渐近估计所适用的变量范围

patterns.name: 分数阶周长的全称条件
patterns.context: 说明分数阶周长对一段参数范围均有限

en.concept: Structured expressions in legal decisions and academic formulas
en.description: Primarily responds to procedural, review, and adjudicative wording in federal appellate decisions, especially dismiss, affirm, appeal, and fixed concluding phrases; also shows sporadic responses to trademark claims, habeas standards, criminal plain-error wording, and two types of mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Procedural wording in federal appellate opinions
patterns.context: In federal appellate court opinions, especially case summaries, reasoning, or conclusion sections; common formats include PER CURIAM, appellate review, and disposition.

patterns.name: Fixed wording at the end of decisions
patterns.context: The opinion concludes by stating that oral argument is unnecessary, often followed by reasons such as the facts and legal arguments being adequately presented.

patterns.name: Trademark infringement and cybersquatting claims
patterns.context: Lists claims related to trademark infringement and cybersquatting after the parties’ names.

patterns.name: Arguability standard for constitutional claims
patterns.context: Discusses whether a habeas petitioner meets the standard for obtaining a certificate of appealability, focusing on whether reasonable jurists would consider the constitutional claim debatable.

patterns.name: Substantial compliance with criminal procedure rules and plain error
patterns.context: Reviews whether a plea procedure substantially complied with the rules of criminal procedure and assesses errors or omissions under the plain-error standard.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation defining a Gamma subset and finite cardinality
patterns.context: Uses set construction or a definition to state that the relevant intersection/cardinality is finite for all Λ.

patterns.name: Acoustic degenerate boundary-value problem
patterns.context: Uses formulas to specify a partial differential equation and its boundary conditions in the region Ω.
patterns.domain: Mathematical or applied mathematics papers, partial differential equations/acoustics

7_1247.concept: 法律判决与学术公式中的结构化表述
7_1247.description: 主要响应联邦上诉判决中的程序、审查与裁判措辞，尤其是 dismiss、affirm、appeal 及固定结尾语；另对商标诉因、habeas 标准、刑事 plain-error 表述及两类数学公式有零星响应。

patterns.name: 联邦上诉意见中的程序性表述
patterns.context: 联邦上诉法院意见书中，尤其是案件摘要、裁判理由或结论段；常见格式包括 PER CURIAM、上诉审查与处置。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦判例法律文书

patterns.name: 判决结尾的固定措辞
patterns.context: 意见书结尾说明无需口头辩论，常接事实与法律论点已充分呈现等理由。

patterns.name: 商标侵权与网络抢注诉因
patterns.context: 当事人名称之后列举商标侵权和 cybersquatting 相关诉因。

patterns.name: 宪法主张的可争辩性标准
patterns.context: 讨论 habeas 上诉人是否满足取得上诉证明的标准，关注合理法官是否会认为宪法主张可争辩。

patterns.name: 有限遵守刑事程序规则及 plain error
patterns.trigger: «Fed. R. Crim. P. 11»、«plain error standard»、«error» 或 om«ission»
patterns.context: 审查认罪程序是否实质遵守刑事诉讼规则，并按 plain-error 标准判断错误或遗漏。

patterns.name: 关于 Gamma 子集与有限基数的数学符号定义
patterns.context: 以集合构造或定义形式说明对所有 Λ，相关交集/基数有限。

patterns.name: 声学退化边界值问题
patterns.context: 通过公式给出区域 Ω 内的偏微分方程及其边界条件。
patterns.domain: 数学或应用数学论文，偏微分方程/声学

en.concept: Structured markers in academic and legal texts
en.description: Activations are distributed across formula symbols, English function words, and words in structured tables and legal documents: mathematical definitions and equations, appellate issues and infringement claims, and groupings, sample sizes, statistical tables, and genomic figure captions in biomedical research.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and set definitions
patterns.context: Formulas use matrix, set, and polynomial-ring notation to describe objects or conditions; activation concentrates on mathematical symbols and adjacent words

patterns.name: Sample sizes and groups in clinical research tables
patterns.context: Table titles or columns juxtapose disease/status groups and sample sizes

patterns.name: Procedural and issue statements in appellate legal documents
patterns.context: Lists issues at the start of an appellate opinion, or states the parties’ appeal and the cases and requests handled by the court

patterns.name: Partial differential equations and boundary-value formulas
patterns.context: Uses equations, aligned environments, and domains to describe a degenerate boundary-value problem

patterns.name: Infringement claims in trademark litigation
patterns.context: Lists the parties to a case and describes claims such as trademark infringement and cybersquatting

patterns.name: Clinical experiment groups and statistics
patterns.context: Describes animal experiment groups, sample sizes, time points, and scores; includes formatted group labels

patterns.name: Baseline characteristics table and case-control comparison
patterns.context: Table title or headers describe baseline characteristics of cancer patients and controls, and how statistics are presented

patterns.name: Genomic regions and sample counts
patterns.context: Describes identified genomic regions or epigenetic allele sites and lists counts by sample/strain

7_1247.concept: 结构化学术与法律文本标记
7_1247.description: 激活分布于公式符号、英语功能词及结构化表格/法律文书词语：数学定义与方程、上诉争点及侵权诉因，以及生物医学研究中的分组、样本量、统计表和基因组图注。

patterns.name: 数学符号与集合定义
patterns.context: 公式中以矩阵、集合及多项式环记号描述对象或条件；激活集中在数学符号及其相邻词

patterns.name: 临床研究表格中的样本数与分组
patterns.context: 表格标题或列项中并列疾病/状态组别及样本量

patterns.name: 上诉法律文书的程序与争点表述
patterns.context: 上诉意见开头列举争点，或陈述当事人上诉及法院处理的案件与请求

patterns.name: 偏微分方程与边界值公式
patterns.context: 用方程、对齐环境和定义域描述退化边界值问题

patterns.name: 商标诉讼中的侵权主张
patterns.context: 列举案件当事方，并说明商标侵权及网络抢注等诉因

patterns.name: 临床实验分组与统计量
patterns.context: 描述动物实验的分组、样本量、时间点及评分；包含格式化组别标记

patterns.name: 基线特征表与病例对照比较
patterns.context: 表格标题或表头说明癌症患者与对照组的基线特征及统计呈现方式
patterns.domain: 临床流行病学论文表格

patterns.name: 基因组区域与样本计数
patterns.context: 说明基因组区域或表观等位基因位点的识别结果，并按样本/品系列出计数

en.description: Highlights span legal, medical, and mathematical papers, including legal litigation terminology, and repeatedly fall on connectives such as and, of, the, and in, as well as formula punctuation and equals signs; local patterns also occur in statistical results, methods descriptions, and physical parameters.

patterns.name: Syntactic connectives and punctuation
patterns.context: Often occurs between nouns, clauses, or formula elements; activation is not limited to a particular word. Some punctuation and short function words also show strong activation.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts, including legal, medical, and mathematical papers

patterns.name: Legal appeals and adjudication language
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions or headings concerning appeals, court rulings, and litigation disputes; this pattern fits legal style, but specific highlights within passages also include general connectives.

patterns.name: Statistical comparisons in scientific research
patterns.context: Describes experimental measurements, statistical tests, significance, or summaries of results.

patterns.name: Equals signs and mathematical structures in formulas
patterns.context: Occurs inside mathematical expressions, boundary-value problems, or formulas containing variables and symbols; highlights cover formula symbols and a few adjacent function words.

patterns.name: Methods and model descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces measurement formulas, spatial resolution, exposure modeling, or methodological steps.

patterns.name: Case parties and entity names
patterns.context: Occurs around the names of case parties or companies, near litigation issues such as trademark infringement and cybersquatting.

patterns.name: Technical physical quantities and parameter notation
patterns.context: Occurs when explaining a particular physical model or parameter value, mixing natural language and mathematical symbols.

7_1247.concept: 跨文体连接成分与符号
7_1247.description: 高亮跨法律、医学及数学论文，包含法律诉讼术语，也反复落在 and、of、the、in 等连接词及公式标点、等号上；另见统计结果、方法描述和物理参数等局部模式。

patterns.name: 句法连接词与标点
patterns.context: 常出现在名词、从句或公式元素之间，激活并不局限于某个特定词；部分标点和短功能词也有强激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括法律、医学和数学论文

patterns.name: 法律上诉与裁判用语
patterns.context: 出现在上诉、法院裁定及诉讼争议的叙述或标题中；该模式与法律文体相符，但段内具体高亮也包含通用连接词。

patterns.name: 科学研究中的统计比较
patterns.context: 描述实验测量、统计检验、显著性或结果汇总。

patterns.name: 公式中的等号与数学结构
patterns.context: 处于数学表达式、边值问题或带变量和符号的公式内部；高亮覆盖公式符号及少量相邻功能词。

patterns.name: 研究方法与模型描述
patterns.context: 介绍测量公式、空间分辨率、暴露建模或方法步骤。

patterns.name: 案件当事方及实体名称
patterns.context: 出现在案件当事方名称或公司名称周围，邻近商标侵权、网络抢注等诉讼事项。

patterns.name: 技术物理量与参数记号
patterns.context: 在解释特定物理模型或参数取值时出现，混合自然语言与数学符号。

en.concept: Structured quantitative statements in technical writing
en.description: Primarily responds to the style of methods, results, and quantitative information in academic papers, especially sample sizes, statistics, formulas, and parameters; also occurs in legal sentencing/attorney claims and mathematical initial conditions. The specific fourth passage describes recruitment and refusals, and it is unclear whether a shared trigger explains it.

patterns.name: Measurements, statistics, and numerical markers in scientific papers
patterns.context: When reporting sample sizes, statistical tests, experimental conditions, equations, or parameter values; activation often falls on numbers, equals signs, punctuation, or nearby function words
patterns.domain: Biomedical, materials science, computational biology, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Paper descriptions of methods, results, and research subjects
patterns.context: When research papers describe measurements, samples, participants, observations, or analysis steps in methods or results sections, often with domain terminology and statistical information in parentheses
patterns.domain: PubMed Central research papers and scientific papers

patterns.name: Sentencing and ineffective-assistance claims in legal decisions
patterns.context: When a decision discusses whether a sentence complies with statutory or guideline requirements and then reviews the defendant’s claim of ineffective assistance of counsel

patterns.name: Initial conditions and boundary data in mathematical texts
patterns.context: Mathematical exposition specifies initial or boundary conditions for functions, derivatives, and parameters using formulas

patterns.name: Research participant recruitment and reasons for refusal
patterns.context: Describes study recruitment, participants or parents declining to participate, and their reasons; related to other paper statistics/methods patterns, but the specific trigger in this passage is recruitment and refusal

7_1247.concept: 技术文体中的结构化定量陈述
7_1247.description: 主要响应学术论文中方法、结果及定量信息的写法，尤其是样本量、统计值、公式和参数；另见法律量刑/律师主张，以及数学初始条件。第4段具体是招募与拒绝叙述，无法确定是否由共同触发因素解释。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的计量、统计与数值标记
patterns.context: 在报告样本量、统计检验、实验条件、方程或参数取值时；激活常落在数字、等号、标点或邻近的功能词上
patterns.domain: 生物医学、材料科学、计算生物学和数学论文

patterns.name: 方法、结果与研究对象的论文叙述
patterns.trigger: “in order to assess”、“scores were assessed at”、“we observed”、“After excluding”、“Materials and methods”、“the consistency scores”
patterns.context: 研究论文以方法或结果段落描述测量、样本、参与者、观察结果或分析步骤时，常伴随领域术语及括号中的统计信息
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 研究论文及科学论文

patterns.name: 法律判决中的量刑与律师帮助主张
patterns.trigger: “Guidelines range”、“minimum required by statute”、“Valderrama’s claim”、“counsel rendered ineffective assistance”
patterns.context: 判决书在讨论量刑是否符合法定或指南要求，并转而审查被告关于律师无效帮助的主张时

patterns.name: 数学文本中的初始条件与边界数据
patterns.context: 数学论述通过公式规定函数、导数及参数的初始或边界条件
patterns.domain: 数学论文，含 LaTeX 公式

patterns.name: 研究参与者招募与拒绝原因
patterns.trigger: “Parents of 29 children were invited”、“parents refused participation”、“Reasons for refusal”
patterns.context: 描述研究招募、参与者或家长拒绝参加及其原因；与其他论文统计/方法模式相关，但该段的具体触发内容是招募与拒绝

en.description: Activations are distributed across symbols, statistical values, methodological connectives, and figure descriptions in various scientific papers, as well as the clause-introducing word that in legal contexts. Patterns span domains and have no consistent trigger form.

patterns.name: that introducing a clause
patterns.context: In legal texts, that appears in a verb-complement clause such as “believes that such a petition would...” ; in [1], the strongest activation falls on that.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula relations
patterns.context: In formulas, operations, and statistical expressions relating numbers, variables, or dimensions, activation falls on symbols or nearby tokens; the specific symbols vary.
patterns.domain: Formulas and quantitative expressions in scientific papers

patterns.name: Statistical results and sample-size expressions
patterns.context: n, N, equals signs, and numbers occur near sample sizes or statistical values; activation primarily falls on equals signs or number tokens.

patterns.name: in in research workflows
patterns.context: in is used in descriptions of methods or analysis workflows, such as “in order to,” “allocated in individual cages,” or “at four time points in …”; the word is marked in only some such positions.

patterns.name: showing in results or figure descriptions
patterns.context: Uses showing to introduce measurements displayed in a figure or the contents of a heatmap.

patterns.name: Scattering and particle phrases in scientific texts
patterns.context: Describes sources of scattering considered in a resistivity model; activation concentrates on and, while most surrounding words are unmarked.

patterns.name: Coordinating connectives in medical texts
patterns.context: Connective elements between coordinated terms, results, or treatments; they occur in multiple passages but vary in position and meaning.

patterns.name: Expressions for numerical measurement ranges
patterns.context: Uses from…to… to give a range of measurement values.

7_1247.concept: 混合的结构与量化标记
7_1247.description: 激活分布于多种科学论文中的符号、统计数值、方法连接词及图示描述，也包括法律语境中从句引导词 that。模式跨领域且触发形式不统一。

patterns.name: that 后接从句引导词
patterns.context: 法律文本中，位于“believes that such a petition would...”一类动词补语从句的 that；[1] 的最强激活落在 that。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式关系记号
patterns.context: 数字、变量或量纲之间的公式、运算及统计表达式中，激活落在符号或符号邻近 token；具体符号不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 科学论文中的公式和量化表达

patterns.name: 统计结果与样本量表达
patterns.context: 样本量或统计数值前后出现 n、N、等号及数字；激活主要落在等号或数字 token。
patterns.domain: 医学与生物学研究论文

patterns.name: 研究流程中的 in
patterns.context: in 用于方法或分析流程表述，如“in order to”“allocated in individual cages”“at four time points in …”；该词仅在部分此类位置标记。

patterns.name: 结果或图示的 showing
patterns.context: 以 showing 引出图表所展示的测量结果或热图内容。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的散射与颗粒边界词组
patterns.context: 描述电阻率模型所考虑的散射来源；激活集中于 and，其他周边词多为未标记。

patterns.name: 医学并列连接成分
patterns.trigger: « and»3« the»2；« and»2 anti-mouse VEGF mAb
patterns.context: 在并列的术语、结果或处理项之间连接成分；多个段出现，但位置和语义各异。

patterns.name: 数字测量区间表达
patterns.context: 以 from…to…给出测量值范围。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on common function words in academic English and on formulas, numbers, and typesetting symbols, spanning biomedicine, environmental science, physics, mathematics, and web links; proper names and domain terms are sporadic, with no unified thematic trigger.

patterns.name: English function words and following tokens
patterns.context: Activation falls on several common English prepositions, articles, conjunctions, or the words following them; positions span in-sentence phrases, noun phrases, and relational expressions, with no single fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: English academic papers, technical texts, and web links

patterns.name: Numbers, operators, and formula symbols
patterns.context: Near numerical values, units, statistical comparisons, formulas, or mathematical typesetting; some symbols occur around activated words, while others such as «×» and «=» are directly marked.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, statistical results, mathematical formulas, and drug dosage descriptions

patterns.name: Prepositions and subword fragments in web paths
patterns.context: Wikipedia URL paths connect title words with underscores; activation corresponds to separators and ordinary English words in the path.

patterns.name: Relational words in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: When defining spaces and their structures, activated words appear in sentence patterns that introduce objects, additional structures, or families of mappings.

patterns.name: Algebraic relation expressions in formulas
patterns.context: Common function words interleave with formula structures in descriptions of algebraic objects, variables, and relations.

patterns.name: Figure captions and experimental methods
patterns.context: Explains curve meanings, calculation methods, physical effects considered, or experimental measurement methods.
patterns.domain: Materials physics captions and biomedical experimental texts

patterns.name: Statistical results and distribution descriptions
patterns.context: Compares observations with expectations, or describes medians, quartiles, and outliers in boxplots.

patterns.name: Individual terms or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation also covers a few proper names, technical terms, or title fragments that cannot be explained by a shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Agricultural research locations, mathematical terminology, web page titles

patterns.name: Medical and experimental vocabulary
patterns.context: Function-word activations occur amid descriptions of tumors, antibody treatments, and radiopharmaceutical experiments; the domain terms themselves show no stable, consistent trigger relationship.

7_1247.concept: 英语功能词与符号
7_1247.description: 激活主要落在学术英语常见功能词及公式、数字和排版符号上，跨生物医学、环境科学、物理、数学与网页链接；专名和领域词激活较零散，未见统一主题触发。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及连接词后的 token
patterns.context: 激活落在多个常见英语介词、冠词、连词或其后的词上；出现位置横跨句中短语、名词短语及关系表达，并无单一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 英语学术论文、技术文本及网页链接

patterns.name: 数字、运算符与公式符号
patterns.context: 数值、单位、统计比较、公式或数学排版附近；其中部分符号出现在激活词周边，亦有「×」「=」等直接标记。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、统计结果、数学公式及药物剂量描述

patterns.name: 网页路径中的介词与分词片段
patterns.context: 维基百科 URL 路径把标题词用下划线连接，激活对应路径中的分隔符和普通英语词。

patterns.name: 数学定义中的关系词
patterns.context: 定义空间及其结构时，激活词位于介绍对象、附加结构或映射族的句式中。

patterns.name: 公式中的代数关系表达
patterns.context: 代数对象、变量及关系式的介绍中，常见功能词与公式结构交错。

patterns.name: 图表说明与实验方法表达
patterns.context: 说明曲线含义、计算方法、考虑的物理效应或实验测量方式。
patterns.domain: 材料物理图注及生物医学实验文本

patterns.name: 统计结果与分布描述
patterns.context: 比较观察结果与期望，或描述箱线图的中位数、四分位数和离群点。
patterns.domain: 生物医学统计结果与图注

patterns.name: 个别术语或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活还覆盖少数无法由共同语义解释的专名、技术词或标题词片段。
patterns.domain: 农业研究地点、数学术语、网页标题

patterns.name: 医学与实验领域词汇
patterns.context: 肿瘤、抗体处理及放射性药物实验叙述中夹杂功能词激活；领域词本身未显示稳定一致的触发关系。

en.concept: Function words in relational and comparative expressions
en.description: Activations are distributed across relational and procedural expressions in legal documents and statistical comparisons and numerical reports in scientific papers; they also occur on for in URLs. Several examples are near prepositions, connectives, numbers, or formatting boundaries, so no single word sense can be identified as the trigger.

patterns.name: Relational, claim, and procedural phrases in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences in decisions, appellate opinions, or motions, connecting parties, claims, matters handled by the court, or outcomes.

patterns.name: Statistical comparisons and correlation expressions
patterns.context: Occurs near correlation coefficients, significance tests, numerical comparisons, or measurements, often alongside numbers, units, and parentheses.

patterns.name: Preposition to in phrases
patterns.context: Introduces the object of a claim or matter handled in legal texts, as in “as to Valderrama’s claim”; the passage also contains other activated words, making it difficult to determine whether to alone is the trigger.

patterns.name: for in web URLs
patterns.context: Occurs in Wikipedia link titles cited in Hacker News posts, with for marked twice; the context differs from the other passages.

patterns.name: Function-word activations at sentence or formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs at sentence beginnings or paragraph transitions; the current passage does not establish whether the boundary position or adjacent content is responsible.

7_1247.concept: 关系与比较表达中的功能词
7_1247.description: 激活分布在法律文书的关系与程序表达、科学论文的统计比较和数值报告中；也见于 URL 中的 for。多个例子邻近介词、连接词、数字或格式边界，无法确定单一词义触发。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的关系、主张与程序短语
patterns.context: 出现在判决、上诉意见或动议语句中，连接当事人、主张、法院处理事项或裁判结果。

patterns.name: 统计比较与相关性表达
patterns.context: 出现在相关系数、显著性检验、数值比较或测量结果附近，常伴随数字、单位和括号。

patterns.name: 短语中的介词 to
patterns.context: 法律文本中引出主张对象或处理事项，如 “as to Valderrama’s claim”；该片段同时有其他激活词，难以断定 to 单独触发。

patterns.name: 网页 URL 中的 for
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 帖子引用的维基百科链接标题中，for 两次被标记；与其他片段的语境不同。

patterns.name: 句内或格式边界处的功能词激活
patterns.context: 出现在句首或段落衔接处；当前片段无法确认是边界位置还是相邻内容触发。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal and scientific texts, often falling on punctuation, function words, numerical formulas, and formatting boundaries; legal terminology, statistical reports, experimental parameters, biomedical objects, and mathematical notation also occur, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formula symbols
patterns.context: In formulas, numerical values, statistical results, or structured argumentation, symbols occur at boundaries between numbers, variables, units, or text; specific triggers vary across passages
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, mathematical texts, legal texts

patterns.name: Short function words and relational connectives
patterns.context: Common prepositions and conjunctions before or after technical terms, experimental subjects, relations, or methods; trigger words are scattered across different syntactic positions

patterns.name: Legal litigation and quotation formats
patterns.context: Case parties, decisions, or statutory references, accompanied by line breaks, indentation, and quotation-style formatting

patterns.name: Statistical tests and significance reports
patterns.context: Reports correlations, significance thresholds, or test results, often with equals signs, numerical values, and statistical symbols

patterns.name: Experimental parameters, measurements, and units
patterns.context: Experimental materials, measurements, equipment dimensions, doses, or results expressed with numbers and units

patterns.name: Animal models, drugs, and biomedical objects
patterns.context: In immunology, oncology, or radiopharmaceutical research, proper names occur alongside experimental descriptions

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and mapping notation
patterns.context: Defines mathematical objects using variables, mappings, matrices, or formulas, including LaTeX typesetting and symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Legal proper names and citation formatting
patterns.context: Case names, company names, or statutory numbers appear in irregularly formatted legal texts

patterns.name: Paragraph and heading boundaries
patterns.context: Section headings, paragraph transitions, or sentence-initial positions after line breaks; may be unrelated to adjacent domain content

7_1247.concept: 专业文本中的结构标记
7_1247.description: 激活分散于法律与科学文本，常落在标点、功能词、数字公式及排版边界；另见法律术语、统计报告、实验参数、生物医学对象和数学记号，缺乏单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 标点与公式符号
patterns.trigger: 逗号「,」、等号「=」、乘号「×」、数学符号「≤」、括号「(」、方括号「[」及其邻近 token
patterns.context: 公式、数值、统计结果或结构化论述中，符号位于数字、变量、单位或文本分隔处；各段具体触发符号并不相同
patterns.domain: 科学论文、数学文本、法律文本

patterns.name: 短功能词及关系连接
patterns.context: 专业名词、实验对象、关系或方法前后的常见介词和连词；触发词分散在不同句法位置

patterns.name: 法律诉讼与引述格式
patterns.context: 案件当事人、判决或法条叙述，伴有换行、缩进及引述式排版

patterns.name: 统计检验与显著性报告
patterns.context: 报告相关性、显著性阈值或检验结果，常有等号、数值和统计符号

patterns.name: 实验参数、测量及单位
patterns.context: 实验材料、测量值、设备尺寸、剂量或结果以数字和单位表达

patterns.name: 动物模型、药物与生物医学对象
patterns.context: 免疫学、肿瘤或放射性药物研究中，专名与实验描述相邻

patterns.name: 数学定义与映射记号
patterns.trigger: 「coherent set of maps」「m_k: K_k × X^k → X」「φ(456^(2))」「coefficient of t^2」「det」
patterns.context: 以变量、映射、矩阵或公式定义数学对象，包含 LaTeX 排版及符号
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 法律专名及引文排版
patterns.context: 案件名称、公司名或法条编号出现在格式不规则的法律文本中

patterns.name: 段落及标题边界
patterns.context: 小节标题、段落转换或换行后句首位置；可能与相邻领域内容无关

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and format triggers
en.description: Activations occur on within-word fragments (especially oid), mathematical numbers and operators, with sporadic patterns involving questions, date headings, and chat discussions. Some medical terms can be explained by within-word oid; the remaining triggers are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Within-word oid pattern
patterns.context: The trigger occurs at the end of longer words, usually marked separately from the preceding stem; it is not limited to a single complete term
patterns.domain: Medical text; also see number/symbol segmentation in mathematical expressions

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Calculations or numerical descriptions composed of numbers, punctuation, and operators; activations fall on number fragments and symbols

patterns.name: Question-style phrases and numbered prompts
patterns.context: Words in the phrase “Turno de preguntas (preg...” are split into fragments, with parentheses and an abbreviation/the beginning of a following word nearby

patterns.name: Months in date headings
patterns.context: Occurs in date lines containing a weekday, date, and year, and recurs in subsequent headings

patterns.name: chat and related complaints
patterns.context: Discussion of code readability, syntax highlighting, and pasting complete class definitions into chat

patterns.name: Isolated technical-term fragments
patterns.context: Sentences about polyp size and NBI diagnostic accuracy; apart from the general within-word fragment pattern in medical terms, no clear shared trigger is apparent

7_1691.concept: 混合的词片段与格式触发
7_1691.description: 激活分布于词内片段（尤其 oid）、数学数字和运算符，并有问句、日期标题、聊天讨论等零散模式。部分医学术语可由词内 oid 解释；其余触发条件并不一致。

patterns.name: 词内片段 oid 的形式
patterns.context: 触发点在较长词的词尾，通常与前面的词干分开标记；并非只限于一个完整术语
patterns.domain: 医学文本；另见数学表达中的数字/符号切分

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 数字、标点和运算符构成的计算或数值描述，激活落在数字片段及符号上

patterns.name: 问句式短语及编号提示
patterns.context: 短语“Turno de preguntas (preg...”的词被拆分成片段，周围有括号及缩写/后续词的开头

patterns.name: 日期标题中的月份
patterns.context: 出现在带星期、日期和年份的日期行，并重复于后续标题

patterns.name: chat 及相关抱怨措辞
patterns.context: 讨论聊天中代码可读性、语法高亮及粘贴完整类定义的问题

patterns.name: 孤立的专业词片段
patterns.context: 有关息肉大小、NBI 诊断准确性的句子；除一般医学词内片段模式外，未见明确共同触发条件

en.concept: Dates, numbers, and local word forms
en.description: Activations occur in dates containing October, mathematical numbers and punctuation, several within-word subword fragments, repeated encyclopedia headings, and line breaks. AI news terminology also activates, but is difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: October in dates
patterns.context: October appears in dates or event schedules, sometimes adjacent to a year or specific day
patterns.domain: Biographies, event updates, television program entries

patterns.name: Numerical and arithmetic formats
patterns.context: In math problems, expressions, or parameter lists, activations fall on numbers, punctuation, and variables

patterns.name: Within-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across initial or internal subword fragments; the words occur in questions, names, or medical terms
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, biographical entries, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Repeated entry headings and line breaks
patterns.context: An entry heading is repeated after a line break, and parts of the heading text also activate

patterns.name: Terminology in AI algorithm reporting
patterns.context: Reporting describes an AI algorithm acquiring a new kind of memory and solving a game

patterns.name: Proper names and numbers in entry headings
patterns.context: Television program entry headings and air dates; activations involve name fragments and dates

patterns.name: Monday date headings
patterns.context: A document begins with a heading comprising a weekday, date, and year, followed by update content

patterns.name: Question-style openings
patterns.context: Question-related word fragments or parameter labels appear near the start of a paragraph or problem

7_1691.concept: 日期、数值及局部词形
7_1691.description: 激活分布于含 October 的日期、数学数字与标点、若干词内子词片段，以及百科标题重复和换行；另有 AI 新闻术语激活，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 日期中的 October
patterns.context: 日期或事件时间表中出现 October；有时紧邻年份或具体日
patterns.domain: 人物传记、事件更新、电视节目条目

patterns.name: 数值及算术格式
patterns.context: 数学题、表达式或参数列表中，激活落在数字、标点及变量上

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在词的开头或内部子词片段；这些词分别处于问题、姓名或医学术语中
patterns.domain: 议会文本、人物条目、医学摘要

patterns.name: 重复的条目标题与换行
patterns.context: 条目标题在换行后重复，标题文字部分也激活

patterns.name: AI算法报道中的术语
patterns.context: 报道描述 AI 算法获得新型记忆并破解游戏

patterns.name: 条目标题中的专名与数字
patterns.context: 节目条目标题及播出日期；激活涉及名称片段和日期

patterns.name: 周一日期标题
patterns.context: 文档开头以星期、日期和年份组成标题，随后进入更新内容

patterns.name: 问题式开头
patterns.context: 段首或题面附近出现提问相关词片段或参数标签

en.concept: Dates/ formatted text and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activations occur in dates and months, encyclopedia entry headings, medical infant contexts, institutional fields, financial news, system notices, email salutations, and Spanish parliamentary phrases. October appears repeatedly in particular, but the passages have no single clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: English month October
patterns.context: The month name appears in dates, headings, or dates in body text; the second passage also contains other months such as January and May, so October is not the only trigger
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, email subjects and body text, dates/announcements

patterns.name: English date and time expressions
patterns.context: Combinations of dates, years, times, and punctuation, often in headings, time ranges, or birth and death dates

patterns.name: Spanish question-session opening
patterns.context: Word fragments in the Spanish phrase “Turno de preguntas” (question session)

patterns.name: infant in medical text
patterns.context: Occurs in infant case descriptions or the title of a study on infant crying

patterns.name: Institutional/role fields
patterns.context: Fields naming the principal investigator in a form or application record

patterns.name: Press releases and financial terminology
patterns.context: Newsletter headings and entries related to credit derivatives

patterns.name: System availability notices
patterns.context: An all-caps heading with spaces between letters, followed by system downtime or availability ranges

patterns.name: Email salutations and back-and-forth correspondence
patterns.context: Salutations in private email body text and expressions about travel and return plans

patterns.name: Repeated headings and entry names
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry heading is repeated at the start of the body, followed by an introduction or biographical dates

patterns.name: Birth and death dates of encyclopedia subjects
patterns.context: A person's name is followed by birth and death dates in parentheses

7_1691.concept: 日期/格式化文本及专名片段
7_1691.description: 激活分布于日期与月份、百科条目标题、医学婴儿语境、机构字段、金融新闻、系统通知、邮件称呼及西班牙语议事短语；其中日期尤其是 October 多次出现，但各段没有单一明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英文月份 October
patterns.trigger: October（第 2 段中还有 «October»9；第 5、8、9、10 段为 «October»8）
patterns.context: 月份名称出现在日期、标题或正文日期中；第 2 段还出现 January、May 等其他月份，故 October 并非唯一触发词
patterns.domain: 百科条目、邮件标题与正文、日期/公告

patterns.name: 英文日期与时间表达
patterns.context: 日期、年份、时间及其标点组合，常处于标题、时间范围或人物生卒日期中

patterns.name: 西班牙语问句开头
patterns.context: 西班牙语短语“Turno de preguntas”（提问环节）中的词片段
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录/议事文本

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 infant
patterns.context: 出现在婴儿病例描述或婴儿哭闹研究标题中

patterns.name: 机构/职务字段
patterns.context: 表格或申请记录中的负责人姓名字段

patterns.name: 新闻稿与金融术语
patterns.context: 新闻简报标题及信用衍生品相关条目

patterns.name: 系统可用性通知
patterns.context: 字母间插空格的全大写标题，后接系统停机或可用时间范围
patterns.domain: 企业邮件/系统维护通知

patterns.name: 邮件称呼与往返信件用语
patterns.context: 私人邮件正文中的称呼及旅行、返回计划表达

patterns.name: 标题与条目名重复
patterns.trigger: «Pebble Mill at One» 重复出现；«Lambert Tree»重复出现
patterns.context: 百科条目标题在正文开头再次重复，后接介绍或人物生卒信息

patterns.name: 百科人物生卒日期
patterns.context: 人物姓名后以括号标出生与逝世日期

en.description: Activations occur across heterogeneous text, often on dates and times, title-style capitalized phrases, email line breaks, and formatted announcements. Other examples involve finance, security, slang, biochemistry, Spanish Q&A, aviation, and Halloween events, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Date and time expressions
patterns.context: Months and numbers occur together in dates, years, times, or time ranges; some examples also include commas, colons, or weekdays.
patterns.domain: Event announcements, email notices, schedule information

patterns.name: Headings and prominent formatting
patterns.context: Capitalized or title-style phrases appear as email subjects, announcement headings, prominent labels, or section headings, often with line breaks.

patterns.name: Email salutations and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Recipient salutations or paragraph separators in email body text; blank lines and line-break markers stand out in multiple passages.

patterns.name: Financial transactions and energy companies
patterns.context: Mentions of transactions, energy companies, or company recruitment in corporate email body text.

patterns.name: Security vulnerabilities and technical evidence
patterns.context: Describes vulnerabilities as long known, disclosed, or supported by evidence such as diagnostic equipment.

patterns.name: Slang and phrase definitions
patterns.context: Asks or explains whether an expression is slang or difficult to understand, and discusses its context.

patterns.name: Amino acid and protein terminology
patterns.context: Introduces the composition of amino acids and mentions their role in proteins.

patterns.name: Spanish Q&A phrase
patterns.context: A Spanish heading for a question-and-answer session appears; the surrounding passage is incomplete.

patterns.name: Travel regulations and airport baggage
patterns.context: Announces aviation travel policies or fee changes, organizing the notice with prominent labels and effective dates.
patterns.domain: Corporate travel notices, aviation management information

patterns.name: Halloween event planning
patterns.context: Lists autumn or Halloween events and provides their times and details.
patterns.domain: Community event websites or promotional copy

7_1691.concept: 结构化文本中的显著片段
7_1691.description: 激活分布于异质文本，常落在日期时间、标题式大写短语、邮件换行与格式化公告；另分别涉及金融、安全、俚语、生化、西语问答、航空及万圣节活动，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 日期与时间表达
patterns.context: 日期、年份、时刻或时间范围中的月份与数字相邻出现；部分例子还带有逗号、冒号或星期。
patterns.domain: 活动公告、邮件通知、日程信息

patterns.name: 标题与醒目排版
patterns.trigger: “Cobra Update”, “END SYSTEMS AVAILABILITY”, “IMPORTANT!”, “POSITIVE BAG MATCH”, “Event Details”
patterns.context: 大写或标题式短语作为邮件主题、公告标题、醒目标签或小节标题出现，常伴随换行。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、网页活动公告

patterns.name: 邮件称呼及换行格式
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的收件人称呼或段落分隔；空行和换行标记在多个片段中突出。

patterns.name: 金融交易与能源公司
patterns.context: 提及交易、能源企业或公司招聘等信息，出现在企业邮件正文中。

patterns.name: 安全漏洞及技术证据
patterns.context: 叙述漏洞早已被知晓、披露或以诊断设备等方式获得证据。
patterns.domain: 黑客论坛、计算机安全讨论

patterns.name: 俚语与短语释义
patterns.context: 提问或解释某个表达是否属于俚语、是否难以理解，并讨论其语境。

patterns.name: 氨基酸与蛋白质术语
patterns.context: 介绍氨基酸的组成，并提及其在蛋白质中的作用。

patterns.name: 西班牙语问答短语
patterns.context: 出现西班牙语的问答环节标题；上下文片段不完整。

patterns.name: 旅行规定与机场行李
patterns.context: 告知航空出行政策或费用变化，并以醒目标签和生效日期组织通知。
patterns.domain: 企业旅行通知、航空管理信息

patterns.name: 万圣节活动安排
patterns.trigger: “Trick or Treating”, “Cabin decorating”, “Golf Cart decorating”, “Halloween crafts”
patterns.context: 列举秋季或万圣节期间的活动，并说明活动时间和详情。
patterns.domain: 社区活动网页或宣传文案

en.concept: notch phrases and sporadic local features
en.description: Primarily responds to notch phrases (up/down a notch, top notch); also includes in introducing events or times, pin forms, and activations on isolated within-word fragments, line breaks, and sporadic words. The gesture description in passage 4 does not fit a stable pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed expression up a notch
patterns.context: The word notch appears, especially with up, down, or top; “notch” itself and tokens in nearby phrases activate strongly.

patterns.name: in introducing emphasis on time or events
patterns.context: The preposition in occurs within a sentence and introduces an event or time range; activation falls on in.

patterns.name: pin-related forms
patterns.context: The literal form pin or a name containing the root appears; activation concentrates on pin or pinching.

patterns.name: Local fragment in an unusual word form
patterns.context: Activation falls on a within-word fragment of the nonstandard spelling “squeeking”; seals are discussed nearby.

patterns.name: Text fragments and line breaks
patterns.context: Strong activations occur in short passages or around line breaks, but have no stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Sporadic highlights not explained by shared semantics
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context, with no reproducible shared collocation or condition.

7_1691.concept: notch短语及零散局部特征
7_1691.description: 主要响应 notch 短语（up/down a notch、top notch）；另见 in 引导活动或时间、pin 词形，以及个别词内片段、换行和零散词的激活。第4段的手势描写无法归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: up a notch固定搭配
patterns.trigger: “up a notch” / “tone that down a notch” / “top notch”
patterns.context: 出现短语 notch，尤其与 up、down 或 top 搭配；“notch”本身及其邻近短语中的 token 有强激活。

patterns.name: in 后强调时间或活动
patterns.context: 介词 in 位于句中并引出活动或时间范围；激活落在 in。

patterns.name: pin相关词形
patterns.context: 出现 pin 的字面词形或包含该词根的名称；激活集中在 pin 或 pinching。

patterns.name: 怪异词形中的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在非标准拼写“squeeking”的词内片段，附近谈论 seals。

patterns.name: 文本片段与换行
patterns.trigger: “Jussi Jumppanen”附近的换行，以及“back”后的换行
patterns.context: 短片段或换行前后出现强激活，但没有稳定的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 无法由共同语义解释的零散高亮
patterns.context: 各自出现于不同语境，未见可复现的共同搭配或条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several contexts: housing, sports game appearances, inheritance, motivation, neighbors, and several one-off word senses. They sometimes cluster locally within word forms, but have no clear unified semantics overall.

patterns.name: houses and housing construction
patterns.context: Involves developers building houses or a shortage of housing supply and a tight rental market.

patterns.name: games in sports
patterns.context: Describes player appearances or the number of games played this season after a suspension.

patterns.name: Inheritance forms
patterns.context: Describes a character inheriting an estate or title; activation concentrates on the inherit stem and its inflections.

patterns.name: Motivation and incentives
patterns.context: Describes someone using incentives or being inspired after watching content.

patterns.name: Neighbors and acquaintances
patterns.context: Mentions neighbors as personal relations or as people observed or interacted with.

patterns.name: The action hit
patterns.context: Used as a sports instruction meaning to watch the ball and hit it.

patterns.name: Benefits of nomad life
patterns.context: Discusses digital nomad life and notes its conveniences or advantages.

patterns.name: stakes and major events
patterns.context: Uses “stakes could be higher” to emphasize the importance of events such as a Super Bowl berth.

patterns.name: Quantity expressed as half
patterns.context: Half of a piece of land is sold, followed by area or quantity information.

patterns.name: Temporal sense of close
patterns.context: “at its close” refers to the end of a life or experience.

7_1691.concept: none
7_1691.description: 激活分散在多类语境：住房、体育比赛场次、继承、动机、邻居及若干单次词义。词形内部有时局部集中，但整体没有明确统一语义。

patterns.name: houses及住房建设
patterns.context: 涉及开发商建房，或住房供给不足、租赁市场紧张。

patterns.name: 比赛中的 games
patterns.context: 描述球员出赛场次或停赛后本赛季仅参加的比赛数。

patterns.name: 继承词形
patterns.context: 叙述人物继承遗产或爵位；激活集中在 inherit 词干及其变形。

patterns.name: 动机及激励
patterns.context: 描述某人用激励方法，或观看内容后受到鼓舞。

patterns.name: 邻居与熟人
patterns.context: 提及邻居作为人物关系或被观察、交往的对象。

patterns.name: hit 的动作
patterns.context: 作为运动指令，指看球并击球。

patterns.name: nomad 的益处
patterns.context: 谈数字游牧生活，并指出其带来的便利或优势。

patterns.name: stakes 与重大赛事
patterns.context: 用“stakes could be higher”强调超级碗席位等赛事的重要性。

patterns.name: half 的数量表达
patterns.context: 出售土地的一半，后接面积或数量信息。

patterns.name: close 的时间义
patterns.context: “at its close”表示生命或经历的终末。
patterns.domain: 古典人物传记、文学文本

en.concept: Strings containing ugg and competition statistics
en.description: Activations mainly fall on strings containing “ugg” (such as snuggles, smuggled, sluggish), as well as accounts of competition results, wins, rankings, and games played; there is also an activation on the number of degrees in a biography.

patterns.name: Strings containing smugg
patterns.context: No fixed syntax or word sense is required; appears in different word forms, including both actual smuggling and a word describing sluggish performance

patterns.name: Competition records and rankings
patterns.context: Describes competitions, seasons, wins, rankings, or athlete career records, often with consecutive numbers and results
patterns.domain: Sports news, encyclopedia biographies, and competition reports

patterns.name: Number of degrees
patterns.context: States the number of degrees earned by a person in a biography

7_1691.concept: 含ugg词串与赛事统计
7_1691.description: 激活主要落在含“ugg”的词串（如 snuggles、smuggled、sluggish），以及赛事成绩、胜场、名次和比赛场次等统计叙述；另在一处人物传记的学位数量处激活。

patterns.name: 含有 smugg 的字符串
patterns.context: 不要求固定句法或词义，出现在不同词形中；既包括实际走私，也包括形容性能迟缓的词
patterns.domain: 评论、法律叙述、技术讨论

patterns.name: 赛绩与名次统计
patterns.context: 描述比赛、赛季、胜场、名次或运动员生涯纪录，常见连续数字与成绩表述
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、百科人物传记及赛事报道

patterns.name: 学历数量
patterns.context: 人物传记中说明个人获得的学位数量

en.concept: Proper names and data in sports news
en.description: Primarily responds to team names, personal names, event results, and statistical figures in sports text, also covering football leagues and player information, drafts, injuries, and team commentary; a few other contexts include game combat and financial index reporting.

patterns.name: Score and ranking number strings
patterns.context: Numbers, hyphens, or ordinals form scores, records, draft picks, player numbers, or statistics, often in accounts of results and rankings.
patterns.domain: Sports news, event coverage, and sports statistics; [10] may also be financial index data

patterns.name: Sports team and player names
patterns.context: Team names, personal names, or team nicknames appear in accounts of games, player performance, injuries, and drafts; triggers sometimes fall on subword fragments within names.
patterns.domain: Ice hockey, American football, soccer, and team/faction descriptions in fantasy games

patterns.name: Soccer matches and league accounts
patterns.context: Soccer contexts involving league affiliation, home grounds, transfers, or whether a player can appear regularly.

patterns.name: Games and fantasy combat
patterns.context: Discusses game scenarios, leading orcs into battle, and number of battles, in a personal essay-like tone.

patterns.name: Injuries and season absences
patterns.context: A player misses games due to injury or post-concussion symptoms, followed by an account of a change in captaincy.

patterns.name: Stock or index movements
patterns.context: Describes a market rebound using an index name and point levels.

patterns.name: Team composition and coaching decisions
patterns.context: Discusses coaches assigning player positions, judging starting eligibility, and opinions on roster decisions.

patterns.name: Evaluation of results and team strength comparisons
patterns.context: Comments on a team's comeback or resilience, or compares defensive strength within a division.

patterns.name: Odds and draft picks
patterns.context: Describes a team's odds of drawing a draft pick and the final order.
patterns.domain: North American professional sports draft reporting

patterns.name: League teams and venue information
patterns.context: A small club changes leagues and introduces its home ground and capacity.

7_1691.concept: 体育新闻中的专名与数据
7_1691.description: 主要响应体育文本中的队名、人名、赛事结果与数字统计，也涵盖足球联赛和球员信息、选秀、伤病及球队评论；另有游戏战斗与金融指数报道等少数语境。

patterns.name: 比分及排名数字串
patterns.context: 数字、连字符或序数构成的比分、战绩、选秀顺位、球员号码或统计数据，常出现在比赛结果和排名叙述中。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、赛事报道与体育统计；[10]也可能是金融指数数据

patterns.name: 体育队伍及球员名称
patterns.context: 队名、人名或队伍昵称出现在比赛、球员表现、伤病、选秀等叙述中；触发有时落在名称内部的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 冰球、美式橄榄球、足球，以及奇幻游戏的队伍/阵营叙述

patterns.name: 足球比赛与联赛叙述
patterns.context: 联赛归属、主场、转会或球员能否稳定出场等足球语境。

patterns.name: 游戏与奇幻战斗
patterns.context: 谈及游戏情境、带领兽人参战及战斗次数，语气偏个人随笔。
patterns.domain: 游戏/奇幻题材网络帖子

patterns.name: 伤病与赛季缺阵
patterns.context: 球员因伤病或脑震荡后遗症缺席比赛，之后叙述队长更替。

patterns.name: 个股或指数涨跌数据
patterns.context: 以指数名称及点数、关口描述市场反弹。

patterns.name: 球队配置与教练决策
patterns.trigger: «put everyone where he thinks they fit best»、«starting at LT»
patterns.context: 讨论教练安排球员位置、判断先发资格及对阵容决策的看法。

patterns.name: 赛果评价与球队实力比较
patterns.trigger: «sure victory»、«gutty performances»、«not even the best defensive team»
patterns.context: 评述球队逆转、表现韧性，或比较分区内防守实力。

patterns.name: 赔率与选秀顺位
patterns.context: 描述球队抽中选秀签位的概率和最终顺序。
patterns.domain: 北美职业体育选秀报道

patterns.name: 联赛球队及场地信息
patterns.trigger: «Dumfries & District Amateur Football League»、«South of Scotland Football League»、«Moffat Academy»
patterns.context: 小型俱乐部更换联赛并介绍主场及容量。

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and sports-context features
en.description: Activations are scattered across segmented proper names, sports players and event commentary, statistical numbers, and ordinary function words; business email figures and literary proper-name fragments also occur, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sports names and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within personal, team, or organization names, often as proper-name fragments split by tokenization; also includes numbers, hyphens, or abbreviations adjacent to proper names.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, business emails, and literary text

patterns.name: Hockey roster and NHL level
patterns.context: Evaluates whether a player is at NHL level or their tier within a team roster, often alongside player names, position abbreviations, and hyphenated tiers.

patterns.name: Sports performance and statistical descriptions
patterns.context: Descriptions of player performance, game data, positions, or roles; some activations fall on numerical values, statistical terms, role words, and adjacent fragments.
patterns.domain: Basketball, hockey, and general sports commentary

patterns.name: Common English function words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Short words or phrase fragments in ordinary syntactic contexts; spans sports reporting, emails, and literary text without a stable specialized semantic condition.

patterns.name: Events and game-action words
patterns.context: Words related to games, stages of an event, or possession, occurring in soccer or basketball reporting.

patterns.name: Email amounts and times with numbers
patterns.context: Emails involving amounts, units of measurement, effective dates, or numerical corrections; organization names also occur around the numbers.

patterns.name: Book titles and character references in literary works
patterns.context: Italics-marked titles of literary works and tokenized ordinary words or forms of address; no clear connection to sports contexts.

patterns.name: Player appearance and physical characteristics
patterns.context: Describes players' appearance, physique, or fitness, often alongside evaluations of athletic ability.

7_1691.concept: 混杂的词片段与体育语境特征
7_1691.description: 激活分散在专名拆分、体育球员与赛事评论、统计数字和普通功能词上；另有商务邮件数值及文学专名片段，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 体育人名与专名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名、球队名或机构名内部，常是被分词拆开的专名片段；也包括紧邻专名的数字、连字符或缩写。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、商业邮件及文学文本

patterns.name: 冰球阵容与 NHL 级别
patterns.context: 评价球员是否达到 NHL 水平或在球队阵容中的等级，常与球员姓名、位置缩写和连字符等级并列。

patterns.name: 体育表现与统计描述
patterns.context: 球员表现、比赛数据、位置或角色的描述；部分激活落在数值、统计词、角色词及其相邻片段上。
patterns.domain: 篮球、冰球及一般体育评论

patterns.name: 英语常见功能词及短语片段
patterns.trigger: « a»、« but»、« his»、« at»、« in»、« being»、« but»、«when»、« as»
patterns.context: 出现在普通句法环境中的短词或短语片段；跨越体育报道、邮件和文学文本，未显示稳定的专门语义条件。

patterns.name: 赛事与比赛动作词
patterns.context: 与比赛、赛事阶段或球权相关的词语，出现在足球或篮球报道中。

patterns.name: 带数字的邮件金额与时间
patterns.context: 邮件中涉及金额、计量单位、有效日期或数值更正；数字周围也有机构名。

patterns.name: 文学作品中的书名与人物称谓
patterns.context: 文学文本中斜体标记的作品名及被拆分的普通词或称谓；与体育语境无明显联系。

patterns.name: 球员外观与身体特征
patterns.context: 描述球员外貌、身体条件或体能特点，常与竞技能力评价并列。

en.description: Examples of activations divide into fragments of the surname Plimpton, several within-word fragments, and proper names, scores, and terminology in various sports texts. Sports text is the largest category, but trigger locations are scattered, so it is unclear whether the remaining fragments share a mechanism with the sports theme.

patterns.name: Fragment within the surname Plimpton
patterns.context: When the English name Plimpton is tokenized, activation falls on a fragment in the middle of the surname; one passage features a character in a narrative, the other a list of names.

patterns.name: Specific fragments in proper names or words
patterns.context: Activations occur within longer English words or at word-form boundaries; no shared semantics or stable morphological condition is apparent across the three examples.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, personal-experience review, music review

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in sports commentary
patterns.context: Occurs in reports or commentary related to hockey, basketball, football, or wrestling, involving sports, names, scores, positions, or game terminology; specific activation locations vary.

7_1691.concept: 体育文本与词内片段
7_1691.description: 激活例子可分为 Plimpton 姓氏片段、若干词内片段，以及多种体育文本中的专名、比分和术语。体育文本覆盖最多，但触发位置分散，不能确定其余片段与体育主题共享机制。

patterns.name: Plimpton 姓氏内部片段
patterns.context: 英文人名 Plimpton 被切分时，激活落在姓氏中间的片段；一段是叙事中的人物，一段是人名列表。

patterns.name: 专名或词内的特定片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在较长英文单词内部，或词形切分处；三例之间看不出共享语义或稳定词形条件。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、个人体验评论、音乐评论

patterns.name: 体育评论中的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «face»«off»（face-off，第1段）；«NHL»（第1段）；«2»-«3»、«6»-«8»、«6»-«9»（比分，第2段）；«Jets»«football»（第6段）；«She»amus、«vs»、Or«ton»、R«umble»（第7段）；«three»-«down»（第10段）
patterns.context: 出现在冰球、篮球、橄榄球或摔角相关报道、评论中，涉及运动项目、人名、比分、位置或比赛用语；激活具体落点各异。

en.description: Activations often fall on numbers or numeric suffixes: examples include competition rankings, quantities, player numbers, scores, and scientific multiples. Other examples include faceoff, country music, and split fragments of names or proper nouns. The overall pattern is dispersed, and some proper-noun fragments resist a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Ordinal rankings and placement
patterns.context: A number followed by the ordinal suffix th indicates a competitor’s placement; activation falls near the number and suffix.

patterns.name: The quantity word “five”
patterns.context: The English number word five indicates a quantity in a sentence estimating that someone was a few years late to an event.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in faceoff
patterns.context: The word faceoff (a hockey face-off) is split into two subword fragments; the latter part activates more strongly.

patterns.name: The phrase “country music”
patterns.context: country is followed directly by music to form a music genre name; it appears twice.

patterns.name: 9 in a number string
patterns.context: 9 appears in a numeric expression after factor; the text describes a change in simulation results by a multiple or a range of galaxy brightness.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on split names, event names, or fragments within ordinary words; these examples have no obvious shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, lyrics, and entertainment content

patterns.name: Basketball player numbers and score digits
patterns.context: Activations occur in player numbers or score-like number strings, including separators and adjacent digits.

7_1691.concept: 数字及子词片段
7_1691.description: 激活多落在数字或数字后缀中：比赛名次、数量、球员号码、比分和科学倍数均有例子；另有 faceoff、country music 及拆分的人名或专名片段。整体模式分散，部分专名片段无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 序数名次与排名
patterns.context: 数字后接序数后缀 th，表示选手在比赛中的名次；激活落在数字及后缀附近。

patterns.name: “five”数量词
patterns.context: 英文数词 five 表示数量，出现在估计晚了几年参加活动的句子中。

patterns.name: faceoff 词内片段
patterns.context: 词组 faceoff（冰球开球争球）被分成两个子词片段；后半部分激活更强。

patterns.name: “country music”词组
patterns.context: country 紧接 music，构成音乐类型名称；两处重复出现。

patterns.name: 数字串中的 9
patterns.context: 9 出现在 factor 后的数值表达中；文中描述模拟结果的变化倍数或星系亮度范围。

patterns.name: 人名及专名的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在拆分的人名、赛事名或普通词内部片段；这些例子没有共同的明显语义条件。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、歌词及娱乐内容

patterns.name: 篮球球员号码与比分数字
patterns.context: 激活出现在球员号码或比分样式的数字串中，包含分隔符及相邻数字。

en.concept: Word-internal fragment detection; specific feature unclear
en.description: High activations often fall on word-internal substrings or identifier fragments, such as spiky, pimped, fratboy, SPIN_LOCK, Jumpin', spatially, and spindly. Genres and semantics vary; there are also sports and humanoid-robot contexts, making it difficult to assign a single meaning.

patterns.name: The word form spiky
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within spiky; examples describe the peak of a power distribution and a person’s hairstyle, which are not in the same semantic field.

patterns.name: Word-internal pim
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on a fragment within the spelling pimped. The sentence says a mouse provides instant credibility; no stable lexical meaning or contextual condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal frat
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on frat in fratboy, in a derogatory description of a person.

patterns.name: SPIN lock identifier
patterns.context: The SPIN fragment in the uppercase identifier INIT_SPIN_LOCK; code initializes a lock.

patterns.name: Word-internal jumpin
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within the album title Jumpin' at Capitol, which contains an apostrophe.

patterns.name: Word-internal spatial
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within spatially; the context discusses generating spatially coherent 3D scenes from input.

patterns.name: Word-internal spindly
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within spindly, describing a small character’s build.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment Jumpin/spin?
patterns.context: Visible high-activation fragments mainly extend into the place name Peoria and the team name Gophers; no semantic trigger condition consistent with the other cases is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments oid/rob
patterns.context: Discussion of future humanoid robots; activation markers occur in the ending of humanoid and the following rob fragment, with an unclear relationship.

7_1691.concept: 词内片段检测，具体特征不明
7_1691.description: 高激活多落在词内子串或标识符片段，如 spiky、pimped、fratboy、SPIN_LOCK、Jumpin'、spatially、spindly；体裁与语义分散，另有体育、人形机器人语境，难归为单一含义。

patterns.name: spiky 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 spiky 的词内片段；分别描写权力分布的尖端和人物发型，并非同一语义场。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论；人物外貌描写

patterns.name: 词中间的 pim
patterns.context: 激活集中在拼写为 pimped 的词内片段，句子说鼠标带来即时可信度；未见稳定的词义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 词中间的 frat
patterns.context: 激活集中于 fratboy 中的 frat，处在对人的贬损性描述中。

patterns.name: SPIN 锁标识符
patterns.context: 大写标识符 INIT_SPIN_LOCK 中的 SPIN 片段；代码初始化锁。

patterns.name: 词中间的 jumpin
patterns.context: 激活落在专辑标题 Jumpin' at Capitol 的词内片段，标题中含撇号。

patterns.name: 词中间的 spatial
patterns.context: 激活落在 spatially 的词内片段；上下文讨论由输入生成空间连贯的 3D 场景。

patterns.name: 词中间的 spindly
patterns.context: 激活落在 spindly 的词内片段，修饰小人物的身形。

patterns.name: 词内片段 Jumpin/spin?
patterns.context: 可见高激活片段主要跨入地名 Peoria 和球队称呼 Gophers，未呈现与其他段一致的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内片段 oid/rob
patterns.context: 讨论未来人形机器人；激活标记分布在 humanoid 的词尾及后续 rob 片段，关系不明确。

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal word fragments, numbers, proper nouns, technical terms, and colloquial descriptions. No stable semantic or stylistic commonality is apparent; the most notable shared feature is that several word fragments are split by tokenization, but the trigger forms also vary.

patterns.name: Specific word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of words split into multiple tokens, often in the middle or at the end of a word; they occur across different words and contexts.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur near numbers, quantities, or mathematical notation; some numeric expressions do not trigger continuously.

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper nouns and titles
patterns.context: Some subword fragments in names, stage names, song titles, or nicknames activate; no unified category of proper noun is apparent.
patterns.domain: Music catalogs, sports commentary, local news

patterns.name: Technical and future-speculation contexts
patterns.context: A few word fragments activate in discussions of computational complexity, software replication, 3D space, or future technology; the words themselves do not form a stable shared trigger.

patterns.name: Descriptive or slang word fragments
patterns.context: In descriptions of appearance, quantities, or derogatory colloquial language, activations are scattered within words or across adjacent words.

7_1691.concept: none
7_1691.description: 激活分布在多种词的内部片段及数字、专名、技术词和口语描述上。未见稳定的语义或文体共性；较显著的共同点是若干被分词切开的词片段，但触发形式也不一致。

patterns.name: 词内特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆成多个 token 的词内部片段，常为词中部或后部；跨不同词与语境出现。
patterns.domain: 通用文本、论坛、音乐条目

patterns.name: 数字与数值表达
patterns.context: 数字、数量或数学记号附近出现激活，部分数字表达并非连续触发。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、数学/技术文本

patterns.name: 专名及标题中的局部片段
patterns.context: 人名、艺名、歌曲名或戏称中的某些子词片段被激活；未见统一的专名类别。
patterns.domain: 音乐目录、体育评论、地方新闻

patterns.name: 技术与未来设想语境
patterns.context: 讨论计算复杂度、软件复制、3D 空间或未来技术时，少数词片段激活；这些词本身不构成稳定共同触发。

patterns.name: 描述性/俚语词片段
patterns.context: 人物外貌、数量或带贬义的口语描述中，激活分散在词内或相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 叙事、体育评论、网络口语

en.description: Activations primarily occur on or: commonly in more or less and numeric alternatives. Other scattered local triggers include from in come from behind, an asterisk in a censored swear word, a fragment within tumble, and form.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “more or less”
patterns.context: The trigger is or in the phrase; more precedes it and less follows it. The phrase can mean approximately/about the same, or indicate approximate degree in comparison or enumeration.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, fictional narration, and general prose

patterns.name: “or” linking alternatives
patterns.context: or links adjacent numeric or quantity options, indicating an approximation or an either-or listing.

patterns.name: from in come from behind
patterns.context: In a post-game sports quote, from occurs in come from behind, describing a comeback after trailing.

patterns.name: Asterisk in “F* Michael Dell”
patterns.context: The asterisk immediately follows F and is used as a censored swear word or part of an abbreviation, in a short sentence mentioning a person.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in tum-ble
patterns.context: Activation falls within the word tumble, split by a line break or tokenization; nearby context discusses words slipping out.

patterns.name: Local trigger in form
patterns.context: The word appears in an expression like something form that person, discussing recognition of someone’s writing style; the available material is insufficient to determine a more specific trigger condition.

7_1691.concept: 英语中局部高频词片段
7_1691.description: 激活以 or 为主：常见于 more or less 以及数字备选项；另有 come from behind 中的 from、脏话缩写星号、tumble 的词内片段和 form，呈现零散的局部触发。

patterns.name: 固定短语“more or less”
patterns.context: 触发词是短语中的 or；前有 more、后有 less，可表示“大致/差不多”，也可在比较或列举语境中表示程度近似。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、小说叙述及一般散文

patterns.name: “or”连接备选项
patterns.context: or 连接相邻的数字或数量选项，表示约数或二选一式列举。
patterns.domain: 小说散文、网络安全讨论

patterns.name: come from behind 中的 from
patterns.context: 体育赛后引语中，from 与 come from behind 搭配，描述落后后追赶或逆转。

patterns.name: “F* Michael Dell”中的星号
patterns.context: 星号紧接 F，用作被遮蔽的脏话或缩写的一部分，出现在提及人物的短句中。

patterns.name: tum-ble 中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被换行或分词切开的单词 tumble 内部；邻近语境谈到话语脱口而出。

patterns.name: form 的局部触发
patterns.context: 该词出现在 something form that person 一类表达中，谈论识别某人的写作风格；可见材料不足以确定更具体的触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several sentence patterns: sentence-final tag questions (“isn’t it”), numeric alternatives or ranges (especially “or” and “-”), the comparative structure “than,” and several local phrases. There is insufficient evidence that these patterns share a single semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Tag-question endings
patterns.context: A statement or judgment is followed by a tag question, often to emphasize a point or seek agreement; “isn” and “’t” are split into marked tokens

patterns.name: “or” introducing alternative quantities
patterns.context: Connects two possible numbers, often in the format “X or Y”; the numbers themselves need not be the same
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, economic discussion, fictional narration, technical discussion

patterns.name: Hyphen in numeric ranges
patterns.context: A hyphen connects two numbers to indicate a range or duration, such as “10-20”; activation may also involve nearby numeric expressions

patterns.name: “form” in a quantity or proportion expression
patterns.context: Appears in sentences like “seen something … that person”; the precise grammatical relation is unclear

patterns.name: Hyphen in the compound cash-out
patterns.context: The hyphen occurs between “cash” and “out”; the nearby text also contains the quantity comparison “9 or 10 stories”
patterns.domain: HackerNews startup and employee stock-option discussion

patterns.name: “three” in a repeated-quantity expression
patterns.context: The number “three” describes the number of repeated calls, followed by “or four”

patterns.name: Comparative structure with “than”
patterns.context: Used to compare degree or quantity; the passages contain “more than understandingly” and “more than 2 or three days”

patterns.name: Irregular sentence-initial we
patterns.context: The paragraph begins with lowercase “we,” followed by a hypothetical argument about the money supply and work

patterns.name: “four straight” in a retrospective account
patterns.context: Describes four consecutive events, then discusses losing a game and waiting for the next season

patterns.name: “9 or 10” in a quantity comparison
patterns.context: Compares the number of cash-out stories with other stories, adjacent to the cash-out context

patterns.name: “like” in online colloquial language
patterns.context: “like crazy” indicates strong degree or large quantity, not literal similarity

patterns.name: “people” and “these” in conversation
patterns.context: Discusses contacting others, getting them to speak candidly, and keeping them engaged; these are ordinary referential expressions syntactically

patterns.name: Retrospective time range
patterns.context: A hyphen connects a range of years, followed by a question about whether future hosting costs will be too high

7_1691.concept: none
7_1691.description: 激活分散在多类句式中：反问句尾“isn’t it”、数字备选或范围（尤其“or”及“-”）、比较结构“than”，以及若干局部词组。没有足够证据表明这些模式共享单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 反问式句尾
patterns.context: 陈述或判断后接反问，常用于加强语气或寻求认同；“isn”与“’t”被拆成标记 token

patterns.name: “or”引出备选数量
patterns.context: 连接两个可能的数字，常见格式为“X or Y”；数字本身未必相同
patterns.domain: 体育报道、经济讨论、小说叙述、技术讨论

patterns.name: 数字区间的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接两个数字，表示范围或时长，如“10-20”；激活也可能涉及附近的数字表达

patterns.name: 数量或比例表达中的“form”
patterns.context: 在“seen something … that person”一类句子中出现，具体语法关系不明确

patterns.name: 现金套现的复合词连字符
patterns.context: 连字符位于“cash”和“out”之间；附近还出现数量比较“9 or 10 stories”

patterns.name: 重复数量表达中的“three”
patterns.context: 以数字“three”描述反复发生的来电次数，后接“or four”

patterns.name: “than”比较结构
patterns.context: 用于比较程度或数量；段中分别出现“more than understandingly”和“more than 2 or three days”

patterns.name: 不规则句首 we
patterns.context: 段落以小写“we”开头，后接关于货币供应和工作的假设性论述

patterns.name: 回顾经历的“four straight”
patterns.context: 描述连续经历的四次事件，随后谈输球及等待下一赛季

patterns.name: 数量比较中的“9 or 10”
patterns.context: 比较套现故事与其他故事的数量，紧邻cash-out语境

patterns.name: 网络口语中的“like”
patterns.context: “like crazy”表示程度强或数量多，不是字面上的相似关系

patterns.name: 对话中的“people”与“these”
patterns.context: 谈到联系他人、让他们坦诚表达并持续参与；句法上是普通指代表达

patterns.name: 回顾性时间范围
patterns.context: 以连字符连接年数范围，并询问未来托管成本是否过高

en.concept: Common English function words and word fragments
en.description: Activations primarily fall on the negative contraction suffix n't (especially isn’t and don’t) and or in quantity ranges. Colloquial phrases, insults, and some proper-noun fragments also appear, but the latter groups lack a unified context.

patterns.name: n't in negative questions
patterns.context: Occurs in negative auxiliary contractions, often at the end of rhetorical or evaluative sentences, but also in ordinary statements.

patterns.name: or in quantity expressions
patterns.context: Connects two quantities to form an approximation or alternative range, such as “three or four,” “five or six,” “six or seven,” and “two or more”; covers the stronger activation locations.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, legal testimony, personal blogs, wrestling commentary, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Other standalone colloquial words and phrases
patterns.context: Triggers vary across passages, with no stable shared syntactic or semantic condition; examples include insults, colloquial expressions, and common phrases.
patterns.domain: News commentary, sports quotes, IRC chat, HackerNews discussion

patterns.name: Proper nouns or proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on partial tokens of proper nouns; no obvious shared contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony, music reviews, wrestling commentary

7_1691.concept: 常见英语功能词与词片段
7_1691.description: 激活主要落在否定缩写 n't（尤其 isn’t、don’t）及数量范围中的 or；另见口语词组、辱骂词和若干专名片段，后几类缺乏统一上下文。

patterns.name: 否定疑问句中的 n't
patterns.context: 出现在否定助动词缩写中，常位于反问或评价性句子的末尾，也可位于普通陈述中。

patterns.name: 数量表达中的 or
patterns.context: 连接两个数量，构成约数或备选范围，如“三或四”“五或六”“六或七”“两种或更多”；覆盖较强激活位置。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、法律证词、个人博客、摔角评论、技术问答

patterns.name: 其他独立的口语词与短语
patterns.context: 在各段中分别触发，未显示稳定的共同句法或语义条件；包括辱骂和口语表达，以及常见词组。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、体育引语、IRC聊天、HackerNews讨论

patterns.name: 专名或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的部分 token 上；没有明显共同的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 法律证词、音乐评论、摔角评论

en.description: Activations occur on n at the end of negative-contraction stems, on operators and relational symbols in numbers and formulas, and on several word-internal subword fragments. Online slang, music narratives, and scattered ordinary words also appear across varied genres, making it difficult to assign a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric equations and connective operators
patterns.context: Connects options, assignments, or relations of magnitude between numbers, variables, or mathematical expressions; sometimes occurs in incomplete formula fragments.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and engineering discussions, as well as everyday numeric expressions; passages 2, 3, 4, 7, 10

patterns.name: n in negative contractions
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on n at the end of negative-contraction stems, across different persons, tenses, and moods; nearby text is often negative.
patterns.domain: English narratives, dialogue, and online discussions; passages 1, 5, 6, 8

patterns.name: Adjacent morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on adjacent subword fragments within a word or formula rather than on whole words; may overlap with numeric/symbol patterns.
patterns.domain: Music narratives and mathematically typeset text; passages 1, 2, 9

patterns.name: Social media and online dialogue language
patterns.context: Discusses platform features or waiting and responding in online communication.
patterns.domain: HackerNews and Ubuntu IRC online discussions; passages 5, 8

patterns.name: Performances, music, and performance anxiety
patterns.context: Involves experiences of creating, singing, or performers coping with stage fright.

patterns.name: Hard-to-classify local word items in passages
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across ordinary words or stems, with no clear shared local collocation; they may be influenced separately by semantics or tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narratives, storage-cost discussions, battery-charging discussions, and personal blogs; passages 1, 5, 7, 10

7_1691.concept: 异质的词形与符号模式
7_1691.description: 激活分布于否定缩写词干末尾的 n、数字和公式中的连接／关系符号，以及若干词内子词片段；另见网络用语、音乐叙述和分散的普通词项，跨语料文体，难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数字等式与取值连接词
patterns.context: 在数字、变量或数学表达式之间连接选项、赋值或大小关系；有时处在不完整的公式片段中。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及工程讨论，也包括日常数字表达；段2、3、4、7、10

patterns.name: 否定缩写中的撇号后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在否定缩写词干末尾的 n，出现在不同人称、时态和语气中；周围常有否定句。
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、对话及网络讨论；段1、5、6、8

patterns.name: 相邻构词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词或公式中相邻的子词片段，而非完整词；与数字／符号模式可能重叠。
patterns.domain: 音乐叙述与数学排版文本；段1、2、9

patterns.name: 社交媒体与在线对话用语
patterns.context: 谈及平台功能或在线交流中的等待、回应行为。

patterns.name: 演出、音乐及表演焦虑
patterns.context: 涉及创作、演唱或表演者应对舞台紧张的经历。

patterns.name: 片段中较难归类的局部词项
patterns.context: 各段的激活分散于普通词或词干，缺乏明显统一的局部搭配；可能分别受语义或分词边界影响。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、存储成本讨论、电池充电讨论及个人博客；段1、5、7、10

en.concept: Local word forms and collocational fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across negative auxiliary contractions, anything in degree expressions, up to speed, and numeric and of phrases. There are also several sporadic word-internal fragments and common words, which are difficult to explain with a single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Negative auxiliary contractions
patterns.context: The stem portion of negative auxiliary contractions is highlighted; covers different word forms and punctuation styles

patterns.name: anything in degree expressions
patterns.context: anything occurs in degree or contrast structures, followed by close, but, or similar elements

patterns.name: to in a degree expression
patterns.context: to occurs in the fixed expression up to speed; preceding text discusses reaching proficiency

patterns.name: Tokenization boundary in the numeral zero
patterns.context: 000 in a digit string is highlighted, near topics such as resale value and other numeric or price-related discussion

patterns.name: Person descriptor followed by an of phrase
patterns.context: The person descriptor guy is followed by an of phrase describing his talent

patterns.name: Adjacent collocation man of
patterns.context: man of is followed by an abstract quality noun, forming an evaluation of a person

patterns.name: Ordinary words or subword fragments
patterns.context: Highlighted positions are scattered, involving ordinary nouns, word-internal segmentation, and spelling fragments, with no shared syntactic environment

patterns.name: Scattered common words and phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall in different semantic and syntactic positions, with no stable shared contextual condition

7_1691.concept: 局部词形与搭配片段
7_1691.description: 激活分散于否定助动词缩写、anything 与程度搭配、up to speed，以及数字和 of 短语；另有多处零散词内片段与常见词，难以由单一稳定语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 否定助动词缩写
patterns.context: 否定助动词缩写中的词干部分被突出；覆盖不同词形和标点写法

patterns.name: 程度表达中的 anything
patterns.context: anything 出现在程度或对比结构中，后接 close、but 等成分

patterns.name: 程度表达中的 to
patterns.context: to 位于 up to speed 固定表达中；前文谈及达到熟练程度

patterns.name: 数词零的分词边界
patterns.context: 数字字符串中的 000 被突出，邻近 resale value 等数字或价格话题

patterns.name: 人物称谓 of 后接名词
patterns.context: 人物称谓 guy 后接 of 短语，描述其才华

patterns.name: man 与 of 的相邻搭配
patterns.context: man of 后接抽象品质名词，构成对人的评价

patterns.name: 普通词或子词片段
patterns.context: 突出位置分散，分别涉及普通名词、词内切分及拼写片段，缺乏共同句法环境
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论、文学、网页文本

patterns.name: 分散的常见词与短语
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语义和句法位置，未见稳定的共同上下文条件

en.concept: Degree expressions introduced by to and relational symbols in formulas
en.description: Activations are mixed: one group occurs in expressions of degree, standards, or roles introduced by to; another concentrates on equals signs, inequality signs, and numeric punctuation in scientific formulas. Other isolated cases include anything close and sentence-final punctuation.

patterns.name: to + abstract degree/standard
patterns.context: to is followed by a degree, standard, or role; examples include “to the required physical readiness standards,” “rise to the level,” and “to be an obnoxious brain box,” but it does not necessarily activate when followed by a specific action.
patterns.domain: General narrative, formal investigation reports, online discussion

patterns.name: be + anything close
patterns.context: In the structure “anything close to precise,” anything emphasizes approaching a certain degree or state.

patterns.name: Relational symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Equals signs and inequality signs occur in formulas or mathematical expressions; they are often surrounded by variables, subscripts/superscripts, and formula layout.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and cosmology papers

patterns.name: Numeric/formula punctuation
patterns.context: Includes decimals, parameters, and punctuation in formulas near numeric values or mathematical symbols; may overlap with the relational-symbol pattern.

patterns.name: Period after a short time frame
patterns.context: A sentence-final punctuation mark is followed by a line break, then a shift to discussion of automotive resale value.

7_1691.concept: to 引导的程度表达与公式关系符号
7_1691.description: 激活分布较杂：一类出现在 to 引出的程度、标准或身份表达，另一类集中于科学公式中的等号、不等号及数值标点；另有 anything close 和句末标点等孤例。

patterns.name: to + 抽象程度/标准
patterns.context: to 后接程度、标准或角色；包括 “to the required physical readiness standards”“rise to the level”“to be an obnoxious brain box”，但后接具体动作时未必激活。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、正式调查报告、网络讨论

patterns.name: be + anything close
patterns.context: “anything close to precise”结构中，anything 强调接近某种程度或状态。
patterns.domain: 关于器材精度的论坛式叙述

patterns.name: 数学公式中的关系符号
patterns.context: 公式或数学表达式中出现等号、不等号；周围多为变量、上下标及公式排版。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理与宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 数值/公式标点
patterns.context: 数值或数学符号附近，包括小数、参数及公式中的标点；可能与关系符号模式重叠。

patterns.name: 短时间框架后的句点
patterns.trigger: «.»（出现在“a fairly short time frame”之后）
patterns.context: 句末标点后接换行，之后转入汽车转售价值话题。

en.description: Activations often occur in technical formulas and numeric comparisons, and also cover economic prices, percentages, output, and time expressions, as well as military fitness-training vocabulary. Passage 4 contains only a potential-energy formula, with no more specific shared trigger feature apparent.

patterns.name: Less-than inequality in mathematics
patterns.context: The comparison symbol occurs in a formula or technical numeric statement, often with a threshold, upper bound, or parameter range on the right; passage 10 also contains >

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in quantitative statements about prices, proportions, output, durations, or scientific parameters; numbers alone are insufficient to establish a unified semantics
patterns.domain: News, economics, agriculture, and scientific text

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula markers
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical typesetting contains dense symbols, variables, brackets, and commands; activations may fall on common short tokens within formulas

patterns.name: Physical parameters and particle symbols
patterns.context: Involves mass, particles, or cosmological parameters, accompanied by values, bounds, or formula derivations

patterns.name: Economic price and increase expressions
patterns.context: Prices, economic growth, or agricultural prices are expressed in monetary amounts and percentages
patterns.domain: News and economic and agricultural reporting

patterns.name: Short-duration expression
patterns.context: A time range is modified by short, in a context summarizing how long something takes

patterns.name: Military fitness-training vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes training manuals for soldiers, training activities, and physical fitness requirements

patterns.name: Potential media-article reference
patterns.context: Automotive resale value is related to oil prices; the passage shifts from a short-duration expression to media or consumer-product narrative

7_1691.concept: 数值与公式表达
7_1691.description: 激活多见于技术公式及数值比较，也覆盖经济价格、百分比、产量和时间表达；另有军事体能训练词汇。第4段仅呈现势能公式，未见更具体的共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 数学中的小于不等式
patterns.context: 比较符号出现在公式或技术性数值陈述中，右侧常为阈值、上界或参数范围；第10段也出现 >
patterns.domain: 数学、物理与天体物理论文

patterns.name: 数字与定量表达
patterns.trigger: 数值或数字单位，如「3.00」「3 percent」「14.17 billion」「10.8 billion」「10^{-3}」
patterns.context: 数字嵌在价格、比例、产量、时间长度或科学参数等定量陈述中；单独出现数字并不足以确定统一语义
patterns.domain: 新闻、经济、农业及科学文本

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学排版中，符号、变量、括号及命令密集出现；激活可能落在公式内部的常见短 token 上

patterns.name: 物理参数及粒子符号
patterns.context: 涉及质量、粒子或宇宙学参数，并伴随数值、界限或公式推导
patterns.domain: 物理、宇宙学与粒子物理

patterns.name: 经济价格与涨幅表达
patterns.context: 价格、经济增长或农产品价格以货币金额和百分比表示

patterns.name: 短时长表达
patterns.context: 时间范围由 short 修饰，语境为对一件事所需时间的概述

patterns.name: 军事体能训练词汇
patterns.context: 描述面向士兵的训练手册、训练项目及体能达标要求

patterns.name: 潜在媒体文章引用
patterns.context: 汽车转售价值与油价相关；片段从短时长表述转入媒体或消费品叙述
