patterns.context: 激活命中多音节专名内部的字母片段；这些名字分属不同人物，且字母片段不固定。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、音乐家/歌曲条目、法律文书及商务邮件。

patterns.name: Wikipedia 分类与条目模板
patterns.context: 条目尾部的分类、参考文献、外部链接或资料栏等模板化结构；激活分散在模板词及邻近内容。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目及其列表、分类和链接。

patterns.name: 年份与条目列表格式
patterns.context: 年份出现在体育赛事列表、出生分类或歌曲分类等条目式文本中，常邻接换行与标点。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 目录、分类及参考列表。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼代理人格式
patterns.context: 律师姓名、律所和地点之后，标注其代表的诉讼当事人。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件开头的元数据字段，后接日期、收件人或主题。

patterns.name: 转会与球员招募表述
patterns.context: 谈到球员签约、租借或招募，含球队及球员姓名。

patterns.name: 专辑发行与音乐合作
patterns.context: 音乐人条目中描述专辑发行及其为其他艺人制作混音；激活还落在艺人姓名片段。

patterns.name: 歌曲创作分类
patterns.context: 条目分类按作词或创作者归类歌曲，后接姓名。

patterns.name: 地址/物业描述
patterns.context: 路名及住宅物业的描述性文字，激活包含地名中的词片段。
patterns.domain: 地产或地址相关条目文本。

en.concept: Proper names and rare word fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across rare internal fragments or word endings in names, proper nouns, and compounds: legal names, McDonnell, film and bibliographic titles, aircraft names, Chinese transliterations, and interviewee. There is no unified semantics or stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: McDonnell surname
patterns.context: Appears in a person's name or the full name of an aircraft manufacturer; activates only when this surname appears

patterns.name: Rare surnames or name fragments
patterns.context: Attorney, judge, or party names in legal texts; spans different names with no unified spelling pattern

patterns.name: Film titles or character names
patterns.context: A voice actor's work entry in a table, or a name in a children's rhyme directory; trigger positions differ

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in aircraft names
patterns.context: Appears within aircraft names in a list of military aircraft models

patterns.name: Name fragment in Chinese transliteration
patterns.context: Chinese transliteration of a processor entry's name; activation concentrates on syllable fragments

patterns.name: Rare word ending related to interviewees
patterns.context: Mentions an interviewee in philosophical commentary; occurs only here

7_2521.description: 激活分散在姓名、专名及复合词的罕见内部片段或词尾：法律人名、McDonnell、影视与书目名称、飞机名、中文转写及 interviewee。未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: McDonnell 姓氏
patterns.context: 出现在人名或飞机制造商全名中；只在该姓氏出现时激活

patterns.name: 人名中的罕见姓氏或姓名片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中的律师、法官或当事人姓名；覆盖不同姓名，未见统一拼写模式

patterns.name: 影视标题或角色名
patterns.context: 表格中的配音演员作品条目，或儿童韵文目录中的名字；触发位置不同
patterns.domain: 百科影视条目、书目目录

patterns.name: 航空器名称中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 列举军用飞机型号时，出现在机名内部

patterns.name: 中文转写的姓名片段
patterns.context: 处理器条目的中文名转写，激活集中于音节片段

patterns.name: 访谈对象相关的罕见词尾
patterns.context: 哲学评论文字中提到受访者；仅此一处

en.description: Primarily responds to split subwords in names, especially names of people and judge or attorney signatures in legal documents; also responds to disposition terms, court opinion headings, titles, and case metadata. A few non-legal names appear in biographies and research project text.

patterns.name: Names and name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in names of attorneys, judges, parties, or other people, especially when names are split into multiple subwords; activation often falls on the end or an internal fragment of a name.
patterns.domain: Primarily court opinions, case titles, and attorney directories; also appears in Wikipedia biographies and NIH project descriptions; covers [1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8][9]

patterns.name: Disposition and procedural terms in legal opinions
patterns.context: Appears in the court's ruling or conclusion, often near remand, reversal, judgment, and subsequent proceedings.
patterns.domain: Appellate opinions and judicial decisions; covers [3][10]

patterns.name: Name signatures and case metadata in court layouts
patterns.context: Court level, judicial title, case number, originating appeal, or opinion title appears around names; some activations fall on headings, titles, or case fields rather than names.
patterns.domain: Front pages of U.S. court opinions, headers, and signature blocks; covers [2][6][7][8]

7_2521.description: 主要响应姓名中被拆分的子词，尤见法律文书的人名与法官、律师署名；也响应裁判结论词及法院意见标题、职衔和案件元数据。个别非法律姓名出现在简介和科研项目文本中。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的人名及姓名片段
patterns.trigger: 姓名内部或姓名边界附近的片段，如 «K»5«erm»5«it»10« Hill»4、«Mart»4«one»10、«Dix»2«it»10、«Mc»2«El»4«we»9«e»4、«S»2«AN»7«DE»10«NA»6«W»6
patterns.context: 出现在律师、法官、当事人或其他人物姓名中，尤其姓名被分词切成多个子词；激活常落在姓名末尾或姓名内部片段。
patterns.domain: 以法院意见、案件标题和律师名录为主，也出现维基百科人物简介与 NIH 项目介绍；覆盖 [1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8][9]

patterns.name: 法律意见的裁判结论与程序用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院对案件的裁定或结论部分，常与发回重审、撤销、判决及后续程序相邻。
patterns.domain: 上诉法院意见与裁判文书；覆盖 [3][10]

patterns.name: 法院版式中的姓名署名与案件元数据
patterns.context: 姓名周围出现法院层级、法官职衔、案件号、上诉来源或意见标题等版式信息；部分激活落在标题、职衔或案件字段而非姓名。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见首页、案头信息及署名栏；覆盖 [2][6][7][8]

en.concept: Legal document layout and name fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to legal opinion pages: specific letter fragments in names, court headers, judge and party sections, judicial language, and reasoning; also responds once to the book conclusion heading “CONCLUDING REMARKS”.

patterns.name: Tokenized names in court opinions
patterns.context: In court headers, party names, or judge names, names are split into irregularly capitalized subword fragments; activation falls on specific internal name fragments

patterns.name: Court layout and document structure
patterns.context: Appears in fixed layout positions such as court headers, presiding judge sections, party sections, or the end of an opinion, often accompanied by line breaks, whitespace, and docket numbers

patterns.name: Disposition and procedural phrasing
patterns.context: Phrases about the ruling, whether a judge participated, and the conclusion of an opinion

patterns.name: Legal terminology in judicial reasoning
patterns.context: The body discusses evidence, findings of fact, legal conclusions, or grounds for appeal, rather than just formatted header text

patterns.name: Heading for a book's conclusion
patterns.context: A conclusion chapter heading at the end of a book, rendered in all caps

7_2521.concept: 法律文书版式与姓名片段
7_2521.description: 主要响应法律判决页面：姓名中的特定字母片段，以及法院抬头、法官与当事人栏、裁判措辞和判决理由；另对书籍结论标题“CONCLUDING REMARKS”有一次响应。

patterns.name: 法院判决中的人名分词
patterns.context: 法院抬头、当事人姓名或法官姓名中，姓名被拆分为大小写不规则的子词片段；激活落在姓名内部特定片段上

patterns.name: 法院版式与文书结构
patterns.context: 出现在法院抬头、审理法官栏、当事人栏或判决结尾等固定版式位置，常伴随换行、空白和案号

patterns.name: 裁判结论及程序措辞
patterns.context: 判决结果、法官是否参与，以及意见书结尾等裁判程序语句

patterns.name: 判决理由中的法律术语
patterns.trigger: «trial»« court»、«evidence»、«findings»« of»« fact»、«conclusions»« of»« law»、«clear and convincing evidence»
patterns.context: 正文讨论证据、事实认定、法律结论或上诉理由，而非仅有抬头的格式文本

patterns.name: 书籍结论部分标题
patterns.context: 书籍正文末尾的结论章节标题，标题以全大写呈现
patterns.domain: 学术／宗教与科学主题书籍

en.description: Primarily responds to formatted judicial information, judge names, and subword fragments of some attorneys or case names in legal documents; also activates on the proper name CHSH and a passage of ordinary Greek text, whose relation to the main pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Split surnames in court judge names
patterns.context: In judge lists in U.S. federal appellate opinion headers, surnames are split into multiple subword tokens; activation concentrates on fragments within surnames.

patterns.name: Opinion titles and judicial dispositions
patterns.context: Formatted front matter such as the title, date, presiding judges, and disposition of an opinion or order; some uppercase titles are split into marked tokens.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and judicial documents

patterns.name: Case-name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: In case citations or titles, proper names are split into subword tokens; not all case-name fragments activate.

patterns.name: Attorney and party names, locations
patterns.context: Attorneys, parties, or their addresses appear in litigation representation information; some subwords of surnames and place names activate.

patterns.name: Proper name in a statistical-physics inequality
patterns.context: A compound eponym related to Bell inequalities is segmented; activation falls on the hyphen and name fragments.

patterns.name: Within-word Greek letter fragments
patterns.context: Several Greek-letter subwords within ordinary words in continuous Greek text are marked; there is no clearly visible syntactic or semantic trigger.

7_2521.description: 主要响应法律文书中的格式化判决信息、法官姓名及部分律师或案件专名的子词片段；也在 CHSH 专名和一段希腊语普通文本中激活，后两者与主模式联系不明。

patterns.name: 法院法官姓名中的切分姓氏
patterns.context: 法院判决页眉的法官名单中，姓氏被拆成多个子词 token；激活集中在姓氏内部片段。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决格式

patterns.name: 判决标题及裁判结论
patterns.context: 判决或裁定的标题、日期、审理法官和裁判结果等格式化前言；部分大写标题被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与司法文书

patterns.name: 法律引文中的案件名片段
patterns.context: 判例引用或案件标题中，专有名称被拆分成子词 token；并非所有案件名片段都激活。

patterns.name: 律师及当事人姓名、地点
patterns.trigger: « Hogan»；« Hogan» & Hogan；« Leach»；« Washington»；« Rock»«ville»
patterns.context: 律师、当事人或其地址出现在诉讼代理信息中；姓氏和地名的部分子词有激活。
patterns.domain: 法院诉讼文书及律师名录

patterns.name: 统计物理不等式专名
patterns.context: Bell 不等式相关术语 CHSH 的复合人名被分段，激活落在连字符及人名片段上。

patterns.name: 希腊语词内字母片段
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中，普通词内部的若干希腊字母子词被标记；没有明确可见的句法或语义触发条件。

en.concept: Proper names and formatting markers in legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to proper names and template strings in legal documents that are unusually capitalized, split, or formatted: attorneys, parties, court and judge names, institution names, court headers, and case citations; also occurs on intra-word fragments in Swedish parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: Names and titles in court opinions
patterns.context: In the header or conclusion of a court opinion, attorney, party, and judge names and titles are formatted with unusual capitalization or word segmentation; often accompanied by AFFIRMED/Affirmed.

patterns.name: Party names and docket-number formatting
patterns.context: On a case cover page or in a caption, names are split into uppercase letter fragments and co-occur with parentheses, docket numbers, aligned spaces, and similar formatting.

patterns.name: Attorney names and law-firm credits
patterns.context: Credits for counsel appearing or representing a party in a decision, listing names, law firms, and cities.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Swedish political speeches
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speeches, words are marked as segmented; the passage mentions Jean-Marie Le Pen, applause by members, and his latest statement.
patterns.domain: European Parliament records / Swedish political speeches

patterns.name: Institution and party names in case captions
patterns.context: Institution names, party names, and litigation capacities such as representatives of an estate appear in uppercase or split-uppercase form in a case caption.

patterns.name: Pennsylvania appellate court non-precedential decision header
patterns.context: The header contains a docket number, a non-precedential designation, the Superior Court of Pennsylvania, and Commonwealth of Pennsylvania; similar templates recur.

patterns.name: Case citations and cited company names
patterns.context: Legal arguments contain ambiguous provisions, case citations, citation signal words, and company or insurance company names.

7_2521.concept: 法律文书中的专名与格式标记
7_2521.description: 主要响应法律文书中被异常大写、拆分或格式化的专名与模板词串：律师、当事人、法院及法官姓名、机构名称、法院标头和判例引证；另见瑞典语议会发言中的词内片段。

patterns.name: 法庭意见中的姓名及头衔
patterns.context: 法院意见的页眉或结尾，律师、当事人、法官姓名和职衔以异常大小写或分词形式排版；常伴随 AFFIRMED/Affirmed。

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人姓名与案号排版
patterns.context: 案件首页或标题区，姓名被拆成大写字母片段，并与括号、案号、对齐空格等格式共现。

patterns.name: 律师姓名及律所署名
patterns.context: 判决中的出庭律师或代理律师署名，列出姓名、律所及所在城市。

patterns.name: 瑞典语政治发言中的词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，词语被拆分标记；谈及让·玛丽·勒庞、议员鼓掌及其最新声明。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录／瑞典语政治演讲

patterns.name: 案件标题中的机构与当事人名称
patterns.context: 案件标题区以大写或拆分大写形式呈现机构名、当事人名及代表遗产等诉讼身份。

patterns.name: 宾夕法尼亚州上诉法院非先例判决标头
patterns.context: 标头包含案件编号、非先例声明、宾夕法尼亚州高级法院及 Commonwealth of Pennsylvania；重复出现近似模板。
patterns.domain: 宾夕法尼亚州上诉法院判决

patterns.name: 判例引证及引用的公司名称
patterns.trigger: « Corp» ... « (»quoting ... We«yer»«ha»«e»«user» Co. ... Commercial« Union» Ins
patterns.context: 法律论证中出现模糊条款、判例引证、引文提示词及公司或保险公司名称。

en.description: Activations center on names and their segmented spellings, especially parties, attorneys, and judges in legal documents; they also occur in historical quotations, classical bibliographies, and email contacts. Often accompanied by legal formatting, roles, addresses, or citations.

patterns.name: Names in court case citations and captions
patterns.context: Names in legal case citations, captions, or party names are split into multiple subword fragments; names contain common name fragments or company names.

patterns.name: Names and job information in legal documents
patterns.context: Names of attorneys, judges, parties, and others appear in court documents, often adjacent to titles, courts, jurisdictions, or litigation roles.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, decisions, and court directories

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and concluding language in decisions
patterns.context: Near formulaic legal language concerning participant status, appellate roles, judicial opinions, or case outcomes.

patterns.name: Segmented headings and court formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Formatting positions such as headings, court abbreviations, judge signatures, and line breaks in decisions or memoranda.

patterns.name: Place names and addresses in legal texts
patterns.context: City, state, or regional addresses appear after the names of attorneys or representatives.
patterns.domain: Representative address blocks in legal documents

patterns.name: Signature names in U.S. historical documents
patterns.context: Names in quotations or bibliographies of historical documents are split into multiple subword fragments; here, the name appears in a letter signature.
patterns.domain: U.S. Revolutionary-era historical documents and quotations

patterns.name: Classical personal names in bibliographies or catalogs
patterns.context: Segmented names of classical writers or figures appear in bibliographic entries or catalog-style formatting.

patterns.name: Name fields in email address books
patterns.context: Contact names appear in email address lists, immediately followed by email addresses enclosed in angle brackets.

7_2521.description: 激活集中于姓名及其分段拼写，尤其是法律文书中的当事人、律师和法官；也出现在历史引文、古典书目及邮件联系人中。常伴随法律文书格式、角色、地址或引文。

patterns.name: 法院案件引文与案名中的姓名
patterns.context: 法律判例的引文、案名或当事人姓名中，姓名被切成多个子词片段；姓名中含有常见姓名片段或公司名称。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的人名与职务信息
patterns.trigger: «TIM»5«OT»4«HY»4« P»3«.»2« DON»2«AH»5«ER»9»；«D»2«UNC»1«AN»5« W»4«.»4« KE»4«IR»9»；«Tim»1«othy»4« James»2 Paul«us»2»
patterns.context: 法庭文件中出现律师、法官、当事人等姓名，常与职位、法院、地区或诉讼角色相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律意见、判决及法院名录

patterns.name: 法律程序与判决结语
patterns.context: 诉讼参与人身份、上诉角色、法官意见或判决结果等法律套语附近。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的分段标题和法院格式
patterns.context: 判决或备忘录的标题、法院缩写、法官署名及换行排版等格式位置。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的地名与地址
patterns.context: 律师或代理人姓名之后列出城市、州或地区地址。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的代理人地址栏

patterns.name: 美国历史文献中的署名姓名
patterns.context: 历史文献引文或书目中，人物姓名被分成多个子词片段；此处是信件署名。
patterns.domain: 美国革命时期历史文献、引文

patterns.name: 书目或目录中的古典人物姓名
patterns.context: 书目条目或目录式排版中出现古典作家、人物的分段姓名。
patterns.domain: 文学书目、古典文学目录

patterns.name: 邮件地址簿中的姓名字段
patterns.trigger: L P«ERSON»4；L«ARR»4«Y»2« BL»3«ACK»4；« LU»1IS« MAN»3«U»9«EL»3 P«AD»1«ILL»6«A»2
patterns.context: 电子邮件地址列表中显示联系人姓名，姓名后紧邻尖括号包围的邮箱地址。

en.concept: Signatures and end formatting in legal documents
en.description: Strongly responds to signature blocks at the ends of legal opinions, internal fragments of judge names, and titles such as JJ./J.; favors decision line breaks and concluding formats. Also responds to case citation abbreviations and one historical author name.

patterns.name: Chief justice / panel signature format in decisions
patterns.context: After the reasoning or disposition concludes, judge names, abbreviated titles, and concluding formats such as concur and affirmed appear; activations concentrate on segmented name fragments and nearby signatures.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions, appellate opinions, and case citations

patterns.name: Fragments in judge names and titles
patterns.context: Appears in judge or attorney names, often alongside commas, JJ., J., Circuit Judges, or Before; activations fall on internal name fragments rather than fixed complete words.
patterns.domain: Legal signature blocks, lists of judicial officers

patterns.name: Decision endings and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Near line breaks, disposition language, and signature blocks at the end of court opinions; whitespace and punctuation also provide layout context.
patterns.domain: Decision layout and legal document endings

patterns.name: Abbreviations and citation formatting in court references
patterns.context: Appears in case citations, volume numbers, or legal abbreviations, where digits, letters, and punctuation are interspersed.

patterns.name: Author names in historical document citations
patterns.context: Internal letter fragments in the titles and author names of historical documents; distinct from legal decision signature formatting.

7_2521.concept: 法律文书署名与末尾格式
7_2521.description: 强烈响应法律意见末尾的署名块、法官姓名内部片段及JJ./J.等职衔，并偏好判决换行和结尾格式；另响应判例缩写与一处历史作者名。

patterns.name: 判决书中的首席大法官／合议庭签署格式
patterns.trigger: «SM»3«ITH»10« and»3 K«5«AH»7«N»6«,»4 JJ«.,»5« concur»3；«BO»6«OTH»10« and»6 BR«6«OWN»8«ING»6；«PER»2« CURIAM»1；«MA»2«STR»6«O»4
patterns.context: 判决理由或裁判结果结束后，出现法官姓名、职衔缩写及 concur、affirmed 等结尾格式；激活集中在姓名被拆分的片段和署名附近。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、上诉法院意见及判例引证

patterns.name: 法官姓名及称谓中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在法官或律师姓名中，常伴随逗号、JJ.、J.、Circuit Judges 或 Before；不同姓名中激活的是姓名内部片段，而非固定完整词。
patterns.domain: 法律署名栏、审判人员名单

patterns.name: 判决结尾及换行排版
patterns.context: 法院意见末尾的换行、判决处置语与署名块附近；空白及标点也构成版式背景。
patterns.domain: 判决书排版与法律文书结尾

patterns.name: 法院引用中的缩写与引证格式
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证、卷号或法律缩写中，局部数字、字母和标点交错。

patterns.name: 历史文献引文中的作者名
patterns.context: 历史文献书名和作者名的内部字母片段；与法律判决署名格式不同。

en.concept: Proper names and signature formatting in formal documents
en.description: Strong responses commonly occur in judge signatures, decision dispositions, citations, and attorney lists at the ends of judicial opinions; also appears on book title pages, in Latvian parliamentary commentary, and in email address lists. The shared form is segmented fragments and formatting markers in proper names or formal document fields.

patterns.name: Judge signatures at the end of judicial opinions
patterns.context: Appears at the end of decision text or after an opinion heading, often followed by commas, judicial titles, JJ., or signature formats such as concur(s); particularly responsive to segmented fragments within surnames

patterns.name: Decision conclusions and procedural dispositions
patterns.context: At the end of a decision or judicial opinion, expressing affirmance, reversal, remand, or a judge's opinion; often adjacent to judge signatures

patterns.name: Legal citations and docket-number formatting
patterns.context: Appears in legal arguments or footnote-style citations containing volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, page numbers, and case names

patterns.name: Attorney and party representation information
patterns.context: Lists attorneys, parties, and their roles in decisions, often ordered by name, location, and represented party

patterns.name: Publication information on book title pages
patterns.context: Title-page elements such as title, intended audience, place of publication, and publisher, accompanied by uppercase formatting and line breaks

patterns.name: Commentary and forms of address for legislators in Latvian
patterns.context: Latvian sentences mention commentary and members of parliament; words are split into subwords, with a personal name at the end

patterns.name: Email recipient address lists
patterns.context: Multiple contacts and organizational addresses in email headers or correspondence lists are separated by commas, slashes, and line breaks

7_2521.concept: 正式文书中的专名与署名格式
7_2521.description: 强响应多见于司法意见末尾的法官署名、判决处置语、引文和律师名单；另见书籍扉页、拉脱维亚语议会评论及邮件地址列表。共同形式是专名或正式文书字段中的分词片段与格式标记。

patterns.name: 司法意见末尾的法官署名
patterns.trigger: 大写姓氏被切成多个子词，如 «BO»5«OTH»10« and»4« BR»6«OWN»10«ING»6；«SM»4«ITH»9；«KN»5«UT»9«SON»5
patterns.context: 出现在判决正文末尾或意见标题之后，常接逗号、法官职衔、JJ.、concur(s) 等署名格式；对姓氏内部被分词的片段反应突出

patterns.name: 判决结语与程序处置
patterns.context: 判决或司法意见末尾，表达维持、撤销、发回或法官意见；常与法官署名相邻

patterns.name: 法律引文和案号格式
patterns.context: 出现在法律论证或脚注式引用中，含卷号、记者名缩写、页码及案件名称

patterns.name: 律师及当事人代理信息
patterns.trigger: « Gordon»…« for appellant»；« for»…« respondent»；« Attorney General»；« for»…« the mother»
patterns.context: 判决书中列出代理律师、当事人及其身份，常按姓名、地点、代表对象排列

patterns.name: 书籍扉页的出版信息
patterns.context: 书名、读者对象、出版地、出版社等扉页元素，伴随大写排版和换行

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语中的评论与议员称呼
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语句子中提到评论及议员，词语被切分成子词；句末接人名

patterns.name: 邮件收件人地址列表
patterns.trigger: «Commun»ications…@«Enron»；姓名与公司路径、邮箱地址连续排列
patterns.context: 邮件头或通信名单中，多名联系人及其组织地址以逗号、斜杠和换行分隔

en.description: Primarily responds to legal decision layout and language: uppercase, segmented judge surnames and signatures, and formulaic expressions such as affirmed, appeals, and court opinions. Also occurs in court headings, email addresses, weather headings, football commentary, and isolated subword activations.

patterns.name: Segmented uppercase fragments in judge names
patterns.context: Names are printed entirely in uppercase but split into multiple subword tokens; activations concentrate on internal letter fragments, especially surname fragments
patterns.domain: Court decisions, judge signatures, and panel lists

patterns.name: Decision and court closing format
patterns.context: Disposition, opinion notation, or judge signature section at the end of a decision, often accompanied by line breaks, punctuation, and uppercase formatting

patterns.name: Court names and jurisdiction headings
patterns.context: Court or state names appear in decision headers, court descriptions, or case backgrounds

patterns.name: Case procedure and adjudicative language
patterns.context: Describes appeals, injunctions, disputed matters, or court rulings, usually in the body or conclusion of a decision

patterns.name: Email contacts and organizational addresses
patterns.context: Names, departments, or company email addresses are separated by directory-style commas and include slashes, @, and line breaks

patterns.name: Weather layout headings
patterns.context: An all-uppercase section heading appears after the body, followed by weather forecast text
patterns.domain: News/weather layout in email or correspondence

patterns.name: American football commentary
patterns.context: Discusses team performance and how to limit an opponent, adjacent to a weather section heading

patterns.name: Highly activated subword fragments within names or words
patterns.context: Some activations fall on segmented name fragments or isolated common words and cannot be consistently explained solely by legal semantics or name formatting

7_2521.description: 主要响应法律判决的排版与用语：大写、拆分的法官姓氏和署名，以及 affirmed、上诉和法院意见等公式表达。另见法院抬头、邮件地址、天气标题、橄榄球评论及孤立子词激活。

patterns.name: 法官姓名的拆分大写片段
patterns.context: 姓名以全大写形式排印，但被切分成多个子词 token；激活集中在姓名内部的字母片段，尤其是姓氏片段
patterns.domain: 法院判决、法官署名及合议庭名单

patterns.name: 判决与法院结尾格式
patterns.context: 判决末尾的裁判结果、意见说明或法官署名区，常伴随换行、标点和大写排版

patterns.name: 法院名称与司法管辖区标题
patterns.context: 法院或州名出现在判决抬头、法院说明或案件背景中

patterns.name: 案件程序与裁判用语
patterns.trigger: «Judgment affirmed»、«order of protection»、«appellant's remaining contention»、«The People appeal»
patterns.context: 描述上诉、保护令、争议事项或法院裁判；通常处于判决正文或结尾

patterns.name: 邮件联系人与组织地址
patterns.context: 人名、部门或公司邮箱地址以目录式逗号分隔，含斜线、@及换行

patterns.name: 天气版面标题
patterns.context: 正文后出现全大写栏目标题，后接天气预报文字
patterns.domain: 邮件或通讯中的新闻/天气版面

patterns.name: 美式橄榄球评论
patterns.context: 谈球队表现及如何限制对手，且邻接天气栏目标题

patterns.name: 姓名或词语内部的高激活子词片段
patterns.context: 个别激活落在拆分姓名片段或孤立常用词上，无法仅由法律语义或姓名排版稳定解释

en.concept: Proper names and formatting markers in structured text
en.description: Most activations occur on segmented uppercase names, judge signatures, court headers, party designations, and case citations in legal documents; other patterns include procedural disposition language, Latvian word forms, and cautious-advice phrases in forums.

patterns.name: Names in court decisions
patterns.context: In court documents, names appear in uppercase or segmented uppercase form, often in lists of judges, parties, or litigants; paragraph [4] also contains a recipient name.

patterns.name: Judge and panel title/list formatting
patterns.context: Lists of judges, judicial officers, or panel members appear around names; uppercase names, titles, commas, and line breaks jointly form court signature or decision formatting.

patterns.name: Court decision headers and document layout
patterns.context: Court names, reporters, dates, and other header information are presented with line breaks, abbreviations, and uppercase formatting.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions and official case reporters

patterns.name: Case parties and litigation designations
patterns.context: In case facts or the case cover page, names are associated with party status and litigation roles; especially evident in paragraph 1.

patterns.name: Case citations and docket numbers
patterns.context: Reporter abbreviations, volume and page numbers, and years appear in decision text in citation format.

patterns.name: Legal procedural disposition language
patterns.context: Appellate decisions discuss procedural remedies such as reversal, remand, and a new hearing; this pattern is prominent only in paragraph 10.

patterns.name: Complex inflected Latvian word forms
patterns.context: A sequence of Latvian word forms is split into multiple subword fragments in EU parliamentary text; unlike the surrounding legal English case format.

patterns.name: Cautious advice in webpage comments
patterns.context: A non-legal forum comment advises readers to interpret LSP cautiously; activations fall on common English phrases rather than proper names or court formatting.

7_2521.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与格式标记
7_2521.description: 多数激活出现在法律文书的分块大写人名、法官署名、法院抬头、当事人称谓及判例引证；另有程序处置语、拉脱维亚语词形和论坛中的谨慎建议短语。

patterns.name: 法院判决中的人名
patterns.trigger: 分块大写的人名，如 «HE»«CH»«T»、«JO»«E»« KE»«IM»、«W»«ILL»«IAM»« F»«.»« MA»«STR»«O»、«SM»«ITH»、«K»«AH»«N»
patterns.context: 法院文书中，姓名以大写或分块大写形式出现，常见于法官、当事人或诉讼参与者名单；段[4]也出现收件人姓名。

patterns.name: 法官及合议庭职衔/名单格式
patterns.context: 姓名周围出现法官名单、审理者或合议庭格式；大写姓名与职衔、逗号及换行共同构成法院署名或判决格式。

patterns.name: 法院判决抬头与文书排版
patterns.context: 法院名称、报告集、日期等抬头信息以换行、缩写和大写排版呈现。
patterns.domain: 法律判决及官方判例汇编

patterns.name: 案件当事人及诉讼称谓
patterns.context: 法院案情或案件首页中，姓名与当事人身份、诉讼角色相连；段1尤为明显。

patterns.name: 判例引证与案号
patterns.context: 判决文本中出现报告集缩写、卷页和年份等引证格式。

patterns.name: 法律程序处置用语
patterns.context: 上诉判决讨论撤销、发回及再次听证等程序性救济；本模式只在段10突出。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语复杂屈折词形
patterns.context: 一串拉脱维亚语词形被拆成多个子词片段，出现在欧盟议会文本中；与周围法律英语判例格式不同。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、拉脱维亚语

patterns.name: 网页评论中的谨慎建议
patterns.context: 非法律论坛评论中，提醒读者谨慎理解 LSP；激活落在常见英语短语而非专名或法院格式。

en.concept: Local word fragments and formatting in multilingual text
en.description: Activations are distributed across text types: be careful/consult in English advice, citations, proper names, and argument strings in legal cases, and sporadic subword fragments in Swedish and Portuguese parliamentary texts and code comments; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Advice wording in health disclaimers
patterns.context: Tells readers that the content is not intended to diagnose or treat disease and advises consulting a physician before taking a product.

patterns.name: Intra-word suffix fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within Swedish vocabulary, such as “vilket,” “övervägande,” and “överenskommelse”; the sentence concerns proposals, framework decisions, or energy.

patterns.name: Cautionary advice in English
patterns.context: Reminds readers to interpret a technical concept cautiously, preceded by “Once again reminding people to”.

patterns.name: Cautious translation guidance in program comments
patterns.context: A code comment explains that screen readers may not pronounce non-English words correctly and advises caution when translating.

patterns.name: Names and citation fragments in legal references
patterns.context: Case names, institutions, volume and page numbers, and case reporter citations appear in legal case references; activations include segmented proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Function-word strings in legal argument
patterns.context: Discusses not reading into a statute what is not in it and argues that legislative intent can be expressed through omission.

patterns.name: Character fragments in names of court personnel
patterns.context: In names and lists of judges, attorneys, and other court personnel, activations fall on character or subword fragments in capitalized proper names.
patterns.domain: U.S. appellate court decision signatures/appearance information

patterns.name: Digits and proper-name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Activations occur near volume numbers, page numbers, years, and institution names in reporter citation formats.

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary votes and applause markers
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech says a political group supports a commitment and hopes to receive Parliament's support, followed by a parenthetical applause marker.

7_2521.concept: 多语文本中的局部词片段与格式
7_2521.description: 激活分布于多类文本：英语劝告中的 be careful/consult，法律判例的引证、专名与论证词串，以及瑞典语、葡萄牙语议会文本和代码注释中的零散子词片段；缺少统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 健康免责声明中的建议措辞
patterns.trigger: « be»« sure»、« consult»« your»« physician»« before»« taking»
patterns.context: 告知读者内容不用于诊治疾病，并建议服用产品前咨询医生。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语词汇内部的子词片段，如“vilket”“övervägande”“överenskommelse”；句子涉及提案、框架决定或能源。

patterns.name: 英语劝告中的谨慎提示
patterns.context: 提醒读者谨慎理解某项技术概念，前接“Once again reminding people to”。

patterns.name: 程序注释中的谨慎翻译提示
patterns.context: 代码注释说明屏幕阅读器可能无法正确朗读非英语词汇，要求翻译时小心。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码注释/无障碍本地化

patterns.name: 法律引用中的名称与引证片段
patterns.context: 法律判例引用中出现案名、机构名及卷页和判例汇编引证；激活包含被拆分的专名片段。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的功能词串
patterns.trigger: «into»« a»« statute»« that»« is»« not»« there»，以及« anything»、« well»、« as»
patterns.context: 讨论不得把法条中不存在的内容读入法条，并论述立法意图可由遗漏表达。

patterns.name: 法院人员姓名的字符片段
patterns.context: 法官、律师等姓名及法院人员名单中，激活落在大小写专名的字符或子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决书署名/出庭信息

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字及专名片段
patterns.context: 报告引证格式中，卷号、页码、年份及机构名称附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 葡语议会表决与掌声标记
patterns.context: 议会发言称政治团体支持承诺并希望获得议会支持，随后以括号标注掌声。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会记录

en.concept: Relational words and local boundaries in context
en.description: High activations often fall on relational words in clauses or phrases: before in advice contexts, when/while in conditional or ongoing contexts, and way in expressions of scope; unusually high activations also occur on hyphens in legal text and fragments in case names.

patterns.name: before preceding advice
patterns.context: After advice, a warning, or a disclaimer, before introduces an action to take first; common collocations include consult your physician/adviser or read it carefully. Activation falls on before.
patterns.domain: Medical product disclaimers, investment risk disclosures, and fund promotional materials

patterns.name: when in legal conditionals
patterns.context: Legal reasoning describes the circumstances under which a court permits amendment of a complaint; activation falls on when, followed by justice so requires.

patterns.name: while in translation guidance
patterns.context: Software comments remind translators of considerations during translation; activation falls on while, followed by a gerund phrase.
patterns.domain: GitHub code comments, accessibility, and localization

patterns.name: while in disclaimers
patterns.context: Website disclaimers or usage guidance advise users to exercise judgment when browsing links; activation falls on while, followed by an action.

patterns.name: way in patent scope
patterns.context: In language disclaiming limitations on the scope of a patent abstract, way occurs in the phrase in any way; activation falls on way.

patterns.name: omission in legal terminology
patterns.context: The word “omission” is hyphenated across a line break in statutory interpretation, discussing omissions and legislative intent; high activation falls on the hyphen, possibly due to line wrapping or word form.

patterns.name: LAWLOR in a case name
patterns.context: The name LAWLOR in an appellate case caption is split into multiple tokens; activation falls on WL in the middle of the name, with no apparent semantic condition shared with other highly activated words.

7_2521.concept: 语境关系词及局部边界
7_2521.description: 高激活多落在从句或短语中的关系词：建议语境的 before、条件或进行语境的 when/while，以及范围表述中的 way；另有法律文本断词连字符和案名片段的异常高激活。

patterns.name: 建议前的 before
patterns.context: 在提供建议、警告或免责声明后，以 before 引出应先做的事情，常见搭配为 consult your physician/adviser 或 read it carefully；激活落在 before 上。
patterns.domain: 医疗产品免责声明、投资风险披露与基金宣传材料

patterns.name: 法律条件句中的 when
patterns.context: 法律论述中，说明法院准许修改诉状的条件；激活落在 when，后接 justice so requires。

patterns.name: 翻译指引中的 while
patterns.context: 软件注释中提醒译者在进行翻译时注意事项；激活落在 while，后接动名词短语。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码注释、无障碍与本地化

patterns.name: 免责声明中的 while
patterns.context: 网站免责声明或使用提示中，建议用户浏览链接时自行判断；激活落在 while，后接动作。

patterns.name: 专利范围中的 way
patterns.context: 专利摘要不限制发明范围的表述中，way 与 in any way 连用；激活落在 way。

patterns.name: 法律术语中的 omission
patterns.context: 法条解释论述中出现断词换行的“omission”，讨论遗漏与立法意图；高激活落在连字符上，可能受断行或词形影响。

patterns.name: 案名中的 LAWLOR
patterns.context: 上诉案件标题中的人名 LAWLOR 被拆成多个标记，激活落在名字中部的 WL；看不出与其他高激活词共享的语义条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across text types: English cue words such as before, while, and when; an internal fragment of the Latvian word jautājums; Greek intra-word fragments; and areas near legal document layout and headings. Only some examples show recurring word forms, and the whole set is difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Advice/caution wording or contrastive cue words
patterns.context: Introduces a temporal, conditional, or accompanying circumstance in a sentence, often in warnings, disclaimers, legal rules, or instructions; activation falls on the complete word itself, with inconsistent meanings across contexts.
patterns.domain: Website disclaimers, legal texts, software comments

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a Latvian question word
patterns.context: The Latvian word jautājums (question) is tokenized into multiple tokens, with activation concentrated on the medial «aut»; both instances occur in a topic/question-related context.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in a Greek letter string
patterns.context: A part of the Greek word ἐκκλησία (church), appearing in non-English text of a parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Layout/headings in legal opinions
patterns.context: Line breaks, page numbers, and opinion headings after attorney signatures; activations include punctuation and name tokens, with no clear lexical trigger.

patterns.name: before in investment warnings
patterns.context: Fund investment risk disclosures advise considering objectives, risks, and fees before investing; the same word as the before in [1], but in a different disclaimer context.

7_2521.description: 激活分散于多类文本：英语 before、while、when 等引导词，拉脱维亚语 jautājums 词内片段、希腊语词内片段，以及法律文档排版与标题附近。仅部分例子呈现重复词形，整体难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 建议/注意用语或转折引导词
patterns.context: 在句中引出时间、条件或伴随情境，常出现在警告、免责声明、法律规则或操作说明中；激活落在完整词本身，不同上下文语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 网页免责声明、法律文本、软件注释

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语问句词内部片段
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语词 j jautājums（问题）被分词为多个 token，激活集中在词中间的 «aut»；两处均处于议题/问题相关语境。
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 希腊字母串中的词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语词 ἐκκλησία（教会）的一部分，出现在议会发言的非英语正文中。

patterns.name: 法律意见书中的排版/标题结构
patterns.context: 律师署名之后的换行、页码及意见书标题附近；激活包括标点和姓名 token，未见明确词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 投资警示中的 before
patterns.context: 基金投资风险提示中，要求投资前考虑目标、风险和费用；与[1]的 before 同词但属于不同免责声明语境。
patterns.domain: 基金招募说明书/投资者材料

en.description: Activations often occur in formal notices or regulatory contexts involving restrictions, scope, and cautionary wording, as well as in an isolated disclaimer, code translation guidance, and Greek subwords; they do not reduce to a single meaning.

patterns.name: Broad negative/scope language in law or rules
patterns.context: In formal legal texts, negation words occur beside any, way, or suit and other scope or object words, often describing inapplicability, what may not be prohibited, or jurisdictional scope.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, regulations, and procedural rules

patterns.name: Disclaimers and advice before taking action
patterns.context: A health product disclaimer limits the intended use of the information and advises consulting a professional before taking action; activation is especially prominent on before physician.

patterns.name: Website liability and cautious browsing notices
patterns.context: A website disclaimer states that it lacks control over third-party links and reminds readers to use their judgment and browse cautiously.

patterns.name: Translation cautions in code comments
patterns.context: Code comments address localizers or translators and flag issues involving screen readers and non-English content.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword activations in Greek parliamentary text
patterns.context: Greek body text is represented as segmented byte-level or subword tokens; visible fragments concern appeals, shared political heritage, and Greek thought.

7_2521.description: 激活多见于正式告知或规范语境中的限制、范围与谨慎措辞，也见单例免责声明、代码翻译提示及希腊语子词；无法归结为单一词义。

patterns.name: 法律或规则中的宽泛否定/范围措辞
patterns.trigger: “not ... any ... way”、“shall not ... any suit”以及“when ... possible”
patterns.context: 在正式法律文本中，否定词与 any、way、suit 等范围或对象词相邻，常用于说明不适用、不得禁止或管辖范围。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法规和程序规则

patterns.name: 免责声明与行动前劝告
patterns.trigger: “before taking this or any other product”
patterns.context: 健康产品免责声明中，告知信息用途有限，并建议行动前咨询专业人士；激活尤其突出 before physician。

patterns.name: 网站内容责任与浏览谨慎提示
patterns.trigger: “take no responsibility”“use your own discretion while surfing the links”
patterns.context: 网站免责声明说明对第三方链接缺乏控制，并提醒读者自行判断、谨慎浏览。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的翻译注意事项
patterns.context: 代码注释面向本地化或翻译工作者，提示屏幕阅读器及非英语内容的处理问题。

patterns.name: 希腊语议会文本的词内子词激活
patterns.context: 希腊语正文中以拆分的字节级或子词 token 呈现；可见片段涉及呼吁、共同政治遗产与希腊思想。

en.description: The core trigger is running, typically placed between a subject and software, a service, or an object of analysis to express a running state; it also has a running-apparel sense. Other activations involve question-and-answer formats, code paths, and domain-specific vocabulary in individual passages.

patterns.name: running software or services
patterns.context: Appears in expressions about running instances, programs, tests, analyses, services, or code; [5] describes a “running t-shirt” intended for use as clothing.
patterns.domain: Software Q&A, academic abstracts, product descriptions

patterns.name: Q&A titles and question formats
patterns.context: Q&A markers and title/body separators at the start of StackExchange questions; newline markers also occur in other formats.

patterns.name: Paths and code-file structures
patterns.context: Lists project directories and Python test files, then mentions using Pytest to run unit tests.

patterns.name: Flight behavior and motor skills
patterns.context: The abstract discusses the role of experience in fruit fly flight behavior and vertebrate motor skill acquisition.

patterns.name: Product titles and marketing copy
patterns.context: The product page describes an item as a running T-shirt for hot weather and includes e-commerce fields such as price and a sold-out notice.

patterns.name: Software test coverage
patterns.context: Mentions Angular.js, Karma, and Jasmine, and describes running coverage analysis on an application.

patterns.name: HTML lists and web generators
patterns.context: Discusses a display issue with HTML ordered lists when they encounter tables, and compares Jekyll with using Kramdown directly.

patterns.name: Puppet commands and environment errors
patterns.context: A Puppet command cannot resolve the production environment or find the master.pp file when run.

patterns.name: Queue and data-center code
patterns.context: Describes adding SocketHolder to a queue and discusses where code runs in a data-center environment.

patterns.name: Directory services and certificates
patterns.context: Discusses a read-only domain controller running on Windows Server 2012 R2 Core, as well as third-party certificates and internal names.

7_2600.description: 核心触发词是 running，常置于主语与软件、服务或分析对象之间，表达运行状态；另有跑步商品义。其余激活还涉及问答格式、代码路径及各段特定领域词汇。

patterns.name: running 软件或服务
patterns.context: 出现在正在运行实例、程序、测试、分析、服务或代码的表达中；[5]则是描述衣物用途的“running t-shirt”。
patterns.domain: 软件问答、学术摘要、商品描述

patterns.name: 问答标题与问题格式
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题开头的问答标记、标题与正文分隔格式；换行标记也见于其他格式。

patterns.name: 路径与代码文件结构
patterns.context: 列出项目目录和 Python 测试文件，后文提到用 Pytest 运行单元测试。

patterns.name: 飞行行为与运动技能
patterns.context: 摘要讨论经验在果蝇飞行行为及脊椎动物运动技能习得中的作用。

patterns.name: 商品标题和营销文案
patterns.context: 商品页面将产品描述为适合炎热天气的跑步 T 恤，并含价格、售罄提示等电商字段。

patterns.name: 软件测试覆盖率
patterns.context: 提及 Angular.js、Karma、Jasmine，并描述对应用运行覆盖率分析。

patterns.name: HTML 列表与网页生成器
patterns.context: 讨论 HTML 有序列表遇到表格时的显示问题，并比较 Jekyll 与直接使用 Kramdown。

patterns.name: Puppet 命令与环境错误
patterns.context: 运行 Puppet 命令时无法解析 production 环境或找到 master.pp 文件。

patterns.name: 队列与数据中心代码
patterns.context: 描述队列中添加 SocketHolder，并以数据中心环境讨论代码运行位置。

patterns.name: 目录服务与证书
patterns.context: 讨论 Windows Server 2012 R2 Core 上运行的只读域控制器及第三方证书、内部名称。

en.description: Strongly responds to running (including sentence-initial capitalization and weaker variants of running), covering program execution, animal movement, running apparel, and the term running lights; domains and senses vary.

patterns.name: running meaning program execution
patterns.context: running occurs in the context of computing tasks such as code, programs, tests, or analyses, meaning currently executing or running

patterns.name: running meaning animal movement
patterns.context: Appears alongside flight behaviour and motor skills to describe animal movement or motor skills

patterns.name: running meaning apparel use
patterns.context: Modifies t-shirt to indicate clothing suitable for running

patterns.name: Fixed phrase running lights
patterns.context: running combines with lights to form a term for work lights hidden from theater audiences, not meaning “currently running”

7_2600.description: 强烈响应 running（含句首大写及较弱变体 running），涵盖程序运行、动物奔跑、跑步服装和 running lights 术语；跨领域与词义均有变化。

patterns.name: running 表示程序执行
patterns.context: running 出现在代码、程序、测试或分析等计算任务的语境中，表示正在运行或执行

patterns.name: running 表示动物运动
patterns.context: 与 flight behaviour、motor skills 并列，描述动物的运动行为或运动技能

patterns.name: running 表示服装用途
patterns.context: 修饰 t-shirt，表示适合跑步穿着的衣物

patterns.name: running lights 固定词组
patterns.context: running 与 lights 构成术语，指剧院中观众看不到的工作灯，并非“正在运行”

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the complete word Conditions across multiple domains, often in titles or noun phrases; weaker responses also occur to Population in medical research titles and to a few health terms and sentence-initial Recently. The activations show no clear unified semantics.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “Conditions”
patterns.context: The complete word Conditions appears in Terms and Conditions, descriptions of conditions, or titles; it can occur in a phrase, sentence, or title.
patterns.domain: Business terms, web forms, patents, mental health materials, regulations, general prose

patterns.name: Population in medical titles
patterns.context: At the beginning of a medical abstract title, followed by pharmacokinetics or -based validation.

patterns.name: Modifiers and terms in medical titles
patterns.context: Words describing population health, lower levels, or comorbidities in health research titles or abstracts.

patterns.name: Title-like Recently near the end
patterns.context: The sentence-initial time adverb Recently, followed by a comma and an indefinite article.

7_2600.description: 主要强烈响应完整单词 Conditions，跨多领域但常见于标题或名词短语；另对医学研究标题中的 Population 及少数健康术语、Recently 句首有较弱响应。各次触发未显现明确统一语义。

patterns.name: 固定短语“Conditions”
patterns.context: 完整单词 Conditions 出现在 Terms and Conditions、描述条件或标题中；可位于短语、句子或标题内。
patterns.domain: 商务条款、网页表单、专利、心理健康材料、法规、一般叙述

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 Population
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题开头，后接 pharmacokinetics 或 -based validation。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的限定词与术语
patterns.context: 健康研究标题或摘要中描述人群健康、较低水平或合并症的词语。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 研究计划

patterns.name: 文末附近的标题式 Recently
patterns.context: 句子开头的时间副词 Recently，后接逗号和不定冠词。

en.description: The strongest activations are scattered across wait, the beginning of skeptic, part of the case name Trib, and the abbreviation ASAP; there are also how within a URL and several isolated subword fragments. Contexts span forums, email, legal texts, and patents, with no unified semantic or stylistic trigger condition.

patterns.name: wait string
patterns.context: Appears as a complete word or a URL path fragment; context is not consistent.

patterns.name: skeptic substring
patterns.context: Appears in a discussion of the word “skeptic,” as a subword fragment at the beginning of the word.

patterns.name: Trible case-name substring
patterns.context: Appears in a legal case citation as part of a case name.

patterns.name: ASAP abbreviation
patterns.context: Means as soon as possible in a business email; appears at the end of a sentence related to planning.

patterns.name: how substring
patterns.context: The how fragment in a URL activates strongly, but peaks at 6, below this batch’s peak of 10.

patterns.name: Other sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Each appears in a different sentence, with no shared stable sense or context; recorded alongside the peak fragments.
patterns.domain: Pandemic discussions, astronomy, science fiction reviews, patent technical texts

7_2600.description: 最强激活分散在 wait、skeptic 词首、Trib 案名片段及 ASAP 缩写等；另有 URL 内 how 和多个孤立词片段。语境跨论坛、邮件、法律与专利文本，未见统一语义或文体触发条件。

patterns.name: wait 字符串
patterns.context: 作为完整单词或 URL 路径片段出现；上下文并不固定。

patterns.name: skeptic 子串
patterns.context: 出现在对“skeptic”一词的讨论中，位于单词开头的分词片段。

patterns.name: Trible 案名子串
patterns.context: 出现在法律判例引注中，属于案名的一部分。

patterns.name: ASAP 缩写
patterns.context: 商务邮件中表示尽快；位于规划用途相关语句末尾。

patterns.name: how 子串
patterns.context: URL 中的 how 片段激活较强，但峰值为 6，低于本批峰值 10。

patterns.name: 其他零散片段
patterns.context: 各自在不同句子中出现，缺乏共同稳定的词义或上下文；与峰值片段并列记录。
patterns.domain: 疫情讨论、天文学、科幻评论、专利技术文本

en.description: All passages contain highly activated “qualify”; in legal texts it means meeting the conditions for a legal category or program, while in sports contexts it means qualifying to compete.

patterns.name: Legal qualification
patterns.context: In legal argument, determining whether a fact, status, offense, or case meets the conditions for a statutory category or exception
patterns.domain: Case law, criminal and family law

patterns.name: Eligibility for legal or policy programs
patterns.context: Determining whether a person qualifies for programs such as loan modification or rehabilitation; also involves meeting conditions for a specific legal program
patterns.domain: Case law, housing finance, and public services

patterns.name: Competition or funding eligibility

en.description: Activations are scattered across different genres and syntax: they include legal judgment, clarity, and uncertainty; claims, comparisons, and time series in biomedicine; and expressions such as make sense and easy, as well as the test string World. No unified trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: been in an auxiliary verb chain

patterns.name: Verb expressing a proposition or claim

patterns.name: equal in experimental results

patterns.name: made clear in legal writing
patterns.context: The passive construction “should be made clear” calls for a clear explanation of a legal rule.

patterns.name: World in test text
patterns.context: The final word in the Hello\tWorld test string, following an escaped tab character.

patterns.name: make in a negative judgment
patterns.context: In “does not make the notice ineffective,” make combines with negation to express a judgment about legal effect.

patterns.name: The record leaves uncertainty
patterns.context: “the record leaves doubt as to whether or not” introduces uncertainty about whether a fact occurred.

patterns.name: Time markers in a time series

patterns.name: 否定/疑问结构中的 whether 或 not
patterns.trigger: «whether»、«not»（如「whether or not」及「could not be considered」）
patterns.context: 出现在法律论证或事实不确定性表述中；此处不是跨段稳定的独立主题。

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的时间紧迫与变更
patterns.context: 邮件说明邮件地址变更造成沟通问题，排期严格、剩余时间不多。

patterns.name: 评论中的前页/首页传播
patterns.context: 网络评论解释某个故事为何登上首页，并提到读者没理解内容。

patterns.name: 目录中的书名与章节编号
patterns.trigger: «Making»9，及相邻的«XXX»、罗马数字章节号和书名
patterns.context: 目录排版中出现章节标题「Beggars in the Making」及页码；激活词嵌在书名末尾。
patterns.domain: 古典书籍目录/排版文本

en.concept: Triggers in common English sentence patterns
en.description: Strong triggers cluster in explanatory or evaluative constructions with makes/made; there are also varied collocations with leave, makes sense judgments, and sentence-initial Like comparisons. Although trigger forms recur, their meanings and contexts are not entirely the same.

patterns.name: Explanation/evaluation triggered by makes
patterns.context: The causative verb makes or made appears in constructions asking or explaining why something is different, prominent, special, or feasible; often followed by What, then an object of evaluation or a reason.
patterns.domain: Promotional copy, interview quotations, narration, forum discussions

patterns.name: Idiomatic expressions with leave
patterns.context: leave and its variants occur in common collocations concerning leaving a message, omitting information, or ending/shelving a discussion; the contextual conditions differ.
patterns.domain: Website copy, sports commentary, forum posts

patterns.name: Reasonableness judgments with makes sense
patterns.context: Past or present makes sense indicates that an action or decision is reasonable.

patterns.name: General analogies introduced by Like
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Like introduces an analogy about a group, followed by a summary of traits shared by its customers.

7_2600.description: 强触发集中在 makes/made 的解释或评价句式；另有 leave 的多种搭配、makes sense 判断及句首 Like 类比。触发形式虽重复，但涉及的语义和上下文并不完全相同。

patterns.name: makes 触发的解释/评估
patterns.trigger: “What Makes Our Center Different”“What makes these shows standout”“What made Jess so special”“What makes that work”“what in particular makes you say”中的 makes/made
patterns.context: 使役/因果动词 makes 或 made 出现在询问、说明某事物为何不同、突出、特殊或可行的结构中；常接 What，后续评价对象或原因
patterns.domain: 宣传文案、采访引语、叙述、论坛讨论

patterns.name: leave 的惯用表达
patterns.context: leave 及其变体出现在常见搭配中，分别涉及留言、遗漏信息或结束/搁置讨论；上下文条件彼此不同
patterns.domain: 网站文案、体育评论、论坛发帖

patterns.name: makes sense 的合理性判断
patterns.trigger: “it made sense then”“it makes sense now”
patterns.context: 过去式或现在式 makes sense，用来说明某行动或决定合理

patterns.name: Like 引出的泛指类比
patterns.context: 句首 Like 引出群体类比，接着概括客户共有的特点

en.concept: Forms of left/leave and local technical uses
en.description: Primarily responds to the forms of left/leave and their different semantic uses; activation also occurs on spatial-interface/height terminology in patents, the “Fewer than” quantity construction in research texts, and the typesetting command \left in formulas.

patterns.name: left/leave and inflected forms
patterns.context: English forms meaning to depart, leave something behind, cause something to remain in a state, or appearing as a verb in a title; surrounding contexts vary across infinitive, perfect, past tense, third-person singular, and title capitalization.
patterns.domain: Literary criticism, reader comments, business email, research papers, news headlines

patterns.name: Interface, surface, and height
patterns.context: Spatial geometry, imaging regions, object surfaces, or phase interfaces in technical or patent descriptions; in [6], height occurs repeatedly and in adjacent triggers, while [7] contains the explicit term vapor-liquid interface.

patterns.name: English expressions for quantities below a threshold
patterns.context: The fixed comparative construction “Fewer than” is followed by a proportion or quantity to indicate a value below a threshold; activation falls on different parts of Few/er and than.

patterns.name: left in formulas
patterns.context: Part of the LaTeX typesetting command \left in mathematical formulas, used to delimit brackets rather than as the English verb “to leave.”

7_2600.concept: left/leave 词形及局部技术用法
7_2600.description: 主要响应 left/leave 的词形及其不同语义用法；另对专利中的空间界面/高度术语、科研文本里的“Fewer than”数量结构，以及公式排版命令 \left 有激活。

patterns.name: left/leave 及其屈折形式
patterns.context: 英语中表示离开、留下、使某事保持某种状态，或作为标题中的动词；周围语境有不定式、完成时、过去时、第三人称单数及标题大小写等变化。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、读者评论、商务邮件、科研论文、新闻标题

patterns.name: 界面、表面与高度
patterns.context: 技术或专利描述中的空间几何位置、成像区域、物体表面或相界面；[6]中 height 连续出现且相邻触发，[7]中 vapor-liquid interface 是明确术语。

patterns.name: 少于数量的英文表达
patterns.context: 固定比较结构 “Fewer than” 后接比例或数量，表示低于某个数值；激活落在 Few/er 及 than 的不同部分。

patterns.name: 公式中的 left
patterns.context: 数学公式中作为 LaTeX 排版命令 \left 的一部分，用于括号定界，而非英语动词“离开”。

en.concept: Mixed responses to English phrases and local structures
en.description: High activation often falls on expressions such as would like to and leave/left/leaves, and also appears in make perseverance, web imperatives, mathematical minus signs, and What is; other function-word activations are sporadic, and the patterns are not semantically or syntactically unified.

patterns.name: Fixed expression for being willing to do something
patterns.context: After the first-person plural subject (We), expresses willingness or politely introduces an action; activation is concentrated on like, with weaker activation on neighboring tokens.

patterns.name: Leaving an impression or state on something
patterns.context: leave/leaves is followed by an object, expressing leaving something unfinished or causing someone to feel confused; activation falls on the verb and its immediate object.

patterns.name: Abstract noun after make
patterns.context: make is followed by the abstract noun perseverance, with an emphatic or evaluative tone; found in only one example.

patterns.name: leave in a comment-related imperative
patterns.context: Imperative leave is followed by a comment, inviting readers to leave a comment; this differs from the “leave/cause” uses in other passages.

patterns.name: Definite article and possessive
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases; this passage has no clear, coherent local syntactic pattern and may represent sporadic activation.

patterns.name: Minus signs in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign precedes numbers, fractions, or algebraic expressions; it recurs in math problems, though most numbers and arithmetic symbols are unmarked.

patterns.name: What is in mathematical questions
patterns.context: What is introduces a question asking for a value or a common denominator; it occurs in problem text containing many formulas.

patterns.name: Ordinary sentence-initial or medial function words
patterns.context: These triggers are scattered across web sentences, narrative sentences, and academic acknowledgments, with no consistent local collocation or semantic condition.

7_2600.concept: 英语短语与局部结构的混合响应
7_2600.description: 高激活较常落在 would like to、leave/left/leaves 等表达中，也见于 make perseverance、网页祈使句、数学负号及 What is；另有零散功能词激活，各模式语义与句法并不统一。

patterns.name: 愿意做某事的固定搭配
patterns.context: 在第一人称复数主语（We）后，表达意愿或礼貌地引出行动；激活集中在 like，前后 token 也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文致谢、技术说明

patterns.name: 使某物留下某种印象或状态
patterns.context: leave/leaves 后接宾语，表达留下未尽之处，或使人感到困惑；激活落在动词及其紧邻宾语。

patterns.name: make 后接抽象名词
patterns.context: make 后接表示抽象性质或状态的名词 perseverance，带有强调、评价意味；只见于一例。

patterns.name: 评论性祈使句中的 leave
patterns.context: 命令式 leave 后接 a comment，邀请读者留言；不同于其他段落中 leave 的“留下/使得”用法。

patterns.name: 定冠词与所有格
patterns.context: 在名词短语中出现；这段没有明显连贯的局部句法模式，可能是零散激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的负号
patterns.context: 负号出现在数字、分数或代数表达式前；数学题中负号反复出现，但多数数字和算术符号未标记。

patterns.name: 数学问句的 What is
patterns.context: 以 What is 提出求值或求公分母的问题；出现于带有大量公式的题目文本。

patterns.name: 普通句首或句间功能词
patterns.context: 这些触发项分散在网页句子、叙述句和论文致谢中，缺少一致的局部搭配或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、叙述、学术论文

en.description: Responds to several kinds of text containing specialized labels or structural markers: policy/license webpage wording, statistics, social-class categories, forum production instructions and proper names, and JSON and HTML template fields; no single stable word sense is evident.

patterns.name: Web consent and terms-of-service wording
patterns.context: Website privacy/advertising notices, editorial complaint policies, or software license text; activation falls on words such as service, license, and complaint and their neighboring words.
patterns.domain: Website copy, legal/policy notices, open-source software licenses

patterns.name: Numbers, monetary amounts, and demographic statements
patterns.context: Numbers such as ages, proportions, and amounts occur densely in demographic or income statistics sentences.

patterns.name: Social-class classification terms
patterns.context: Social classes are divided by occupation type and hierarchical level, with category labels listed consecutively.

patterns.name: Shape and production instructions
patterns.context: An author introduces an image they made from common geometric shapes, identifying as a non-designer.

patterns.name: Split subword fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Forum discussions contain usernames, product names, or organization names; activation falls within the names or on adjacent fragments.

patterns.name: Structured data fields
patterns.context: In JSON-like records, field names, counts, years, and dates are arranged as key-value pairs.

patterns.name: HTML/CSS class names and template variables
patterns.context: HTML templates contain Angular directives, CSS class names, and interpolation variables.

7_2600.concept: 专门标签与结构化文本
7_2600.description: 响应多类含有专门标签或结构标记的文本：政策/许可网页措辞、统计数字、社会阶层分类、论坛制作说明与专名，以及 JSON 和 HTML 模板字段；未见单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: 网页同意与服务条款措辞
patterns.context: 网页隐私/广告说明、编辑投诉政策或软件许可文本；激活落在服务、许可、投诉等词及相邻词上
patterns.domain: 网页文案、法律/政策声明、软件开源许可

patterns.name: 数字、金额及人口统计表述
patterns.context: 人口统计或收入统计句中，年龄、比例、金额等数字密集出现

patterns.name: 社会阶层分类术语
patterns.trigger: “non-manual work middle (class II)”“non-manual low”“manual work high / middle”“class V”
patterns.context: 按职业类型与高低层级划分社会阶层，分类标签连续列举
patterns.domain: 医学/公共卫生研究文本

patterns.name: 形状与制作说明
patterns.trigger: “made all these images”“Google Slides”“basic shapes such as square, circle, triangle”
patterns.context: 作者以非设计师身份介绍自己用常见几何形状制作图片

patterns.name: 专名中的拆分词片段
patterns.context: 论坛对话中出现用户名、产品或组织名称，激活落在名称内部或邻近片段

patterns.name: 结构化数据字段
patterns.context: JSON 类记录中字段名、计数值、年份及日期以键值形式排列
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的结构化数据

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 类名与模板变量
patterns.context: HTML 模板中出现 Angular 指令、CSS 类名及插值变量

en.description: Activations are scattered across license disclaimers and GPL contact instructions, demographics and monetary amounts, computational discussions, positive/negative mathematical components, and instructions for returning electronic texts; there is no stable shared semantic trigger. GitHub samples are mostly repetitions of the same passage.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases in license disclaimers
patterns.context: Software license terms describe software as provided as-is and without warranty; activation is concentrated around this disclaimer.

patterns.name: GPL copies and contact instructions
patterns.context: A copyright notice requires the GPL to accompany the code and instructs readers to write to the Free Software Foundation if they have not received a license copy; multiple samples are the same passage.

patterns.name: Demographic and income statements
patterns.context: Demographic sentences describe age distribution, median household income, and figures listed by gender.

patterns.name: Even numbers and computational performance discussions
patterns.context: Discusses large numbers or repeated computations, using Project Euler problems as examples; «even» is strongly activated, but surrounding context also involves computational performance.

patterns.name: Positive and negative components in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A theoretical or mathematical derivation explains that an evolution contains two components with positive and negative signs.

patterns.name: Electronic text return instructions
patterns.context: Explains how to make a request and return a physical-media version if one is received; activation falls near line breaks and media examples.

7_2600.description: 激活分散在许可证免责声明与 GPL 联系指引、人口统计和金额、计算讨论、数学正负分量及电子文本退回说明中；没有稳定共享的语义触发点。GitHub 样本多为同一段落的重复。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明中的固定短语
patterns.context: 软件许可证条款中，描述软件按现状提供且不作担保；激活集中在该免责声明附近。

patterns.name: GPL 副本及联系指引
patterns.context: 版权注释要求随代码附上 GPL，并指示未收到许可证副本时写信给自由软件基金会；多个样本是同一段文本。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码许可证注释

patterns.name: 人口统计与收入表述
patterns.context: 人口统计句子描述年龄分布、家庭收入中位数和按性别列出的数值。

patterns.name: 偶数与计算性能讨论
patterns.context: 谈论较大数字或多次计算，并以 Project Euler 问题为例；«even» 强激活，但周围还有计算性能语境。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的正负分量
patterns.context: 理论或数学推导中，说明一个演化包含两个带正负号的分量。

patterns.name: 电子文本退回指引
patterns.context: 说明收到实体介质版本时如何提出请求并退回；激活落在换行及介质示例附近。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子文本许可条款

en.description: Activations are scattered across cognitive evaluation, argumentation, and state-change expressions, and also occur in legal reasoning, numerical operations, concessive limitations, and contexts involving commitment; trigger words vary widely across corpora, with no unified stable local feature.

patterns.name: Emphasis in evaluation or inference
patterns.context: In opinions, judgments, or arguments, activation often falls on verbs expressing cognition, evidence, or evaluation, or on the complement immediately following them; the specific trigger words differ across examples.
patterns.domain: Narration, film criticism, legal argumentation, technical discussions

patterns.name: Expressions of time and state transitions
patterns.context: Involves duration, completion, unrealized outcomes, or a change of state at a given stage; some examples occur in time phrases or fixed legal expressions.

patterns.name: Legal reasoning and statutory language
patterns.context: Occurs in the context of arguments about decisions, legal tests, or eligibility for remedies; activation is distributed across legal terminology and argumentative connectors.

patterns.name: Quantification and numerical operations
patterns.context: Activation occurs near numbers, arithmetic operations, or multiplicative relationships, but no single mathematical mechanism explains all locations.

patterns.name: Concession, negation, and limitation
patterns.context: Includes expressions of concession, negation, exception, or degree limitation; activation falls near subordinating conjunctions, negative constructions, or degree-related contexts.

patterns.name: Commitment, attachment, and attitude
patterns.context: Describes commitment to a cause or viewpoint, persistence, attachment, or related donation behavior.

7_2600.description: 激活散布于认知评价、论证与状态变化表达，也见于法律推理、数字运算、让步限制和投入态度语境；触发词跨语料差异较大，尚无统一稳定的局部特征。

patterns.name: 评价或推断中的强调
patterns.trigger: thought« it»4 a»1 particularly nice« place»2；«should've been« one；«don't think»7；«makes»9 clear»7；«shows»9；«doesn't»4« make»9 it
patterns.context: 在观点、判断或论证中，激活常落在表达认知、证据或评价的动词上，或其后紧接的补语；各例的具体触发词并不一致。
patterns.domain: 叙事、影视评论、法律论证、技术讨论

patterns.name: 时间与状态转换表达
patterns.context: 涉及持续、完成、未实现或某一阶段的状态变化；有的出现于时间短语或法律固定搭配中。

patterns.name: 法律推理与法条表述
patterns.context: 在判决、法律测试或救济资格的论证语境中；激活分布于法律术语和论证连接处。

patterns.name: 量化与数字运算
patterns.context: 数字、算术操作或倍数关系附近有激活，但单一数学机制无法解释全部位置。

patterns.name: 让步、否定与限制
patterns.context: 包含让步、否定、例外或限制程度的表达；激活分别落在从属连词、否定结构或程度语境附近。

patterns.name: 投入、依附与态度
patterns.context: 描述对事业或观点的投入、坚持、依附，或相应的捐赠行为。
patterns.domain: 历史叙事、网络技术评论

en.description: Activation spans mathematical symbols and typesetting in formulas, indented code, aligned data/table formats, and also a small number of device terms and clinical statistical statements; the shared cue is mainly structured symbols, abbreviations, and formatting in technical texts, not a unified topic.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and formula structure
patterns.context: Occurs in formulas, set definitions, or matrix entries, often with alignment symbols, brackets, subscripts, and superscripts; no specific mathematical topic is required.

patterns.name: Indented code and control structures
patterns.context: Code blocks contain file/directory checks, method calls, and newline indentation.

patterns.name: Structured data and aligned whitespace
patterns.context: Fields, values, or table cells are arranged in rows and columns, with whitespace and punctuation serving formatting purposes.
patterns.domain: Configuration/log-style data, medical tables, or extracted table text

patterns.name: Hyphens and alphanumeric combinations in device names
patterns.context: Technical terms combine letters, hyphens, and abbreviations and occur in device descriptions.
patterns.domain: Patent background, circuit and semiconductor technology

patterns.name: Medical terminology and statistical reporting
patterns.context: Clinical research describes cases, group differences, or statistical significance.

7_2600.description: 激活覆盖公式中的数学符号与排版、缩进代码、对齐的数据/表格格式，也包括少量器件术语和临床统计表述；共同线索偏向技术文本中的结构化符号、缩写与排版，主题并不统一。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学与公式结构
patterns.trigger: 数学符号、下标/上标及 LaTeX 命令，如「q^{-1}(C_p)」「\underbrace」「\begin{pmatrix}」「\tau」
patterns.context: 出现在公式、集合定义或矩阵条目中，常伴随对齐符号、括号、下标和上标；不要求特定数学主题

patterns.name: 缩进代码与控制结构
patterns.context: 代码块中出现文件/目录判断、方法调用和换行缩进

patterns.name: 结构化数据与对齐空白
patterns.trigger: 「REPORT」「{sync}」、数值列表，以及大量对齐空格和换行
patterns.context: 字段、数值或表格单元按行列排列，空白和标点承担格式化作用
patterns.domain: 配置/日志式数据、医学表格或表格抽取文本

patterns.name: 器件名称中的连字符与字母数字组合
patterns.context: 技术名词由字母、连字符和缩写组合，出现在器件说明中
patterns.domain: 专利背景、电路与半导体技术

patterns.name: 医学术语与统计报告
patterns.context: 临床研究叙述病例、组间差异或统计显著性

en.description: Primarily responds to dense sequences of formal symbols: variables, operators, numbers, and punctuation in LaTeX scientific formulas; it also appears in structured code/data and semiconductor patent terminology, with no single fixed trigger word.

patterns.name: Mathematical/scientific formula symbols
patterns.context: Dense LaTeX mathematics or scientific formulas; activation falls on symbols, numbers, punctuation, and adjacent formula tokens, rather than on a single mathematical symbol.
patterns.domain: Mathematical, physics, and scientific texts from ArXiv, StackExchange, and PubMed Central

patterns.name: Structured data and numbers in code
patterns.context: Parentheses, delimiters, numbers, and identifiers are interspersed in code or data sequences.

patterns.name: Technical patent materials and layer names
patterns.context: Describes the formation, material composition, and growth temperature of semiconductor layers.

7_2600.description: 主要响应密集的形式化符号序列：LaTeX 科学公式中的变量、运算符、数字和标点；也出现在结构化代码/数据及半导体专利术语中，未见单一固定触发词。

patterns.name: 数学/科学公式符号
patterns.trigger: 如“\rho”“\nabla”“\lambda”“\infty”“\pi”“\sum”“\begin{pmatrix}”及公式中的上下标、运算符
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学或科学公式密集出现；激活落在符号、数字、标点及公式相邻 token 上，并非单一数学符号
patterns.domain: ArXiv、StackExchange、PubMed Central 的数学、物理及科学文本

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化数据与数字
patterns.trigger: [1] 中的 JSON 样式片段“:[”“]”；[6] 中的“Reals.Expo(2.0)”及行号注释“(* 127 *)”
patterns.context: 代码或数据序列中，括号、分隔符、数字与标识符交错出现

patterns.name: 技术专利材料与层名
patterns.context: 描述半导体层的形成、材料组成及生长温度

en.concept: Difficult to assign to a single concept
en.description: Activation is most concentrated on prisoner and incarceration or judicial contexts; it also occurs on intra-word fragments in medical terminology, especially musculoskeletal terms and adrenal, as well as in an email-draft context. Surface trigger forms vary substantially across groups.

patterns.name: prisoner and related judicial contexts
