patterns.domain: Technical discussions, product and service reviews, interviews

patterns.name: Document formatting and webpage markup
patterns.context: Web promotional text or quoted email combines line breaks and layout markers with prose; activation occurs near formatting markers.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Proper names, abbreviations, or token boundaries may trigger local activation; acclaim recurs in two film-related texts.
patterns.domain: Sports regulations, technical commentary, film descriptions

7_2794.concept: 评价性表达与名词短语
7_2794.description: 激活分散于评价性名词短语、轻便或颜色描述、数值评分、网页/邮件格式和专名缩写等；多处落在形容词修饰的名词附近，但没有单一稳定触发词或统一语境。

patterns.name: 形容词与名词的搭配
patterns.trigger: “great emotional blow”“great overall look”“huge critical acclaim”“positive feedback”等评价性修饰语，常见激活落在名词或名词短语末尾，如 “blow”“look”“acclaim”“feedback”
patterns.context: 评价或描述某事物、结果、表现时，激活常出现在形容词修饰的名词短语中；不同词汇组合均可出现。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、影视介绍、用户评价及一般叙述

patterns.name: 轻便与颜色描述
patterns.context: 描述服装颜色或物品便于携带、重量轻；激活落在 light/colors 一带。
patterns.domain: 体育服装规定、商品评价

patterns.name: 数量与度量表达
patterns.context: 出现数值、评分或计量表达；这些片段中激活并不稳定地落在数值本身，可能与邻近词及格式有关。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、商品与服务评价、访谈

patterns.name: 文档格式与网页标记
patterns.trigger: “↵↵”“SUBSCRIBE TO OUR NEWSLETTER”“FOLLOW US ON:”及引文前缀“>”
patterns.context: 网页宣传文本或邮件引用中，换行、版式标记与正文并存；激活出现在格式标记附近。

patterns.name: 专名与缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 专名、缩写或分词边界可能触发局部激活；acclaim 在两处影视相关文本中重复出现。
patterns.domain: 体育规章、技术评论、影视介绍

en.description: Activation falls on final words in various evaluative or technical and sports expressions: acclaim, hit, look, output, noise, rating, punch, etc.; also left for remaining time in a game. Semantics and word forms are inconsistent.

patterns.name: acclaim suffix
patterns.context: When “acclaim” is split into subwords, strong activation falls on the ending claim; the context is a work or performance receiving praise

patterns.name: hit as a success evaluation
patterns.context: Hit means popular or successful, preceded by an intensifier such as huge

patterns.name: look as an appearance evaluation
patterns.context: Look refers to the overall visual effect, preceded by overall or great

patterns.name: Final item in a compound term: output
patterns.context: In the technical compound expression input/output, activation falls on output

patterns.name: Game-winning context
patterns.context: Describes the final stages of a game, time remaining, and a winning goal or score

patterns.name: Appearance and gloss evaluation
patterns.context: Describes the wet appearance and gloss produced by a polishing product

patterns.name: Rating term
patterns.context: Customer reviews express ratings in stars; the preceding text mentions receiving a rating

patterns.name: Signal-to-noise terminology
patterns.context: In the expression signal-to-noise, activation falls on noise

patterns.name: Sports compound expression with punch
patterns.context: “1-2 punch” metaphorically describes the combined strength of a team’s center positions

7_2794.description: 激活落在多类评价或技术、体育表达的末词：acclaim、hit、look、output、noise、rating、punch 等；另有比赛剩余时间 left。语义与词形不统一。

patterns.name: acclaim 后缀
patterns.context: “acclaim”被拆分为子词时，强激活落在词尾 claim；语境是作品或表演获得好评

patterns.name: hit 作为成功评价
patterns.context: hit 指受欢迎或成功，前有 huge 等程度修饰词

patterns.name: look 的外观评价
patterns.context: look 指整体视觉效果，前有 overall、great

patterns.name: output 复合术语末项
patterns.context: 在 input/output 技术复合表达中，激活落在 output

patterns.name: 比赛胜利语境
patterns.context: 描述比赛末段、剩余时间及制胜球或得分

patterns.name: 外观与光泽评价
patterns.context: 描述抛光产品带来的湿润外观和光泽

patterns.name: 评分词
patterns.context: 客户评价中以星级表示评分，前文提及收到评分

patterns.name: 信噪比术语
patterns.context: signal-to-noise 表达中激活落在 noise

patterns.name: 体育 punch 复合表达
patterns.context: “1-2 punch”比喻球队中锋位置上的组合实力

en.description: Strong activation often falls on exclamation marks and final words in positive evaluations or promotional copy; also includes look in aesthetic evaluations, acclaim for praise, and evidence in medical literature. No clear shared lexical or semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Exclamation mark at sentence end or before punctuation
patterns.context: An exclamation mark ends promotional, evaluative, or explanatory sentences; usually it appears at sentence end, possibly followed by a space, line break, or new sentence.
patterns.domain: Website copy, reviews, recommendations, emails, etc.

patterns.name: look before a positive evaluation
patterns.context: Evaluates appearance, visual effect, or presentation; examples include “great overall look” and “deeper, wet look gloss.”

patterns.name: Praise for performance
patterns.context: The latter part of the word for praise in “critical acclaim,” referring to a work receiving positive reviews.

patterns.name: Evidence reported after a percentage
patterns.context: Appears in the evidence statement “strong evidence to show” after a percentage, research findings, and citations.

7_2794.description: 强激活多落在感叹号及正面评价、宣传语的句末；另有 look 的审美评价、acclaim 的赞誉和医学文献中的 evidence，未见它们共享明确的词法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 句末或标点前的感叹号
patterns.context: 感叹号结束宣传、评价或说明性句子；多在句末，之后可能接空格、换行或新句。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、评论、推荐、邮件等

patterns.name: 正面评价词前的 look
patterns.context: 评价外观、视觉效果或呈现方式；一例为“great overall look”，另一例为“deeper, wet look gloss”。

patterns.name: 对表现的赞誉
patterns.context: “critical acclaim”中赞誉一词的后半部分，指向作品获得好评。

patterns.name: 百分比后报告证据
patterns.context: 在百分比、研究结果和引用之后，出现在“strong evidence to show”这一证据陈述中。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to evaluative wording such as “critical acclaim/reception” in entertainment entries; sporadic responses also occur to exclamation marks in promotional copy, chat headline wording, placeholders in research abstracts, and public-health labels, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Review and positive reception wording
patterns.context: Descriptions of reviews of a film or television work, commonly including “critical acclaim” or “critical reception”; nearby text may mention the work, performance, or review outcome.

patterns.name: Final exclamation mark
patterns.context: Promotional or sales copy ends with an exclamation mark; activation falls on the punctuation itself rather than a topic-specific word.

patterns.name: Unreadable placeholder in a research abstract
patterns.context: An NIH abstract contains a text placeholder labeled unreadable, especially near sentence or abstract-fragment boundaries; strong activation falls around the placeholder.

patterns.name: goodness in chat promotion
patterns.context: A website or product update headline uses “goodness” to describe a new chat feature; seen only once, the trigger may be the word or its collocation.

patterns.name: Promotional “and more!” ending for an event
patterns.context: After listing sports stars or autographs, a promotional passage ends with “and more!”
patterns.domain: Promotional or event copy in Enron emails

patterns.name: Public-health relevance heading in a research abstract
patterns.context: An uppercase label introduces a statement about public-health significance in a research abstract.

7_2794.concept: 文本评价与宣传式强调
7_2794.description: 主要对娱乐条目中的“critical acclaim/reception”评价措辞强烈响应；另对宣传文案的感叹号、聊天标题用语、科研摘要占位符及公共卫生标签有零星响应，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 评论与好评措辞
patterns.context: 电影或电视作品介绍中描述评论界评价，常见搭配为“critical acclaim”或“critical reception”；附近可能出现作品、表演或评价结果。

patterns.name: 感叹号结尾
patterns.context: 宣传或促销语句以感叹号收尾；激活落在标点本身，而非特定主题词。

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的不可读占位符
patterns.context: NIH 摘要中出现被标注为 unreadable 的文本占位符，尤其在句子或摘要片段边界附近；此处强激活落在占位符周围。

patterns.name: 聊天宣传中的 goodness
patterns.context: 网站或产品更新标题中以“goodness”描述新增聊天功能；仅见一次，触发点可能是该词或其搭配。

patterns.name: 活动宣传的 more 感叹式收尾
patterns.context: 列举体育明星或签名等内容后，用“and more!”作宣传式收尾。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的促销或活动文案

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的公共卫生相关性标题
patterns.context: 研究摘要中以大写标签引出公共卫生意义说明。

en.description: Activation often falls on evaluative or summative words at the end of a sentence or paragraph, and also appears in headings of evaluative sections; additionally includes academic emphasis on evidence and descriptions of guitar feel and tone, generally favoring salient summative or evaluative expressions.

patterns.name: Evaluative concluding word
patterns.context: A word with a summarizing, judgmental, or evaluative meaning appears at the end of a review or description, often near the end of a sentence or paragraph.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, media reviews, biographies, product descriptions, etc.

patterns.name: Evaluation-related section heading
patterns.context: A title or section label; “Reception” is also adjacent to positive evaluation in the following text.

patterns.name: Appreciative expression in a product review
patterns.context: Consumers evaluate clothing or food using concise, explicit positive wording.

patterns.name: Emphasis on academic significance or evidence
patterns.context: A health research abstract emphasizes the weight of evidence in its public-health significance section; activation falls on “evidence.”

patterns.name: Tone description of a traditional instrument
patterns.context: Compares guitar body designs and summarizes playing feel and tone.

7_2794.description: 激活常落在句末或段落末的评价、总结性词语，也见于评价类小节标题；此外包括学术证据强调及吉他手感、音色描述，整体偏向显著的总结或评价表达。

patterns.name: 评价性结尾词
patterns.context: 评论或描述末尾出现带总结、判断或评价意味的词语；常位于句子或段落结尾附近。
patterns.domain: 商品评论、媒体评论、人物介绍、产品描述等

patterns.name: 评价相关章节标题
patterns.context: 标题或小节标签；其中“Reception”还与后文正面评价相邻。

patterns.name: 商品评论中的赞赏表达
patterns.trigger: “The bow detail on these is great!”, “These socks are terrific!”, “very pleasant lemon flavor”
patterns.context: 消费者以简短、明确的正面措辞评价服饰或食品。

patterns.name: 学术意义或证据强调
patterns.context: 健康研究摘要中，在公共卫生意义部分强调证据分量；激活落在“evidence”。

patterns.name: 传统乐器音色描述
patterns.context: 比较吉他琴体设计，并概括其演奏手感与音色。

en.concept: Emphasis on positive evaluations and evidence
en.description: Activation commonly occurs in positive evaluations or emphatic conclusions, especially on words such as evidence, influence, received, great, terrific, and scent; product reviews also include exclamation marks. Domains include academic, encyclopedic, news, and consumer texts.

patterns.name: Emphasis on evidence or influence
patterns.context: Occurs in statements of positive evaluation, influence, or research conclusions, often near evaluative or evidence-related words; also appears with performance statistics in sports reporting.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, encyclopedia entries, news reports

patterns.name: Product praise and purchase experience
patterns.context: Product reviews or descriptions positively evaluate socks, clothing details, or shampoo scent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final exclamation mark
patterns.context: An exclamation mark follows a positive evaluative word or product description and may be triggered jointly by the evaluative tone.

7_2794.description: 激活常见于积极评价或结论性强调处，尤其是 evidence、influence、received、great、terrific、scent 等词；商品评论中还伴随感叹号。涵盖学术、百科、新闻与消费文本。

patterns.name: 证据或影响的强调
patterns.context: 处于正面评价、影响或研究结论的陈述中，常见于评价性词语或证据类词语附近；另有体育报道中的表现数据。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、百科条目、新闻报道

patterns.name: 商品赞誉与购买体验
patterns.context: 商品评论或产品描述中，对袜子、服饰细节或洗发水气味作积极评价。

patterns.name: 句末感叹号
patterns.context: 感叹号紧随积极评价词或商品描述，可能与评价语气共同触发。

en.concept: Multiple local lexical and formatting features
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in Enron email headers, RE/forward boundaries, and blank lines or numeric fragments following them; it also appears in research abstracts’ evidence statements, descriptions of fur texture, and introductions to musical styles. Sporadic activation also occurs in apologies, replies, and friendly expressions in email bodies.

patterns.name: Blank lines and forwarding separators in email reply chains
patterns.context: Activation often occurs after email headers (From/Sent/To/Subject) or at forwarded-message boundaries, before the body appears or just as it begins.

patterns.name: Standalone numbers or placeholder content in emails
patterns.context: Appears near email headers, reply separators, or blank message bodies; these numbers seem more like formatting fragments, and it is unclear whether they represent meaningful amounts or identifiers.

patterns.name: Descriptions of texture and shimmer
patterns.context: Describes the feel, color, or shimmering appearance of Bengal cat fur.

patterns.name: Musical style and classical influence
patterns.context: Emphasizes classical music influences when introducing a musician and their style.

patterns.name: Research evidence and data supporting an argument
patterns.context: Research papers or abstracts use data or preliminary results to support an interpretation, intervention, or conclusion.

patterns.name: Polite or responsive language in everyday replies
patterns.context: Email body fragments involving a lack of response, an apology, or evaluating whether someone is too friendly; may overlap with email-format triggers.

7_2794.concept: 多种局部词汇与格式特征
7_2794.description: 激活主要出现在 Enron 邮件头、RE/转发边界及其后的空行或数字残片；另在研究摘要的证据表述、皮毛质地描写和音乐风格介绍中激活，邮件正文的道歉、回应及友善表达也有零星激活。

patterns.name: 邮件回复链中的空白行与转发分隔
patterns.context: 邮件头部（From/Sent/To/Subject）之后或转发邮件边界处，常在正文尚未出现或仅刚开始时激活。

patterns.name: 邮件中的独立数字或占位内容
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头、回复分隔符或空白正文附近；这些数字更像格式残片，不能确定是有语义的金额或编号。

patterns.name: 质地与闪光效果描述
patterns.context: 描写孟加拉猫皮毛触感、色泽或闪光外观。

patterns.name: 音乐风格与古典影响
patterns.context: 介绍音乐人及其音乐风格时，强调古典音乐影响。

patterns.name: 研究证据与数据支持论点
patterns.context: 研究或论文摘要中，以数据或初步结果支持某种解释、干预或结论。

patterns.name: 日常回复中的礼貌或回应
patterns.context: 邮件正文片段，涉及未回复、道歉或评价某人是否过于友善；与邮件格式触发可能重叠。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on email structure markers: field names, colons, line breaks, reply/forward boundaries, and dates and times; it also covers common email components such as body requests, salutations, brief replies, subjects, and signatures.

patterns.name: Email header fields and delimiters
patterns.context: High activation occurs near field names, colons, line breaks, and email boundaries in headers or forwarded headers; sometimes the subject contains «RE:»

patterns.name: Polite requests or prompts at the start of an email body
patterns.context: Requests to view an attachment or update prices appear at the start of the email body or after a salutation; this is not triggered in every message

patterns.name: Reply, forward, and original-message markers
patterns.context: Subject lines and original-message quotation boundaries in reply or forward threads

patterns.name: Conventional business-email greetings and closing expressions
patterns.context: Near a body salutation, brief status reply, or apology

patterns.name: Proper nouns and business topics in email subjects
patterns.context: Names of events, projects, products, or business matters in the subject field; subject wording varies considerably

patterns.name: Date and time formats
patterns.context: Send dates and times in email headers, interspersed with numbers and punctuation

patterns.name: Sporadic body words and tone
patterns.context: Short, informal reply fragments whose specific meaning depends on missing context

patterns.name: Names and signatures
patterns.context: Name or signature fragments at the end of the body or in an email signature

7_2794.description: 激活主要集中在邮件结构标记：字段名、冒号、换行、回复/转发边界及日期时间；另覆盖正文请求、称呼、简短回复、主题和签名等邮件常见成分。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与分隔符
patterns.trigger: «Sent»、«To»、«Cc»、«Subject»、«:»及«↵»，常见于日期、收件人和主题行
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发邮件头中，字段名、冒号、换行及邮件边界附近出现高激活；有时主题含«RE:»

patterns.name: 邮件正文开头的礼貌请求/提示
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头或称呼之后，提出查看附件、更新价格等请求；触发并非每段都有

patterns.name: 回复、转发与原始邮件标记
patterns.context: 回复或转发线程中的主题和原始邮件引用边界

patterns.name: 常规商务邮件称呼/收尾式表达
patterns.context: 正文称呼、简短状态回复或道歉语句附近

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的专名与业务主题
patterns.trigger: «Baby Shower»、«Winning the cultural war»、«Agave Pricing»、«BuySideDirect»、«Credit worth»iness、«Click Paper Approvals»
patterns.context: 主题字段内的活动、项目、产品或业务事项名称；主题措辞差异较大

patterns.name: 日期时间格式
patterns.trigger: 日期如«Friday, October 26, 2001»及时间中的«:»
patterns.context: 邮件头中的发送日期和时间，数字与标点交错

patterns.name: 零散正文词语与语气
patterns.context: 短小的非正式回复片段，具体语义依赖缺失的上下文

patterns.name: 姓名与签名
patterns.context: 正文末尾或邮件签名处出现的姓名/签名残片

en.concept: Document structure and local context markers
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in business email header fields, requests, and forwarding markers; it also appears in baseball reports’ expressions for a lead and game progress, and in medical abstracts’ descriptions of effects and topics.

patterns.name: Email header fields and punctuation
patterns.context: Recipient, cc, and subject fields in Enron email headers and the line breaks following them; activation in multiple passages falls near colons, line breaks, or field names.

patterns.name: Requests or collaboration in email bodies
patterns.context: Work-related communication in email bodies involving requests, apologies, or questions, often after a salutation or quoted email.

patterns.name: Email forwarding and quotation markers
patterns.context: Subject or body contains forwarding or original-message separators, with activation concentrated near message-forwarding markers.

patterns.name: Expressions of a lead in the score
patterns.context: A baseball report describes a team taking the lead, usually followed by the score and inning information.

patterns.name: Research findings and topic introduction
patterns.context: An abstract’s conclusion states the effect of an intervention, or introduces research background with “What is known about the topic?”

patterns.name: Numbers and descriptions of game progress
patterns.context: A baseball report includes scores, innings, hits, or game action; this is adjacent to but distinct from descriptions of taking the lead.

7_2794.concept: 文档结构与局部语境标记
7_2794.description: 激活主要出现在商务邮件的头字段、请求与转发标记；另见棒球报道中的比分领先及比赛进程词，以及医学摘要的效果与主题表述。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段及标点
patterns.context: Enron 邮件头中的收件人、抄送、主题字段及其后的换行；多段激活落在冒号、换行或字段名附近。

patterns.name: 邮件正文请求或协作表达
patterns.context: 邮件正文出现请求、道歉或询问等工作沟通语句，常在称呼或引用邮件之后。

patterns.name: 邮件转发与引用标记
patterns.context: 主题或正文包含转发、原始邮件分隔线，激活集中在消息转发标记附近。

patterns.name: 比分领先表达
patterns.context: 棒球比赛报道中描述球队取得领先，通常紧接比分并带有局数信息。

patterns.name: 研究成果与主题介绍
patterns.context: 摘要末尾陈述干预效果，或以“What is known about the topic?”引出研究背景。

patterns.name: 数字与比赛进程描述
patterns.context: 棒球报道中出现比分、局数、安打或比赛动作；与领先表达相邻，但不完全相同。

en.description: Appears mainly in business email header fields, forwarding separators, and various business or event announcements; it also activates in a baseball report describing a team taking the lead, which does not fit the email pattern.

patterns.name: Email headers and field separators
patterns.context: Colons after field names, field line breaks, and blank lines before the body in email metadata; activation in multiple passages is concentrated near these formatting markers

patterns.name: Forwarded emails and original-message separators
patterns.context: A fixed separator or forwarding wording appears when an email includes a forwarded or quoted original message

patterns.name: Invitations and event arrangements in emails
patterns.context: Notifies recipients to respond, attend an event, or view an invitation; includes dates, lunch, or private celebrations

patterns.name: Business, legal, and credit-related content
patterns.context: Discusses transaction documents, lawyers’ conflicts of interest, regulatory investigations, or credit assessments; activation does not fall only on these business words and also involves email formatting
patterns.domain: Corporate legal, transaction, and credit business emails

patterns.name: Internal email matters and transaction communication
patterns.context: Subjects concern forms, missing transactions, or counterparties; the body is brief and often appears in internal correspondence

patterns.name: Greetings and interpersonal communication in emails
patterns.context: The email body begins with a salutation or personal questions about where someone lives, rather than purely business content

patterns.name: Baseball game progress and taking the lead
patterns.context: Describes a team taking the lead in an inning of a baseball game, with nearby information about players, batting, and the score

7_2794.concept: 邮件格式与消息边界标记
7_2794.description: 主要出现在企业邮件的头部字段、转发分隔符和多种业务或活动通知中；另有一段棒球报道在叙述球队取得领先时激活，无法归入邮件模式。

patterns.name: 邮件头部与字段分隔
patterns.trigger: «:»、«Subject»、«↵»，以及收件人、抄送和主题字段
patterns.context: 邮件元数据中字段名后的冒号、字段换行及邮件正文前的空行；多段中激活集中在这些格式标记附近

patterns.name: 转发邮件与原邮件分隔线
patterns.context: 邮件包含转发或引用的原始邮件时，出现固定分隔线或转发措辞

patterns.name: 邮件中的邀请与活动安排
patterns.context: 通知收件人回复、参加活动或查看邀请函；含日期、午餐或私人庆祝活动信息
patterns.domain: 企业内部活动通知邮件

patterns.name: 商业、法律与信用业务内容
patterns.trigger: «continental»« power» trading« documents»、«SEC inquiry»、«Credit»« worth»iness、«credit»«worth»«iness» criteria
patterns.context: 讨论交易文件、律师利益冲突、监管调查或信用评估；激活并非只落在这些业务词上，也涉及邮件格式
patterns.domain: 企业法律、交易与信用业务邮件

patterns.name: 内部邮件中的事项与交易沟通
patterns.trigger: «Subject»«:» New PA form、«The PA:»、«Subject» Re: Missing deal?、«counterpart»
patterns.context: 主题涉及表格、缺失交易或交易对手，正文简短，常出现在内部往来邮件中

patterns.name: 邮件问候与人际交流
patterns.trigger: «Jeff:»、«Where do you want to live»、«which area, condo/house?»
patterns.context: 邮件正文从称呼或对居住地的个人询问展开，而非纯业务内容
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的私人交流

patterns.name: 棒球比赛进程与得分领先
patterns.context: 描述棒球比赛某队在某局取得领先，附近有球员、击球和比分信息

en.description: Activation often occurs at email format boundaries, salutations, and business email requests; it also covers baseball game reports, car performance reviews, and soccer results, presenting several distinct genre cues.

patterns.name: Email headers and salutations
patterns.context: Email metadata, salutations, or the start of the body, often accompanied by line breaks and signatures

patterns.name: Requests and business content in emails
patterns.context: The email body makes requests, asks about transactions, or discusses credit and pricing

patterns.name: Strong line-break / blank-space boundaries
patterns.context: Between the email body and signature, between the header and body, or at the end of the text

patterns.name: Baseball game narration
patterns.context: Game reports describing batting, scoring, and innings

patterns.name: Car specifications and evaluation
patterns.context: Introduces vehicle features and evaluates performance

patterns.name: Soccer match results
patterns.context: Describes a team’s match result and related advancement or season information

7_2794.description: 激活多见于邮件格式边界、称呼及商务邮件请求；另覆盖棒球比赛报道、汽车性能评论和足球赛果，呈现为若干不同文体线索。

patterns.name: 邮件头与称呼
patterns.context: 邮件元数据、称呼或正文起始处，常伴随换行和署名

patterns.name: 邮件中的请求与业务内容
patterns.context: 邮件正文提出请求、询问交易或谈论信用与定价

patterns.name: 强换行/空白边界
patterns.trigger: 连续 «↵»，以及尾部大片空白后的 «↵»
patterns.context: 邮件正文与署名之间、邮件头与正文之间或文本结尾处

patterns.name: 棒球比赛叙述
patterns.context: 描述击球、得分及局次的比赛报道

patterns.name: 汽车参数与评价
patterns.context: 介绍车辆配置并给出性能评价

patterns.name: 足球赛果叙述
patterns.context: 叙述球队比赛结果及晋级/赛季相关信息

en.description: The most stable trigger is the in-word character fragment mim, spanning different contexts such as mimicking, mimetype, mimosa, and mimetic. There are also sporadic activations on the legal word estopped, case-title formatting, and a few scientific and web text fragments.

patterns.name: In-word fragment beginning with mim-
patterns.context: Activation centers on the in-word character fragment mim; the same word-initial fragment occurs across varied meanings and word forms, without requiring a specific syntactic or semantic context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: research abstracts, technical documents, prose, legal texts, websites, and research funding descriptions

patterns.name: In-word letter fragment stoppel
patterns.context: In legal text, appears as an in-word fragment in “were estopped from maintaining the action”; distinct from the primary mim pattern.

patterns.name: Legal case-title formatting
patterns.context: Formatting of case citations and party titles; no mim fragment appears.

patterns.name: Sporadic non-mim in-word activations
patterns.context: Individual words or word fragments are marked in their respective contexts; no shared semantic, formatting, or stable trigger condition is apparent.

7_2890.concept: 词内 mim 字符片段
7_2890.description: 最稳定的触发是词内字符片段 mim，横跨 mimicking、mimetype、mimosa、mimetic 等不同语境。另有法律词 estopped、案件标题格式及少量科研和网页词片段的零散激活。

patterns.name: mim- 开头的词中片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内的字符片段 mim；同一词首片段出现在多种不同词义和词形中，并不要求特定句法或语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：科研摘要、技术文档、散文、法律文本、网页及研究资助说明

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 stoppel
patterns.context: 法律文本中，作为“were estopped from maintaining the action”里的词内片段；与主要 mim 模式不同。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题格式
patterns.context: 案件引注与当事人标题的排版格式；没有出现 mim 片段。

patterns.name: 非 mim 的零散词内激活
patterns.context: 个别词或词片段在各自语境中被标记；未见共同语义、格式或稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 化学科研摘要；网页评论

en.description: Activations are sporadic: > at the start of email quotation lines recurs most clearly; the rest are scattered across sentence-initial capitalized word fragments, mathematical formatting, URLs, and ordinary words, with no shared semantic or syntactic pattern explaining all fragments.

patterns.name: Greater-than sign marker
patterns.context: Before email quotations or quoted text, activation centers on the literal >; one segment also includes a line break.

patterns.name: Capitalized initial letters or word fragments
patterns.context: Split positions vary between text beginnings and inside words; some are capitalized initial words/fragments, and others begin with digits, with no uniform semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: cert in a URL
patterns.context: Appears in a path fragment of an ENISA cybersecurity URL; activation is related to URL segmentation, with weaker activations on other nearby URL fragments as well.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in common words and phrases
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in full sentences or in-word fragments; segments lack shared local morphological, syntactic, or semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Line break after formula or number
patterns.context: In a math problem, a line break after numbers, symbols, and letters is followed by the instruction “Find the third derivative of”; the trigger may relate to formatting or symbols, but there is only one example.

patterns.name: Word fragment in sports reporting
patterns.context: Appears at the start of sports reports such as “Bowl win caps amazing season turnaround,” with activation on a split fragment of Bowl.

7_2890.concept: none
7_2890.description: 激活分布零散：邮件引用行首的 > 最明显地重复出现；其余分散于句首大写词片段、数学格式、网址及普通词语中，未见能解释全部片段的共同语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 大于号标记
patterns.context: 在邮件引用格式或被引用文本前，激活集中在字面上的 >；其中一段还伴随换行。

patterns.name: 词首大写字母或词片段
patterns.context: 文本开头或词内部的切分位置不一；部分是大写词首/片段，另有数字开头，缺乏统一的词义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 网址中的 cert
patterns.context: 出现在 ENISA 网络安全网址的路径片段中；激活与网址切分相关，周围其他 URL 片段也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 常见词与短语中的零散激活
patterns.context: 在完整句子或词内片段中零散出现；各段缺少共同的局部词形、句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 公式或数字后的换行
patterns.context: 数学题文本中，数字、符号和字母后换行，再接指令“Find the third derivative of”；触发可能与格式或符号有关，证据仅一例。

patterns.name: 比赛报道词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Bowl win caps amazing season turnaround”一类体育报道开头，激活落在 Bowl 的切分片段。

en.description: Strong activations mainly center on minus signs and adjacent numbers, variables, and algebraic expressions in math problems, and also occur at problem line breaks and instructions; there is also an NIH GOAL marker and a dash after an email salutation, possibly reflecting different punctuation or boundary patterns.

patterns.name: GOAL/AL format
patterns.context: Appears in an NIH project description, followed by a colon and the goal statement “To decrease the morbidity and mortality”.

patterns.name: Minus signs and number sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Mostly fragments of math exercises, where minus signs are often part of a number or algebraic expression; some problem fragments activate immediately after a minus sign.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics problems and practice materials

patterns.name: Negative-coefficient algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Minus signs occur adjacent to coefficients, variables, or multiplication signs; common in expressions from polynomial, equation, or sequence problems, rather than natural-language usage.

patterns.name: Problem boundaries and math-problem instructions
patterns.context: Adjacent to negative numbers or algebraic expressions, appearing at problem line breaks, question beginnings, or in question wording; activation is not limited to instruction words.

patterns.name: Dash as separator
patterns.context: A dash appears after an email salutation, like a separator or em dash in the email body; no mathematical expression is nearby.

7_2890.concept: 负号及文本边界标记
7_2890.description: 强激活主要集中在数学题里负号及其邻接的数字、变量和代数式，也见于题目换行与指令；另有 NIH 的 GOAL 标记和邮件称呼后的短横线，可能反映不同的标点或边界模式。

patterns.name: GOAL/AL 格式
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 项目描述中，后接冒号及“To decrease the morbidity and mortality”这一目标陈述。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负号与数字序列
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 « -»，以及其后的数字、逗号、问号或换行
patterns.context: 多为数学练习题的片段，负号常作为数值或代数式的一部分；部分题目片段在负号后立即出现激活。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 题目与练习材料

patterns.name: 负系数代数式
patterns.context: 负号与系数、变量或乘号相邻；常见于多项式、方程或数列题中的表达式，而非自然语言用法。

patterns.name: 题面边界与数学题指令
patterns.context: 与负数或代数式相邻，作为题目换行、题干开头或提问措辞出现；激活并非只落在指令词上。

patterns.name: 短横线分隔语
patterns.context: 短横线位于邮件称呼后，像是邮件正文中的分隔符或破折号；周围不含数学表达式。

en.concept: Math problem structure and sequence queries
en.description: Mainly responds to numbers and structured formulas in mathematical question answering, especially “nth term” sequence problems; also covers ordering/comparison, continuing a sequence, finding the number of digits, and weaker or localized patterns such as problem line breaks.

patterns.name: nth term of an arithmetic sequence
patterns.context: Asks for a term in a sequence of integers, usually followed by a linear general-term expression such as “5*k**2 + 21*k + 1994” or “s**2 - 9*s - 133”; the trigger centers on the ordinal-variable suffix “'th term”.

patterns.name: Order statistics among sequence choices
patterns.context: Determines which item is largest, smallest, or closest to a target among a finite set of candidate values or choices; options and numbers often appear nearby.

patterns.name: Asking for the next sequence term
patterns.context: Provides a sequence of numbers and asks for the next term; the sequence may follow a regular or irregular numeric pattern.

patterns.name: Asking for the number of digits
patterns.context: Asks for a specific digit position, such as the ones or hundreds place, of a number or expression; variable definitions and formulas may be nearby.

patterns.name: Numbers and operator strings in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Dense spans of math tokens contain numbers, minus signs, multiplication and division symbols, variables, and question marks; these local fragments do not have a stable shared problem type.

patterns.name: Math task boundaries/line breaks
patterns.context: A line break separates a problem, answer, and following problem or new derivation; activation may occur near the line break marker, but also co-occurs with numbers and problem templates.

7_2890.concept: 数学题结构与数列查询
7_2890.description: 主要响应数学问答中的数字与结构化算式，尤其是“第n项”数列题；也覆盖排序/比较、续写数列、求数字位数，以及题目换行边界等较弱或局部模式。

patterns.name: 等差数列的第 n 项
patterns.trigger: “What is the «l»'th term of -143, -312, -481?”；“What is the «o»'th term…”；“What is the «t»'th term…”；“What is the «b»'th term…”
patterns.context: 问由若干整数构成的数列第几项，随后通常给出线性通项表达式，如“5*k**2 + 21*k + 1994”或“s**2 - 9*s - 133”；触发点集中在序数变量后缀“'th term”。

patterns.name: 选择序列中的次序统计量
patterns.trigger: “Which is the second biggest value?”；“What is the third biggest value…”；“Which is the closest to f?”；“What is the second smallest”
patterns.context: 从有限候选值或选项中判断最大、最小、接近目标的第几项；附近常有选项标记与数字。

patterns.name: 询问数列下一项
patterns.context: 给出一串数字并要求续写下一项；序列可能是常规或不规则数字模式。

patterns.name: 询问数字位数
patterns.trigger: “What is the units digit of”及“what is the hundreds digit of”
patterns.context: 对数或算式求个位、百位等特定位数，附近可有变量定义与算式。

patterns.name: 数学算式中的数字与运算符串
patterns.context: 大段数学 token 中出现密集数字、负号、乘除符号、变量和问号；这些局部片段自身没有稳定的共同题型。

patterns.name: 数学任务边界/换行
patterns.context: 题目、答案与下一道题或新推导以换行分隔；换行标记附近可激活，但也与数字和题目模板共现。

en.concept: Negative numbers and signed expressions in mathematics
en.description: Mainly responds to minus signs and negative numbers in mathematical text, including hexadecimal data in code and various algebra problems; also has localized responses to comparatives, question templates, variable operations, and questions about sequence terms.

patterns.name: Negative numbers/math text beginning with a minus sign
patterns.context: A minus sign is adjacent to a number or used as a subtraction operator in an algebraic expression; often mixed with variables, operators, and numbers.
patterns.domain: Math question answering and algebra problems; in [1], hexadecimal numbers in code

patterns.name: Ordinal apostrophe in sequence-term questions
patterns.context: Asks for the nth term of a given sequence, with the variable connected to an apostrophe-style ordinal.
patterns.domain: Sequence problems, automatically generated math question answering

patterns.name: Comparative cue in comparison problems
patterns.context: Compares two expressions or values, with the comparative word itself clearly activating.

patterns.name: Compound math question-template word
patterns.context: Appears in short question forms; “composite” is often followed by an integer or variable.

patterns.name: Hexadecimal literals in code
patterns.context: Appears as code data in comma-separated key-value pairs enclosed in braces.

patterns.name: Algebraic variable and coefficient operation fragments
patterns.context: Polynomial or equation fragments composed of variables, coefficients, multiplication, or powers; no single variable or operator explains all activations.

7_2890.concept: 数学中的负数与符号表达
7_2890.description: 主要响应数学文本中的负号及负数，覆盖代码十六进制数据和多种代数题；还对比较级、提问模板、变量运算和数列项次问法有局部响应。

patterns.name: 负数/减号开头的数学文本
patterns.context: 负号紧邻数字，或作为代数表达式中的减法运算符；常与变量、运算符和数字混排。
patterns.domain: 数学问答与代数题；[1]中则是代码里的十六进制数

patterns.name: 序列项次提问中的撇号序数
patterns.context: 询问给定数列的第 n 项，变量与撇号序数形式相连。
patterns.domain: 数列题、自动生成的数学问答

patterns.name: 比较题中的比较级提示
patterns.context: 比较两个表达式或数值，比较级词本身激活明显。

patterns.name: 复合数学问答模板词
patterns.context: 出现在简短的题目提问句式中；“composite”后常接整数或变量。

patterns.name: 代码中的十六进制字面量
patterns.context: 出现在花括号包围、逗号分隔的键值对中，作为代码数据。

patterns.name: 代数变量与系数运算片段
patterns.context: 变量、系数、乘法或幂组成的多项式/方程片段；并非单一变量或运算符能解释全部激活。

en.concept: Prominent terms and numbers in technical text
en.description: Activations cover magnitude terms (especially million), various programming code structures, API documentation about team members, script and web technology terms, and UI loading prompts and typography discussions; trigger conditions span domains, with no unified local syntax.

patterns.name: Large numbers and magnitude text
patterns.context: Numbers or quantities include magnitude terms such as million/billion; often used with descriptions of the scale of users, elements, etc. [1] also involves a numerical rounding issue.
patterns.domain: Math problems, product discussions, business/social media descriptions, news comments

patterns.name: Calls and return statements in code
patterns.context: Method calls, parameters, assignments, or return statements in code snippets; activations are distributed around punctuation, keywords, and code identifiers, without a single fixed syntactic structure.
patterns.domain: Go, C#, Objective-C code and programming Q&A

patterns.name: API documentation for project members and roles
patterns.context: Lists operations related to team members and their functions in sequence, including compound identifiers and permissions/role terminology.

patterns.name: Script and web code terminology
patterns.context: Explains the concept of a scriptlet across platforms and lists scripting languages, components, and web code.

patterns.name: UI loading prompts and typography suggestions
patterns.context: Discusses whether to show a loading prompt in UI design and whether typography/content should be presented online; “Loading…” activates especially strongly.
patterns.domain: Product design discussions, web or interface UX

7_2890.concept: 技术文本中的显著术语与数值
7_2890.description: 激活覆盖数量级词（尤以 million 为主）、多种编程代码结构、团队成员 API 文档、脚本与网页技术术语，以及界面加载提示和排版讨论；触发条件跨领域，未见统一局部句法。

patterns.name: 大数字及数量级文本
patterns.trigger: “one million”前的“million” [1]；“300 million” [5]；“billion”与“25 million” [7]；“70 million”“300 million” [10]
patterns.context: 数字或数量表达中出现 million/billion 等数量级词；常与用户、元素等规模描述连用。[1] 中还出现了数值舍入问题。
patterns.domain: 数学题、产品讨论、商业/社交媒体介绍、新闻评论

patterns.name: 代码中的调用与返回语句
patterns.context: 代码片段中的方法调用、参数、赋值或返回语句；激活分布在标点、关键字和代码标识符附近，并无单一固定语法结构。

patterns.name: 项目成员与角色的 API 文档
patterns.context: 连续列出团队成员相关操作及其功能说明，包含复合标识符和权限/角色术语。

patterns.name: 脚本及网页代码术语
patterns.context: 解释不同平台中的 scriptlet 概念，并列举脚本语言、组件与网页代码。

patterns.name: 界面加载提示与排版建议
patterns.context: 讨论界面设计中是否显示加载提示，以及排版/内容是否应在线呈现；“Loading…”处激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 产品设计讨论、网页或界面 UX

en.concept: Code and identifiers in technical text
en.description: Activations mainly fall on code and its boundaries, paths, and technical identifiers, and also occur in patent-style technical descriptions and programming Q&A; specific topics are varied, including databases, exception logs, user lookup, barcodes, and web hosting.

patterns.name: Code and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across code formatting and syntax boundaries, spanning HTML, Java, Swift, C/C++, and other code; they are not specific to a single language or API.
patterns.domain: Source code, code snippets, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Paths and filenames
patterns.context: Path- or filename-related strings occur in code, comments, or technical descriptions; in [1], activations are especially concentrated on path and extension fragments.
patterns.domain: Software development, code, and technical documentation

patterns.name: Databases and encryption
patterns.context: Descriptions or questions about database encryption, re-encryption, and processing at startup.

patterns.name: Offline folder processing
patterns.context: A patent-style statement describing a folder hierarchy in a client database and offline module flags for messages that must be retained.

patterns.name: Error handling and logs
patterns.context: After an exception is caught, parsing failure information is logged and execution continues.

patterns.name: User lookup and row nodes
patterns.context: A code comment describes local user lookup; separate tree row-node key-value handling code also appears.

patterns.name: User interface and conditional checks
patterns.context: Swift-style cell configuration and string conditional checks.

patterns.name: Barcodes and multimedia access
patterns.context: Patent-style claims describe generating and obtaining a barcode associated with multimedia content.

patterns.name: Free virtual hosting
patterns.context: Explains “unlimited” hosting service promises and recommends free hosting, also mentioning ads.

patterns.name: C/C++ Q&A code

en.description: Activations are scattered across text types, often on words introducing focus or degree (most, main, primary, more, really) and several specific phrases; there are also isolated phenomena such as Portuguese word forms, URL symbols, and pronouns, which cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Main conclusion/focus in comments or posts
patterns.context: Introduces the main point, question, or subsequent focus in an explanation, question, or discussion; activations often fall on focus-marking words.

patterns.name: Emphasis words most / more
patterns.context: In degree or comparative constructions, especially when emphasizing what is most important or prominent, or shifting to a more serious topic.

patterns.name: Help or positive evaluation
patterns.context: Describes a tool or ability as helpful or worthy of praise to the speaker; activation centers on “help”.

patterns.name: Reference/use of the pronoun he
patterns.context: In an account of Windows usage, he refers to the son mentioned earlier; activation falls on “he”.

patterns.name: Portuguese decision-related word form
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence discusses Descartes’s decision; strong activation centers on “decis”.

patterns.name: Symbols and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: A browser extension URL is shown split up, with activations on several punctuation marks and URL substrings.

patterns.name: Uniqueness of code/identifier strings
patterns.context: Discusses generating and validating unique strings to avoid user resource conflicts; activation falls on descriptions of code correctness and conflict avoidance.

patterns.name: Emphasis shifting to blockchain and art commerce
patterns.context: Discusses blockchain tracking the provenance of digital files and protecting transfers, while emphasizing that the project is fundamentally still an art business.

patterns.name: Introducing the main question in technical Q&A
patterns.context: Introduces the question to be answered after describing an encrypted-message workflow.

patterns.name: Windows habits and content already used
patterns.context: Mentions that the son does not know how to use Windows and describes the tools he has actually used.

patterns.name: Most extreme expression in golf satire

patterns.name: Personal qualification in a method-overriding question

patterns.name: Emphasis on how a project is supported
patterns.context: A project description states that its main support channel is a mailing list.

7_2890.concept: 强调重点或程度词
7_2890.description: 激活分散于多类文本，常落在引出重点或程度的词（most、main、primary、more、really）及若干特定短语上；另有葡语词形、URL 符号和代词等孤立现象，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 评论或帖子中的主要结论/重点
patterns.trigger: “the most important thing”“The main questions”“a more serious note”“the primary support”
patterns.context: 在说明、提问或讨论中引出主要观点、问题或后续重点；激活常落在重点标记词上。

patterns.name: 强调词 most / more
patterns.trigger: “most”“more”，如“the most important”“the most insulting”“a more serious note”
patterns.context: 程度或比较结构中，尤其是强调某项最重要、最突出或转向较严肃话题时。

patterns.name: 帮助或积极评价
patterns.context: 描述工具或能力对说话者有帮助、值得肯定；激活集中于“help”。

patterns.name: 代词 he 的指代/使用
patterns.context: Windows 使用情况的叙述中，he 指前文提到的儿子；激活落在“he”。

patterns.name: 葡语决定相关词形
patterns.context: 葡语句子中谈到笛卡尔的决定；强激活集中于“decis”。

patterns.name: URL 中的符号及路径片段
patterns.trigger: “Url -”及“chrome-extension://…/chrome_ex_oauth.html”中的换行、斜线、点号和路径片段
patterns.context: 浏览器扩展 URL 被拆分展示，激活落在多种标点和 URL 子串上。

patterns.name: 代码/标识符字符串的唯一性
patterns.trigger: “globally unique strings”“no user will overwrite another user's image”
patterns.context: 讨论如何生成并验证唯一字符串以避免用户资源冲突；激活落在代码正确性及无冲突的表述上。

patterns.name: 区块链与艺术商业的转折强调

patterns.domain: 区块链与艺术相关说明

patterns.name: 技术问答中的主问题引出
patterns.context: 在描述加密消息流程后引出待回答的问题。

patterns.name: Windows 使用习惯及已用内容
patterns.context: 谈到儿子不懂如何使用 Windows，并说明其实际使用过的工具。

patterns.name: 讽刺高尔夫的最极端表达
patterns.trigger: “the most insulting thing possible in the least characters”
patterns.context: 提出以尽可能少字符写出最侮辱性内容的挑战。

patterns.name: 方法重写问题的个人限定语
patterns.trigger: “i hope the question is sufficiently specific”
patterns.context: 提问者说明问题可能受其他因素影响，并希望问题足够具体。

patterns.name: 项目支持方式的重点说明
patterns.context: 项目介绍中指出其主要支持渠道是邮件列表。

en.concept: less, programming source code, and path fragments
en.description: Activations center on comparative uses of less/Less, C++ compilation and source code, and lib in code paths; they also involve JS module loading, implementation discussions, and kernel driver filenames. These patterns are not obviously unified.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Less for degree comparison
patterns.context: Less/less appears in a comparative or degree expression, followed by than, a noun phrase, or an adjective; capitalization varies.

patterns.name: C/C++ and compiled source code
patterns.context: Programming contexts such as C++, source file extensions, compilation commands, or project directory structures.

patterns.name: lib directory in paths
patterns.context: lib occurs in filesystem paths or filenames; meanings involve Python package directories, JS module paths, and kernel source files.

patterns.name: JavaScript module formats and conditional branches
patterns.context: Uses conditional branches to detect CommonJS/AMD environments and load modules.

patterns.name: Discussion of implementation and its quality/standards
patterns.context: Discusses differences between tutorial examples and implementations that better conform to industry standards.

patterns.name: Digit zero and filename fragments in code
patterns.context: rt2x00 and rt2800 filenames in Linux wireless adapter driver paths; activations center near the patch path.

7_2890.concept: less、编程源码与路径片段
7_2890.description: 激活集中于 less/Less 的比较用法、C++ 编译与源码，以及代码路径中的 lib；另涉及 JS 模块加载、实现讨论和内核驱动文件名。各模式表面上并不统一。

patterns.name: 句首 Less 的程度比较
patterns.trigger: «Less»10（另见 less）：第1段“Less than 12 hours after…”，第2段“Less code, more ‘magic’”，第6段“the less savvy users”
patterns.context: Less/less 出现在比较或程度表达中，后接 than、名词短语或形容词；大小写不同

patterns.name: C/C++ 与编译源码
patterns.context: C++、源文件扩展名、编译命令或项目目录结构等编程上下文

patterns.name: 路径中的 lib 目录
patterns.context: lib 出现在文件系统路径或文件名中；语义分别涉及 Python 包目录、JS 模块路径和内核源码文件

patterns.name: JavaScript 模块格式与条件分支
patterns.context: 以条件分支检测 CommonJS/AMD 环境并加载模块

patterns.name: 提及实现及其质量/标准
patterns.context: 讨论教程示例与更符合行业标准的实现之间的差异

patterns.name: 代码中数字零与文件名片段
patterns.context: Linux 无线网卡驱动路径中的 rt2x00、rt2800 文件名；激活集中在补丁路径附近

en.concept: Local comparative words and technical text fragments
en.description: Activations are relatively prominent in more/less used in comparisons or contrasts, and also cover file paths, module code, command lines, and error logs; there are also scattered everyday words, platform comments, and Markdown markers that cannot be explained uniformly.

patterns.name: more in contrast or elaboration contexts
patterns.context: Used to compare degree, shift to a more serious or general topic, or specify a category of work; activation may fall on more/less or adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, technical descriptions, encyclopedic narrative

patterns.name: Less in negation or correction contexts
patterns.context: In comparative descriptions, less is followed by a quantity or property; strong activation is not limited to more.

patterns.name: Paths and library filenames
patterns.context: Multiple path fragments and filenames activate in slash-separated filesystem paths, shared library names, or code module paths.

patterns.name: Commands, options, and repeated execution
patterns.context: When explaining how to repeatedly run a compilation command, command-related words and command-line syntax fragments activate.

patterns.name: Short words/word fragments in informal text
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across everyday phrases, word fragments, and neighboring function words, without stable shared contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Conditional code module definition
patterns.context: Multiple code tokens activate when loading and defining a module in a CommonJS/AMD branch; this may neighbor the path pattern but has a more specific trigger condition.

patterns.name: Error logs and stack paths
patterns.context: When log filenames, configuration file locations, and stack output occur in sequence, error identifiers and path components activate.

patterns.name: Social platforms and comment contexts
patterns.context: Activations occur in comment text mentioning Reddit posts and platform rules, without a stable, specific semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Text markers and code fences
patterns.context: A few activations occur near Markdown fences or line breaks in forum content, possibly an incidental formatting pattern.

7_2890.concept: 局部比较词与技术文本片段
7_2890.description: 激活较明显地出现在比较或转折中的 more/less，也覆盖文件路径、模块代码、命令行及错误日志；另有零散日常词、平台评论和 Markdown 标记，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 对比、补充语境中的 more
patterns.context: 用于比较程度、转向较严肃或较一般的话题，或限定作品类别；激活点可能落在 more/less 或相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、技术说明、百科叙述

patterns.name: 否定或纠正语境中的 Less
patterns.context: 比较性描述中 less 后接数量或性质，强激活并不局限于 more。

patterns.name: 路径及库文件名
patterns.context: 斜杠分隔的文件系统路径、共享库名或代码模块路径中，路径片段及文件名多个 token 均激活。

patterns.name: 命令、选项及重复执行
patterns.context: 说明如何重复执行编译命令时，命令相关词和命令行语法片段激活。

patterns.name: 非正式文本中的短词/词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在日常短语、词语片段和邻近功能词上，未见稳定的共同上下文条件。

patterns.name: 条件式代码模块定义
patterns.context: CommonJS/AMD 分支中加载并定义模块时，多个代码 token 激活；可能与路径模式相邻但触发条件更具体。

patterns.name: 错误日志与堆栈路径
patterns.context: 日志文件名、配置文件位置和堆栈输出连续出现时，错误标识及路径组件激活。

patterns.name: 社交平台与评论语境
patterns.context: 提及 Reddit 帖子及平台规则的评论文字中出现激活，未显示稳定的特定语义触发词。

patterns.name: 文本标记与代码围栏
patterns.context: 论坛内容中的 Markdown 围栏或换行附近有少量激活，可能是格式相关的偶发模式。

en.concept: Local word forms and technical text fragments
en.description: Activation cues are scattered: degree or extension expressions such as English less/more, Unix path fragments, and code words in technical text; also includes multilingual subword fragments and a few fixed expressions, with no single semantic explanation.

patterns.name: “less” and its following word forms
patterns.context: Appears when comparing or describing degree; activation falls on less or adjacent word-form fragments. [7] also contains s’mores, possibly due to local substring overlap.
patterns.domain: Technical discussion, spam-link discussion, everyday narration

patterns.name: Path separators and system library paths
patterns.context: Appears in Unix-like file paths or shared-library paths, often adjacent to directory names, architecture names, or version numbers.
patterns.domain: Command-line build logs, Linux debugging logs

patterns.name: Code, encryption, and file I/O
patterns.context: Technical discussions listing required functionality or discussing how much code to write; there is no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: Generic stuff for complex things
patterns.context: Describes the complexity of tasks or content, from simple to complex; in [8], more involved stuff is associated with UI improvements.

patterns.name: more in generalizing expressions
patterns.context: Used to introduce a more general description or elaboration, such as «more generically»; the trigger may relate to degree-comparison uses in other segments.

patterns.name: Multilingual subword fragments
patterns.context: Fragments fall inside Portuguese or Hungarian words split by tokenization, with no clear semantic link to English patterns.

patterns.name: Emphasis about a difficult experience
patterns.context: English narration uses “learned this the hard way” to express learning from experience.

7_2890.concept: 局部词形与技术文本片段
7_2890.description: 激活线索分散：英语中的 less/more 等程度或扩展表达、Unix 路径片段，以及技术文本中的代码词语；另有多语言词内片段和少数固定表达，无法归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: “less”及其后续词形
patterns.context: 在比较或描述程度时出现；激活落在 less 或相邻的词形片段上。 [7] 中还出现 s’mores，可能是局部子串重合。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、垃圾链接讨论、日常叙述

patterns.name: 路径分隔符与系统库路径
patterns.context: 出现在 Unix 类文件路径或共享库路径中，常与目录名、架构名、版本号相邻。
patterns.domain: 命令行构建日志、Linux 调试日志

patterns.name: 代码、加密与文件 I/O
patterns.context: 技术讨论中列举实现所需功能，或谈论要编写的代码量；没有单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 泛指复杂事物的 stuff
patterns.context: 描述任务或内容从简单到复杂的程度；[8] 中 more involved stuff 与 UI 改进相连。

patterns.name: 泛化表达中的 more
patterns.context: 用于引出更一般的描述或扩展说明，如 «more generically»；触发可能与其他段的程度比较用法有关。

patterns.name: 多语言词内子词片段

patterns.context: 片段落在被分词切开的葡萄牙语或匈牙利语词内部，未见与英语模式相连的明确语义。

patterns.name: 难点经历的强调表达
patterns.context: 英语叙述中用 “learned this the hard way” 表达从经验中吸取教训。

en.description: Activations are scattered across technical code, paths and logs, compiler names, forum text containing more, and diff addition markers; no unified semantics or stable lexical pattern explains all fragments.

patterns.name: The letter r in code, commands, or paths

patterns.name: more in more/generalizing contexts

patterns.name: Plus signs in diff patch markers
patterns.context: Appears in added-line markers in source-code diffs, near file paths and patch context

7_2890.concept: none

patterns.name: 代码、命令或路径中的字母 r

patterns.name: more 的 more/泛化语境

patterns.name: diff 补丁标记中的加号

en.concept: Heterogeneous word fragments and technical markers
en.description: Activations do not follow a single semantic pattern: they include English more in comparative/contrastive phrases, fragments within Swedish huvud and Portuguese cuidado and necessário, and C++/Android code identifiers, filenames, and compiler names; all come from forum, parliamentary, or technical text.

patterns.name: The contrastive expression more serious note
patterns.context: In English forum posts, a fixed expression introduces a more serious or earnest additional point; high activation is concentrated on more.

patterns.name: Comparative structures with rather than / more than
patterns.context: An English question compares a choice with a more conventional platform; activation falls on more.

patterns.name: Swedish huvud word forms
patterns.context: The Swedish word huvud (“main/head”) and the internal fragment in the compound huvudskälet; both occur in relatively formal sentences.

patterns.name: Portuguese cuidado word form
patterns.context: An internal fragment of cuidado (care, caution) appears in Portuguese prose discussing Descartes’s approach.

patterns.name: Portuguese necessário word form
patterns.context: The word for necessary appears in a formal parliamentary statement about following up on a matter.

patterns.name: C++ filenames and preprocessor directives
patterns.context: C++ source filenames and markers such as pragma once and include appear in code or project file lists; activation also involves line breaks in code.

patterns.name: Android API identifiers
patterns.context: Member access and API calls in Java/Android code, including external storage directories and video fullscreen controls.

patterns.name: GCC/Clang version notes
patterns.context: Project introductions or technical lists mention compilers and version support.

7_2890.concept: 异质词片段与技术标记
7_2890.description: 激活并非单一语义模式：包括英语 more 的比较/转折短语、瑞典语 huvud、葡萄牙语 cuidado 与 necessário 等词内片段，以及 C++/Android 代码标识符、文件名和编译器名称；均来自论坛、议会或技术文本。

patterns.name: more serious note 转折表达
patterns.context: 英文论坛帖子中，以固定表达引出较严肃或认真的补充意见；高激活集中在 more。

patterns.name: rather than / more than 比较结构
patterns.trigger: « rather»6 than learning« on»4« a»3« more»10
patterns.context: 英文问句比较某种选择与更常规的平台；激活落在 more。

patterns.name: 瑞典语 huvud 词形
patterns.context: 瑞典语词 huvud（“主要/头部”）及复合词 huvudskälet 的词内片段；两处均在较正式的句子中。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 cuidado 词形

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 necessário 词形

patterns.name: C++ 文件名与预处理指令

patterns.name: C++ 编译与标准库
patterns.context: 出现在编译命令、编译器比较、标准库实现或 C++ 模板/头文件相关文本中
patterns.domain: C++ 编程问答、代码与技术讨论

patterns.name: Python、Spark 与扩展构建痕迹
patterns.context: Python 堆栈路径、Spark 代码或 Cython/NumPy 构建脚本；常与 C/C++ 工具链交界
patterns.domain: 编程问答、错误日志与构建代码

patterns.name: 错误日志中的系统路径
patterns.context: 异常回溯或模板实例化错误中出现 Unix 系统路径
patterns.domain: 编译器/运行时诊断日志

patterns.name: 非英语词形中的 port 子串
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中的普通词内部子串，无明显编程语境

en.concept: Code, command lines, and script formatting
en.description: Primarily responds to multiline code and command-line formatting, especially Unix shebangs with /usr/bin/env and Clang compilation commands and options; also includes scattered technical code markers and forum Q&A words. Some segments are difficult to group under a unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Shebang paths
patterns.context: Unix shebangs at the start of scripts, especially /usr/bin/env followed by an interpreter name; punctuation, slashes, and path fragments also activate.
patterns.domain: Shell, Python, and Perl scripts and code Q&A

patterns.name: Clang compiler commands
patterns.context: Compiler names, options, and arguments in Clang compilation or test commands, commonly found in RUN comments.

patterns.name: Code blocks and command-line formatting
patterns.context: Code or terminal commands embedded in text as multiline snippets; activation covers scripts, code examples, and test commands, not just one language.
patterns.domain: Technical forums, Q&A, and code repositories

patterns.name: Scattered markers in technical code discussions
patterns.context: Code, compiler, and language markers in technical Q&A or discussions; beyond code formatting, specific triggers are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: C++, compiler, concurrency, Perl, and C# technical discussions

patterns.name: Natural-language and conversational fragments
patterns.context: Isolated natural-language words in forum or Q&A text, with no stable semantic or lexical commonality.

7_2890.concept: 代码命令行与脚本格式
7_2890.description: 主要响应代码和命令行的多行格式，尤其 Unix shebang 的 /usr/bin/env 与 Clang 编译命令及选项；另有零散技术代码标记、论坛问答词语，部分段落难归入统一触发模式。

patterns.name: Shebang 路径
patterns.context: 脚本开头的 Unix shebang，尤其是 /usr/bin/env 后跟解释器名称；标点、斜杠和路径片段也有激活。

patterns.name: Clang 编译器命令
patterns.context: Clang 编译或测试命令中的编译器名称、选项及参数，常见于 RUN 注释。
patterns.domain: GitHub C/C++ 编译测试配置

patterns.name: 代码块与命令行格式
patterns.trigger: «↵↵»、缩进空行、«#»、«!/»、«-»及命令/代码行的结构性片段
patterns.context: 代码或终端命令以多行片段嵌在文本中；激活覆盖脚本、代码示例与测试命令，不局限于某一种语言。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛、问答及代码仓库

patterns.name: 技术代码讨论中的零散标记
patterns.context: 技术问答或讨论中的代码、编译器和语言标记；除代码排版外，具体触发词并不一致。
patterns.domain: C++、编译器、并发、Perl及C#技术讨论

patterns.name: 自然语言与对话片段
patterns.context: 论坛或问答正文中的零星自然语言词语，未显示稳定的语义或词汇共性。

en.concept: Compilation, builds, and technical text fragments
en.description: Activations often occur in compilation and build commands and their code/paths; also responds to the Russian “пом...” fragment, semicolon-smiley endings, code keywords, runtime warnings, and codebase discussions, without a fully unified pattern.

patterns.name: Compilation, builds, and toolchains
patterns.context: Discussion of compiler options, compilation commands, build scripts, extension-module builds, or Java target platforms; some triggers occur in marked code or commands.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, developer discussions, and code

patterns.name: Unix paths and executable script headers
patterns.context: Unix-style paths in commands, file paths, or shebangs; often occurs alongside compilation and build content, but also appears in Python scripts.
patterns.domain: Shell, C/C++, Python code, and command lines

patterns.name: Punctuation and emoticons
patterns.context: A semicolon followed by a smiley at the end of a sentence or paragraph; activation centers on punctuation and the emoticon rather than an obvious compilation term.

patterns.name: pom fragment in Russian text
patterns.context: The continuous internal word fragment “пом...” appears in Russian sentences; [6] discusses pom.xml, [7] mentions Axios, and [9] asks for help with a Python generator, with differing semantics.

patterns.name: Code keywords and program fragments
patterns.context: Language keywords, library calls, or import statements occur in code blocks or program fragments; they need not relate to compilation.

patterns.name: Debugging, warnings, and runtime behavior
patterns.context: Discussion of program failures, whether user messages are output, and warnings; compilation commands are not clearly the central topic.

patterns.name: Script organization and project reuse
patterns.context: Discussion of project scripts and build steps, or codebase design and feature reuse; the semantic connection between the two is limited.

7_2890.concept: 编译构建与技术文本片段
7_2890.description: 激活常出现在编译、构建命令及其代码/路径中；也响应俄语“пом...”词片段、句末分号笑脸、代码关键字，以及运行时警告和代码库讨论，模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 编译、构建与工具链
patterns.context: 讨论编译器选项、编译命令、构建脚本、扩展模块构建或 Java 目标平台；有的触发词在标记代码或命令中。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、开发者讨论与代码

patterns.name: Unix 路径与可执行脚本头
patterns.context: 命令、文件路径或 shebang 中出现 Unix 风格路径；与编译和构建内容常同时出现，但也出现在 Python 脚本中。

patterns.name: 标点与表情符号
patterns.context: 句末或段落收尾处出现分号加笑脸表情；激活集中在标点和表情，而非明显的编译词。

patterns.name: 俄语文本中的 pom 词片段
patterns.context: 俄语句子中出现“пом...”这一连续词内片段；[6]讨论 pom.xml，[7]提 Axios，[9]是 Python 生成器求助，语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 代码关键字与程序片段
patterns.context: 代码块或程序片段中出现语言关键字、库调用或导入语句；不要求与编译主题相关。

patterns.name: 调试、警告与运行时行为
patterns.context: 讨论程序运行失败、是否输出用户消息及警告；未见明显构建命令是主题中心。
patterns.domain: 软件兼容性与故障讨论

patterns.name: 脚本组织与项目复用
patterns.context: 谈项目脚本及构建步骤，或代码库设计与功能复用；两类语义相关性有限。

en.description: Activations are scattered across software code, build configurations, version installation, technical discussions, and ordinary text. Local patterns include C++ standard markers, Rake/Maven terminology, software component names, negative contractions, and chat emoticons, but no single stable feature covers them all.

patterns.name: C++ standard-version markers
patterns.context: C++ standard versions in compiler commands or C++ header paths

patterns.name: Maven build-directory properties
patterns.context: Maven XML properties and build configuration, including directory names or version strings

patterns.name: Rake task paths and loading
patterns.context: Describes the placement and loading of task files in Rails/Rake projects

patterns.name: Mercurial package installation and versions
patterns.context: Asks how to use apt to install a version newer than the one currently in the repository

patterns.name: Colon followed by an emoticon
patterns.context: A colon introduces a text emoticon at the end of a sentence or in chat messages

patterns.name: Frontend/component terminology in program identifiers
patterns.context: Technical discussions mention software components, objects, or UI elements; trigger locations and semantics are not fully consistent

patterns.name: The negative contraction n't
patterns.context: An English sentence contains a negative contraction; there is also local activation on words following an apostrophe

patterns.name: Sequences of comparison/contrast words
patterns.context: Sentence contrasts, explanations of causes, or introductions to follow-up questions; activations are sparse, with no unified structure

patterns.name: Isolated C++ code symbols and path fragments

patterns.domain: StackExchange C++ code and error output

patterns.name: Isolated novel dialogue and narration fragments
patterns.context: Character dialogue and narration, with no stable technical or proper-name pattern

patterns.name: Isolated software reuse and concurrency explanations
patterns.context: Explains compiler object state and multithreaded reuse limitations

patterns.name: C++ 标准版本标记

patterns.name: 连续否定词 n't

patterns.name: 多次比较/转折词序列
patterns.context: 句子对比、解释原因或引出后续问题；激活分布稀疏，未见统一结构

patterns.domain: StackExchange C++ 代码与错误输出

patterns.name: 独立的小说对话与叙述片段
patterns.context: 人物谈话及叙述，未显示稳定技术或专名模式

patterns.name: 独立的软件复用与并发说明
patterns.context: 说明编译器对象状态及多线程复用限制

en.description: Activations are distributed across C/C++ code and compilation/debugging text, and also often occur near line boundaries, delimiters, terminal punctuation, and emoticons in forum comments and IRC messages; English lexical items are scattered, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: C/C++ code and compilation syntax
patterns.context: Code, command-line compiler arguments, debugger output, or code examples in technical discussions; activation often falls on punctuation, keywords, and subwords in compiler options.

patterns.name: Emoticons and terminal punctuation in forum text
patterns.context: Activations occur at emoticons and surrounding punctuation, line breaks, and reply separators at the ends of forum or chat messages.

patterns.name: Forum reply separators and signatures
patterns.context: At the ends of HackerNews comments, signatures, quotations, or comment separators; sometimes appears with emoticons.

patterns.name: Real-time reply contexts in chat
patterns.context: When IRC discusses waiting for answers, response speed, or conversational turns, activation falls on reply-related words and message boundaries.

patterns.name: Local high-frequency words and punctuation in ordinary English
patterns.context: In English forum narration or comments, triggers are scattered across common words, terminal punctuation, and nearby emoticons, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation in code snippets
patterns.context: Occurs at line boundaries and indentation in multiline code, terminal output, or formatted text; overlaps with code syntax and forum boundary markers.

7_2890.concept: 代码与论坛文本边界
7_2890.description: 激活分布在C/C++代码及编译/调试文本中，也常出现在论坛评论、IRC消息的行边界、分隔符、结尾标点和表情附近；英文词项较零散，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: C/C++代码与编译语法
patterns.context: 代码、命令行编译参数、调试器输出或技术讨论中的代码示例；激活常落在标点、关键字和编译选项的子词上。

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的表情与结尾标点
patterns.context: 论坛或聊天消息末尾，表情符号及其前后标点、换行和回复分隔符处激活。

patterns.name: 论坛回复分隔符与署名
patterns.trigger: «~~~»、«------»、«↵»及其附近的用户名或回复尾部
patterns.context: HackerNews评论的结尾、署名、引用或评论分隔处；有时与表情同时出现。

patterns.name: 聊天中的即时回复语境
patterns.context: IRC中讨论等待回答、回复速度或对话轮次时，激活落在回复相关词和消息边界。

patterns.name: 普通英文中的局部高频词与标点
patterns.context: 英文论坛叙述或评论中，触发分散在常见词、句末标点和表情附近，缺少一致的语义条件。

patterns.name: 代码片段中的换行与缩进
patterns.context: 多行代码、终端输出或格式化文本的行边界和缩进处出现；与代码语法及论坛边界标记交叠。

en.description: Primarily responds to C/C++ compilation and build text, especially compiler options introduced by hyphens and -O optimization levels; also covers macro definitions, Makefiles, Clang test commands, Objective-C methods and initialization code, and adjacent C/C++ code and terminal examples.

patterns.name: Compiler optimization options
patterns.context: Part of GCC/Clang compilation commands, followed by an optimization level; the level varies by example or configuration.
patterns.domain: C/C++ compilation commands, build scripts, container configurations

patterns.name: Option separators in compiler commands
patterns.context: A hyphen introduces compiler arguments on the command line; commonly adjacent to gcc/g++/clang commands and argument values.
patterns.domain: C/C++ command lines and build configurations

patterns.name: Objective-C methods and control-flow markers
patterns.context: Near method declarations or implementations in Objective-C code, method signatures, class implementation markers, and conditional branches.

patterns.name: C++ code and language-standard markers
patterns.context: Discusses or shows C++ range-for loops, forwarding references, compilers, and standard options; code and compilation notes occur together.
patterns.domain: C++ technical discussions and command lines

patterns.name: Ordinary C functions and compilation examples
patterns.context: A short C program snippet followed by a terminal compilation command or program output.

patterns.name: Preprocessor macro-definition options
patterns.context: The -D option in gcc defines a preprocessor macro; one example substitutes character spelling, another enables GNU extensions.

patterns.name: Shell variable assignment and command substitution
patterns.context: A Makefile calls pkg-config through the shell and sets or appends variable values.

patterns.name: Clang container run directives
patterns.context: Test-run instructions given as comments, including the Clang internal compiler, optimization options, input placeholders, and target triple.

patterns.name: Objective-C initialization and object allocation
patterns.context: An Objective-C initializer allocates and initializes an object, or checks the result of self initialization.

patterns.name: Shell prompts and filename fragments
patterns.context: A gcc command runs after a terminal prompt, with a short filename or number present.

7_2890.concept: 编译与构建代码
7_2890.description: 主要响应 C/C++ 编译构建文本，尤其连字符引出的编译器选项及 -O 优化级别；也覆盖宏定义、Makefile、Clang 测试命令、Objective-C 方法与初始化代码，以及相邻的 C/C++ 代码和终端示例。

patterns.name: 编译器优化选项
patterns.context: 作为 GCC/Clang 编译命令的一部分，后接优化级别；级别可能因示例或配置而异。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 编译命令、构建脚本、容器配置

patterns.name: 编译命令中的选项分隔符
patterns.context: 命令行中以连字符引出编译器参数；常与 gcc/g++/clang 命令及参数值相邻。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 命令行和构建配置

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法与控制流标记
patterns.context: Objective-C 方法声明或实现代码中，方法签名、类实现标记及条件分支附近。

patterns.name: C++ 代码与语言标准标记
patterns.context: 讨论或展示 C++ 范围 for、转发引用、编译器及标准选项；同时出现代码和编译说明。
patterns.domain: C++ 技术讨论与命令行

patterns.name: 普通 C 函数与编译示例
patterns.context: 短小 C 程序片段后接终端编译命令或程序输出。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 C 编程示例

patterns.name: 预处理宏定义选项
patterns.context: gcc 参数用 -D 定义预处理宏；一例用于替换字符拼写，另一例用于启用 GNU 扩展。

patterns.name: shell 变量赋值与命令替换
patterns.context: Makefile 中通过 shell 调用 pkg-config 并设置或追加变量值。

patterns.name: Clang 容器运行指令
patterns.context: 以注释形式给出的测试运行指令，包含 Clang 内部编译器、优化选项、输入占位符及目标三元组。

patterns.name: Objective-C 初始化与对象分配
patterns.context: Objective-C 初始化器中分配并初始化对象，或检查 self 初始化结果。

patterns.name: shell 提示符与文件名片段
patterns.context: 终端提示符后运行 gcc 命令，并出现短文件名或编号。

en.description: Primarily responds to C/C++ and Objective-C programming and compilation contexts, especially gcc/clang commands and -O, -D, and -std options; also covers Makefiles, compiler tests, terminal examples, and some code-Q&A text.

patterns.name: -O in compiler options

patterns.name: -D in compiler options

patterns.name: gcc commands and compilation

patterns.name: C/C++ source code and syntax examples
patterns.context: C/C++/Objective-C declarations, loops, method definitions, and other constructs appear in code or snippets; exact activation locations are inconsistent
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code repositories, compiler discussions

patterns.name: pkg-config and compilation variables in Makefiles
patterns.context: Makefile variable assignments and shell command substitution use pkg-config to query library information and set compiler flags

patterns.name: Natural-language compile
patterns.context: English explanations discuss how to compile code or describe compiler options; activation centers on compile and nearby command text

patterns.name: fray in a Silverlight question
patterns.context: An informal first-person post describes being new to Silverlight and being thrown directly into a complex task

patterns.name: The -std=c++1z command-line option
patterns.context: A specific standard option appears in an explanation of gcc support for C++ standards

patterns.name: printf and port examples in a terminal
patterns.context: A shell session shows a short C program and its output

patterns.name: clang test-run directive
patterns.context: A RUN comment in a source test file contains a clang invocation and target architecture arguments

patterns.name: Objective-C method initialization code
patterns.context: An Objective-C initializer calls self's init and checks the assignment result

patterns.name: Objective-C animation method and class check
patterns.context: Implements an animation-addition method and checks the animation object's class or type

patterns.name: Frama-C analyzer command
patterns.context: Explains a command for running a static analyzer and shows its resulting gcc preprocessing invocation

patterns.name: gcc 命令与编译过程
patterns.context: 出现 gcc 编译命令、编译器说明或其参数；激活也落在周边命令文本上
patterns.domain: C/C++ 编译、终端示例、构建文档

patterns.name: C/C++ 源码与语法示例
