en.description: Activations are scattered across local fragments such as proper-name segmentation, NB identifiers, months, humid, numbers, and common function words. They span domains and vary widely by context; some patterns occur only once or twice.

patterns.name: Split fragments and case boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Fragments occur in proper names, organization names, identifiers, or comments; common cases include splits within words, case boundaries, or punctuated abbreviations.

patterns.name: Month or duration unit months
patterns.context: The noun months appears in phrases about durations or elapsed time; once in parentheses and once in a news headline.

patterns.name: humid and related word forms
patterns.context: When describing cultivation environments or climate, humid appears as an adjective or as the stem of humidified.

patterns.name: Numbers, years, identifiers, or statistics
patterns.context: Numbers occur within years, sample sizes, durations, or numeric constants in code; activation positions vary.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase continuation
patterns.context: Prepositions, articles, and common phrase components in general prose or technical explanations; trigger words are scattered, with no stable collocations observed.

patterns.name: NB identifiers and component class names in code
patterns.context: NB occurs in CSS class names or platform constants in Angular/UI code, near mixed hyphens, underscores, and capitalization.

patterns.name: Named astronomical event titles
patterns.context: Encyclopedia entry titles consist of a year followed by an event name; activation concentrates on the year fragment and Great.

patterns.name: Equals signs and line continuation in option descriptions
patterns.context: Option definitions in email wrap across lines due to formatting, with equals signs adjacent to numbers and continuation text.

patterns.name: NB in cryptography code comments
patterns.context: NB is used as a cue in code comments introducing an explanation of the initialization vector.

7_2896.description: 激活分散在专名切分、NB 标识符、months、humid、数字及普通功能词等局部片段；跨领域且上下文差异大，部分模式仅见一两次。

patterns.name: 专名中的切分片段与大小写边界
patterns.context: 片段落在专名、机构名、标识符或注释中；常见于词内部切分、大小写边界或带标点的缩写。

patterns.name: 月份或时长单位 months
patterns.context: 月份名词出现在时间长度或经过时间的短语中；一次在括号内，一次在新闻标题中。

patterns.name: humid 及其词形延续
patterns.context: 描述培养环境或气候时，humid 作为形容词或 humidified 的词干出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法、地理气候条目

patterns.name: 数值与年份、编号或统计量
patterns.context: 数字嵌在年份、样本数、时间长度或代码中的数值常量里；激活位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、邮件、新闻

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语续接
patterns.context: 普通散文或专业说明中的介词、冠词及常见短语成分；触发词分散，未见稳定固定搭配。

patterns.name: 代码中的 NB 标识符及组件类名
patterns.context: NB 出现在 Angular/界面代码的 CSS 类名或平台常量中，附近有连字符、下划线和大小写混排。

patterns.name: 有名天文事件标题
patterns.context: 百科条目标题以年份加事件名称构成；激活集中在年份片段及 Great。

patterns.name: 期权说明中的等号和行续接
patterns.context: 邮件中期权定义因格式换行，等号与数字、续行文字相邻。

patterns.name: 密码学代码注释中的 NB
patterns.context: NB 作为代码注释中的提示语，引出初始化向量说明。

en.description: Primarily responds to year or date fields beginning with «19», covering multiple types of encyclopedia titles and one legal citation; there are also isolated activations in the segmented proper name Imam Sadiq University and at a period in a sentence about the European single market.

patterns.name: Years or dates beginning with 19
patterns.context: Trigger point is the year prefix represented by token «19»; following digits often form years or dates such as 1906, 1907, 1913, 1922, 1915, and 1927. These often occur in titles, entry openings, or date fields.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry titles and legal citations

patterns.name: Segmented spelling of Adiaq
patterns.context: Activates in subword fragments of the proper name Imām Ṣādiq University; character boundaries do not align with ordinary word boundaries. Occurs alongside a blank line after the title and the beginning of the body text.

patterns.name: Single Market phrase
patterns.context: Activation falls on a period token, immediately followed by text about the European single market and parentheses; distinct from the date-prefix pattern.

7_2896.concept: 以19开头的日期字段为主
7_2896.description: 主要对以 «19» 开头的年份或日期字段起反应，涵盖多类百科标题及一处法律引文；另有伊玛目萨迪克大学专名分词和欧洲单一市场句点处的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 以 19 开头的年份或日期
patterns.context: 触发点是以 token «19» 表示的年份前缀，后续数字常组成 1906、1907、1913、1922、1915、1927 等年份或日期；常出现在标题、条目开头或日期字段。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题及法律引文

patterns.name: Adiaq 的分词拼写
patterns.context: 在专名 Imām Ṣādiq University 的词片段中激活，字符边界与常规词界不一致；伴随标题后的空行和正文开头。

patterns.name: 单一市场短语
patterns.context: 激活落在句点 token，且该处紧接欧洲单一市场相关表述与括号；与日期前缀模式不同。

en.description: Activations are heterogeneous: they often fall on analytical and its surrounding academic context, and also occur in within-word fragments, parenthetical abbreviations, formulas, math problems, and medical phrases. Some subword fragments or physics-paper triggers lack a common explanation.

patterns.name: Words related to analytical forms
patterns.context: Occurs when discussing whether a function can be given in analytical form, an analytical expansion, or analytical research as opposed to numerical studies.

patterns.name: Within-word subwords and segmentation boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal word fragments or within-word portions spanning tokens rather than complete words; contexts vary, with no unified semantic condition observed.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedia titles, medical abstracts, and physics texts

patterns.name: Military blast-injury phrase
patterns.context: In medical research abstracts about military service and related hearing loss.

patterns.name: Ordinal and minimum-value problem
patterns.context: Asks for the third-smallest value in a set of numbers; a short math problem.

patterns.name: Parenthetical abbreviation in an encyclopedia title
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry title is followed by a parenthetical location or abbreviation, then a line break and the start of the body text.

patterns.name: Detection and screening language
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes a rapid method for detecting bacteriuria for screening; high activation falls on a subword fragment of screening.

patterns.name: Other mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical or physics formulas, subscripted variables, function expressions, and formula fragments after line breaks; these symbols do not appear to share a unified meaning.

7_2896.description: 激活模式较杂：多次落在 analytical 及其相邻学术语境，也出现在词内片段、括号缩写、公式、数学题和医学短语中。部分分词片段或物理文献触发缺少共同解释。

patterns.name: 分析形式相关词
patterns.context: 出现在讨论函数能否以解析形式给出、解析展开，或与数值研究相对的分析研究时。

patterns.name: 词内子词与分词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在词的内部片段或跨 token 的词内部分，而不是完整单词；各段上下文不同，未见统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科标题、医学摘要、物理文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 军事爆炸伤害短语
patterns.context: 在关于军旅经历及其相关听力损失的医学研究摘要中。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、军事医学

patterns.name: 序数与最小值问题
patterns.context: 询问一组数中的第三小值，属于简短数学题。

patterns.name: 百科标题中的括号缩写
patterns.context: 百科条目标题后紧跟括号内地点或缩写，随后换行并开始正文。

patterns.name: 检测与筛查措辞
patterns.context: 医学摘要描述快速方法用于检测菌尿，并以筛查为目的；高激活落在 screening 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 其他数学符号及公式片段
patterns.context: 在数学或物理公式、下标变量、函数表达式及换行后的公式片段中出现；未显示这些符号本身有统一语义。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various technical texts, often falling on “each” and contexts involving item-by-item processing, measurement, or response. They also involve medical terminology, patent geometry, and isolated within-word fragments; these features do not explain all passages.

patterns.name: Item-by-item / each object
patterns.context: Sentences describe processing, calculating, aligning, or measuring each object, reaction, time interval, or measurement item in turn; however, the specific meanings around each differ across several passages.

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology or morphological fragments
patterns.context: Specialized terms occur in medical, life-science, or anatomy-related texts; some activations fall on within-word subword fragments, with no confirmed common terminology feature.
patterns.domain: PubMed, NIH, Wikipedia, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Hospital resources and service provision
patterns.context: Discusses inpatient facility resource use, staff incentives, hospital financing, and the volume of medical services provided by each hospital.

patterns.name: Social science fields and knowledge contributions
patterns.context: Lists contributions from multiple disciplines to the body of knowledge on an issue; high activation falls on each, with discipline names in context.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, social science/mental health research

patterns.name: Structural components and geometric alignment
patterns.context: Describes components of toothed structures, radial arrangement, and alignment between tips and bases.

patterns.name: Point-by-point plotting and measurement
patterns.context: Calls for plotting points, lines, and angles individually and measuring them for comparison with standard values.

patterns.name: Quantitative scale with citation markers
patterns.context: Discusses the microsecond scale of protein motion and includes literature citation markers; activation may be related to adjacent symbols or numeric formatting.

patterns.name: French title/proper name
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry title or proper name with a line break; its semantic connection to other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: Statement of concurrent conditions
patterns.context: Begins with “Concurrent with” to introduce a condition occurring alongside a trend.

patterns.name: Biochemical reaction steps
patterns.context: Examines the enzymatic reactions required at each step of bile acid conjugation.

patterns.name: Limits on detecting protein motion
patterns.context: Explains that fluorescence correlation methods cannot detect very slow or immobile proteins, but can measure faster motion.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于多种专业文本，常落在“each”及逐项处理、测量或反应语境，也涉及医学术语、专利几何结构和孤立词内片段；这些特征不足以解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 逐项/每个对象
patterns.context: 句子描述对每个对象、反应、时间区间或测量项目逐一处理、计算、对齐或测量；但若干段的 each 周围具体语义不同。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 生物医学术语或构词片段
patterns.context: 医学、生命科学或解剖相关文本中出现专业术语；有些激活落在词内子词片段上，无法确认一个共同术语特征。

patterns.name: 医院资源与服务供给
patterns.context: 讨论住院机构资源利用、人员激励、医院融资及每家医院提供的医疗服务量。

patterns.name: 社会科学领域及知识贡献
patterns.context: 列举多个学科对某议题知识体系的贡献；高强度落在 each，且上下文包含学科名称。
patterns.domain: NIH项目说明、社会科学/心理健康研究

patterns.name: 结构部件与几何对齐
patterns.context: 描述带齿构件的部件、径向布置和尖端与基部的对齐关系。

patterns.name: 逐点绘图与测量
patterns.context: 要求逐一绘制点、线、角并测量，以便与标准值比较。

patterns.name: 带引文标记的定量尺度
patterns.context: 讨论蛋白运动速度的微秒尺度，并夹有文献引用标记；激活分布可能与相邻符号或数值格式有关。

patterns.name: 法语标题/专名
patterns.context: 百科条目标题或专名，含换行；与其他段落的语义联系不明显。

patterns.name: 并发状况陈述
patterns.context: 句首以“Concurrent with”引入与某趋势同时发生的情况。

patterns.name: 生物化学反应步骤
patterns.context: 研究胆汁酸结合过程，逐项分析所需酶促反应。

patterns.name: 蛋白质运动检测限制
patterns.context: 说明荧光相关方法无法检测极慢或不动蛋白，但可测量较快运动。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code conditionals and SQL, LaTeX formulas, set definitions, dark matter discussions, and network science prose. A visible common feature is structured symbols, terminology, or syntax in technical text, but there is no single stable thematic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Conditionals and parentheses in code
patterns.context: Activation falls near conditionals, function calls, and nested parentheses in program code, especially repeated if/eq structures.

patterns.name: LaTeX structure in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical expressions and adjacent prose, covering different topics such as piecewise mapping definitions, radial equation transformations, measurement vectors, and integral expressions.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and theoretical science papers

patterns.name: SQL keywords and statements
patterns.context: Around column names, window functions, subqueries, and deletion operations in SQL statements.

patterns.name: Astrophysical abbreviations and units
patterns.context: Dark matter density values and related particle discussions, accompanied by citation markers and physical units.

patterns.name: Set and topology definition terminology
patterns.context: States properties such as a set belonging to a family of sets and closure under unions and intersections.
patterns.domain: PhilPapers philosophy of mathematics/topology definition texts

patterns.name: Network power laws and examples
patterns.context: Introduces power-law distributions in real-world networks and gives examples of technological, biological, or social networks.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于代码条件与 SQL、LaTeX 数学公式、集合定义、暗物质讨论和网络科学正文；共同可见特征是技术文本中的结构化符号、术语或语法，但没有单一稳定的主题触发模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的条件与括号
patterns.context: 激活落在程序代码里的条件判断、函数调用和嵌套括号附近，尤其是重复的 if/eq 结构。

patterns.name: 数学公式的 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 出现在展示数学表达式及其邻接正文中；覆盖映射分段定义、径向方程变换、测量向量和积分表达式等不同内容。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论科学论文

patterns.name: SQL 查询关键字与语句
patterns.trigger: “Row_Number() Over ( Partition By Name Order By Id )”, “From Table”, “Delete Table”, “Where Id In ( Select Id From Dups”
patterns.context: SQL 语句的列名、窗口函数、子查询及删除操作周围。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 SQL/数据库代码

patterns.name: 天体物理缩写与单位
patterns.context: 暗物质密度数值及相关粒子讨论，伴随引用标记和物理单位。

patterns.name: 集合与拓扑定义术语
patterns.context: 陈述集合属于某个集合族、并集与交集封闭性等性质。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 数学哲学/拓扑定义文本

patterns.name: 网络幂律及实例
patterns.context: 介绍现实网络中的幂律分布，并列举技术、生物或社会网络实例。

en.description: Activations occur in mathematical formulas and code, technical descriptions of functions and performance, life-science research, and a wage-withholding patent. There is no single obvious lexical theme; responses may be associated with structured technical text and its specialized terminology.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical derivations, formulas, or mathematical expressions in code; also includes explanatory text adjacent to formulas.
patterns.domain: StackExchange, ArXiv mathematics content, and code

patterns.name: Function or performance descriptions in technical explanations
patterns.context: Describes the purpose, performance, design requirements, or functions of technical systems.
patterns.domain: Patent background, software functional requirements, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Life-science research terminology
patterns.context: Discusses radiation experiments and the relationship between chromosomal changes and cell death, mutation, or cancer.

patterns.name: Wage withholding and noncustodial parents
patterns.context: Describes wage assignment and automatic withholding processes for noncustodial parents.
patterns.domain: Legal or administrative system patent background

patterns.name: Code testing and string processing
patterns.context: Tests variable definitions and processes whitespace using regular expressions.

7_2896.description: 激活分布于数学公式与代码、技术功能性能说明、生命科学研究和工资扣缴专利等语境；没有单一明显的词汇主题，可能较多响应结构化技术文本及其专门术语。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式
patterns.context: 数学推导、公式或代码中的数学表达式；也包括紧邻公式的说明文字。

patterns.name: 技术说明中的功能或性能描述
patterns.trigger: “purposes of tension control”、“storage density”、“performance”、“power consumption”、“tool to work with data”
patterns.context: 描述技术系统的用途、性能、设计要求或功能。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、软件功能需求及技术问答

patterns.name: 生命科学研究术语
patterns.context: 讨论辐射实验及染色体变化与细胞死亡、突变或癌症的关联。

patterns.name: 工资扣缴与非监护家长
patterns.context: 说明非监护家长工资划拨及自动扣缴流程。
patterns.domain: 法律或行政系统专利背景

patterns.name: 代码测试与字符串处理
patterns.context: 测试变量定义，并通过正则表达式处理空白字符。

en.concept: Preference for life forms, plus isolated word forms
en.description: The strongest activations often fall on forms of life, spanning varied life-related meanings and disciplines. There are also isolated strong activations on well, bulk, rich, and absorption, with no common semantics or contextual pattern to explain them.

patterns.name: Forms of life
patterns.context: Activates on the English word life itself; meanings and collocations vary widely, including quality of life, life, cells, planetary habitability, immune memory, life course, and life on Earth.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: medicine, cell biology, astrophysics, immunology, public health, and general-interest articles

patterns.name: well-hyphenated word form
patterns.context: Activation falls on well in well-parenthesed, in a description of a mathematical combinatorial object; it may also relate to other occurrences of well, but only this instance is explicitly observed.

patterns.name: Form of bulk
patterns.context: Occurs in condensed matter physics terms such as bulk boundary conditions and bulk normal phase.

patterns.name: Form of rich
patterns.context: Modifies characteristics, describing the degree-distribution properties of a network model.

patterns.name: Form of absorption
patterns.context: Lists optical phenomena affecting the perceived color of dental restorations, alongside reflection and scattering.
patterns.domain: Dental materials and optics papers (PubMed Central)

7_2896.concept: life 词形偏好，另有孤立词形
7_2896.description: 最强激活多落在 life 的词形上，覆盖多种生命相关语义与学科；另有 well、bulk、rich、absorption 等孤立强激活，尚无共同语义或上下文规律可解释。

patterns.name: life 词形
patterns.context: 在英文单词 life 本身处激活；语义和搭配差异很大，包括生活质量、生命、细胞、行星宜居性、免疫记忆、生命历程及地球生命。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；医学、细胞生物学、天体物理、免疫学、公共卫生及通俗文章

patterns.name: well-连字符词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 well-parenthesed 的 well 上，处于数学组合对象的描述中；与 well 的其他出现也可能有关，但目前只明确见此例。

patterns.name: bulk 词形
patterns.context: 出现在 bulk boundary conditions 和 bulk normal phase 等凝聚态物理术语中。

patterns.name: rich 词形
patterns.context: 修饰 characteristics，描述网络模型的度分布特征。

patterns.name: absorption 词形
patterns.context: 列举影响牙齿修复体感知颜色的光学现象，与反射、散射等并列。
patterns.domain: 牙科材料与光学论文（PubMed Central）

en.description: Activations span multiple text types: variables and property assignments in code, and trajectories, closed-form solutions, compactness, group theory, and set-intersection systems in mathematics. There is also a motivational vision passage. No single clear semantic trigger covers all content.

patterns.name: Distance, state, or variable assignment in programs
patterns.context: Code contains variable declarations, property assignments, or object/set initialization; trigger positions are often near assignment symbols, while specific variable names vary
patterns.domain: JavaScript, Scala, C#, and other programming code; covers segments 1, 4, 5, and 10

patterns.name: Trajectories and boundary behavior
patterns.context: Discusses continuity or limiting behavior of trajectories at the boundary of a state domain
patterns.domain: Mathematical physics or dynamical systems papers

patterns.name: Equations without closed-form solutions
patterns.context: Compares solution methods for algebraic and transcendental equations and notes the absence of a closed-form solution

patterns.name: Topological spaces and compactness
patterns.context: States definitions or properties using terms such as open sets, compactness, and finite subcovers

patterns.name: Motivational expression about vision and personal potential
patterns.context: Uses encouraging language to describe a shared vision, human potential, and the time to act

patterns.name: Solvable subgroups in group theory
patterns.context: States the algebraic property that a group has a solvable subgroup of finite index

patterns.name: Set-intersection systems and cardinality bounds
patterns.context: Gives a definition of an intersecting family on finite sets or a bound on its maximum size

7_2896.description: 激活跨越多类文本：代码中的变量与属性赋值，以及数学中的轨迹、闭式解、紧致性、群论和集合交系；另有一段励志愿景文字。没有覆盖所有内容的单一清晰语义触发点。

patterns.name: 程序中的距离、状态或变量赋值
patterns.context: 代码中出现变量声明、属性赋值、对象或集合初始化；触发位置常在赋值符号附近，具体变量名并不一致
patterns.domain: JavaScript、Scala、C# 等编程代码；覆盖段 1、4、5、10

patterns.name: 轨迹及其边界行为
patterns.trigger: “no trajectory can enter or leave”、“there must be trajectories that approach indefinitely”、“boundary solutions”
patterns.context: 讨论状态域边界上轨迹的连续性或趋近行为
patterns.domain: 数学物理或动力系统论文

patterns.name: 方程无闭式解
patterns.context: 比较代数方程与超越方程的求解方式，并指出无闭式解

patterns.name: 拓扑空间与紧致性
patterns.context: 以开集、紧致性及有限子覆盖等术语陈述定义或性质

patterns.name: 愿景与个人潜能的励志表达
patterns.trigger: “Our vision is to create a world”、“highest potential”、“the very best in themselves”
patterns.context: 以鼓舞性语言描述集体愿景、人类潜能及行动时机

patterns.name: 群论中的可解子群
patterns.context: 说明群具有有限指数的可解子群这一代数性质

patterns.name: 集合交系与基数界
patterns.context: 给出有限集合上的相交族定义或最大规模界

en.concept: Common local English collocations and heterogeneous text features
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: the clearest recurring cue is well (know, studied, over, well-defined), alongside ordinary English function words. Other activations occur in code constructs, mathematical symbols, historical narratives, vision quotations, and scientific terminology, making them difficult to group under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Local collocations of well
patterns.context: In English text, well acts as a degree adverb modifying know/studied/over, or combines with the hyphenated word defined to form well-defined; trigger positions are usually within phrases.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion, grant abstracts, math Q&A

patterns.name: English grammatical contexts following well
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across ordinary English phrases, often after auxiliaries, copulas, or clause linkers; however, these words are merely ordinary context in several passages, with no consistent specific syntactic structure observed.

patterns.name: Object construction in code
patterns.context: JavaScript code constructs a prototype using Object.create, within a subclass prototype assignment statement.

patterns.name: Specific symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Symbols occur in formulas, variable operations, or function definitions; only individual symbols are marked, with no stable common mathematical meaning apparent.

patterns.name: Dates and historical event narratives
patterns.context: News reports or historical events are linked by years and event order.

patterns.name: Motivational vision language
patterns.context: A quotation forms an inspiring declaration using vision, potential, and a call to action.

patterns.name: Chemical process terminology
patterns.context: Explains how colloidal particles in water are neutralized and kept dispersed, followed by a figure reference.

patterns.name: Oxidative damage repair description
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of oxidative damage to HSA and oxidized molecules repaired by quercetin.

patterns.name: Wave functions and half-shell terminology
patterns.context: Discusses potential functions and wave-function properties at support points in the EST scheme.

patterns.name: Answer markers in math problems
patterns.context: Develops an argument about functions over an algebra or ring through setup, definitions, and comments.

patterns.name: Anomalous or hard-to-classify fragments
patterns.context: These activations fall on terms or ordinary prose in their respective passages; the samples alone do not establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Philosophy, medical abstracts, and grant texts

7_2896.concept: 英语常见局部搭配与异质文本特征
7_2896.description: 激活模式分散：最明显的重复线索是 well（know、studied、over、well-defined），另有普通英语功能词；其余分别落在代码构造、数学符号、历史叙述、愿景引文及科学术语中，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: well 的局部搭配
patterns.context: 在英语文本中，well 作程度副词，修饰 know/studied/over，或与连字符词 defined 构成 well-defined；触发位置多在短语内部。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、资助摘要、数学问答

patterns.name: well 后接词的英语语法上下文
patterns.context: 激活散布于普通英语短语中，常处于助动词、系动词或从句连接词之后；但这些词在多段中只是普通上下文，未见一致的特定句法结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文与技术文本

patterns.name: 代码中的对象构造
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中通过 Object.create 构造原型，并处于子类原型赋值语句内。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的特定符号
patterns.context: 符号出现在公式、变量运算或函数定义中；仅个别符号被标记，未显示稳定的共同数学语义。
patterns.domain: 数学解答与形式化论文

patterns.name: 日期与历史事件叙述
patterns.context: 以年份和事件顺序串联新闻报道或历史事件。
patterns.domain: 百科全书传记/历史叙述

patterns.name: 励志愿景措辞
patterns.context: 引用中以愿景、潜能和行动号召构成鼓舞性宣言。

patterns.name: 化学过程术语
patterns.context: 解释水中胶体颗粒如何被中和并保持分散，后接图示引用。

patterns.name: 氧化损伤修复表述
patterns.context: 报告槲皮素对 HSA 氧化损伤及氧化分子的修复比例。

patterns.name: 波函数与半壳术语
patterns.context: 在 EST 方案的支持点处讨论势函数及波函数性质。

patterns.name: 数学题中的答案标记
patterns.context: 以设定、定义和注释推进代数或环上的函数论证。

patterns.name: 异常或难以归类的碎片
patterns.context: 这些激活落在各自段落的术语或普通叙述中，无法仅凭样本确定共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: 哲学、医学摘要与资助文本

en.description: Activations occur across varied texts, often on copulas, auxiliaries, and assignment code. Other activations involve relations of maintaining/adopting/possessing, expressions of necessity, variable positions, academic structural descriptions, and a few isolated word fragments. There is no stable unified theme across these contexts.

patterns.name: Copulas and following structures
patterns.context: In code, quotations, technical explanations, and prose, copulas or auxiliaries occur in subject-predicate structures, definitions, state descriptions, or existential sentences; they often connect to a complement or action.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: code, popular science, religion, social science, and academic text

patterns.name: Assignment and variables in programming
patterns.context: JavaScript code declares variables, assigns values, or retrieves object properties; whitespace indentation also shows weak activation.

patterns.name: Relations of keeping, maintaining, or bearing
patterns.context: Semantically describes something maintaining a state, adopting a form, granting an expression, or possessing a qualification; trigger words are scattered across different syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Scientific explanations, network models, quotations, and religious texts

patterns.name: Expressions of time or necessity
patterns.context: Uses has/have constructions to express completion or necessity, indicating that the time has come or something must be addressed.

patterns.name: Equation, distance, and position calculations
patterns.context: Code assigns numeric values or query results to variables, especially geographic distances and web element positions.

patterns.name: Symmetry or structural relations in physics and mathematics
patterns.context: Academic papers describe band symmetry, network construction, or their forms; the highly activated words are not a single unified set of terms.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics and network theory papers

patterns.name: Possessive own / inherent property
patterns.context: A historical town is described as having its own order, with own adjacent to the property it refers to.

patterns.name: Ticket or admission eligibility expression
patterns.context: Religious polemic uses “a ticket into heaven” as a metaphor to describe the state of believing oneself to be saved.

patterns.name: Within-word substrings and technical terms
patterns.context: A few high activations fall on word fragments spanning tokens or on specific terms; this does not support inferring a unified semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Colloid chemistry, physics, and urban theory

7_2896.description: 激活分布于多种文本，常见于系词、助动词及赋值代码；另对维持/采取/拥有关系、必要性表达、变量位置、学术结构描述和少数孤立词片段有激活。各处缺少稳定统一的主题。

patterns.name: 系词及其后续结构
patterns.context: 在代码、引文、技术说明和散文中，系词或助动词出现在主谓结构、定义、状态描述或存在句里；常与后续补语或动作相连。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：代码、科普、宗教、社会与学术文本

patterns.name: 编程中的赋值与变量
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中声明变量、赋值或取得对象属性；空格缩进也有弱激活。

patterns.name: 保持、维持或承载关系
patterns.context: 语义上描述某物维持状态、采取某种形式、赋予表达或拥有某种资格；触发词分散在不同句法环境。
patterns.domain: 科学说明、网络模型、引文及宗教文本

patterns.name: 时间或必要性表达
patterns.trigger: « has»10« come»、« has»7« to»10« be»8« done»
patterns.context: 以 has/have 构成完成或必要结构，表达时机已到或事情必须处理。

patterns.name: 方程、距离与位置计算
patterns.context: 代码里将数值或查询结果赋给变量，尤其是地理距离及网页元素位置。

patterns.name: 物理与数学中的对称性或结构关系
patterns.context: 学术论文中描述能带对称性、网络构造或其形式；高激活词并非统一术语。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理与网络理论论文

patterns.name: own 所有格／自身属性
patterns.context: 历史城镇被描述为具有自身的秩序，own 与其所指属性紧邻。

patterns.name: 票券或入场资格表达
patterns.context: 宗教论辩中用“有进入天堂的票”作比喻，描述自认已获救的状态。

patterns.name: 词内子串与技术术语
patterns.context: 少数高激活落在跨 token 词语片段或特定术语中；不能据此归纳成统一语义模式。
patterns.domain: 胶体化学、物理与城市理论

en.description: Activations are distributed across English auxiliary verbs and sporadic words, JavaScript DOM APIs and assignment syntax, as well as mathematical symbols, photonics abbreviations, and place-name subwords; there is no single stable semantic or lexical pattern.

patterns.name: has come / has to
patterns.context: In English, auxiliary has/have is followed by a participle, noun phrase, or infinitive, often in sentences expressing change, necessity, or possession; activation occurs on the auxiliary and nearby words.
patterns.domain: English prose, philosophical argument, public issues, and persuasive writing

patterns.name: JavaScript DOM method name
patterns.context: JavaScript code contains document.getElementsByTagName; activation is concentrated on the DOM API method name, split across multiple tokens, and nearby code.

patterns.name: JavaScript assignment operator
patterns.context: In a variable declaration, the identifier is is immediately followed by the assignment symbol =; this occurs in only one sample.

patterns.name: Z in mathematical text
patterns.context: A symbol for the set of integers in a mathematical paper’s LaTeX formula, near mathematical discussion of amenability, limit points, and related topics.

patterns.name: TR symmetry in topological photonics
patterns.context: TR appears in a photonics paper describing symmetries of a crystal system; activation is strongly concentrated on this abbreviation.

patterns.name: Place name Suffolk
patterns.context: An English geographical entry describes the Suffolk region and village boundaries; activation falls on subword fragments of the place name.

patterns.name: Sporadic English content words
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different English sentence and semantic context and cannot be explained by a shared local trigger.
patterns.domain: Inspirational writing, philosophical argument, literary prose

7_2896.description: 激活分散于英语助动词与零散词、JavaScript DOM API/赋值语法，以及数学符号、光子学缩写和地名子词；没有单一稳定的语义或词法模式。

patterns.name: has come / has to
patterns.trigger: “has”10 in “The time has come” [1]；“has”10 in “something has changed” [2]；“has”9、“to”10 in “Something has to be done” [3]；“have”10 in “We all have our share” [5]
patterns.context: 英语中助动词 has/have 后接分词、名词短语或不定式，常处于表达变化、必要性、拥有的句子中；激活落在助动词及其附近词上。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、哲学论述、公共议题及劝说文字

patterns.name: JavaScript DOM 方法名
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中出现 document.getElementsByTagName，激活集中在被拆分成多个 token 的 DOM API 方法名及其邻近代码。

patterns.name: JavaScript 赋值运算符
patterns.context: 变量声明中标识符 is 后紧接赋值符号 =；样本仅此一例。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 Z
patterns.context: 数学论文 LaTeX 公式中表示整数集合的符号，附近为 amenability、limit points 等数学论述。

patterns.name: 拓扑光子学 TR 对称性
patterns.context: 光子学论文描述晶体系统的对称性时出现 TR，激活显著集中于该缩写。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 凝聚态/光子学论文

patterns.name: 地名 Suffolk
patterns.context: 英文地理条目介绍英格兰萨福克地区及村镇边界，激活落在地名的拆分子词上。

patterns.name: 零散英语内容词
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同英语句子与语义环境中，无法由共同的局部触发条件解释。
patterns.domain: 励志文字、哲学论述、文学散文

en.concept: Local word forms and syntactic fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across English possessives and be constructions, the penetr- root, and code, mathematical physics terminology, and occasional fixed expressions. No single cross-domain semantic theme is apparent; the pattern more likely reflects a mixture of local word-form and grammatical triggers.

patterns.name: our / their possessive constructions
patterns.context: In English narration or argument, a possessive determiner is followed by a noun, especially in “our share” and “their own order”; have may also occur.

patterns.name: Syntactic constructions with be and following constituents
patterns.context: Activation falls on the verb be and nearby constituents in copular, passive, or modal/obligation constructions; the specific collocations vary.
patterns.domain: General English prose, argument, and online text

patterns.name: penetrate / penetrable word forms
patterns.context: The same root appears in “impenetrable silence” and in a description of a town being penetrated by a new process; the first passage has the tokenized form impenetrable, the second penetrated.
patterns.domain: Literary prose, urban and social theory

patterns.name: JavaScript properties and DOM method chains
patterns.context: Code calls a DOM query method via document, with assignment and chained property/method access.

patterns.name: JavaScript require import
patterns.context: After a strict-mode declaration, var is assigned a call to require to import a module.

patterns.name: Simplify instruction in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: An instruction to simplify follows a complex power and rational-exponent expression; activation also falls on formula symbols.

patterns.name: Discrete spectrum statement in spectral theory
patterns.context: After defining an unbounded positive self-adjoint operator, the text states that it has discrete spectrum.

patterns.name: Bohr radius in atomic physics
patterns.context: Discusses mechanical signals generated by the fine-structure constant or modulation of electron mass, and mentions the Bohr radius.

patterns.name: Half-line compound
patterns.context: Paired with line to describe the space on which a Dirac operator acts under a symmetry condition.

patterns.name: Emphasis on the need to act
patterns.context: When discussing nuclear-waste disposal options, has to be done expresses that action is necessary.

patterns.name: Ongoing disarray expressed by keep slipping aside
patterns.context: A first-person, social-media-style exclamation describes important matters continually being sidelined; social-emotional words such as leaders, trust, and hate also appear.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于英语所有格与be结构、penetr-词根，以及代码、数学物理术语和个别固定表达；未见单一跨领域语义主题，较像混合的局部词形与语法触发。

patterns.name: our / their 所属结构
patterns.context: 在英语叙述或论述中，所有格限定词后接名词，尤其是“our share”“their own order”；可能伴随 have。

patterns.name: be 与后续成分的句法结构
patterns.context: 激活落在 be 动词及其邻近成分，出现在系表、被动或情态/义务结构中；具体搭配并不一致。
patterns.domain: 一般英语散文、论述及网络文本

patterns.name: penetrate / penetrable 词形
patterns.context: 同一词根在“不可穿透的沉默”与“城镇被新进程渗透”中出现；首段是分词切分的 impenetrable，第二段为 penetrated。
patterns.domain: 文学散文、城市与社会理论

patterns.name: JavaScript 属性与 DOM 方法链
patterns.context: 代码中以 document 调用 DOM 查询方法，出现赋值和链式属性/方法访问。

patterns.name: JavaScript require 导入
patterns.context: 严格模式声明之后，以 var 赋值调用 require 导入模块。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 Simplify 指令
patterns.context: 复杂幂与有理指数表达式后出现要求化简的指令，激活也落在公式符号上。

patterns.name: 谱论中的离散谱表述
patterns.context: 定义无界正自伴算子后，说明其具有离散谱。
patterns.domain: 数学物理 / ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: 原子物理中的玻尔半径
patterns.context: 讨论精细结构常数或电子质量调制所产生的机械信号，并提及玻尔半径。
patterns.domain: 理论物理 / ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: half-line 复合词
patterns.context: 与 line 并列，描述对称条件下 Dirac 算子所在的空间。
patterns.domain: 数学物理 / ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: 强调必须采取行动
patterns.context: 谈论核废料处理选项时，以 has to be done 表达必须采取行动。

patterns.name: keep slipping aside 的持续失序表达
patterns.context: 第一人称社交媒体式感叹中，描述重要事务持续被搁置；同时出现 leaders、trust、hate 等社会情绪词。

en.concept: Mixed response to mathematical symbols and English function words
en.description: Strong activations mainly occur in two types of material: algebra-simplification problems with variables, exponents, and multiplication/division parentheses; and common function words in English prose. There is also local activation in a seasonal reversal metaphor and a “their own order” discussion context, but its relation to the main patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Variable markers in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in formal power-expression simplification problems, especially where variables recur with exponents, followed by “assuming … is positive” or “↵…**(…)↵Simplify”
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; exercises and symbolic algebra

patterns.name: Relational or function words in English narration
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous English prose, embedded in narrative or argumentative syntax; no clear condition involving mathematical symbols or a specific fixed phrase

patterns.name: Winter-summer seasonal reversal
patterns.context: Describes warm, bright weather and uses winter-summer reversal as a metaphor; these words cluster in this passage

patterns.name: Possessive pronoun and its referent
patterns.context: Argues that towns cannot isolate themselves from new processes and notes that these processes have an order of their own; “their own order” forms a local semantic combination
patterns.domain: PhilPapers humanities and social sciences argument

7_2896.concept: 数学符号与英文功能词的混合响应
7_2896.description: 强激活主要出现在两类材料：含变量、指数和乘除括号的代数化简题；以及英文散文中的常见功能词。另有季节互换比喻和“their own order”论述语境中的局部激活，无法确认它们与主模式同因。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的变量标记
patterns.trigger: 变量字母及其周围的算术符号，如 «o»、«h»、«n»、«p»、«y»、«u»、«a»，以及指数、乘除和括号
patterns.context: 出现在形式化幂运算化简题中，尤其变量反复出现并带指数，随后有“assuming … is positive”或“↵…**(…)↵Simplify”
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；练习题与符号代数

patterns.name: 英文叙述中的关系或功能词
patterns.context: 出现在连续的英文散文句子中，嵌在叙述或论述句法里；没有明显的数学符号或特定固定短语条件
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 文学散文、PhilPapers 论述

patterns.name: 冬夏季节反转表述
patterns.context: 描写气候温暖明亮，并用冬夏互换作比喻；这些词在此段集中出现

patterns.name: 所有格代词及其所属对象
patterns.context: 论述城镇无法隔绝新过程，并指出这些过程具有自身秩序；“their own order”构成局部语义组合

en.description: Activations are distributed across different domains and parts of speech, with no reliable unifying feature. keep (and inflected forms) appears occasionally in multiple passages, Simplify is common in math problems, and of occurs in several places, but the contexts differ substantially; it is unclear whether these are shared trigger patterns.

patterns.name: Uses of keep
patterns.context: The verb keep occurs in sentences, often taking objects or complements such as only, a nonzero mass, and our notations; there is no fixed collocation, and capitalization varies.

patterns.name: Simplify in mathematical simplification problems
patterns.context: After a complex algebraic expression and its simplified result, an imperative introduces the next problem; fractional powers, variables, and positivity assumptions recur in the passage.

patterns.name: Preposition of
patterns.context: An English preposition in varied contexts, connecting nouns or noun phrases, such as «Straits of Gibraltar» and «physics of heavy quarks»; trigger position and syntactic function are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: keep in a physics context
patterns.context: In an infinitive, keep takes «a nonzero mass», expressing the operation of retaining a nonzero mass during calculation.

patterns.name: keep in general explanatory contexts
